jobs.title: Controls Engineer
jobs.description: Mid\-Level Controls Engineer **Company:** Automated Machine Systems (AMS) **Department:** Controls Engineering **Reports To:** Controls Engineering Manager / Director of Controls **Employment Type:** Full\-Time Position Summary Automated Machine Systems (AMS) is seeking a Mid\-Level Controls Engineer to design, program, commission, and support industrial automation systems. This position is intended for an engineer who has developed a solid foundation in industrial controls and is capable of taking ownership of the controls portion of a project with limited supervision. The Controls Engineer will work closely with mechanical engineering, project management, assembly, customers, and other members of the controls team to deliver reliable and maintainable automation systems. The ideal candidate is comfortable working both independently and as part of a project team, can troubleshoot equipment methodically, and is capable of supporting equipment from initial design through programming, testing, installation, startup, and ongoing customer support. Primary ResponsibilitiesControls Design \& Development * Develop PLC programs for industrial automation and material\-handling equipment. * Develop and modify HMI applications. * Configure and integrate VFDs, servo systems, remote I/O, sensors, safety devices, and other industrial control components. * Develop machine sequences, interlocks, permissives, alarms, and fault\-recovery logic. * Assist with electrical control system design and component selection. * Review electrical drawings and provide feedback or corrections prior to panel construction and machine assembly. * Develop controls systems that are organized, maintainable, and consistent with AMS programming standards. * Participate in controls design reviews and project planning. Machine Integration \& Testing * Bring up and test controls systems during machine assembly. * Perform I/O checkout and verify proper operation of sensors, actuators, motors, safety devices, and communication networks. * Debug machine sequences and identify electrical, programming, mechanical, or application\-related problems. * Work directly with mechanical engineering and assembly personnel to resolve equipment issues. * Participate in internal machine testing and Factory Acceptance Testing (FAT). * Verify equipment performance against project requirements prior to shipment. Installation \& Commissioning * Travel to customer facilities for equipment installation, commissioning, startup, and Site Acceptance Testing (SAT). * Perform controls checkout and system validation following installation. * Integrate AMS equipment with customer equipment and third\-party systems. * Troubleshoot issues involving PLC logic, electrical systems, industrial networks, field devices, and machine operation. * Make programming changes required to achieve reliable production performance. * Work with customer operations and maintenance personnel during commissioning. * Provide operator and maintenance training when required. * Document remaining issues and work with the project team to drive them to resolution. Troubleshooting \& Customer Support * Provide remote and on\-site technical support for AMS equipment. * Diagnose machine faults using PLC programs, electrical drawings, HMI diagnostics, network tools, and field observations. * Identify root causes rather than relying solely on temporary fixes. * Clearly communicate technical issues and recommended corrective actions to customers and internal teams. * Support existing installations and assist with equipment upgrades or modifications. Project Ownership * Take responsibility for the controls portion of assigned projects. * Coordinate controls activities with project schedules and communicate potential delays or risks. * Maintain awareness of project scope and identify requests that may represent scope changes. * Communicate project status, technical concerns, and resource needs to project management and Controls leadership. * Maintain accurate programs, backups, documentation, and project files. * Support project closeout and ensure final programs and documentation accurately represent the installed system. Technical Qualifications The successful candidate should have practical experience with several of the following: * Rockwell Automation / Allen\-Bradley PLCs * Studio 5000 / Logix Designer * CompactLogix and ControlLogix platforms * FactoryTalk View or similar HMI platforms * Ethernet/IP industrial networks * Variable Frequency Drives (VFDs) * Distributed and remote I/O systems * Industrial sensors and instrumentation * Motor controls and industrial electrical systems * Machine safety circuits and safety PLCs * Safety relays, light curtains, interlocks, and E\-stops * Industrial Ethernet troubleshooting * Reading and interpreting electrical schematics * Basic understanding of applicable machine safety and electrical standards Experience with the following is beneficial but not required: * AutoCAD  L, Python, C\#, or other higher\-level programming languages * Linux\-based industrial computers * Industrial PC and edge\-computing applications * Integration with MES, databases, or cloud\-connected systems Education \& Experience * Associate's or Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Electrical Engineering Technology, Automation, Controls, Mechatronics, or a related field preferred. * Equivalent industrial controls experience will also be considered. * Typically **3–7 years of industrial controls or automation experience**. * Experience independently programming and commissioning automated equipment is strongly preferred. * OEM, machine\-building, systems\-integration, conveyor, or material\-handling experience is beneficial. Expected Level of Responsibility A Mid\-Level Controls Engineer at AMS should be capable of independently handling the majority of normal project controls responsibilities. The engineer should be able to: * Develop a PLC program from an established project design and functional requirements. * Understand and troubleshoot electrical drawings. * Perform machine I/O checkout. * Commission standard AMS equipment. * Troubleshoot controls and electrical problems without requiring step\-by\-step direction. * Communicate effectively with customers while representing AMS professionally. * Recognize when a problem requires assistance from a Senior Controls Engineer, Controls leadership, Mechanical Engineering, Software Engineering, or another discipline. * Assist less\-experienced Controls Engineers and technicians when appropriate. This position is not expected to have all of the technical knowledge of a Senior Controls Engineer. However, the individual is expected to independently solve routine controls problems, investigate unfamiliar problems, and appropriately escalate issues when necessary. Travel Requirements This position requires travel to customer facilities for equipment installation, startup, commissioning, troubleshooting, and support. Travel may include: * Multi\-day or multi\-week customer site visits * Early morning or extended\-hour startup activities when required by the project * Occasional weekend work based on customer production schedules * Air and vehicle travel throughout the United States Travel requirements will vary depending on project workload. Skills \& Attributes Successful AMS Controls Engineers demonstrate: * Strong troubleshooting and problem\-solving skills * Logical and methodical thinking * Personal ownership of assigned work * Ability to work independently * Ability to collaborate across engineering disciplines * Strong written and verbal communication * Professional interaction with customers * Ability to prioritize work in a project\-driven environment * Willingness to learn new technologies * Attention to detail * Understanding that machine reliability and maintainability are as important as making the equipment function Physical \& Work Environment This position includes work in both office and industrial environments. The employee may be required to: * Work around operating industrial machinery. * Work from a laptop while on the manufacturing floor. * Stand or walk for extended periods during equipment commissioning. * Bend, climb, or access equipment as necessary for troubleshooting. * Wear required personal protective equipment at AMS and customer facilities. * Follow AMS and customer safety procedures at all times. Success in This Role A successful Mid\-Level Controls Engineer at AMS is someone who can be assigned the controls portion of a typical AMS project and be trusted to move it forward. Success is demonstrated by delivering systems that are safe, reliable, understandable, maintainable, and ready for production while communicating issues early and working collaboratively with the rest of the project team. Pay: $33\.00 \- $37\.00 per hour Expected hours: 40\.0 – 55\.0 per week Experience: * Controls Engineering: 5 years (Required) Work Location: In person

jobs.title: Platform Security [US]
jobs.description: **Our Mission** =============== Rebuild how the world works, to make institutions work better for the people they serve. **About Brain Co.** =================== Brain Co. builds AI\-native operating systems for large, regulated institutions. Each system is built for a specific industry, powered by agents that push real workflows forward. Underneath it all is Atlas, our proprietary platform that keeps customers in control, secure by design, and never locked into one model. **Why Now** =========== Brain Co. is entering its next phase of production deployments on a national scale with an elite team built from Palantir, Google, Meta, and Nvidia, and a growing footprint across government, insurance, health, and financial services. Joining now means shaping both the company and a new category of applied AI. Every project here ships to production and is expected to create measurable customer value and impact. You'll work alongside exceptional peers on some of the hardest problems in applied AI. It’s the kind of work you'll still be proud of in ten years from now. **About the Role:** We’re looking for a Platform Security Engineer to build the guardrails that keep our AI agents safe to run on real customer data. This isn’t a policy or compliance role—it’s a builder role. You’ll design and ship the code that constrains what an agent can access, do, and expose: scoped credentials, data access boundaries, action validation, and audit trails, so product teams can put agents in front of sensitive government, healthcare, and enterprise data with confidence. You’ll work as a software engineer embedded with our product and agent\-platform teams—writing production code, not just policy—to make the secure path the only path an agent can take. **What You’ll Build \& Ship** * Design and build the guardrail services that mediate actions an AI agent takes, scoped permissions, tool\-call validation, and hard limits on what an agent can read, write, or send * Write production code for data access controls that keep customer PII and sensitive records inside approved boundaries, even when an agent is orchestrating the request * Build reusable guardrail libraries and SDKs so product engineers can drop data protection and permissioning into new agent workflows without reinventing it each time * Design detection and containment for agent\-specific failure modes, prompt injection, tool misuse, data exfiltration attempts, and build automated tests and red\-team harnesses to catch them before production * Instrument agents with tamper\-evident audit logs and decision trails so every customer\-data access is explainable after the fact * Partner with product, platform and ML engineering to review new agent capabilities before launch and flag where guardrails are missing * Own the developer experience for guardrails: clear APIs, documentation, and low\-friction integration so engineers adopt controls instead of routing around them * Help define and measure guardrail effectiveness, coverage across security workflows, false positive/negative rates, mean time to detect and contain **What We’re Looking For** **Required** * 5 to 8 years as a software engineer building and shipping production systems, with meaningful time spent on security, data protection, or trust \& safety problems * Strong general\-purpose programming skills (Python, Go, TypeScript, or similar), comfortable designing services and APIs other engineers depend on, not just writing scripts or config * Experience with or strong working knowledge of how AI agents operate in production, tool use, function calling, orchestration frameworks (LangChain, LangGraph, or similar) * Solid grasp of data protection fundamentals: PII handling, access control, encryption, and least privilege, and how they hold up once an agent is in the loop * Comfortable designing systems used by other engineers—clear interfaces, sensible defaults, predictable failure modes * Working cloud experience (AWS, GCP, or Azure) sufficient to build and deploy services securely * Comfortable across the SDLC, understands how developers work and designs guardrails that don’t create friction * Strong written English; able to write documentation and runbooks engineers actually read **Nice to Have** * Direct experience building guardrails or safety layers for LLM/agent systems—prompt injection defenses, content filtering, output validation * Background in regulated industries (healthcare, government, financial services) handling sensitive customer data * Familiarity with policy\-as\-code, secrets management, or software supply\-chain security tooling * Prior startup experience; comfort with ambiguity and working autonomously **Why This Role** You’ll have real ownership and clear scope: a defined guardrail surface across our platform, and the mandate to build. Your code will ship into production and directly shape how safely our agents operate on customer data as the platform grows. If you’re a software engineer who wants to spend more time building than advising, this is that role. To apply, send your CV and a brief note on a guardrail, safety control, or piece of security tooling you’ve built to \[hiring contact].

jobs.title: Global Director, AI, Data, & Emerging Technology Advancement
jobs.description: The **Director, AI, Data, and Emerging Technology Advancement** is a new leadership role within the Global Business Systems (herein referred to as “GBS”) team and is responsible for building BAC (Baltimore Aircoil Company, Inc.)’s strategy, architecture, governance, and capability across two connected areas: the foundational data that the business runs on, and the AI, automation, and self\-service analytics capabilities built on top of it. This person owns data strategy end to end — architecture, master data governance, tooling, and compliance — and uses that foundation to define how the business uses AI and Emerging Technology tools and self\-service analytics safely and effectively. This is a build role at the intersection of strategy and hands\-on governance; accountable for getting the underlying data foundation right, then building the strategy, governance, and training that make safe, effective self\-service AI and analytics possible on top of it. **PRINCIPAL ACCOUNTABILITIES** **Data Foundation** * **Data Strategy**: define the enterprise data strategy: what data matters most to the business, how it should be organized and governed, and how the strategy sequences over time as the company grows. * **Data Architecture**: own the enterprise data architecture: how data flows between SAP, custom applications, the MarTech stack, and analytics platforms, in partnership with Enterprise Architecture. * **Master Data Governance:** Stand up master data governance for the enterprise's critical data domains (e.g., customer, product, vendor, materials). Define parameters for ownership, stewardship, quality standards, and the processes that keep master data trustworthy as it moves through SAP and downstream systems. * **Data Quality \& Lifecycle:** drive the ongoing effort to identify and remediate legacy, unstructured, duplicate, and over\-permissioned data across the enterprise, partnering with business data owners. * **Data Tooling \& Platform**: evaluate, select, and govern the enterprise's data platform and tooling to manage data quality, cataloging, master data management, and integration. * **Data Compliance \& Privacy**: own the data governance controls that keep the enterprise compliant with data privacy and retention obligations, including cross\-border data handling where relevant to the company's global footprint; partner with legal and compliance on data policies and with security on enforcement. **AI, Automation, Emerging Technology \& Self\-Service** * **AI \& Analytics Strategy**: define the enterprise roadmap for self\-service AI and analytics, including standard toolsets and guardrails, built on top of the data foundation strategy and tools. * **AI Governance**: own the governance framework for AI use across the enterprise: acceptable use, data access boundaries, oversight of AI\-surfaced content, security, and risk review for new AI use cases. Evaluate and deploy the tools that control what AI can see and surface, including restricted content discovery, M365 archive, SharePoint advanced management, and DLP. * **Automation**: set the strategy and standards for process automation (RPA, workflow automation, low\-code tools), self\-service governance, monitoring, and maintenance. * **Self\-Service Analytics**: own the platform, standards, and support model for self\-service analytics. * **Emerging Technology:** own the evaluation and recommendation of emerging technologies to drive operational efficiency, enhance business effectiveness, and support digital transformation objectives**.** * **Enablement \& Training**: build and deploy the training and change management program for self\-service AI, automation, and analytics tools. * **Risk \& Compliance Partnership**: work with security, legal, and compliance to make sure AI, automation, and data use stay within regulatory and privacy obligations as the program scales. * **Center of Excellence**: stand up a lightweight data \& AI center of excellence with champions, standards, and a support model that scales with adoption. * **Cross\-Functional Partnership**: partner closely enterprise architecture, infrastructure, and security to allow the data, AI, and automation strategy to leverage and enhance existing platform investments. **NATURE AND SCOPE** The **Global Director,** **AI, Data, and Emerging Technology Advancement** reports to the Global Vice President, Chief Digital \& Information Officer and is a member of the IT leadership team. As part of the Global Business Systems organization, this role influences senior leaders across the enterprise and partners closely with regional business teams. The role leads a globally dispersed team of approximately 6 to 10 professionals, including internal employees and contracted resources, and is expected to expand as the organization grows. The role is accountable for the AI, Data, and Automation strategy, architecture, governance, and capability and owns the associated multi\-year roadmap, operating and capital budget, tools ecosystem, and associated vendor relationships. **WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE IN THE FIRST YEAR** * A documented enterprise data strategy and target\-state data architecture, aligned with Enterprise Architecture. * Master data governance stood up for at least one or two critical domains, with clear ownership and stewardship in place. * A published AI governance framework and acceptable use policy deployed across the enterprise. * Measurable reduction in stale, unstructured, duplicate, and over\-permissioned data reachable by AI tools like Copilot and others. * A self\-service analytics platform and support model with real adoption, reducing the backlog of ad hoc reporting requests to IT. * A training program with completion and usage metrics tracked. * Several automation use cases delivered end\-to\-end, and plan to scale further. **KNOWLEDGE \& SKILLS** * 10\+ years in data, analytics, or AI\-related roles in enterprise IT, with 4\+ years in a leadership role owning data strategy and governance, delivery and reporting. * Direct experience building enterprise data strategy and architecture — able to make and defend decisions about how data should flow, be owned, and be governed across a multi\-system landscape. * Hands\-on master data management (MDM) experience, designing governance for critical data domains (customer, product, vendor, materials, or similar) and standing up business stewardship models. * Experience with Microsoft 365 Copilot (and other popular AI tools), governance and the surrounding data governance toolset (e.g., Purview, SharePoint Advanced Management, Restricted Content Discovery, or equivalents). * Working knowledge of data privacy and compliance obligations relevant to a global manufacturer (e.g., GDPR and similar cross\-border data regimes), and how to translate them into practical governance controls. * Practical experience building a governance framework from scratch, including policy, standards, and training, in an organization without a mature data or AI governance function already in place. * Experience with self\-service BI/analytics platforms (e.g., Power BI, Tableau), data platform/MDM tooling (e.g., Purview, Informatica, SAP Master Data Governance), and process automation tools (e.g., Power Automate, UiPath). * Experience with enterprise data platforms in an SAP environment is a plus. * Manufacturing, industrial, or engineer\-to\-order environment experience is a plus. * Comfortable operating as a builder in an evolving organization; someone who scales governance and tooling appropriate to the pace of the team adoption. * A direct, clear communication style, able to explain data and AI risk and governance to executives and end users in practical terms. **WORKING CONDITIONS** The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodation may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions of the job. This position requires travel both domestically and internationally up to 30% of the time. BAC Hiring Compensation Range $154,100\- $264,000 BAC offers a comprehensive benefits package to include medical, dental, vision, paid time off, 401k, employee stock ownership plan, and more. Please see additional details on the BAC website at www.Baltimoreaircoil.com. (http://www.baltimoreaircoil.com/) BAC Employees are eligible to participate in an annual bonus incentive program. Equal Opportunity Employer This employer is required to notify all applicants of their rights pursuant to federal employment laws. For further information, please review the Know Your Rights (https://www.eeoc.gov/poster) notice from the Department of Labor.

jobs.title: MEP Project Manager
jobs.description: **Job Overview** We are seeking a dynamic and highly skilled MEP Project Manager to lead and oversee complex Mechanical, Electrical, and Plumbing (MEP) infrastructure projects from inception to completion. This role is vital in ensuring that all projects are delivered on time, within budget, and in strict compliance with safety standards and construction regulations. The ideal candidate will possess exceptional leadership abilities, extensive construction management experience, and a deep understanding of MEP systems, with a passion for driving project success through meticulous planning, coordination, and team management. **Duties** * Manage MEP/FP projects from preconstruction through completion, overseeing estimating, engineering, procurement, field operations, subcontractors, commissioning, and closeout. * Lead overall project execution to ensure projects are delivered safely, on schedule, within budget, and in accordance with contract documents, specifications, codes, and quality standards. * Develop and implement project execution plans establishing project objectives, responsibilities, milestones, procurement requirements, risk controls, and communication protocols. * Develop and maintain the master project schedule, incorporating design deliverables, procurement, equipment lead times, fabrication, subcontractor activities, installation sequencing, inspections, commissioning, and project constraints. * Monitor project progress and schedule performance, proactively identifying and mitigating risks, delays, and impacts to critical activities. * Manage procurement of major equipment, materials, and subcontracted services, including lead times, purchasing, fabrication, and delivery requirements. * Manage MEP subcontractors and trade partners, including bid reviews, scope development, contract requirements, performance, coordination, and compliance. * Develop and manage detailed scopes of work for Mechanical, Electrical, Plumbing, and Fire Protection trades, ensuring clear responsibility and minimizing scope gaps and overlaps. * Review contracts, drawings, specifications, and project requirements to identify contractual obligations, constructability concerns, design deficiencies, code issues, and potential cost or schedule impacts. * Coordinate with owners, architects, engineers, consultants, and other stakeholders to resolve technical issues and maintain alignment with project objectives. * Lead project and MEP coordination meetings, tracking decisions, action items, design issues, schedule impacts, and required follow\-up. * Manage change orders and commercial issues, including pricing, negotiation, approval, documentation, and incorporation into project budgets and schedules. * Review subcontractor invoices and payment applications and ensure timely, accurate owner billing and project cash flow. * Establish and enforce project quality and safety requirements, ensuring compliance with company policies, contract requirements, applicable codes, and industry standards. * Coordinate inspections, testing, commissioning, and closeout activities, ensuring MEP systems meet project requirements and are properly documented and turned over. * Manage project logistics, including site access, material deliveries, equipment staging, phasing, shutdowns, mock\-ups, inspections, and coordination with external agencies. * Work closely with field leadership to align project planning with field execution, installation sequencing, manpower, productivity, and site conditions. * Maintain accurate project records, including RFIs, submittals, meeting minutes, schedules, procurement logs, change orders, cost reports, correspondence, and other project documentation. * Lead project closeout by coordinating punch\-list completion, final inspections, commissioning documentation, as\-builts, O\&M manuals, warranties, and turnover requirements. and operational challenges to maintain productivity and project objectives. * Travel and overtime work will be required. **Requirements** * Associates/Bachelor degree in Mechanical Engineering, Construction Management, or equivalent or relevant experience a plus but not a requirement. * 10\-15 years of experience in Mechanical/Electrical or General contracting / construction management, experience in various aspects of construction (estimating, bidding, preparing and administering contracts, scheduling, cost control, etc.) is a plus. * Experienced in managing staff, vendors and contractors. * Proficiency with computer software including Microsoft Office, BIM, CAD, Excel, PowerPoint, etc. is required * Experience with other computer software (AutoCAD, Microsoft Projects, Prolog (or other project management software packages) P3 or P6, Timberline, etc.) is preferred but not required. * Strong verbal and written communication skills. * Must be able to read and interpret construction drawings and technical specifications. * Hands\-on experience with construction site supervision, safety standards compliance, and regulatory requirements. * Excellent leadership skills with a track record of managing teams in a fast\-paced construction environmeJoin us as an MEP Project Manager to lead innovative infrastructure projects that shape communities! Bring your expertise in project management software, technical knowledge of MEP systems, and passion for delivering high\-quality results — all while working in a collaborative environment that values your leadership and dedication. Job Type: Full\-time Pay: $62,824\.25 \- $75,659\.32 per year Benefits: * 401(k) * AD\&D insurance * Dental insurance * Employee assistance program * Flexible spending account * Health insurance * Health savings account * Life insurance * Paid time off * Vision insurance Work Location: In person

jobs.title: IT Business Systems Engineer
jobs.description: ### **MEDICAL INSURANCE 100% ON US!** Great careers start with great benefits! Join the Barrett Petfood family and enjoy a comprehensive benefits package, including medical (company paid), dental, and vision insurance; a 401(k) with company match; life insurance; health savings account; paid time off; seven paid holidays; employee discounts; complimentary pet food; and fun, company\-sponsored events. **About Barrett** This position is based in Little Falls, Minnesota, and an on\-site presence is expected due to the role's close partnership with manufacturing and operational teams and the need to support business\-critical systems used within the facility. Barrett Petfood develops super premium pet food diets from emerging brands to market leaders in the industry. Our family\-owned, nimble execution and continuous innovation takes pet food manufacturing, packaging and distribution to differentiating levels. With a relationship focus and a family feel, we offer many career opportunities throughout our process. **Purpose:** The IT Business Systems Engineer is responsible for supporting, maintaining, troubleshooting, and enhancing Barrett Petfood's core business and manufacturing systems, with a primary focus on ERP (Plex), Manufacturing Execution Systems (MES), system integrations, reporting, and related applications. This is a hands\-on technical role that combines application support, system administration, troubleshooting, testing, documentation, integration support, and continuous improvement. This role is not primarily focused on desktop support, hardware support, printers, or general help desk ticket resolution. The primary focus is business applications, ERP/MES support, integrations, reporting, documentation, and system improvement. The IT Business Systems Engineer will work closely with IT Leadership, the IT Business Systems Lead, IT Operations, business stakeholders, and external technology partners to support reliable system operation, reduce dependency on individual system knowledge, and help expand Barrett Petfood's internal technical capabilities over time. **Attributes:** * Strong technical aptitude with the ability to learn complex business systems and technologies. * Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and problem\-solving skills. * Ability to understand business processes and apply technology to solve operational problems. * Curiosity and willingness to develop deep knowledge of ERP, MES, integrations, and related manufacturing systems. * Strong communication and relationship\-building skills across technical and non\-technical teams. * Ability to work independently while collaborating closely with the IT Business Systems Lead and other internal resources. * Comfortable balancing day\-to\-day system support with technical enhancements and continuous improvement. * Strong documentation and knowledge\-sharing habits. **Responsibilities:** * Support the day\-to\-day performance, reliability, configuration, and administration of Barrett's ERP (Plex), MES, and related business systems. * Develop strong functional and technical knowledge of Barrett's core business systems and serve as an internal resource for system administration and support. * Troubleshoot application, configuration, integration, data, and user\-related issues and coordinate resolution with IT leadership, the IT Business Systems Lead, IT Operations, or external vendors as appropriate. * Support manufacturing, supply chain, finance, quality, and other business teams with system questions, issues, and process improvements. * Assist with system enhancements, upgrades, new modules, integrations, configuration changes, and process\-improvement initiatives. * Support system integrations, EDI processes, APIs, interfaces, and reliable data flow between business applications. * Assist with the development, modification, or support of smaller technical solutions, scripts, reports, interfaces, or application enhancements based on business needs and individual technical capabilities. * Test and validate system changes, vendor\-developed solutions, enhancements, integrations, and upgrades before deployment into production. * Help identify opportunities for automation, standardization, simplification, and improved user experience. * Support user administration, system configuration, access management, and other application administration activities. * Assist in developing and supporting knowledgeable business system power users across the organization. * Partner with IT Operations to help ensure the integrity, availability, security, backup, recovery, and continuity of business systems and data. * Develop and maintain technical documentation, support procedures, system configurations, integration documentation, and knowledge\-sharing practices. * Build knowledge across multiple business and manufacturing systems to help reduce organizational dependency on individual system knowledge. * Take on increasing technical responsibility and system ownership as experience, capability, and business knowledge develop. **Education and Experience:** * Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Technology, Information Systems, Engineering, or a related field preferred. Equivalent relevant education or experience will be considered. * Experience in software development, application support, systems administration, integrations, databases, APIs, scripting, or other technical disciplines preferred. * ERP, MES, manufacturing systems, or enterprise business systems experience preferred but not required. * Experience working with ERP systems in a manufacturing environment is a plus. * Plex ERP experience is a plus but not required. Candidates with strong technical aptitude and demonstrated ability to quickly learn complex systems will be considered. * Experience with Manufacturing Execution Systems (MES) is a plus. * Experience with system integrations, APIs, databases, EDI, or related technologies is preferred. * Experience supporting or troubleshooting business\-critical applications is preferred. * Recent graduates with strong technical fundamentals, demonstrated problem\-solving ability, and an interest in business and manufacturing systems are encouraged to apply. **Requirements** * Ability to sit, stand and walk for extended periods throughout the manufacturing facility. * Ability to bend, reach, climb stairs, stoop, kneel, and perform other physical activities required in a manufacturing environment. * Work in varying environmental conditions, including areas that may be hot, cold, wet, humid, noisy, or subject to temperature fluctuations. **Compensation** The anticipated base salary range for this position is **$60,000\-$85,000 annually**, depending on experience, qualifications, technical expertise, and overall fit for the role.

jobs.title: Field Service Technician
jobs.description: **About Bell and Howell** Bell and Howell delivers technology\-driven **Automation Services** and **Automation Solutions** that help businesses optimize performance, reduce downtime, and improve customer experiences. Our Automation Services bring a dedicated team of expert mechatronic service engineers completely covering North America and backed by our Integrated 360™ advanced technology enabling remote repair, diagnostics, automated SmartOps Dispatch™ and 24/7/365 technical assistance for our clients. We provide a comprehensive and certified level of support for thousands of diversified clients. Our Automated Solutions product portfolio consists of next\-generation equipment delivering best\-in\-class performance enhancing workflow efficiency and elevating customer experiences across multiple markets including retail, pharmaceuticals, packaging, mail production, ecommerce and manufacturing – all backed by the best service in the industry. **Location: Howell, MI (Locally in Michigan. Training out of State)** **Hourly Range: 23\-30/hr.** **Summary:** The Field Customer Service Engineer serves as primary customer contact on technical and service\-related problems on a wide range of industrial, robotic and printing equipment. Diagnoses electronic, mechanical, software and system failures, using established procedures provided by our highly rated service training department. This job may include any aspect of field support, including electrical/electronics, hardware, software, PC’s, and networking. Provides technical support to customers on operational or maintenance aspects of system equipment. Determines most cost\-effective repair/resolution to minimize customer downtime. **Note: This is not an IT role. The position requires hands\-on electrical and mechanical troubleshooting with experience using Digital Multi Meter (DMM) and more.** **Duties and Responsibilities:** * Primary responsibility will be to install, troubleshoot and repair a variety of industrial products that include, but are not limited to; printing and packaging equipment, cash recycling products, inserting and sorting machines, credit card attaching and processing systems, robotics and any other applicable third\-party accessories attached as part of the system. * Schedule and perform regular predictive/preventive maintenance inspections on equipment. * Provide support by managing parts inventory, customer service calls and preventative maintenance schedules. * Foster positive customer relations and a high degree of customer satisfaction by communicating effectively with customers. * Act as a liaison between the customer and other departments/functions of the company. * May need to provide an “on call” level of service up to seven (7\) day/week twenty\-four (24\) hour/day for emergency customer assistance; respond to emergency and non\-scheduled calls for service within established response time goals. **Supervisory Responsibilities:** N/A **Competencies (Skills, Knowledge and Abilities):** * Requires understanding of computer program functionality and software troubleshooting skills. * Strong interpersonal/customer relation skills. * Ability to build and maintain strong customer relationships by understanding their operations and instilling confidence with effective proactive communication. * Ability to effectively resolve conflict internally and externally. * Ability to accomplish the describe duties through appropriate hand, power, and testing tools/equipment. * Ability to reason logically and make sound decisions along with considering alternative and diverse perspectives. * Strong analytical, problem\-solving, quantitative, and time management skills. * Ability to communicate effectively both orally and in writing. * Ability to understand, remember and follow verbal and written instructions. * Ability to work as an integral part of a team. * Ability to read and understand written procedures and diagrams for assembly and test. * Ability to develop and implement solutions to assembly problem. * Ability to maintain regular attendance and be punctual. **Education and Experience:** * High School degree or equivalent with 2\-year degree or diploma in electronics/advanced mechanics/software training with 1\+ years related industry/equipment experience, or equivalent combination of education and experience. * Requires strong electronics and mechanical background, understanding of computer program functionality and software troubleshooting skills * Associate degree preferred. **Travel:** This position requires minimal travel in the United States and Canada for training and other requirements. For field only, local travel time could be greater than 50%. **Physical Requirements:** * Ability to use standard and specialized hand, power and diagnostic tools and measuring equipment, such as oscilloscopes, DMM, gauges, etc. * Requires lifting to waist seventy (70\) pounds. * Requires walking and standing; using hands to feel objects; reaching; and requires balance. * Requires bending, stooping, kneeling, crouching and/or crawling for periods of time. * Ability to work in a loud environment. * Ability to work in small, cramped areas. * Ability to work in elevated environment up to twenty (20\) feet. * Work is performed in a controlled office, retail, and manufacturing environment; noise within acceptable safety levels; paper dust prevalent; cleaners and solvents used to clean machines; machines contain moving parts. **Other Duties** Please note this job description is not designed to cover or contain a comprehensive listing of activities, duties or responsibilities that are required of the employee for this job. Duties, responsibilities, and activities may change at any time with or without notice. Bell and Howell is an Equal Opportunity Employer. jobs.title: Director, Public Sector Compliance
jobs.description: Blitzy is a Cambridge, MA based AI software development platform on a mission to revolutionize the software development life cycle by autonomously building custom software to unlock the next industrial revolution. We're transforming how enterprises build software, turning enterprise requirements into enterprise grade code with an agentic software development platform that can autonomously execute 80% of the quantum of software development work. We're backed by multiple tier 1 investors, and have proven success as founders of previous start\-ups. **Our Culture** --------------- **Who we are:** Led by two pioneering co\-founders we are one of the fastest growing companies in the U.S., creating our own category of enterprise autonomous software development. We automate thousands of hours of software development for our customers, which includes strong representation within the Fortune 500\. **How we work:** * **We move Blitzy Fast:** Time is both our company’s and our clients’ most precious asset. We move quickly and decisively to innovate internally and deliver exceptional software externally. * **Championship Mindset:** We operate like a professional sports team. We win as a team by holding ourselves and each other to high standards, collaborating in\-person, and remaining focused on the mission. * **Passion for Invention:** We’re pushing the frontier of what’s possible, requiring constant innovation and iteration. * **We Work for the Customer:** We focus on delivering outsized value to the customers we work with and expanding those relationships into deep, meaningful partnerships. **About the Role** ------------------ Compliance is the single biggest blocker between Blitzy and the public sector market \- and, handled correctly, one of our biggest product opportunities. Federal agencies, the defense industrial base, and the integrators who serve them want what our enterprise customers already have: an agentic platform that turns requirements into production\-ready code. Getting there is an accreditation problem, and we’re hiring the leader who will own it. The near\-term mandate is clear. Drive Blitzy from FedRAMP Moderate to FedRAMP High as quickly as we can defensibly get there, because High is the baseline for DoD SRG IL2, IL4, and IL5\. National security mission and business systems at the unclassified level — Advana among them — require IL5, and we intend to operate there. The longer\-term mandate is more interesting. Static authorization packages and POA\&M bookkeeping are giving way to proactive, continuous security. You’ll build our posture that way from the start, and then help productize the internal primitives you create as part of the broader Blitzy Proactive Insights portfolio, aligned to the cyber security needs of the DIB. This is a compliance title attached to a revenue mandate. Every control you land unblocks, closes, or expands a deal. You’ll work in person in Cambridge, MA with direct access to the founders and the engineers building the platform. **Responsibilities** -------------------- * Own the roadmap and execution from FedRAMP Moderate to High, then to DoD SRG IL4/IL5 — boundary definition, control implementation strategy, SSP quality, and the assessment calendar. * Partner with GTM on every public sector opportunity: security reviews, agency and prime questionnaires, ATO strategy, and the compliance narrative that turns a blocked deal into a landed and expanded one. * Replace point\-in\-time compliance with automated evidence, control monitoring, and drift detection so authorization is a byproduct of how we operate, not a project we run. * Identify which internal compliance and security primitives have external value, and work with product and engineering to bring them to market for the defense industrial base. * Manage 3PAO, sponsoring agency, FedRAMP PMO, and DISA engagement — and represent Blitzy credibly with government security stakeholders. * Own the unglamorous foundations — configuration baselines, vulnerability management, access control, incident response, supply chain — and make build\-versus\-buy calls that keep cost and dependency in check. * Give engineering clear, automatable requirements instead of compliance homework, and give GTM answers they can use on their own. **Qualifications** ------------------ * 8\+ years in security, compliance, or GRC leadership, including ownership of a federal authorization program end to end. * Hands\-on experience taking a cloud system through FedRAMP authorization, and direct familiarity with what FedRAMP High and DoD SRG IL4/IL5 actually require beyond Moderate. * Deep working fluency in NIST 800\-53, the FedRAMP baselines, the DoD Cloud Computing SRG, and adjacent regimes such as CMMC. * Track record of managing 3PAOs, sponsoring agencies, and government security reviewers — and of getting decisions out of them. * Demonstrated impact on revenue: you’ve personally unblocked, accelerated, or expanded deals where security and compliance were the obstacle. * Technical depth sufficient to earn engineering’s respect — cloud architecture, infrastructure as code, CI/CD, and evidence automation are conversations you can hold your own in. * Excellent written communication. Control narratives, agency responses, and customer\-facing security documentation are all writing problems. * Existing relationships and credibility across the defense industrial base, primes, or DoD program offices. ***Salary Range: $215,000\-$230,000 Bonus \+ Equity*** *Blitzy is an equal opportunity employer committed to building a diverse and inclusive team. We believe different perspectives make us stronger. Base salary ranges are determined by country, role, level, experience, and skills. The range displayed on each job posting reflects Blitzy’s good faith determination of the minimum and maximum targets for new hire salaries across all ocations. Individual pay is determined by related factors, including job skills, experience, and relevant education or training, which may impact a final offer. Your Talent Partner can share more about the specific salary range during the hiring process.*

jobs.description: **Location:** Remote or hybrid, based in Northern Nevada, USA. Preferably Elko, Reno, Winnemucca or Lovelock **Department:** Project Management Office **Reports To:** Springer Project Director **Employment Type:** Full\-Time The Project Engineer will provide engineering, project development, cost estimating, and technical coordination support for mining projects and associated infrastructure. The role will focus on developing and evaluating infrastructure projects, preparing capital and operating cost estimates, supporting project studies and budgets, and coordinating engineering activities from conceptual design through construction and commissioning. Working closely with project management, engineering consultants, mine operations, procurement, finance, and contractors, the Project Engineer will help ensure projects are technically sound, cost\-effective, constructible, and aligned with company objectives. **Key Responsibilities** * Support the development and execution of mining infrastructure projects, including **roads, site facilities, water systems, power, utilities, camps, warehouses, workshops, tailings and waste facilities, and processing\-related infrastructure**. * Develop scopes of work, engineering requirements, design criteria, technical specifications, and project execution plans. * Coordinate engineering activities with internal teams, consultants, EPC/EPCM contractors, and construction contractors. * Prepare and maintain **capital cost estimates, operating cost estimates, project budgets, and cost forecasts**. * Develop and maintain cost estimating models and databases using current market pricing, historical project data, vendor quotations, and contractor estimates. * Support preparation of **Class 5 through Class 1 estimates** as appropriate to the project stage. * Review engineering designs, drawings, specifications, quantity take\-offs, and contractor proposals for completeness, accuracy, and cost effectiveness. * Develop quantity take\-offs and equipment/material requirements for infrastructure projects. * Obtain and evaluate vendor and contractor quotations and assist with bid evaluations and procurement activities. * Track project costs, commitments, forecasts, change orders, and contingencies in coordination with Project Controls and Finance. * Identify cost risks, opportunities, and potential value\-engineering initiatives. * Support project scheduling, progress measurement, risk management, and change management. * Participate in technical and commercial evaluations of alternative project designs and execution strategies. * Assist with feasibility studies, permitting support, project development studies, and board/investment committee presentations. * Support field investigations, site assessments, construction planning, and contractor coordination. * Conduct site visits to verify existing conditions, monitor engineering progress, and support construction activities as required. * Assist with project procurement, contracting, expediting, and equipment/material selection. * Ensure engineering and project activities comply with applicable **federal, state, and local regulations, permits, industry standards, and company requirements**. * Promote safe, practical, and cost\-effective engineering solutions throughout the project lifecycle. * Support commissioning, start\-up, and project close\-out activities. **Costing \& Project Controls Focus** The Project Engineer will have a strong emphasis on project economics and will: * Develop detailed **CAPEX and OPEX estimates** for infrastructure projects. * Prepare quantity and material take\-offs and validate contractor estimates. * Maintain estimating assumptions, exclusions, allowances, escalation, and contingency. * Analyze cost variances against approved budgets and forecasts. * Support development of project cost curves and cash\-flow forecasts. * Review change orders and assess their technical and financial impacts. * Identify opportunities to reduce capital costs while maintaining safety, reliability, and operability. * Provide cost inputs for **PEA, PFS, FS, permitting, financing, and construction decisions**. * Assist in evaluating **owner\-build versus contractor/EPC/EPCM execution strategies**. * Develop cost benchmarks and maintain historical project cost information for future estimates. **Qualifications** * Bachelor's degree in **Civil, Mechanical, Mining, Electrical, Construction Engineering**, or a related engineering discipline is required. * **Minimum 5 years of relevant engineering/project experience**, preferably within mining, heavy industrial, infrastructure, energy, or construction projects. * Experience developing capital cost estimates and project budgets. * Strong understanding of engineering drawings, specifications, quantity take\-offs, and construction methodologies. * Experience working with engineering consultants, contractors, and vendors. * Strong Excel skills and familiarity with estimating, project controls, scheduling, or cost management software. * Ability to interpret technical documentation and translate engineering requirements into scopes, quantities, and costs. * Willingness to travel periodically to mine sites and project locations. **Preferred Qualifications** * Professional Engineer (**P.E.**) license or progress toward licensure. * Experience with **mine infrastructure or mineral processing projects**. * Experience supporting projects through feasibility, permitting, detailed engineering, procurement, and construction. * Experience with **EPCM/EPC contracting models**. * Familiarity with mining project development and **NI 43\-101 / S\-K 1300** technical study environments. * Experience with Primavera P6, MS Project, or similar scheduling software. * Experience with cost management systems such as **Pronto, SAP, CostOS, HCSS, or similar platforms**. * Experience with AutoCAD, Civil 3D, or other engineering/design software. **Working Environment** This position will be based primarily in a corporate or project office environment, with regular travel to mine sites, construction sites, engineering consultants, vendors, and other project locations. The role may require extended periods in the field during major project development, construction, commissioning, or start\-up activities. **This is an excellent opportunity for an engineer who wants broad exposure to mine development and the opportunity to play a key role in developing infrastructure, controlling project costs, and advancing projects from concept through construction and operations.** We are committed to diversity and inclusivity in our hiring practices and encourage applications from all qualified individuals. This job posting is for an existing vacancy. Blue Moon Metals Inc. and its business entities do not currently utilize AI to screen, assess or select applicants.

jobs.title: Lead AI Solutions Engineer
jobs.description: **About Bluevine** Bluevine is the largest small business banking platform in the U.S., redefining how entrepreneurs manage their money. We create modern financial solutions, from checking and lending to payments and beyond, designed to help small business owners grow, thrive, and take control of their financial future. Our best\-in\-class technology, advanced security, and deep understanding of the small business community give our customers the confidence to focus on what they do best. Since 2013, we've supported more than 750,000 small businesses nationwide. Backed by leading investors like Lightspeed Venture Partners, Menlo Ventures, 83North, and Citi Ventures, our 500\+ person global team shares one mission: to give small businesses the financial tools they need to succeed. We're innovators driven by big ideas, collaboration, and real impact. Here, you'll have the freedom to take ownership, grow your career, and make a difference for small business owners across America. Ready to shape what's next? We're looking for a hands\-on AI builder to help Bluevine reinvent how work gets done across the company. In this role, reporting directly to R\&D leadership, you'll identify high\-friction, repetitive processes across the business and turn them into practical AI\-powered tools, automations, and workflows that drive real impact at scale.This highly technical, cross\-functional position is dedicated to enhancing the efficiency and productivity of non\-technical departments through practical automation and applied AI. You will collaborate with a wide range of stakeholders—across go\-to\-market, operations, and corporate functions—to identify opportunities, define necessary solutions, and construct effective tools. You will leverage a combination of software engineering expertise, strong product intuition, and a service\-oriented approach to develop and deliver practical solutions. These solutions will include AI workflows, internal agents, automation pipelines, Chrome extensions, scripts, and lightweight applications. A core part of your responsibility will be ensuring all development adheres to robust R\&D and SDLC practices, resulting in solutions that are scalable, maintainable, and manageable over the long term. **WHAT YOU'LL DO:** ------------------- * Partner with business stakeholders across the organization to identify repetitive, tedious, and high\-friction workflows that can be improved using AI and automation. * Design and build AI\-powered workflows, agents, automations, browser\-based tools, integrations, and lightweight applications. * Translate business problems into technical solutions, define implementation plans and success metrics, and choose the right tools and patterns for each use case. * Apply software engineering and SDLC best practices to deliver reliable, secure, scalable, and maintainable solutions. * Evaluate and select the right tools and patterns for each use case, including LLM workflows, agents, prompt\-based solutions, APIs, and scripting. * Create reusable components, documentation, and standards, and measure impact through efficiency gains, adoption, and business outcomes. * Measure solution impact through efficiency gains, time savings, adoption, quality improvements, and business outcomes. **WHAT WE LOOK FOR:** --------------------- * 5\+ years of experience in software engineering, automation engineering, solutions engineering, or a similar hands\-on technical role. * Strong coding and scripting skills, ideally in Python and/or JavaScript/TypeScript, with experience building automations, integrations, workflow systems, or AI\-powered solutions. * Experience with AI tools and platforms such as OpenAI, Gemini, Copilot, AI agents, LLM workflows, prompt engineering, retrieval workflows, and related evaluation methods. * Experience working directly with non\-technical stakeholders and moving from ambiguous business needs to well\-scoped, well\-executed solutions. * Strong understanding of software engineering fundamentals, APIs, browser automation, workflow tooling, low\-code/no\-code tools, and sound judgment on when to use each. * Strong communication skills, high ownership, service orientation, and an entrepreneurial mindset. * Familiarity with prompt engineering, retrieval workflows, and evaluation of LLM\-based systems. * Experience with APIs, browser automation, workflow tooling, and systems integration. **NICE TO HAVE:** * Experience building Chrome extensions or browser\-based automation tools. * Experience supporting GTM, operations, support, finance, or other business functions through technical solutions. * Experience working in regulated environments or in organizations where reliability, maintainability, and governance matter. * BSc/BA in Computer Science or related field or equivalent practical experience. **Benefits \& Perks** *(US Based ONLY)* * Excellent health coverage and life insurance benefits * 401K with an immediate 3% company match * PTO, Company Holidays, and Flexible Holidays * Company\-sponsored Mental Health Benefits, including 1:1 therapy * Over $1,000 each year to spend on your personal wellness * Monthly WFH stipends totaling over $1,000 annually * Generous, paid parental leave covering up to 20 weeks of leave for birthing parents and up to 12 weeks of leave for all other parents * Access to financial coaches and education sessions * Weekly catered lunches and fully stocked kitchen pantries * Community\-based volunteering opportunities \#LI\-Hybrid

jobs.title: Solutions Engineer, Data Analytics
jobs.description: As an employee of Boehringer Ingelheim, you will actively contribute to the discovery, development, and delivery of our products to our patients and customers. Our global presence provides an opportunity for all employees to collaborate internationally, offering visibility and the opportunity to directly contribute to the company's success. We realize that our strength and competitive advantage lie with our people. We support our employees in several ways to foster a healthy working environment, meaningful work, mobility, networking, and work\-life balance. Our competitive compensation and benefit programs reflect Boehringer Ingelheim's high regard for our employees. The Solutions Engineer, Data Analytics is responsible for designing, developing, and operationalization of AI/ML solutions that enable advanced data\-driven decision\-making across the organization. This role combines strong Python and C\#/.NET software engineering with data pipeline development to integrate AI capabilities into enterprise systems, manufacturing data platforms, and analytics environments. The position will be responsible for delivering and supporting AI\-enabled solutions that integrate with enterprise data platforms and manufacturing systems. The role operates with a moderate degree of autonomy and collaborates closely with Data Engineering, Solutions Engineering, and business stakeholders to ensure scalable, reliable, and production\-ready implementations. The Solutions Engineer, Data Analytics will be expected to support both development and ongoing optimization of AI services and data pipelines that enable advanced analytics and operational insights. This role will establish proficiency in Data Warehousing \& technical program data management that enable advanced analytics. As directed, the incumbent contributes to global efforts by supporting, developing, and maintaining tools, software, and AI solutions key to enabling statistical modeling, visualization, reporting, and interpretation of results. **Duties \& Responsibilities** ------------------------------ * Design, develop, and implement AI/ML and LLM\-based solutions to support business and operational use cases. * Develop, maintain, and optimize C\#/.NET services, APIs, and application components that operationalize AI capabilities. * Build, administer, and enhance data pipelines to support model training, feature engineering, and real\-time or batch inference workloads. * Integrate AI solutions with SQL Server, enterprise data warehouses, and industrial data platforms (e.g., AVEVA PI, ISA\-88 event frameworks). * Administer, monitor, and optimize performance of deployed AI models and supporting services to ensure reliability and scalability. * Collaborate with cross\-functional teams to ensure proper data availability, quality, and alignment with business requirements. * Develop and deploy AI/ML and LLM\-based solutions. * Build and maintain robust data pipelines for AI use cases. * Develop C\#/.NET services, APIs, and integrations for AI solutions. * Integrate AI with SQL Server, data warehouses, and industrial systems (e.g., PI). * Ensure data governance, security, and compliance. **Requirements** ---------------- * Bachelor's degree in computer science, data analytics or related field required with a minimum of one (1\) year relevant industry experience in applied computer science. * Experience inclusive of: + Programming: Strong proficiency in C\#/.NET and Python and/or + Experience building production\-grade APIs and backend services in C\# and/or + Experience designing and maintaining data pipelines and/or + Strong SQL skills with experience in SQL Server and data modeling and/or + Experience integrating systems via APIs and messaging patterns and/or + Knowledge of LLMs, embeddings, and retrieval\-based architectures (RAG) Strong problem\-solving, system design, and communication skills * **Eligibility Requirements** : * Must be legally authorized to work in the United States without restriction. * Must be willing to take a drug test and post\-offer physical (if required). * Must be 18 years of age or older.

jobs.title: Principal Audio DSP/ML Engineer- Audio Technology
jobs.description: Available in 2 locationsAvailable in 2 locations See allSee all **Principal Audio DSP/ML Engineer\- Audio Technology** ------------------------------------------------------ Available in 2 locations Remote, Massachusetts, United States of America Framingham, Massachusetts, United States of America Category: Engineering Job ID: R29213 Brand: Bose Corporation, U.S.A Posted Date: September 20th 2026 widget: Full time **Description** --------------- At Bose Corporation, we believe sound is the most powerful force on earth — and for over 60 years, we have been a company built on innovation, excellence, and independence. Privately owned, fiercely customer\-focused, and driven by our values, we continue to lead industries and transform lives through sound. Today, Bose Corporation is entering an exciting new era. Across multiple global Business Units and Global Functions, we are shaping the future of audio technology, automotive, luxury, and premium experiences. We invite you to join us in this transformation. **Job Description** =================== **Principal Audio DSP/ML Engineer \- Audio Technology** We are seeking a **Principal** **Audio DSP / Machine Learning Applied Scientist** to invent, develop, and productize advanced audio technologies. In this role, you will combine **signal processing, machine learning, and systems engineering** to deliver high\-quality audio solutions for real\-world consumer devices. You will work across the full pipeline—from algorithm research and deployment to optimized, real\-time deployment on production hardware. Bose has a strong history of combining creative thinking with cutting\-edge technology in the audio domain. We are looking for candidates passionate about machine learning and audio to help us shape the next chapter in the future of Bose! **Responsibilities:** * Design and develop **audio signal processing and machine learning algorithms** for speech and audio applications such as noise suppression, echo cancellation, beamforming, spatial audio, and audio enhancement * Apply primarily **modern ML/deep learning approaches augmented by classical DSP techniques** to audio and time\-series data. * Investigate new modeling approaches and translate research ideas into practical, scalable solutions that will be experienced by millions of consumers. **Qualifications:** * Bachelor’s degree in **Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, Applied Mathematics**, or related field. * Hands\-on experience with **machine learning applied to audio or time\-series data**. * Strong fundamentals in **digital signal processing** (sampling, filtering, FFTs, spectral analysis). * Experience with **Python and/or MATLAB** for research and prototyping. * Solid understanding of **audio systems and acoustics**. * Strong communication skills. **Preferred Qualifications:** * **MS or PhD** in a relevant technical field. * Deep practical knowledge of: + Applied ML frameworks such as **PyTorch/ONNX and/or TensorFlow/TFLite**. + Audio DSP (sampling, filtering, FFTs, spectral analysis) using tools such as Python, Matlab and/or C/C\+\+. * Experience with **speech or audio ML tasks**, such as: + **Audio source separation / speech enhancement** + **Echo reduction** + **Microphone array signal processing** * Strong software engineering practices (debugging, profiling, version control). * Proficiency in **C and/or C\+\+** for performance\-critical systems. * Publications, patents, or demonstrated innovation in DSP or ML. **What success looks like:** * You deliver **robust, high\-quality audio algorithms** that work reliably in real\-world conditions. * You balance **audio quality, ML performance, and system constraints** effectively. * You influence product direction through technical insight and data\-driven decisions. * Your work ships as both licensed audio technology **at scale**. jobs.title: Principal Machine Learning Engineer, Matching and Recommendations

Badoo, which was founded in 2006, is one of the pioneers of web and mobile dating products. **AI Fluency** AI is important to us. jobs.title: Senior Director, Analytics & Data Science
jobs.description: Crusoe is on a mission *to accelerate the abundance of energy and intelligence*. As the only vertically integrated AI infrastructure company built from the ground up, we own and operate each layer of the stack — from electrons to tokens — to power the world's most ambitious AI workloads. When you join Crusoe, you join a team that is building the future, faster. We're in the midst of the greatest industrial revolution of our time. The demand for AI compute is boundless, and power is a bottleneck. We're solving that — with an energy\-first approach that makes AI infrastructure better for the world and faster for the people innovating with AI. We're looking for problem\-solving, opportunity\-finding teammates with a sense of urgency, who believe in the scale of our ambition and thrive on a path not fully paved — people who want to grow their careers alongside a team of experts across energy, manufacturing, data center construction, and cloud services. If you want to do the most meaningful work of your career, help our customers and partners advance their AI strategies, and be part of a high\-performing team that believes in each other, come build with us at Crusoe. **About the Role:** As Senior Director of Analytics \& Data Science, you will play a key role in how Crusoe makes decisions. This is a new role leading a newly formed team of centralized analysts and data scientists who are embedded directly with the business units and domains they support. Your mandate spans cloud, customer experience, construction, power, manufacturing, and more. The analytics team owns the business logic, certified data models, and reporting that leadership relies on, and partners closely with our Data team, which owns and maintains the data platform and the ingestion of data from source systems. We are seeking a hands\-on leader who is energized by building something from the ground up. The ideal candidate is deeply technical, credible with executives and operators alike, and drawn to complex, cross\-functional problems. Reporting into the CFO/COO organization, you will define the operating model, hire and develop the team, set the standards to maintain consistent metrics across the company, and be a key partner to leadership in making faster, better\-informed decisions. In the near term, much of the work is foundational — building the data models and definitions that rigorous analysis depends on. As that foundation matures, the team will take on more forecasting, experimentation, and predictive work. **What You'll Be Working On:** * **Stand Up the Central Team**: Work with leaders across the business to understand their analytical needs, and design the staffing and operating model that meets them. Define how analysts are deployed, how work is prioritized, and how the team engages with each domain. * **Build and Develop the Team**: Recruit and grow analysts and data scientists who pair technical depth with business credibility. Build the career path and development model to retain talent. * **Set Standards for Analytical Rigor**: Define how the team approaches statistical and modeling work, including experimental design, forecasting, and how uncertainty is communicated to decision\-makers. jobs.title: Software Engineering Manager
jobs.description: **Software Engineering Manager, GTI Team Lead** **Monday – Friday 8:00 – 5:00** **Remote** Corptax is the platform behind corporate tax for many of the largest enterprises in the world. Global Tax and Regulatory Intelligence (GTI) is the product that tracks tax and regulatory obligations across jurisdictions, models them as workflows, and tells our clients what is due, where, and when. We are hiring an Engineering Manager to lead the GTI engineering team. This is a hands\-on leadership role. You will run the team, own delivery, and stay close to the code. Your architecture calls and your code reviews carry real weight. You will report to the Head of AI and work alongside product, design, and tax content on everything GTI ships. **Some of the things you will be doing:** * **The team.** You will run one\-on\-ones, set growth plans, give direct feedback, handle performance, and hiring decisions. * **Delivery.** You will work with product to turn the roadmap into releases the team can land, and you will be accountable for the dates you agree upon. * **Technical direction.** You will make and document the architecture decisions across the frontend, the backend services, the database, and the Azure footprint. * **Code quality.** You will review pull requests, set the bar for testing, and contribute code on the novel problems we encounter daily. * **The release process.** GTI ships from a multi\-service repository with release tagging, release candidates, changelog gates, and merge\-back rules. You will own that process and keep it “boring” and stable. * **Production health.** You will own on\-call, alert routing, and the observability stack. You will be the person who asks why an incident happened and makes sure it never happens again. * **Hands\-on work.** You will definitely write code, enough of it to keep your judgment current, though it will not fill most of your week. **The Stack:** GTI has a small number of moving parts, and you should be comfortable in all of them. * **Frontend:** Next.js and TypeScript, with a shared React component library. * **Backend:** .NET and C\# services behind the product APIs. * **Data:** Microsoft SQL Server, including schema design, migrations, and query tuning. * **Hosting:** Azure Container Apps, with Key Vault, Container Registry, managed identities, and private endpoints around it. * **Delivery:** GitHub Actions for CI/CD, Bicep for infrastructure, and Linear for planning. * **Telemetry:** Application Insights for tracing and PostHog for product analytics. **What technical skills, experience and qualifications do you need?** **Required** * Experience building and shipping production software, including leading a team as a manager or a technical lead. * Hands\-on depth in C\# and .NET, including API design, async work, and testing. * Hands\-on depth in modern TypeScript and React, with Next.js experience preferred. * SQL Server skills: schema design, indexing, reading query plans, and running migrations against live data. * Production experience with containerized workloads on Azure. * A track record of shipping on a schedule in an Agile work environment. * Clear written communication. You can write a design document, an incident review, and a performance review, and all three land. **Nice to Have** * Infrastructure as code with Bicep, and CI/CD with GitHub Actions. * Experience with observability tooling such as Application Insights, OpenTelemetry, or PostHog. * Experience leading a team through an agent\-led development workflow with tools such as Claude Code. * Experience shipping LLM\-backed features into production. * Background in tax, accounting, law, or another rule\-governed domain. We can teach the domain, and it is a head start if you already have it. * Experience hiring and onboarding engineers. **What you get out of this:** * A funded product with real regulatory stakes. * A small team you can shape, with enough room to change how it works. * Direct access to the Head of AI and to the AI research feeding into GTI. * The budget and infrastructure to do the job properly, including model APIs and Azure capacity. * Competitive compensation and a flexible remote setup. Tax compliance is unforgiving. A wrong obligation date or a missed filing is a real problem for a real client, so the bar for correctness is high and the surface area keeps growing. We need someone who can hold that bar while still shipping on a schedule, and who can drive a team that holds it without being watched. If that sounds like the kind of team you want to run, apply! \#CSC \#CSCCareers \#CorporateTax \#LI\-HL1
