jobs.title: Senior Data Engineer, Observability Engineering
jobs.description: We’re building a world of health around every individual — shaping a more connected, convenient and compassionate health experience. At CVS Health®, you’ll be surrounded by passionate colleagues who care deeply, innovate with purpose, hold ourselves accountable and prioritize safety and quality in everything we do. Join us and be part of something bigger – helping to simplify health care one person, one family and one community at a time. **POSITION SUMMARY** ==================== CVS Health is seeking a highly skilled Senior Data Engineer, Observability Engineering to join the Enterprise Observability Platform organization and help advance the next generation of observability, infrastructure, and security data capabilities. The Senior Data Engineer, Observability Engineering will play a critical role in designing, building, and operating scalable data pipelines and data products that power enterprise observability, operational intelligence, and security analytics across the organization. The Senior Data Engineer, Observability Engineering is a senior individual contributor responsible for developing and optimizing Databricks\-based data engineering solutions that ingest, transform, govern, and deliver high\-volume telemetry, infrastructure, application, and security data. This role combines deep hands\-on technical execution with ownership of engineering excellence, operational reliability, performance optimization, and data platform best practices. Working closely with Observability Engineering, Security Engineering, Infrastructure Engineering, and Data Platform teams, the Senior Data Engineer, Observability Engineering will contribute to the evolution of the enterprise observability lakehouse by building resilient ingestion frameworks, establishing data quality standards, enhancing governance controls, and driving efficient, scalable data processing patterns. The ideal candidate is passionate about engineering high\-quality solutions, proactively identifying opportunities for improvement, influencing technical standards, and raising the overall quality, reliability, and maintainability of the platform and team. **PRIMARY RESPONSIBILITIES** ============================ * Design, build, deploy, and support scalable Databricks\-based data pipelines and lakehouse solutions that ingest, transform, and curate observability, infrastructure, and security data from multiple enterprise sources. * Develop and optimize PySpark workloads, Structured Streaming jobs, and bronze/silver/gold data architectures while ensuring high performance, reliability, scalability, data quality, and operational excellence. * Partner with Security, Infrastructure, Observability, and Platform Engineering teams to onboard new data sources, establish governance standards, improve metadata management, and deliver trusted enterprise data products. * Contribute to engineering standards, code reviews, CI/CD practices, monitoring strategies, and platform optimization efforts while proactively identifying and addressing technical debt, process gaps, and operational risks. * Support the ongoing evolution of the enterprise observability lakehouse by promoting best practices for Databricks, Delta Lake, Unity Catalog, data governance, security controls, access management, and cost\-efficient data platform operations. **REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS** =========================== * 5\+ years of experience building and supporting enterprise data engineering solutions using Python, Spark, PySpark, SQL, and distributed data processing technologies. * 5\+ years of experience designing, developing, and operating large\-scale data pipelines, data ingestion frameworks, and bronze/silver/gold lakehouse architectures across multiple data sources. * 4\+ years of experience working with Databricks in production environments, including Delta Lake, Unity Catalog, Databricks Asset Bundles, serverless SQL, performance optimization, and platform operations. * 3\+ years of experience developing high\-volume batch and streaming data solutions, implementing data quality controls, troubleshooting pipeline issues, and improving reliability, scalability, and operational efficiency. * 2\+ years of experience collaborating with engineering teams, participating in code reviews, contributing to technical standards, applying cloud security and access management principles, and communicating technical solutions to both technical and non\-technical stakeholders. **PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS** ============================ * Experience building Structured Streaming and near real\-time ingestion solutions within Databricks or similar cloud\-native data platforms. * Experience implementing Databricks governance capabilities, including Unity Catalog, storage credentials, external locations, catalog management, and access control frameworks. * Familiarity with OCSF or similar observability, cybersecurity, or security event normalization frameworks. * Experience implementing CI/CD pipelines for data engineering solutions using Databricks Asset Bundles, GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps, or equivalent automation frameworks. * Prior experience supporting observability, infrastructure, cybersecurity, logging, telemetry, or operational analytics platforms in large\-scale enterprise environments. **EDUCATION** ============= Bachelor’s degree from an accredited university or equivalent work experience (High School Diploma/GED plus 4 years of relevant experience). **BUSINESS OVERVIEW** ===================== Bring your heart to CVS Health. Every one of us at CVS Health shares a single, clear purpose: Bringing our heart to every moment of your health**.** This purpose guides our commitment to deliver enhanced human\-centric healthcare for a rapidly changing world. Anchored in our brand — with heart at its center — our purpose sends a personal message that how we deliver our services is just as important as what we deliver. Our Heart At Work Behaviors™ support this purpose. We want everyone who works at CVS Health to feel empowered by the role they play in transforming our culture and accelerating our ability to innovate and deliver solutions to make healthcare more personal, convenient, and affordable. We strive to promote and sustain a culture of diversity, inclusion, and belonging every day. CVS Health is an affirmative action employer and is an equal opportunity employer, as are the physician\-owned businesses for which CVS Health provides management services. We do not discriminate in recruiting, hiring, promotion, or any other personnel action based on race, ethnicity, color, national origin, sex/gender, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, religion, age, disability, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable federal, state, or local law. We proudly support and encourage people with military experience (active duty, veterans, reservists, National Guard members, and military spouses) to apply for CVS Health job opportunities. **Anticipated Weekly Hours** 40**Time Type** Full time**Pay Range** The typical pay range for this role is: $92,700\.00 \- $222,480\.00 This pay range represents the base hourly rate or base annual full\-time salary for all positions in the job grade within which this position falls. The actual base salary offer will depend on a variety of factors including experience, education, geography and other relevant factors. This position is eligible for a CVS Health bonus, commission or short\-term incentive program in addition to the base pay range listed above. Our people fuel our future. Our teams reflect the customers, patients, members and communities we serve and we are committed to fostering a workplace where every colleague feels valued and that they belong. **Great benefits for great people** We take pride in offering a comprehensive and competitive mix of pay and benefits that reflects our commitment to our colleagues and their families. This full‑time position is eligible for a comprehensive benefits package designed to support the physical, emotional, and financial well‑being of colleagues and their families. The benefits for this position include medical, dental, and vision coverage, paid time off, retirement savings options, wellness programs, and other resources, based on eligibility. Additional details about available benefits are provided during the application process and on Benefits Moments. We anticipate the application window for this opening will close on: 10/31/2026 Qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records will be considered for employment in accordance with all federal, state and local laws.

Currently, we are seeking a Staff Software Development Engineer, who will serve as a senior technical leader on a cross\-functional product team responsible for designing, developing, and delivering scalable healthcare technology solutions. You will play a critical role in driving architecture decisions, mentoring engineers, and partnering with product, UX, and business stakeholders to build secure, cloud\-native applications that enhance the digital healthcare experience. In this role, you will lead the development of distributed systems and microservices leveraging Java, Spring Boot, event\-driven architectures, and modern cloud technologies. This Staff Engineer will also guide data migration and interoperability initiatives, supporting healthcare integrations that enable seamless and secure exchange of clinical data across platforms. The ideal candidate combines strong software engineering expertise with a passion for innovation, technical leadership, and delivering high\-quality solutions in an Agile environment. *Expectations for the Role* **Software Engineering \& Architecture** * Architect, design, and develop high\-performance microservices using Java, JEE, Spring Boot, and Spring Cloud * Lead development of event\-driven services using Apache Kafka (producers, consumers, streaming patterns, schema evolution) * Own API strategy for RESTful services, ensuring consistent JSON modeling, backward\-compatible versioning, and strong API governance * Mentor team members and contribute to engineering standards, design reviews, and coding best practices **Data Migration, ETL, and Data Management** * Design and implement ETL pipelines for structured/unstructured data using tools such as Python\-based pipelines, Spring Batch, or cloud\-native ETL frameworks * Lead data migration efforts for legacy\-to\-cloud or system\-to\-system transitions (incremental loads, bulk loads, validation, reconciliation) * Establish data quality, profiling, and governance practices * Work with clinical data formats, mapping, transformations, and normalization (FHIR resources, HL7 v2 segments, CCD/C\-CDA documents) **Cloud, DevOps \& SecDevOps** * Build and maintain CI/CD automation (unit tests, integration tests, SAST/DAST, artifact provenance, policy gates) * Deploy and operate services on Google Cloud Platform (GCP) using GKE, Cloud Run, Cloud Build, Cloud SQL, Pub/Sub, IAM, Secret Manager, etc * Drive SecDevOps practices: threat modeling, secure coding, dependency scanning, secrets management, container hardening * Implement observability frameworks (OpenTelemetry, tracing, dashboards, alerts, SLOs) **Healthcare/EHR Integration** * Integrate microservices with EHR systems using HL7 v2, FHIR, SMART on FHIR, and standard healthcare APIs * Support workflows across patient data exchange, interoperability, and HIPAA\-aligned data flows * Collaborate with compliance and security teams to implement regulatory safeguards **REQUIRED QUALIFICTIONS** * 7\+ years of professional software engineering experience in enterprise environments * 7\+ years of experience developing applications using Java, J2EE, Spring Boot, and RESTful services * 5\+ years of experience designing and implementing microservices architectures * 3\+ years of experience with Apache Kafka or similar event\-streaming technologies * 3\+ years of experience with CI/CD pipelines, automated testing, and DevOps practices * 3\+ years of experience with containerization and orchestration technologies such as Docker and Kubernetes * 2\+ years of experience working with public cloud platforms, including GCP, AWS, or Azure **PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS** * Experience integrating with healthcare systems using FHIR, HL7, SMART on FHIR, or EHR platforms such as Epic, Cerner, or MEDITECH * Experience leading technical initiatives and influencing engineering decisions across teams * Strong understanding of software design principles, scalable architectures, and distributed systems * Experience building and operating solutions on Google Cloud Platform (GKE, Cloud Run, Cloud Build, Pub/Sub, Cloud SQL, IAM) * Experience with large\-scale application modernization, cloud transformation, or data migration programs * Knowledge of ETL processes, data quality practices, and healthcare data management * Experience with Spring Batch, Dataflow, or cloud\-native data processing frameworks * Understanding of security best practices including OAuth 2\.0, OpenID Connect, secrets management, and vulnerability management * Experience implementing monitoring and observability solutions using OpenTelemetry, Grafana, or similar platforms * Knowledge of regulated healthcare environments, including HIPAA and HITRUST requirements * Strong communication, collaboration, and stakeholder management skills **EDUCATION** Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience (HS diploma \+ 4 years relevant experience) **BUSINESS OVERVIEW** Bring your heart to CVS Health Every one of us at CVS Health shares a single, clear purpose: Bringing our heart to every moment of your health. This purpose guides our commitment to deliver enhanced human\-centric health care for a rapidly changing world. jobs.title: Senior Systems Engineer
jobs.description: **About Cyngn, Inc.** Based in Mountain View, CA, Cyngn is a publicly\-traded autonomous technology company. We deploy self\-driving industrial vehicles \-**specifically autonomous tuggers**\- to factories, warehouses, and other facilities throughout North America. To build this emergent technology, we are looking for innovative, motivated, and experienced leaders to join us and move this field forward. If you like to build, tinker, and create with a team of trusted and passionate colleagues, then Cyngn is the place for you. Key reasons to join Cyngn: **We are small and big.** With under 100 employees, Cyngn operates with the energy of a startup. On the other hand, we’re publicly traded. This means our employees not only work in close\-knit teams with mentorship from company leaders—they also get access to the liquidity of our publicly\-traded equity. **We build today and deploy tomorrow.** Our autonomous vehicles aren’t just test concepts—they’re deployed to real clients right now. That means your work will have a tangible, visible impact. **We aren’t robots. We just develop them.** We’re a welcoming, diverse team of sharp thinkers and kind humans. Collaboration and trust drive our creative environment. At Cyngn, everyone’s perspective matters—and that’s what powers our innovation. **About the role** * Our Vehicles \& Hardware team develops the physical systems that power Cyngn’s autonomous products, with a strong focus on real\-world deployment, safety certification, and operational robustness. * Cyngn is seeking a **Senior Systems Engineer** to lead system definition and architecture for autonomous vehicle and robotics platforms. This role is a senior, hands\-on systems position responsible for converting high\-level product requirements (L0/L1 user stories and product intent) into detailed, testable engineering specifications, architectures, and verification plans using a structured V\-model systems engineering approach. * This is a generalist systems role spanning sensors, compute, power distribution, actuation, and safety\-critical behaviors. The ideal candidate has deep experience in industrial robotics or vehicle systems, understands safety certification expectations, and can bridge product intent with disciplined engineering execution. **What you'll do** * Translate L0/L1 product requirements and user stories into complete, unambiguous, and testable system and subsystem specifications (L2\+). * Define system architectures and interfaces for autonomous vehicle and robotics platforms, including: * + Sensors (perception and low\-level feedback) + Compute and embedded controllers + Power distribution and protection + Actuation and drive systems * Own requirements decomposition, allocation, and traceability across mechanical, electrical, firmware, and software domains. * Develop system\-level verification and validation plans, including test strategies, acceptance criteria, and pass/fail definitions aligned with the systems engineering V\-model. * Lead technical trade studies, risk assessments, and architectural decisions with a focus on safety, reliability, and manufacturability. * Act as the systems engineering point of contact for industrial safety certification, ensuring system requirements and test plans support compliance. * Collaborate with product management, safety engineering, hardware, firmware, software, and test teams to ensure aligned execution. * Drive cross\-functional design reviews, requirements reviews, and system readiness milestones. * Support integration, debugging, and validation of vehicle and robotic systems during development and deployment phases. **Safety \& Certification Responsibilities** * Incorporate industrial safety requirements into system architecture, requirements, and test planning. * Support compliance efforts related to ANSI B56 standards for industrial trucks and autonomous mobile robots (AMRs). * Work closely with safety and compliance teams to define safety functions, fault responses, and operational limits. * Ensure system behaviors are well\-defined for normal operation, degraded modes, and fault conditions. * Contribute to safety\-related documentation, including requirements, test evidence, and certification support artifacts. **Qualifications** * Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Systems Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Robotics, or related field. * 8\+ years of experience in systems engineering for complex electro\-mechanical systems (robotics, vehicles, industrial automation, autonomy). * Strong experience translating product\-level requirements into detailed engineering specifications and verification plans. * Solid understanding of industrial safety standards, particularly ANSI B56 and related AMR / industrial vehicle safety frameworks. * Hands\-on familiarity with low\-level sensors and feedback systems, including: * + Encoders (incremental, absolute) + Angle and position sensors + Temperature sensors + Current and voltage s liarity with system integration, bring\-up, and hardware validation testing. * Experience working in fast\-paced product development environments with cross\-functional teams. ### **Benefits \& Perks** * Health benefits (Medical, Dental, Vision) through Aetna, Kaiser Permanente, and Guardian, with multiple plan tiers to choose from * Ancillary benefits including accident, critical illness, and hospital indemnity plans (Voya) * Company\-paid basic life insurance, plus voluntary (supplemental) life for you and your dependents * Short\-term and long\-term disability insurance plans, fully paid by Cyngn * HSA and FSA (Health \& Dependent Daycare) * Employee Assistance Program * 1:1 Health Concierge * Company 401(k) * Commuter Benefits * Flexible PTO policy * Sabbatical leave opportunity after 5 years with the company * Paid Parental Leave * Daily lunches for in\-office employees and fully\-stocked kitchen with snacks and beverages ### **What You Can Expect (Cyngn’s interview process)** * A real person will review your application * We’ll kick off the process with a one\-sided video interview where you’ll share a little more about yourself and we’ll get some basic questions out of the way * A Recruiter touch point will go over the process in more detail and answer your questions * A 45\-minute interview with the hiring manager * A full\-loop interview process consisting of 3\-4 additional conversations to gauge technical and soft skills and culture fit. * A final onsite interview with the team. *W**e may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.* ***Equal Opportunity Employer*** *Cyngn is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We are committed to providing equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, and related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, ancestry, age, physical or mental disability, genetic information, marital status, familial status, military or veteran status, citizenship status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable federal, state, or local law. This policy applies to all aspects of employment, including recruitment, hiring, compensation, benefits, training, promotion, discipline, and termination.* *If you require accommodation during the application or interview process due to a disability, please let us know and we will work with you to provide reasonable accommodation* ***A Note on Recruitment Scams*** *We've seen an increase in fraudulent job offers and phishing attempts impersonating real companies, including Cyngn.* *To protect yourself:* * *All official communication from Cyngn recruiters and hiring managers will come from an email address ending in* ***@cyngn.com****. We will never contact you from a personal email (Gmail, Yahoo, etc.) or via unsolicited text message or messaging app.* * *Cyngn will never ask you to pay for equipment, training, background checks, or any other fees as part of the application or hiring process.* * *We will never ask for sensitive personal or financial information (e.g., bank account or Social Security number) before you've been extended and have accepted a formal offer through official channels.* * *If you receive a suspicious message claiming to be from Cyngn, please do not respond with personal information, and feel free to verify by reaching out to us directly through our official careers page.* **The pay range for this role is:** 170,000 \- 190,000 USD per year(HQ \- Terra Bella)

jobs.title: Data Records Clerk
jobs.description: **Data Records Clerk** **Location:** Alpharetta, GA **Department:** Cal Engineering Solutions **Position Type:** Full\-Time (40 Hours per Week) **Pay Range:** $16\.00 \- $18\.00 per Hour **Position Summary** Cal Engineering Solutions is seeking a reliable and detail\-oriented **Data Records Clerk** to support our engineering and IT teams in the Alpharetta office. This entry\-level position is responsible for transferring information between company systems, maintaining electronic records, and assisting with basic computer setup activities. The Data Records Clerk plays an important role in ensuring engineers have access to accurate and up\-to\-date project information while supporting daily administrative and technology\-related functions. This position is ideal for a recent high school graduate or someone beginning a career in administrative, data management, or technical support roles. **Essential Duties and Responsibilities** **Data and Records Management** * Download files, records, reports, and project information from designated company systems. * Upload and organize data into engineering platforms for employee access. * Verify information for accuracy and completeness before transferring data. * Maintain organized electronic filing systems and digital records. * Track completed uploads and downloads to ensure proper recordkeeping. * Assist with document organization and data management projects. * Ensure confidentiality and security of company information. IT Support * Assist with setting up desktop and laptop computers for new employees. * Connect monitors, docking stations, keyboards, and other equipment. * Assist with inventory tracking of company computers and technology assets. * Help prepare equipment for employee onboarding and offboarding. * Provide basic administrative support to the IT department. **Administrative Support** * Report data discrepancies or technical issues to management. * Perform general office and administrative duties as assigned. **Qualifications** **Required** * High School Diploma or GED. * Basic computer skills, including Microsoft Outlook, Word, Excel, and Teams. * Strong attention to detail and organizational skills. * Ability to follow instructions and complete tasks accurately. * Strong verbal and written communication skills. * Ability to maintain confidentiality. Preferred * Previous office, administrative, customer service, or data entry experience. * Familiarity with electronic filing systems and document management. **Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities** * Strong attention to detail and accuracy. * Basic technical aptitude and willingness to learn new software systems. * Effective organizational and time management skills. * Ability to work independently and as part of a team. * Positive attitude and strong customer service skills. * Ability to manage multiple tasks in a fast\-paced office environment. **Physical Requirements** * Ability to sit and work at a computer for extended periods. * Ability to occasionally lift and move equipment weighing up to 25 pounds. * Ability to work in an office environment during normal business hours. **Work Schedule** * Monday through Friday * 40 hours per week * In\-office position located in Alpharetta, Georgia **Compensation** * $16\.00 to $18\.00 per hour, based on qualifications and experience.

jobs.title: AI Engineer 4
jobs.description: AI Engineer 4 At Capital One, we are creating responsible and reliable AI systems, changing banking for good. For years, Capital One has been an industry leader in using machine learning to create real\-time, personalized customer experiences. Our investments in technology infrastructure and world\-class talent — along with our deep experience in machine learning — position us to be at the forefront of enterprises leveraging AI. From informing customers about unusual charges to answering their questions in real time, our applications of AI \& ML are bringing humanity and simplicity to banking. We are committed to continuing to build world\-class applied science and engineering teams to deliver our industry leading capabilities with breakthrough product experiences and scalable, high\-performance AI infrastructure. At Capital One, you will help bring the transformative power of emerging AI capabilities to reimagine how we serve our customers and businesses who have come to love the products and services we build. **Team Description:** The Intelligent Foundations and Experiences (IFX) team is at the center of bringing our vision for AI at Capital One to life. We work hand\-in\-hand with our partners across the company to advance the state of the art in science and AI engineering, and we build and deploy proprietary solutions that are central to our business and deliver value to millions of customers. Our AI models and platforms empower teams across Capital One to enhance their products with the transformative power of AI, in responsible and scalable ways for the highest leverage impact. **What You’ll Do:** * Partner with a cross\-functional team of engineers, research scientists, technical program managers, and product managers to deliver AI\-powered products that change how our associates work and how our customers interact with Capital One. * Design, develop, test, deploy, and support AI software components including foundation model training, large language model inference, agents and multi\-agent workflows, similarity search, guardrails, model evaluation, experimentation, governance, and observability, etc. * Leverage a broad stack of Open Source and SaaS AI technologies such as AWS Ultraclusters, Huggingface, VectorDBs, PyTorch, and more. * Invent and introduce state\-of\-the\-art foundation model optimization techniques to improve the performance — scalability, cost, latency, throughput — of large scale production AI systems. * Contribute to the technical vision and the long term roadmap of foundational AI systems at Capital One. * Own the end\-to\-end architecture for complex AI systems \- ensuring maintainability, observability, and ethical alignment * Define and maintain service\-level objectives (SLOs) for AI reliability, including latency, uptime, and model performance drift * Collaborate with infrastructure engineering to optimize GPU/TPU utilization and accelerate model inference pipelines * Lead cross\-functional technical reviews for new AI system deployments, ensuring security, data governance, and compliance standards are met * Mentor Principal and Senior Associates on scalable design, performance tuning and research\-to\-production translation **The Ideal Candidate:** * You love to build systems, take pride in the quality of your work, and also share our passion to do the right thing. You want to work on problems that will help change banking for good * Passion for staying abreast of the latest research, and an ability to intuitively understand scientific publications and judiciously apply novel techniques in production * You adapt quickly and thrive on bringing clarity to big, undefined problems. You love asking questions and digging deep to uncover the root of problems and can articulate your findings concisely with clarity. You have the courage to share new ideas even when they are unproven * You are deeply Technical. You possess a strong foundation in engineering and mathematics, and your expertise in hardware, software, and AI enables you to see and exploit optimization opportunities that others miss * You are a resilient trailblazer who can forge new paths to achieve business goals when the route is unknown **Basic Qualifications:** * Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, AI, Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or related fields plus at least 4 years of experience developing AI and ML algorithms or technologies, or a Master's degree in Computer Science, AI, Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or related fields plus at least 2 years of experience developing AI and ML algorithms or technologies * At least 4 years of experience programming with Python, Go, Scala, CUDA, or Java **Preferred Qualifications:** * Experience leading development AI systems with tradeoff decisions around cost, latency, throughput and accuracy * 6 years of experience deploying scalable and responsible AI solutions on cloud platforms (e.g. AWS, Google Cloud, Azure, or equivalent private cloud)  nference software to improve hardware utilization, latency, throughput, and cost * Experience in building agentic AI systems and agentic workflows * Passion for staying abreast of the latest AI research and AI systems, and judiciously apply novel techniques in production * Proficiency in designing distributed systems for model training, evaluation, and online inference at petabyte scale * Experience defining AI model governance processes, including producibility, lineage tracking, and automated retaining schedules * Demonstrated ability to influence architectural decisions across multiple AI product lines or platforms ***Capital One will consider sponsoring a new qualified applicant for employment authorization for this position.*** The minimum and maximum full\-time annual salaries for this role are listed below, by location. Please note that this salary information is solely for candidates hired to perform work within one of these locations, and refers to the amount Capital One is willing to pay at the time of this posting. Salaries for part\-time roles will be prorated based upon the agreed upon number of hours to be regularly worked. Cambridge, MA: $197,300 \- $225,100 for AI Engineer 4 McLean, VA: $197,300 \- $225,100 for AI Engineer 4 New York, NY: $215,200 \- $245,600 for AI Engineer 4 San Jose, CA: $215,200 \- $245,600 for AI Engineer 4 Candidates hired to work in other locations will be subject to the pay range associated with that location, and the actual annualized salary amount offered to any candidate at the time of hire will be reflected solely in the candidate’s offer letter. This role is also eligible to earn performance based incentive compensation, which may include cash bonus(es) and/or long term incentives (LTI). Incentives could be discretionary or non discretionary depending on the plan. Capital One offers a comprehensive, competitive, and inclusive set of health, financial and other benefits that support your total well\-being. Learn more at the Capital One Careers website. Eligibility varies based on full or part\-time status, exempt or non\-exempt status, and management level. This role is expected to accept applications for a minimum of 5 business days. No agencies please. Capital One is an equal opportunity employer (EOE, including disability/vet) committed to non\-discrimination in compliance with applicable federal, state, and local laws. Capital One promotes a drug\-free workplace. Capital One will consider for employment qualified applicants with a criminal history in a manner consistent with the requirements of applicable laws regarding criminal background inquiries, including, to the extent applicable, Article 23\-A of the New York Correction Law; San Francisco, California Police Code Article 49, Sections 4901\-4920; New York City’s Fair Chance Act; Philadelphia’s Fair Criminal Records Screening Act; and other applicable federal, state, and local laws and regulations regarding criminal background inquiries. If you have visited our website in search of information on employment opportunities or to apply for a position, and you require an accommodation, please contact Capital One Recruiting at 1\-800\-304\-9102 or via email at RecruitingAccommodation@capitalone.com. All information you provide will be kept confidential and will be used only to the extent required to provide needed reasonable accommodations. For technical support or questions about Capital One's recruiting process, please send an email to Careers@capitalone.com Capital One does not provide, endorse nor guarantee and is not liable for third\-party products, services, educational tools or other information available through this site. Capital One Financial is made up of several different entities. (COPSSC).

For years, Capital One has been leading the industry in using machine learning to create real\-time, intelligent, automated customer experiences. From informing customers about unusual charges to answering their questions in real time, our applications of AI \& ML are bringing humanity and simplicity to banking. Our work touches every aspect of the research life cycle, from partnering with Academia to building production systems. We work with product, technology and business leaders to apply the state of the art in AI to our business. jobs.title: Sr. Manager, AI Engineer (IFX)
jobs.description: Sr. Manager, AI Engineer (IFX) At Capital One, we are creating responsible and reliable AI systems, changing banking for good. For years, Capital One has been an industry leader in using machine learning to create real\-time, personalized customer experiences. Our investments in technology infrastructure and world\-class talent — along with our deep experience in machine learning — position us to be at the forefront of enterprises leveraging AI. From informing customers about unusual charges to answering their questions in real time, our applications of AI \& ML are bringing humanity and simplicity to banking. We are committed to continuing to build world\-class applied science and engineering teams to deliver our industry leading capabilities with breakthrough product experiences and scalable, high\-performance AI infrastructure. At Capital One, you will help bring the transformative power of emerging AI capabilities to reimagine how we serve our customers and businesses who have come to love the products and services we build. Team Description: The Intelligent Foundations and Experiences (IFX) team is at the center of bringing our vision for AI at Capital One to life. We work hand\-in\-hand with our partners across the company to advance the state of the art in science and AI engineering, and we build and deploy proprietary solutions that are central to our business and deliver value to millions of customers. Our AI models and platforms empower teams across Capital One to enhance their products with the transformative power of AI, in responsible and scalable ways for the highest leverage impact. **What You’ll Do:** * Partner with a cross\-functional team of engineers, research scientists, technical program managers, and product managers to deliver AI\-powered products that change how our associates work and how our customers interact with Capital One * Oversee the design, development, testing, deployment, and support AI software components including foundation model training, large language model inference, similarity search, guardrails, model evaluation, experimentation, governance, and observability, etc. * Make high judgment build\-vs\-buy decisions across a broad stack of Open Source and SaaS AI technologies such as AWS Ultraclusters, Huggingface, VectorDBs, PyTorch, and more * Invent and introduce state\-of\-the\-art foundation model optimization techniques to improve the performance — scalability, cost, latency, throughput — of large scale production AI systems * Contribute to the technical vision and the long term roadmap of foundational AI systems at Capital One * Attract and retain top talent in the AI industry and nurture personal and professional development for your team. Foster a culture of learning and staying abreast of the state\-of\-the\-art in AI * Translate enterprise AI goals into actionable team roadmaps with measurable outcomes and regular readouts * Operationalize Responsible AI: establish review gates, documentation/evaluation requirements, and rollout/rollback standards for all production AI systems * Create strong collaboration interfaces with Research, Data, and Platform teams to accelerate model lifecycle **The Ideal Candidate:** * You love to build systems, take pride in the quality of your work, and also share our passion to do the right thing. jobs.description: **Senior UI/UX Developer** to lead the design and front\-end implementation of intuitive, accessible, and responsive web applications. UI/UX design and modern front\-end web development. * **Front\-End Engineering** : Solid JavaScript expertise and experience navigating modern JavaScript build tools, package managers, and front\-end frameworks/ecosystems. * **ADA \& Accessibility (WCAG):** Demonstrated experience designing and coding for web accessibility, including ARIA roles, keyboard navigation, contrast compliance, and screen reader compatibility (e.g., NVDA, JAWS, VoiceOver). * **Automated Web \& UI Testing** : Strong experience with automated web testing tools (e.g., Selenium, Cypress) and unit/component testing frameworks. * **UI Security \& Standards:** Good understanding of web application security as it impacts the front\-end (e.g., preventing XSS, safe state management, and secure form handling). * **Collaborative Leadership:** Proven track record of guiding UI/UX initiatives, collaborating closely with backend engineers and project leads, and documenting design systems/components. *A familiarity with Java application stacks (Spring Framework, Tomcat) or RESTful API integrations to collaborate effectively with backend developers. * **Database \& Data Integration** : Basic to solid understanding of SQL/Oracle or data pipelines to better design data\-dense dashboards and admin interfaces. * **AI Tooling in UX/Dev:** Recent exposure to AI\-assisted tools for design, prototyping, or front\-end code generation/testing. * **Environment \& Tools:** Comfort working in Linux\-based developer environments, using Git version control, and deploying containerized applications. * **Domain Context** : Prior experience designing accessible digital services within a Higher Education or public\-sector context. **Key Soft Skills:** * **User Empathy \& Advocacy** : Passion for advocating for diverse user groups, including users with disabilities, to create inclusive digital experiences. * **Visual \& Technical Communication:** Ability to articulate design decisions clearly to developers, product managers, and non\-technical university stakeholders. * **Problem\-Solving \& Detail Orientation** : Sharp eye for visual consistency, user friction points, micro\-interactions, and edge\-case behaviors. * **Adaptability \& Learning** : Drive to keep pace with evolving accessibility standards, modern front\-end frameworks, and emerging design technologies. **Requirements:** * jobs.title: Assistant Production Supervisor (Water Treatment Plant)
jobs.description: **POSITION SUMMARY:** The Assistant Production Supervisor assists in the leadership, management, and continuous improvement of the Authority's water production facilities. This position supports the safe, reliable, efficient, and regulatory\-compliant operation of treatment, pumping, transmission, storage, chemical feed, process waste, hydroelectric, and related production assets. The position supports the Production Supervisor by providing hands\-on operational leadership, technical expertise, direct supervision of production staff, asset management support, preventive maintenance coordination, operator training, process optimization, and development of Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), Operations and Maintenance (O\&M) manuals, and emergency response procedures. As a designated mentor for the Pennsylvania Rural Water Association (PRWA) Apprenticeship Program, the Assistant Production Supervisor provides structured mentoring, competency evaluations, and practical training for apprentice operators. The position also coordinates required plant training and helps ensure certified operators obtain the continuing education units (CEUs) needed to maintain licensing. This is an essential, on\-call supervisory position responsible for responding to operational, facility, chemical, water quality, and emergency situations as required. In the absence of the Production Supervisor, the Assistant Production Supervisor assumes assigned responsibility for production operations and supervisory oversight. **REPORTS TO:** The Assistant Production Supervisor reports to the Production Supervisor. In the absence of the Production Supervisor, or as otherwise directed, the position reports to the Director of Plant Operations or another designated management representative. **ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS AND RESPONSIBILITIES:** · Assist in directing daily production activities to ensure reliable water treatment, pumping, transmission, storage, chemical feed, process waste, and related production operations. · Assist in the management and reliability of production assets, including treatment facilities, pumping stations, storage facilities, transmission systems, chemical feed systems, process analyzers, instrumentation, and related infrastructure. · Monitor plant performance using SCADA, historical data, laboratory results, process testing, operator logs, and other operational records; prepare trends, evaluate events, and recommend operational adjustments. · Optimize treatment processes through process monitoring, data analysis, jar testing, chemical feed evaluation, analyzer verification, and other operational testing needed to maintain water quality and compliance. · Provide technical leadership during abnormal operating conditions, equipment failures, planned shutdowns, restarts, inspections, calibrations, performance testing, storm events, power outages, and emergency response activities. · Coordinate preventive and predictive maintenance activities with Maintenance, Electrical/Mechanical, Engineering, Water Quality, vendors, and contractors as needed. · Assist with equipment condition assessments, lifecycle planning, operational testing, commissioning, calibration, performance verification, and capital improvement recommendations. · Maintain asset records, equipment histories, spare parts information, maintenance documentation, operational performance metrics, and other technical records as assigned. · Develop, revise, implement, and maintain SOPs, O\&M manuals, emergency procedures, operator checklists, process testing procedures, and guidance documents. · Ensure operational documentation reflects current equipment configurations, regulatory requirements, Authority procedures, and industry best practices. · Maintain operational records required for regulatory reporting, inspections, audits, compliance reviews, and performance benchmarking. · Assist in maintaining compliance with PA DEP, EPA, SRBC, FERC, OSHA, Partnership for Safe Drinking Water, and other applicable regulatory or program requirements. · Support the Authority's Risk Management Program (RMP), Spill Prevention, Control and Countermeasure (SPCC) Plan, Spill Response Plan (SRP), chemical safety procedures, and emergency preparedness programs. · Promote safe work practices; conduct or assist with safety inspections, job hazard analyses, emergency response drills, operational audits, and incident reviews; recommend corrective actions when needed. · Assist with chemical inventory management, ordering, receiving, usage tracking, vendor coordination, and maintaining appropriate chemical inventory levels for treatment, pumping, and emergency needs. **TRAINING, MENTORING, AND WORKFORCE DEVELOPMENT:** · Serve as a designated mentor for the PRWA Apprenticeship Program and provide structured guidance to apprentice operators. · Mentor apprentice operators and licensed operators through certification, competency development, career progression, and practical understanding of treat sor, Director of Plant Operations, and other supervisors regarding water quality, production, compliance, staffing, equipment, safety, and emergency issues. · Support workload balance, operational efficiency, employee development, and cross\-training within the Production Department and other plant functions as needed. · Maintain confidentiality, professional conduct, and positive working relationships with employees, departments, vendors, contractors, and regulatory representatives. · Accept delegated and additional responsibilities; attend off\-site training relevant to operations, equipment maintenance, supervision, regulatory compliance, process control, and emergency response when approved by the Authority. **MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS:** · High school diploma or GED required; Associate's or Bachelor's degree in Environmental Science, Engineering, Water Resources, Chemistry, Biology, or a related field preferred. Equivalent operational, supervisory, technical, or managerial experience may be considered by the Authority. · Six (6\) to eight (8\) years of progressively responsible experience in surface water treatment plant operations is preferred, including treatment process optimization, pumping systems, chemical feed systems, regulatory compliance, and emergency response. · Must have, obtain, and maintain the PA DEP Waterworks Operator license required to operate the Authority's treatment facilities. A Class A Waterworks Operator license with subclasses required by the Authority is preferred, or the ability to obtain required licensing within a timeframe established by the Authority. · Demonstrated experience leading or supervising operators, mentoring employees, coordinating operational activities, and supporting training or workforce development programs. · Working knowledge of SCADA systems, PLCs, HMI systems, instrumentation, process analyzers, flow and pressure transmitters, chemical feed controls, computerized maintenance management systems (CMMS), and asset management principles. · Knowledge of OSHA safety requirements, chemical handling, emergency response procedures, drinking water regulations, and compliance requirements applicable to treatment and pumping facilities. · Ability to assess operational issues, determine required actions, seek assistance when appropriate, direct others, coordinate response efforts, and follow issues through to satisfactory resolution. · Ability to communicate effectively, orally and in writing, and prepare clear records, procedures, reports, training materials, summaries, emails, and operational documentation. · Must be professional, self\-directed, organized, accurate, detail\-oriented, and able to demonstrate initiative, sound judgment, confidentiality, and effective decision\-making. · Computer literate and experienced with Windows, word processing, spreadsheets, databases, operational software, and the ability to learn SCADA historian tools, and other business or process control applications. · Must possess and maintain a valid driver's license and be able to respond to after\-hours operational emergencies. · Must be able to work in the presence of chlorine gas or anhydrous ammonia while wearing a self\-contained breathing apparatus, subject to applicable training and safety requirements. · Must be able to operate manual valves, climb stairs and ladders, negotiate catwalks, bend and squat to inspect equipment, open pit lids, and read gauges, meters, charts, and process displays. · Must have no physical limitations that would prevent performance of the essential functions of this position, with or without reasonable accommodation. Pay: $90,000\.00 \- $110,000\.00 per year Benefits: * 401(k) * 401(k) matching * Dental insurance * Dependent health insurance coverage * Employee assistance program * Health insurance * Life insurance * Military leave * Paid time off * Professional development assistance * Retirement plan * Tuition reimbursement * Vision insurance Work Location: In person

Preferably mechanical, manufacturing, production or automation engineering. * 5\+ years of related experience and/or training in a related field. * Ability to manage and collaborate with a team to work on multiple projects at a time. * Familiar with modeling (3D) software, Firmware or software as appropriate to the position. Understanding of analytical tools (such as FEA) a bonus. * Lean design and/or lean manufacturing understanding. * Familiar with manufacturing processes such as industrial equipment manufacturing, sheet steel design, busbar design, control systems, PCB design, materials processing, and manufacturing methods. * Solid grasp of engineering principles in electric fields, specifically medium voltage, heat transfer, material properties. jobs.title: Founding Forward Deployed Engineer
jobs.description: **About Cinchapi:** Cinchapi is where business runs itself. Our operational AI platform powers Ambient Agents that own ongoing outcomes, guided by your high\-level goals and KPIs. Instead of directing AI task by task, you define what success looks like. Ambient Agents figure out how to achieve and sustain it by working continuously in the background to plan, act, orchestrate workflows, and adapt as conditions change. For enterprises and small businesses alike, Cinchapi turns fragmented data and AI into operations that run autonomously. We’re an Atlanta\-based, founder\-led company at an inflection point: the product is live, the AI market is exploding, and we’re ready to build a repeatable revenue engine. That’s where you come in. The role: We’re hiring a Founding Forward Deployed Engineer to help our first customers put Cinchapi to work in their businesses. You’ll work directly with the founder, engineering team, and go\-to\-market lead, taking customer deployments from the first technical conversation through production and ongoing improvement. The work starts with understanding how a business operates: what people are trying to accomplish, where work gets stuck, and which systems and data they depend on. From there, you’ll design and build a solution on the Cinchapi platform, connecting systems, developing agent capabilities, and making sure the deployment delivers the results we agreed on with the customer. Our initial focus is mid\-market companies, with select enterprise design partners where there’s a strong fit. You might work directly with an operations leader on one engagement and navigate an IT team’s security and integration requirements on another. You’ll need to be comfortable with both. This is a hands\-on engineering role, not a position where you write recommendations and hand implementation to someone else. You’ll write production code, troubleshoot real systems, and stay involved after launch. As our first FDE, you’ll also help us figure out how to make deployments more consistent and less dependent on custom work as we grow. What you'll do: Work with customers to understand their operations, identify a useful starting point, and agree on what success looks like. You’ll turn a broad business goal into a practical scope, with clear requirements and measurable outcomes. Build the integrations, data connections, agent capabilities, and interfaces needed to make a deployment work. You’ll use the Cinchapi platform wherever it fits and write the code needed to connect it to the customer’s environment. Configure Ambient Agents around the customer’s goals and KPIs, giving them the context, tools, permissions, and boundaries they need to operate effectively over time. Establish how we test and monitor each deployment. You’ll evaluate agent behavior, handle failure cases, and decide where human review or approval is needed, taking reliability, security, privacy, and operating costs into account. Take promising prototypes into production. That includes resolving integration issues, managing technical scope, documenting how the system works, and making sure someone can diagnose and recover from problems after launch. Partner with the go\-to\-market lead on technical discovery, demos, and pilot design. They’ll own the commercial process; you’ll help determine what we can deliver, what it will take, and how we’ll demonstrate its value. Help customer teams understand and use what you build. You’ll lead practical training, answer questions honestly, and make sure customers know how to oversee their agents and when to step in. Bring recurring needs and deployment lessons back to the engineering team. When an integration or capability would help multiple customers, you’ll help turn it into something reusable rather than rebuilding it for every engagement. Develop the implementation practices, documentation, and tools that future FDEs will use. As the team grows, you’ll help hire and mentor the people who join you. What success looks like: In your first 90 days, you’ll develop a working command of the platform and lead an initial customer deployment from discovery into production. You’ll establish success metrics and reliability checks, while documenting the gaps and lessons we should address before the next deployment. By six months, you’ll have evidence of customer value from live deployments and a clearer understanding of which use cases we can deliver reliably. Useful integrations and implementation patterns should be reusable, and customer feedback should be informing product improvements. By the end of the first year, we should have a repeatable approach to technical delivery, customers who can point to measurable improvements in their operations, and a foundation that allows additional FDEs to become productive without starting from scratch. We’ll judge the work by how well it serves customers over time, not just how quickly we can launch a pilot. Who you are: You have roughly five or more years of software engineering experience and have taken systems from an incomplete set of requirements into production. You’re a strong generalist who can work across backend services, APIs, and data, with enough frontend experience to build a usable interface when needed. We care more about what you’ve built and owned than how many years you’ve spent with a particular framework. We’re especially interested in how you work: You’ve built with LLMs or agentic systems beyond a basic demo. You can explain how you tested their behavior, what failed, and how you decided they were ready for real users. You’re comfortable working directly with customers. You ask good questions, listen to how people actually do their jobs, and can explain technical decisions to both an engineer and a business owner. You have a solid grasp of data modeling, querying, APIs, authentication, and integrations. You can debug a problem that spans several systems, including ones you didn’t build. You can take an ambiguous goal and propose a sensible path forward. You know when to reuse an existing capability, when custom code is justified, and when a request needs to be narrowed or reconsidered. You’re honest about what AI can and cannot do. You’re willing to explain a limitation, raise a concern, or recommend human oversight rather than make a promise the system can’t keep. You can manage competing priorities across customer engagements without losing track of commitments. You communicate risks early and stay accountable when something goes wrong. You’re based in Atlanta or willing to relocate, and you can travel up to 25% for customer work and events. Previous experience in forward deployed engineering, an early\-stage engineering team, or hands\-on technical consulting would be especially useful. So would experience navigating enterprise deployment requirements, teaching non\-technical teams, or turning customer\-specific work into a reusable product. Compensation and benefits: Base salary: $150,000–$180,000, depending on experience. Equity: 0\.75%–1% in stock options, vesting over four years with a one\-year cliff. Benefits: Health reimbursement and flexible PTO. This is a full\-time engineering role with meaningful ownership in the company. As our founding FDE, you’ll help shape both how we deliver for customers and how the team grows. Why this role: You’ll get to build software and work directly with the people who depend on it. You’ll see where the product helps, where it falls short, and have a direct hand in improving it. Because you’re joining early, you’ll also shape how Cinchapi works with customers and how the forward deployed engineering team grows. If you like understanding a business problem, building the solution, and staying close enough to see whether it actually worked, this role gives you responsibility for all three. jobs.title: Business Analyst
jobs.description: Cognizant is a large IT Consulting Firm that leverages modern technologies to transform a variety of business operations. We are seeking a data\-driven Business Analyst to design and optimize customer support, teleoperations, and remote assistance workflows for our autonomous taxi (robotaxi) fleet. In this role, you will act as the bridge between autonomous vehicle operations and rider support. While you will not be performing raw point\-cloud or sensor signal processing, you must bring a solid conceptual understanding of the autonomous stack—including ADAS, LiDAR, radar, and camera perception—to accurately translate vehicle events into real\-time agent workflows. You will pair this domain literacy with strong SQL, Python, and modern dashboarding skills, alongside hands\-on application of GenAI and GenBI, to automate customer interactions and drive fleet performance insights. Please note that this role is fully onsite in Plano, TX . Role Responsibilities **Autonomous Fleet \& Teleoperations Workflows:** Define functional requirements for contact center agents and remote\-guidance operators handling robotaxi edge cases (e.g., sensor\-degradation alerts, pick\-up/drop\-off deadlocks, unexpected stops). Translate vehicle health, perception status flags (LiDAR/radar/camera health indicators), and ADAS state transitions into clear operational triggers for the support team. **Define and track mission\-critical metrics:** Time\-to\-Intervene (TTI), Mean Time to Resolve (MTTR), First Contact Resolution (FCR), and Rider Safety NPS. **Data Analytics, SQL \& Dashboard Engineering:** Write complex SQL queries across relational databases and cloud data warehouses (Snowflake, BigQuery, or Redshift) to track intervention trends, fleet exceptions, and call center throughput. Use Python (Pandas, NumPy) for exploratory data analysis, pattern identification in incident data, and automated reporting scripts. Design, build, and maintain production\-grade operational dashboards using Power BI, Tableau, or QuickSight to deliver real\-time operational visibility to executive and operations teams. **GenAI \& GenBI Implementation:** Specify functional requirements for contact center GenAI tools: real\-time call summarization, automated agent response recommendations, and context\-aware action triggers. Support the rollout of GenBI tools (e.g., Power BI Copilot, ThoughtSpot, Amazon Q) to enable operations stakeholders to query fleet and support data using natural language. Collaborate with AI engineers to design safety guardrails, prompt templates, and evaluation criteria for customer\-facing conversational agents inside the vehicle. **Agile Delivery \& Product Backlog:** Author detailed PRDs, user stories, acceptance criteria, and process flow diagrams (BPMN) in Jira and Confluence. Partner with Teleoperations Leads, Fleet Operations, Data Engineers, and CCaaS engineering teams to deliver iterative platform upgrades. Desired Skills \& Experience **Domain Knowledge :** We would prefer someone with 3\+ years in the Automotive, ADAS, Autonomous Mobility, Connected Vehicle, or Fleet Telematics domain. This is not a hard requirement. **Conceptual literacy of autonomous vehicle systems:** LiDAR, Radar, Cameras, Ultrasonic sensors, and ADAS , including how sensor state degradation (weather, occlusion, hardware fault) impacts fleet routing and safety escalations (no low\-level sensor signal processing required). **Familiarity with autonomous vehicle concepts:** ODD (Operational Design Domain), disengagements, remote assist vs. direct drive, and SAE autonomy levels (L3–L5\). **Analytics \& Technical Toolkit:** **SQL:** Advanced capabilities in joining multi\-table schemas, writing window functions, query optimization, and aggregations. **P ython:** Strong working knowledge for data extraction, manipulation (Pandas), and incident data parsing. **BI \& Data Visualization:** Demonstrated track record building high\-impact operational dashboards in Tableau, Power BI, or Looker. **GenAI / GenBI:** Hands\-on exposure to implementing or evaluating LLM\-driven features (e.g., prompt workflows, conversational AI, natural language querying for BI). **Business Analysis \& Operations:** Proven experience in requirements gathering, process mapping, and root\-cause analysis. Exposure to modern Contact Center / CCaaS platforms (e.g., Amazon Connect, Genesys, Twilio Flex) is a distinct advantage. **Salary and Other Compensation:** The annual salary for this position is between $110,000 \- $140,000 depending on experience and other qualifications of the successful candidate. This position is also eligible for Cognizant’s discretionary annual incentive program, based on performance and subject to the terms of Cognizant’s applicable plans. **Benefits:** Cognizant offers the following benefits for this position, subject to applicable eligibility requirements: Medical/Dental/Vision/Life Insurance Paid holidays plus Paid Time Off 401(k) plan and contributions Long\-term/Short\-term Disability Paid Parental Leave Employee Stock Purchase Plan **Disclaimer:** The salary, other compensation, and benefits information is accurate as of the date of this posting. Cognizant reserves the right to modify this information at any time, subject to applicable law.

jobs.title: Staff Software Engineer (Backend) - Payments
jobs.description: Collectors is the leading creator of innovative technology that provides value\-added services for collectors worldwide. We grade, authenticate, vault, and sell millions of record\-setting collectibles, all while modernizing and digitalizing the process to further our mission of helping collectors pursue their passions. We’re always on the lookout for talented people to join our growing team. Our services span collectible trading cards, autographs, comic books, coins, video games, event tickets, and memorabilia. Our subsidiaries include PSA, PCGS, Beckett, SGC, and Card Ladder. Since our founding in 1986, we have graded and authenticated millions of items. We employ more than 3000 people across our headquarters in Santa Ana, California and offices in New Jersey, Texas, Florida, Japan, Shanghai, Hong Kong, Canada, Mexico, Germany, the UK, and France. As part of our interview process, we request that candidates have their cameras on during video interviews. This helps foster meaningful conversation and allows us to create an experience that closely resembles our standard working environment. Certain interview steps may take place by phone. For remote roles, and at our discretion, candidates may be asked to participate in an on\-site interview as part of the final stages of the process. We understand there may be occasional circumstances requiring accommodation and are happy to discuss them as needed. Your recruiter will be able to clarify expectations and answer any questions you have. **About Collectors** ==================== Collectors is the leading creator of innovative technology that provides value\-added services for collectors worldwide. We grade, authenticate, vault, and sell millions of record\-setting collectibles, all while modernizing and digitalizing the process to further our mission of helping collectors pursue their passions. Our services span collectible trading cards, autographs, comic books, coins, video games, event tickets, and memorabilia. Our subsidiaries include PSA, PCGS, Beckett, SGC, and Card Ladder. Since our founding in 1986, we have graded and authenticated millions of items, and today we employ more than 3,000 people across our headquarters in Santa Ana, California and offices in New Jersey, Texas, Florida, Japan, Shanghai, Hong Kong, Canada, Mexico, Germany, and France. We're transforming the collecting experience with technology that brings authentication, grading, and trading into the modern era. Our products are equalizing the playing field by providing tools that make complex research analytics — including pricing, scarcity reports, and historic sales data — accessible to every collector, old or new. Our Product \& Engineering mission is to democratize technology while promoting innovation, collaboration, and continuous learning throughout the organization. **About the Role** ================== We are looking for a Staff Software Engineer to set the technical direction for our Payments team — a critical engineering domain responsible for building, scaling, and evolving the payments infrastructure that powers every transaction across the Collectors ecosystem. This team owns the full lifecycle of payment capabilities: integrating with and abstracting across multiple payment gateway providers (including Stripe and PayPal), supporting payment methods spanning credit card, ACH, and digital wallets, and building both the APIs that downstream services depend on and the web application experiences that customers and internal tools rely on. As a Staff Software Engineer, your influence extends beyond your team to the technology organization. Payments is the financial backbone of our marketplace — touching grading order checkout, vault and consignment transactions, partner payouts, and customer wallet top\-ups. PostgreSQL) and NoSQL (e.g. DynamoDB).** Schema design, migrations, query performance, and the realities of shared\-database coupling between services. * **Strong distributed\-systems fundamentals.** Service boundaries, API and contract design, Kafka\-based event\-driven architectures, messaging, idempotency, and failure handling — designed and operated in production. * **Production AWS and Kubernetes depth,** with infrastructure\-as\-code fluency (CDK and/or Terraform). * **A track record of raising engineering standards** across testing strategy, observability, documentation, and issues. * **Security\-minded.** You treat payment security as a first\-class engineering concern, not an afterthought, and partner with Security and Compliance to maintain and advance our certifications. * **AI\-first engineer.** Daily fluency with AI coding assistants and agentic tools (Claude Code, Copilot, Cursor, or similar), experience integrating them into team workflows (CI, code review, documentation), and mature judgment about verification, security, and the limits of AI\-generated code. * **Familiar with Agile/Scrum methodologies.** You're comfortable working in jobs.description: **JOB SUMMARY:** We are seeking a senior technology leader to own CFSB's cloud strategy, platform engineering, and cloud operating model. (2x per week) for those located in the NYC Metro Area, or fully\-remote in 23 select states\*****RESPONSIBILITIES:*****Cloud Strategy and Roadmap**** Own and maintain the multi\-year cloud strategy funding and alignment for cloud investments. * Set cloud target architecture and standards with Enterprise Architecture — reference patterns, approved services, and guardrails for what teams may build. * Define and report program metrics — migration progress, platform reliability, control coverage, and unit cost trends — and advise leaders on build\-versus\-buy and cloud\-versus\-on\-premises change. * Own the cloud CI/CD, container, and DevOps tooling that squads consume, and enforce engineering standards for code review, environment promotion, change management, and documentation. * Ensure environments meet availability and recovery objectives; lead resilience testing and serve as senior escalation point for major incidents through to permanent corrective action. ***Cloud Security, Risk, and Regulatory Compliance**** Own the implementation and evidencing of cloud technical controls that satisfy policies and standards set by Information Security, Risk, and Compliance, and escalate gaps where cloud reality and policy diverge. * Serve as the cloud subject matter expert in internal audit, external audit, and regulatory examinations, including FFIEC and GLBA compliance monitoring — and remediate findings and drift to agreed timelines. * Contribute cloud expertise to risk assessments, third\-party technology reviews, and change and exception review boards; provide input to cloud policies as a reviewer, with ownership, approval, and risk acceptance resting with the second\-line functions. ***Cost Management and Vendor Relationship**** Own the cloud budget: forecast spend, cost savings plan, and explain variances to Finance and the \[CIO/CTO]. * Manage the AWS relationship, including account team engagement, support tier decisions, and technical retain cloud engineers; set goals, coach, conduct performance reviews, and create clear technical development paths so no critical capability rests on a single person. * Balance squad\-embedded assignments against core platform work as priorities shift, and represent cloud engineering in technology leadership forums. **KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS, AND ABILITIES:*****Technical**** Deep hands\-on AWS expertise across IAM, networking, compute, storage, database, and cost management. * Strong cloud networking: VPC and subnet design, Transit Gateway, CloudWAN, segmentation, and hybrid connectivity. * Proven infrastructure\-as\-code experience, Terraform preferred — modules, state, and refactoring into code. * Experience with Git\-based workflows, CI/CD, and container platforms such as ECS or EKS at production scale. * Cloud security and multi\-account governance: least\-privilege IAM, encryption, secrets, and Control Tower. * Capable of leading complex, multi\-step, large scale infrastructure related activities like data\-center exit migrations, VPN cutovers, Database migrations, among others. ***Professional**** Sound judgment under constraint, balancing delivery speed against risk, cost, and regulatory obligation. * Technical credibility with engineers and fluency in front of executives, auditors, and examiners. * Succeeds through Security, Risk, and delivery teams, with a strong hiring and development record. * Proven track record leading teams towards successful and timely execution of commitments to executive leadership and board of directors. **EDUCATION, TRAINING, AND EXPERIENCE:*** Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, or equivalent experience. * 10\+ years in technology infrastructure, platform, or cloud engineering, including 3\+ years leading technical teams. * Demonstrated ownership of a production cloud environment at enterprise scale, not solely advisory, architecture\-only, or program\-management exposure. * Experience in a regulated industry with formal audit, control, and change\-management discipline, including direct support of audits or examinations; financial services experience and familiarity with FFIEC guidance and GLBA preferred. **About Community Federal Savings Bank (CFSB)** Community Federal Savings Bank (CFSB) is a federally chartered bank founded in 2001 and headquartered in New York City.
