jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer
jobs.description: **Company Overview** -------------------- Docusign brings agreements to life. Over 1\.5 million customers and more than a billion people in over 180 countries use Docusign solutions to accelerate the process of doing business and simplify people’s lives. With intelligent agreement management, Docusign unleashes business\-critical data that is trapped inside of documents. Until now, these were disconnected from business systems of record, costing businesses time, money, and opportunity. Using Docusign’s Intelligent Agreement Management platform, companies can create, commit, and manage agreements with solutions created by the \#1 company in e\-signature and contract lifecycle management (CLM). **What you'll do** ------------------ We are building a cutting\-edge ecosystem for Docusign that will empower developers to seamlessly integrate and extend Docusign's features and applications by implementing custom APIs. As a Senior Software Engineer, you will be responsible for leading medium to large initiatives and scaling the Developer platform, ensuring that it is robust, secure, and easy to use for builders looking to plug into Docusign's growing IAM ecosystem. In this role, you will collaborate closely with cross\-functional teams across the organization, driving platform architecture and feature development. Your work will impact multiple engineering and product teams as you lead the development of the platform's foundational features. Additionally, guiding architectural decisions, and managing incident response processes that require being on rotational on\-call, and coordination both within the team and other teams within the organization. This position is an individual contributor role reporting to the Director, Software Engineering. **Responsibility** * Design and optimize secure and scalable systems, including queueing architectures, NoSQL, and SQL storage systems, to handle the diverse needs of the ecosystem * Provide technical guidance and mentorship, fostering a culture of innovation, continuous learning, and high performance within the engineering team * Create secure, efficient backend services and agents in Javascript or other object\-oriented programming languages * Develop and maintain feedback loops for your AI Agents * Work directly with customers and internal teams to understand needs and iterate quickly * Adapt quickly to new technologies, coding languages and domains * Raise issues proactively that might impact delivery commitments * Participate in Agile environments using Scrum software development practices, automated unit testing, CI/CD, code reviews, and version control systems (Git) **Job Designation** ------------------- **Hybrid:** Employee divides their time between in\-office and remote work. Access to an office location is required. (Frequency: Minimum 2 days per week; may vary by team but will be weekly in\-office expectation) Positions at Docusign are assigned a job designation of either In Office, Hybrid or Remote and are specific to the role/job. Preferred job designations are not guaranteed when changing positions within Docusign. Docusign reserves the right to change a position's job designation depending on business needs and as permitted by local law. **What you bring** ------------------ **Basic** * Bachelor's degree * 8\+ years of software development experience, with a focus on cloud platforms and large\-scale systems * Experience with Azure services, queueing systems, SQL databases (e.g., Azure SQL Database, SQL Server) and NoSQL solutions (e.g., CosmosDB) * Experience with NodeJS, C\#, Java, C\+\+, or Go * Experience building AI Agents and prompt engineering * Experience using AI\-assisted development tools (e.g., LLMs for coding assistance, code generation) to accelerate software delivery * Experience with RESTful APIs, GraphQL APIs, and microservices architecture and APIs at scale * Experience developing software solutions using object\-oriented methodologies and design patterns **Preferred** * Knowledge and experience in high scale, highly available systems * 3\+ years professional experience building complex, scalable applications * Excellent problem\-solving skills * Curiosity and ability to learn new technologies and tool sets * Experience with NodeJS technology stack and various databases * Familiarity with Microservice architecture * Experience with Cloud platforms like Microsoft Azure or AWS * Care deeply about writing high\-performance, reusable code for components that will be used across our product **Wage Transparency** --------------------- Pay for this position is based on a number of factors including geographic location and may vary depending on job\-related knowledge, skills, and experience. Based on applicable legislation, the below details pay ranges in the following locations: California: $164,700\.00 \- $266,000\.00 base salary Washington, Maryland, New Jersey and New York (including NYC metro area): $158,300\.00 \- $232,575\.00 base salary This role is also eligible for the following: * Bonus: Sales personnel are eligible for variable incentive pay dependent on their achievement of pre\-established sales goals. Non\-Sales roles are eligible for a company bonus plan, which is calculated as a percentage of eligible wages and dependent on company performance. * Stock: This role is eligible to receive Restricted Stock Units (RSUs). Global benefits provide options for the following: * Paid Time Off: earned time off, as well as paid company holidays based on region * Paid Parental Leave: take up to six months off with your child after birth, adoption or foster care placement * Full Health Benefits Plans: options for 100% employer paid and minimum employee contribution health plans from day one of employment * Retirement Plans: select retirement and pension programs with potential for employer contributions * Learning and Development: options for coaching, online courses and education reimbursements * Compassionate Care Leave: paid time off following the loss of a loved one and other life\-changing events **Life at Docusign** -------------------- **Working here** Docusign is committed to building trust and making the world more agreeable for our employees, customers and the communities in which we live and work. You can count on us to listen, be honest, and try our best to do what’s right, every day. At Docusign, everything is equal. We each have a responsibility to ensure every team member has an equal opportunity to succeed, to be heard, to exchange ideas openly, to build lasting relationships, and to do the work of their life. Best of all, you will be able to feel deep pride in the work you do, because your contribution helps us make the world better than we found it. And for that, you’ll be loved by us, our customers, and the world in which we live. **Accommodation** Docusign is committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities in our job application procedures. If you need such an accommodation, or a religious accommodation, during the application process, please contact us at accommodations@docusign.com. If you experience any issues, concerns, or technical difficulties during the application process please get in touch with our Talent organization at taops@docusign.com for assistance.

jobs.title: Forward Deployed Engineering Lead (SF)
jobs.description: **Why Join Doppel** Doppel is building the future of social engineering defense. Our AI\-native platform uses agentic AI to protect executives, employees, customers, and brands from phishing, impersonation, fraud, and other AI\-powered threats across digital channels. We help some of the world’s most recognized brands detect and dismantle attacker infrastructure while strengthening employee resilience through threat\-informed training and simulation. By unifying Digital Risk Protection, Human Risk Management and Email Security, Doppel connects threats into a real\-time intelligence graph to power faster disruption, smarter defense, and modern security awareness at scale. Backed by leading investors including Andreessen Horowitz and Bessemer Venture Partners, and trusted by leading enterprises, Doppel is a rapidly growing Series C startup building the future of social engineering defense. Our team combines deep cybersecurity expertise, operational rigor, and startup velocity to solve some of the internet’s most urgent trust and safety challenges. **What We're Building** We're building the AI\-native social engineering defense platform. This means we're designing scalable systems that monitor billions of domains, social media accounts, apps, dark web forums, etc., and leverage AI agents to identify and neutralize digital threats. **What You'll Do** Doppel's Forward Deployed Engineering team owns the onboarding of our biggest enterprise customers as effective and low touch as possible You'll work directly with our largest enterprise customers alongside GTM and Product to understand their onboarding needs, scope and prioritize technical solutions, and build the end\-to\-end systems that get customers integrated with Doppel’s core offerings. You'll lead the technical direction of the whole FDE team while staying hands\-on with our hardest integrations and most strategic deployments. As Doppel's customer base and product portfolio expand, you'll help turn what we learn in the field into reusable capabilities that make every future deployment faster and easier. * **Lead FDE technically.** Set technical direction, mentor engineers, unblock complex projects, and raise the engineering bar while remaining hands\-on. * **Own our most strategic deployments.** Join customers from technical discovery through production rollout, identifying onboarding friction, scoping solutions, and driving the engineering work required to get them live. * **Build end\-to\-end solutions.** Architect, build, and debug across APIs, webhooks, SIEM/SOAR platforms, identity systems, email infrastructure, and the broader enterprise security stack. * **Turn field work into product.** Identify patterns across customer deployments and turn bespoke solutions into reusable product and platform capabilities. * **Make deployment increasingly scalable.** Build the systems, automation, and internal tooling that make every new customer faster and easier to launch than the last. * **Shape the product from the field.** Create a tight feedback loop between customers, GTM, Product, and Engineering so what we're learning from our largest customers influences what we build. * **Help shape FDE's technical boundaries.** Develop strong judgment around what FDE should build, what should graduate into core product or platform, and where FDE should partner with other engineering teams. **What we’re looking for** * **Strong software engineering foundation.** 6\+ years building and shipping production software, with the technical depth to make architecture decisions and contribute directly to the codebase. * **Technical leadership experience.** You've set technical direction, mentored engineers, and driven complex projects while remaining hands\-on. * **Customer\-facing technical depth.** You've worked directly with complex enterprise customers, can uncover technical needs, and can turn ambiguous problems into scoped production systems. * **Experience with enterprise systems.** You're comfortable working across APIs, webhooks, identity and authentication (OAuth, SAML, SCIM), and enterprise infrastructure. Experience with security platforms or SIEM/SOAR ecosystems is a plus. * **Product instincts.** You recognize patterns across customer needs and know when something should remain customer\-specific versus becoming a reusable product or platform capability. * **High agency in ambiguity.** You cut through organizational and technical blockers to get things done. You figure out who to pull in across Sales, Customer Success, Product, and Engineering, chase down missing context, and create the connections and processes needed to move customer problems from ambiguity to production. * **Strong technical judgment and communication.** You can move comfortably between a customer call, system design, debugging with an engineer, and working with Product on what should be built next. * **AI\-native mindset.** Experience building with LLMs, agents, or AI\-powered workflows is a plus, but we're most interested in engineers who are excited to use AI to change how technical customer work gets done. **Join Doppel** =============== Doppel is the first platform built to dismantle digital deception at scale. We scan over 150 billion entities daily and deploy continuously adaptive AI SOC agents, paired with expert human analysts, to uncover and disrupt the infrastructure behind phishing, impersonation, and online fraud before attacks can spread. Our Threat Grid turns every customer signal into shared intelligence, making each disruption smarter, faster, and more effective. We’re not just another cybersecurity company. We’re defining the future of social engineering defense, where trust is protected, and deception becomes unprofitable. Backed by top\-tier investors and trusted by some of the world’s most recognized brands, Doppel is growing fast. If you’re driven to solve real\-world problems with bold technology, we’d love to meet you. Compensation Range: $120K \- $250K

jobs.title: Digital Instrumentation & Control Design Engineer I OR Engineer II – Oconee Nuclear Station
jobs.description: **Important Application Submission Information** In order to ensure your application is successfully received before the job posting expires, please submit your application by 11:59 PM on Thursday, October 1, 2026**More than a career \- a chance to make a difference in people's lives.** -------------------------------------------------------------------------- Build an exciting, rewarding career with us – help us make a difference for millions of people every day. Consider joining the Duke Energy team, where you'll find a friendly work environment, opportunities for growth and development, recognition for your work, and competitive pay and benefits. *Depending upon the desired qualifications of the successful applicant, the hiring manager may elect to fill this position at a higher level within the job hierarchy.* **Build the Future of Nuclear Energy** -------------------------------------- Join Duke Energy’s Instrumentation \& Control (I\&C) Design Engineering team at Oconee Nuclear Station and help modernize a three\-unit nuclear generating facility that provides safe, reliable, carbon\-free electricity to the Carolinas. In this role, you will develop engineering solutions that support continued operation into the 2050s. You will gain hands\-on experience with plant systems and contribute to projects ranging from targeted component upgrades to major digital control\-system replacements. You will work with experienced engineers and multidisciplinary partners across Operations, Maintenance, Projects, Licensing, Cybersecurity, vendors, and external design organizations. The role offers structured qualification, mentoring, increasing technical ownership, and opportunities to lead a modification from concept through installation, testing, and turnover. **Position Overview** --------------------- **Nuclear Engineer I** is an entry\-level position for candidates who are ready to apply engineering fundamentals in a highly regulated, team\-oriented environment. Work is performed with close supervision while the engineer builds technical proficiency, completes required qualifications, and progressively assumes greater independence. **Nuclear Engineer II** is an intermediate\-level position for candidates with experience in nuclear power, electric utilities, power generation, industrial controls, regulated facilities, digital control systems, or another directly related engineering environment. Engineers at this level apply established concepts and procedures to varied, moderately complex assignments under general supervision and are expected to demonstrate increasing technical depth, judgment, and independence. At either level, you will develop and support plant modifications involving instrumentation and controls, AC and DC power and control systems, digital hardware, software\-based applications, plant computer interfaces, control circuits, and cybersecurity\-related design requirements. After completing the required training and qualification program, you may serve as the Responsible Engineer—the primary technical owner for an assigned modification—through design, planning, installation, testing, turnover, and closeout. Prior nuclear modification\-engineer qualifications may be considered when establishing your qualification plan. The successful candidate will bring strong attention to detail, clear communication, sound technical judgment, a commitment to safety, and the ability to learn and work effectively across organizational boundaries. **Key Responsibilities** ------------------------ * Develop engineering modifications for electrical, instrumentation and control, digital, software, and cybersecurity\-related systems. * Define project scope, technical requirements, design basis, installation approach, testing, acceptance criteria, and turnover strategy. * Prepare accurate, traceable engineering products such as calculations, specifications, drawings, design inputs, evaluations, setpoints, and test plans. * Evaluate design alternatives, technical risk, operating experience, lifecycle needs, and stakeholder input; document clear recommendations and their basis. * Develop conceptual designs and technical specifications and coordinate engineering work performed by vendors and external design firms. * When qualified, serve as the Responsible Engineer and primary technical contact for assigned modifications from design through closeout. * Review installation work instructions and implementation packages to confirm that the approved design is correctly translated into field activities and testing. * Provide field, outage, and implementation support while maintaining configuration control, procedural compliance, and design authority. * Perform or coordinate design reviews, digital and software evaluations, cybersecurity assessments, licensing evaluations, and post\-modification testing. * Apply a strong nuclear safety culture, conservative decision\-making, human\-performance tools, and rigorous procedure use. * C n, operations, maintenance, or project implementation experience. * Nuclear utility modification\-engineer qualification or comparable experience leading engineering changes through implementation. * Experience developing or reviewing digital hardware, software, firmware, network, virtualization, plant computer, or control\-system modifications. * Experience with digital interfaces or protocols such as Modbus, OPC DA, or OPC UA and with migration of legacy systems to modern infrastructure. * Experience applying systems\-engineering principles to the lifecycle of digital modifications, including stakeholder needs, requirements, architecture, testing, implementation, and turnover. * Working knowledge of digital\-upgrade licensing considerations, 10 CFR 50\.59, and 10 CFR 73\.54 cybersecurity requirements. * Experience developing digital or software modification test plans and acceptance criteria. * Experience with an engineering\-change or work\-management system; Nuclear Asset Suite experience is beneficial but not required. * Demonstrated commitment to technical rigor, configuration control, procedure use and adherence, and nuclear safety culture. * Strong professional oral and written communication skills. * Ability to research engineering and design issues, evaluate alternatives, develop sound recommendations, and present the supporting basis. * Ability to work effectively in a team environment and accept coaching while developing independent capability. **Working Conditions** ---------------------- * **Hybrid Mobility Classification** – Work will be performed from both remote and onsite locations after the onboarding period. However, hybrid employees must live within a reasonable commute to their designated Duke Energy facility, not greater than 50 miles one way. Employees are expected to report to their assigned Duke Energy facility as required and directed by their manager, on average 3 full workdays per regular workweek. * On\-site presence is required during onboarding and qualification and as needed for project execution, plant walkdowns, outages, emergent support, and team activities. * The team typically works a four\-day, 10\-hour schedule. The balance of on\-site and remote work may vary based on business, qualification, and project needs. * Occasional travel to other company sites, industry facilities, vendor locations, conferences, and meetings. * Occasional off\-hours or extended\-hours support for outages, testing, plant conditions, storm response, or project implementation. **Additional Requirements** --------------------------- * Ability to obtain and maintain unescorted access to a nuclear facility, including required training, security screening, and compliance with the site Fitness for Duty Program. * Complete required engineering and Responsible Engineer qualifications before performing assigned modification work independently. * The role may include Emergency Response Organization responsibilities, callouts with a defined response time to the site, on\-call duty, and associated Fitness for Duty requirements. * Support utility storm response when assigned. * Ability to wear required personal protective equipment, including a hard hat, safety glasses, and fall protection, as applicable. * Ability to perform plant walkdowns and work in office, field, and industrial environments as required by assigned projects. * Occasional overnight travel, generally 5–10%. \#LI\-VF1 \#LI\-Hybrid **Travel Requirements** 5\-15%### **Relocation Assistance Provided (as applicable)** Yes### **Represented/Union Position** No### **Visa Sponsored Position** No. This is not a Visa Sponsored Position. This role requires the ability to work lawfully in the U.S. without employment\-based immigration sponsorship, now or in the future.### **Please note that in order to be considered for this position, you must possess all of the basic/required qualifications.** Privacy Do Not Sell My Personal Information (CA) Terms of Use Accessibility

jobs.title: Solution Design Engineer
jobs.description: Dynamic Quest is a managed services and cybersecurity firm. Every managed service and project we sell starts as a solution that someone has to design correctly: right architecture, right bill of materials, right labor estimate, right price, delivered on the date we committed to the client. The Solution Design Engineer is that person. You sit at the center of our quoting cycle. Sales brings the opportunity and the client’s requirements; you turn them into a solution that is technically sound, deliverable by our engineering teams, profitable for DQ, and competitive in the market. You work across four domains of managed infrastructure and you are expected to be credible in all of them, deep in at least two. This is a design and estimating role, not a sales role and not a delivery role. You are measured on the quality, speed, and accuracy of the solutions you produce and on how well those solutions perform once they are sold. **Where you fit in the process** DQ runs a structured Opportunity\-to\-Proposal model. Opportunities are classified by client type, size, and service type, and each class carries a defined proposal artifact, review path, and Proposal Commit Date (PCD). The PCD is a commitment to the client, and Design Engineering owns hitting it. Small and budgetary opportunities move fast: an AI\-assisted budgetary estimate is produced within one to two business days and you review it for technical sanity before it goes out. Larger opportunities go through full design: requirements, architecture, environment plan, work breakdown, bill of materials, and pricing, validated at technical and profitability gates before proposal assembly. You receive structured discovery inputs and you are expected to push back when they are incomplete. Designing on assumptions is how proposals lose money. **What you will do:** **Design solutions** * Translate client requirements and discovery data into complete, deliverable solutions across managed services (Quest Complete) and projects. * Produce the standard solution deliverables: work breakdown structure for project labor, environment plan, policy\-to\-configuration instructions for managed services onboarding, bill of materials, and pricing inputs. * Size hardware, software, licensing, and labor accurately. Select the right products and vendors from DQ’s standard catalog and justify exceptions. * Design to DQ standards so what you sell is what Engineering can build and Service Operations can run. **Own the quoting cycle** * Review AI\-assisted budgetary estimates for technical validity within the 24\-hour target and 48\-hour SLA. * Hit the Proposal Commit Date on every opportunity you own, and flag risk to the date early when discovery, vendor lead time, or scope threatens it. * Carry solutions through the Requirement, Technical, and Profitability validation gates, and present them for Deal Desk review when required. * Support Sales in client discovery and design sessions. Ask the questions that surface hidden scope before it becomes unbilled work. **Make the process better** * Build and maintain reusable design patterns, reference architectures, and estimating templates for common opportunity types. * Feed lessons from delivery back into design: when a sold solution runs over on labor or under on scope, you own understanding why and fixing the pattern. * Contribute to the discovery intake and quote tooling so the inputs you receive get better over time. * Keep current on vendor roadmaps and licensing changes across the four domains and update standards accordingly. * **Technology domains** * You are expected to design competently across all four domains and to be the deep expert in at least two. **Domain** **What you need to design and estimate** **End\-User Productivity** Windows and Mac OS workstations, Microsoft 365 (Exchange Online, SharePoint, OneDrive, Teams, Intune), Entra ID and identity design, DNS and domain services, licensing (Business Premium, E3/E5, add\-ons), endpoint lifecycle and imaging, MDM/MAM, and migration from legacy or competing platforms. **Cybersecurity** EDR/MDR, email security, MFA and conditional access, privileged access, vulnerability management, security awareness, backup and recovery design, SIEM and log retention, and alignment to frameworks (CIS Controls, NIST CSF, NIST SP 800\-171 / CMMC, HIPAA, PCI) as required by the client. **Network and Perimeter** LAN/WAN design, switching and wireless (enterprise vendors), next\-generation firewalls and UTM, SD\-WAN, VPN and zero\-trust access, segmentation and VLAN design, ISP and circuit selection, and structured cabling scope. **Data Center and Cloud** On\-premises virtualization (VMware, Hyper\-V), server and storage sizing, Azure (IaaS, networking, identity integration, cost estimation), hybrid designs, Azure Virtual Desktop, disaster recovery and business continuity architecture, and lift\-and\-shift vs. modernization tradeoffs. * **Seven or more years** in IT infrastructure roles, with at least three in a design, pre\-sales, solutions architecture, or senior engineering capacity at an MSP, VAR, or consultancy. * **Broad and current technical range** across the four domains above, with demonstrable depth in at least two. You can explain the tradeoffs in an Azure vs. on\-premises decision as fluently as a firewall replacement or an M365 licensing consolidation. * **Estimating discipline.** You can decompose a project into labor tasks, size them, and defend the number. You understand hardware and software margin and what makes a managed services contract profitable. * **Managed services fluency.** You understand how an MSP delivers, what is in and out of a managed agreement, and how a design decision becomes an operational cost or an operational win. * **Written clarity.** Your designs, assumptions, and scope statements are precise enough that a project engineer can build from them and a client can sign them. * **Deadline ownership.** You work to committed dates and raise risk early rather than late. **Strongly preferred** ---------------------- * Microsoft certifications (AZ\-104, AZ\-305, MS\-102, SC\-300 or equivalent) and one or more network or security vendor certifications (Fortinet, Cisco Meraki, Palo Alto, Aruba, or similar). * Experience with CMMC or other regulated environments where design choices carry compliance consequences. * Experience using a PSA and CPQ toolchain (Autotask, ConnectWise, Salesforce CPQ, or similar) to produce quotes and proposals. * Experience with vendor distribution and licensing programs (Microsoft CSP, Ingram, TD Synnex, or similar). * Comfort using AI\-assisted tools for discovery, estimation, and document production, and the judgment to know when the output is wrong. **What success looks like in the first year** * **90 days:** Owning budgetary reviews and small to medium opportunities end to end across at least two domains, hitting PCD, and producing designs that pass the technical gate without rework. * **6 months:** Owning large and mixed project\-plus\-managed\-services opportunities. At least two reusable reference designs or estimating templates published for the team. * **12 months:** Solutions you designed are delivering at or above their estimated margin. You are the recognized expert in at least one domain and are mentoring newer designers. **Who you will work with** * Sales and account management on discovery, requirements, and client presentations * Professional Services and PMO on estimates, work breakdown, and delivery feedback * Service Operations on managed services standards and operational supportability * Cybersecurity and GovSec teams on compliance\-driven designs * Deal Desk on profitability and contract validation * Procurement and vendor partners on pricing, availability, and lead time **Compensation and benefits** * Competitive salary, commensurate with experience * Medical, dental, and vision coverage * 401(k) with company match * Paid time off and company holidays * Professional development and vendor certification support *Dynamic Quest is an equal opportunity employer.*

jobs.title: Senior Administrative Clerk/Administrative Secretary II
jobs.description: **The Position** ---------------- **Application materials can only be accepted online beginning at 8:00 am on Wednesday, September 23, 2026\. Only the first 200 applications that meet the minimum requirements will be accepted by the Recruitment Division online at www.ebmud.com during the filing period.** Senior Administrative Clerks assume independent and advanced administrative responsibilities and may provide lead direction for subordinate clerical assistants, while Administrative Secretary II’s perform difficult and complex secretarial and administrative duties for division managers, section leaders, and professional staff. The incumbents in both positions exercise a wide latitude of independent judgment to support the administration and maintenance of significant office systems and procedures. Work responsibilities require advanced skills in writing and numerical calculations and the use of a PC and Microsoft software. Flexible/hybrid work from home schedule may be available for some positions in this job classification. Typical duties for both positions include: * Providing authoritative information, requiring the use of judgment and knowledge and interpretation of applicable rules, policies, and guidelines. * Providing lead direction to one or more clerical assistants, including scheduling, assigning, and reviewing the work. * Researching, assembling, and summarizing information from a variety of sources for use by managers in reports, budget preparation, correspondence, meetings, and presentations and completion of forms. * Organizing, processing, and maintaining paper files and online document management systems including construction files (e.g., RFIs, submittals, change orders, etc.). * Working effectively with a variety of East Bay Municipal Utility District (EBMUD) staff including field staff, technicians, engineers, inspectors, and office personnel. * Keying, checking, and proofreading a variety of materials including Board documents, reports, letters, memos, forms, and similar materials from rough drafts, plain or corrected copy or verbal instructions. * Inputting and retrieving data from computers, compiling, and generating a variety of reports and documents in support of assigned functions. * Organizing own work, setting priorities, meeting critical deadlines, and coordinating multiple activities with other EBMUD units to ensure timely completion. * Checking written materials for completion, grammatical, clerical, and arithmetic accuracy and for compliance with established standards and procedures, making corrections as required. * Performing a variety of general clerical duties such as processing electronic timesheets and payroll reports, preparing purchase orders, expense reports, periodic reports of activities and other documents and reports as necessary. Every employee adds value to the EBMUD team as they are committed to responsible stewardship of our resources. The employee standard is to act with integrity, treat others with respect, and value a teamwork culture while fulfilling EBMUD's mission to provide reliable, high\-quality water and wastewater services at fair rates. The most competitive candidates for positions in certain work groups will have some of the following specialized skills and experience: * Experience with or ability to quickly learn specialized software programs and applications specific to the work unit, including web\-based and web\-related applications. * Experience with or the ability to quickly learn to read and interpret engineering drawings, maps, and related documents. * Experience with or the ability to quickly learn fundamentals of finance and budget tracking, including calculations and reconciling financial documents. * Knowledge of and experience with various technical documents, including engineering and construction documents for advertisement and bidding. * Ability to work and interact effectively with members of outside agencies as well as the general public. * Ability to quickly learn and apply complex policies, procedures, and regulations. The initial monthly salary for both Senior Administrative Clerk and Administrative Secretary II is $7,813 per month increasing to $8,204, $8,614, $9,045 and $9,497 after 6, 18, 30, and 42 months, respectively. EBMUD is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified candidates will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, creed, sex, gender, gender identity (including transgender status), gender expression, marital or registered domestic partnership status, age for individuals age forty or older, national origin, ancestry, disability (mental or physical), medical condition (cancer and genetic characteristics), genetic information, sexual orientation, military and veterans status, family or medical leave status, pregnancy (including childbirth, lactation or related medical condition), pregnancy disability leave status, domestic violence victim status, political affiliation, and ot ia driver's license and a satisfactory driving record, in order to drive to other work locations and transport materials as needed. 5\. jobs.title: Experiential Designer
jobs.description: We are seeking a creative, strategic, and driven Experiential Designer to join our team. This role is ideal for a designer who thrives at the intersection of brand, space, culture, and human experience. As a key member of our design team, you will lead and contribute to a wide range of experiential design initiatives, transforming environments into memorable, meaningful experiences that connect people to places, brands, and organizations. You will be responsible for developing and guiding projects from visioning and discovery through concept development, design documentation, fabrication, and implementation. We are looking for a curious design thinker who can translate complex ideas into compelling experiences through storytelling, exhibits, branded environments, placemaking, wayfinding, digital experiences, experiential graphics, and immersive installations. The ideal candidate combines exceptional design talent with strong leadership skills, client acumen, and a passion for creating experiences that inspire engagement and leave lasting impact. **What You'll Do** * Lead the development of experiential design strategies from visioning and discovery through implementation and post\-occupancy evaluation. * Develop innovative, human\-centered experiences that support client goals, organizational culture, brand identity, and user needs. * Create compelling narratives that translate into physical, digital, and interactive experiences. * Guide projects through concept development, schematic design, design development, documentation, fabrication, and installation. * Ensure design excellence, quality control, and consistency across all project deliverables. **Drive Creative Excellence** * Create innovative experiential graphic, exhibit, signage, placemaking, and branded environment solutions. * Translate research, user insights, and stakeholder feedback into meaningful experiential opportunities. * Develop visual communication systems that enhance navigation, storytelling, interpretation, and engagement. * Explore emerging technologies, materials, and interactive experiences that push the boundaries of experiential design. * Champion design thinking and encourage innovation throughout the project team. **Build Strong Client Relationships** * Serve as a trusted creative partner to clients. * Lead and/or assist with discovery sessions, visioning workshops, stakeholder interviews, and collaborative design charrettes. * Present strategic recommendations and design concepts with confidence and clarity. * Facilitate conversations that uncover client aspirations, organizational culture, and experiential goals. * Build and foster long\-term relationships that contribute to future project opportunities and practice growth. **Collaborate Across Disciplines** * Work closely with architects, interior designers, strategists, planners, engineers, and project managers to deliver integrated project solutions. * Ensure experiential design goals are coordinated with architectural and interior design decisions. * Contribute to multidisciplinary design reviews and project critiques. * Collaborate with fabricators, production partners, vendors, and consultants to bring concepts to life. * Mentor colleagues and support the growth of the experiential design practice. **Contribute to Practice Growth** * Help identify new opportunities within existing and emerging markets. * Stay current on industry trends, best practices, technological advancements, and experiential design innovations. * Serve as an advocate for experiential design throughout the organization and within the larger design community. **What Makes You Successful** You are: * A strategic thinker who understands how experiences shape human behavior and perception. * Passionate about storytelling, placemaking, brand expression, and environmental communication. * Highly collaborative and skilled at building trust across diverse teams and stakeholders. * Detail\-oriented while maintaining a strong grasp of big\-picture project goals. * Self\-motivated, organized, and accountable for the quality and success of your work. **Qualifications Required** * Bachelor's degree in Graphic Design, Experiential Design, Environmental Design, Industrial Design, Architecture, Interior Design, or a related field. * 7\+ years of professional experience in experiential design, environmental graphic design, branded environments, exhibit design, or a closely related discipline. * Demonstrated experience leading projects from strategy and concept development through implementation. * Strong portfolio showcasing environmental graphics, wayfinding, exhibits, branded environments, placemaking, storytelling, digital experiences, or other experiential installations. * Expert proficiency in Adobe Creative Suite, including Illustrator, Photoshop, and InDesign. * Exceptional typographic, graphic communication, and information design skills. * Strong verbal, written, and visual presentation capabilities. * Ability to manage multiple projects, priorities, and deadlines simultaneously. * Experience presenting work directly to clients, stakeholders, and leadership teams. **Preferred** * Experience working within integrated architecture, interior design, or multidisciplinary design firms. * Working knowledge of Revit, SketchUp, Rhino, Enscape, Twinmotion, or other 3D visualization tools. * Experience designing and documenting architectural signage and wayfinding systems. * Familiarity with exhibit planning, fabrication processes, materials, and production methodologies. * Experience developing data visualization, interpretive graphics, and information\-rich environments. * Knowledge of brand strategy and brand implementation within physical environments. * Understanding of digital, interactive, and immersive experience platforms. * Experience mentoring or leading junior designers and interdisciplinary teams. **Work Environment \& Travel** * Work is performed in both office and project\-site environments. * Regional travel is common and may include client meetings, workshops, site visits, installations, and project reviews. * Flexibility to support client schedules, project deadlines, and installation activities outside traditional business hours when necessary. * The annual base compensation for this role is $65,000 to $85,000 based on skills and experience Equal Opportunity Employer/Protected Veterans/Individuals with Disabilities This employer is required to notify all applicants of their rights pursuant to federal employment laws. For further information, please review the Know Your Rights (https://www.eeoc.gov/poster) notice from the Department of Labor.

jobs.description: **Position Summary:** Under the administrative oversight of the Senior Network Engineer, incumbent maintains, supports, updates, upgrades, tests, and troubleshoots all layers of the complex physical and logical campus network infrastructure; cable plant, fiber and copper, telecommunications rooms, off campus sites, private departmental networks, T\-1 and DSL circuits, UPS, Core and Edge network switches, Core and distribution routers, Wireless Network Connectivity, Wide Area Network connectivity, packet shaping bandwidth management, network monitoring and management systems, Network Security Intrusion Detection Systems (IDS), Network Security Intrusion Prevention Systems (IPS), Firewalls, and Virtual Private Networks (VPN). **Essential Duties and Responsibilities:** * Under the administrative supervision of the Senior Network Engineer, incumbent: designs, operates, support, monitoring, trend analysis, forecasting, and testing of the Campus Local Area Network/Wide Area Network consisting of a full range on network equipment. * Monitoring and maintenance are performed using data gathered by Ciscoworks, WCS, Network Observer, Fluke fiber and copper network analyzers and other analysis and reporting devices. * Installs hardware and software network components to provide optimal quality to end\-users. * Provides technical and engineering expertise for all phases of the university's enterprise Wi\-Fi 802\.11 network lifecycle including architecture, design, placement surveys, feasibility studies, deployment strategies, precise documentation, troubleshooting, and operations management. responsible for. * Contributes to the success of EIU by performing other duties and assisting with projects, as assigned. * Supervision and training of student workers. **Minimum Qualifications:** * months) + Work experience in IT\-related functions, such as hardware/software support, programming, network design, network engineering, IT systems integration, or closely related field. * Based on position requirements, additional education, training, and/or work experience in the area of specialization inherent to the position may be required. **Knowledge, Skills and Abilities:** * Knowledge of the systems and operations used within the areas and departments of responsibility. * Excellent verbal and written communication skills. * Ability to oversee and coordinate activities of user groups. * Ability to effectively communicate with other colleagues, supervisors, administrative staff, and other IT users. * Ability to identify and resolve technical problems. * Ability to effectively communicate and professionally interact with all staff levels. **Work Hours** The core work hours of this position are Monday through Friday 8:00 a.m.\- 4:30 p.m. **Starting Salary/Pay Rate Range** Current starting salary range for this position is $60,000 \- $75,000 **Application Deadline:** October 5, 2026 In accordance with Eastern Illinois U s Overview:** Eastern Illinois University is proud to offer an excellent benefits package designed to support our employees' well\-being and career goals. **This position is eligible for the following benefits:** * **Comprehensive Medical Coverage:** Competitive employee insurance premiums with flexible plan options. * **Vision Insurance:** Vision coverage is included with medical at no cost. * **Dental Insurance:** Dental plans available to meet your needs. * **Retirement Benefits:** Participation in the State University Retirement System, which includes medical insurance benefits upon retirement. * **Tuition Waivers:** Opportunities to pursue educational goals through tuition waivers for employees and dependent children. * **Generous Paid Time Off:** Up to 12 paid holidays annually, plus earned vacation and sick time. For more information on our employee benefit programs for this specific position class, please visit https://www.eiu.edu/humanres/benefits/newemployees.php Eastern Illinois University is committed to fostering a learning community where all members feel welcomed and valued. jobs.title: RF Support Engineer

jobs.title: Database Software Developer
jobs.description: **Request For Proposal:** **Environmental Data Management Platform** Ensolum LLC is seeking an experienced senior full\-stack developer or small development team to help design and build an Environmental Data Management Platform for environmental consulting operations. Project Overview: The platform will provide consultants with an organized view of projects to which they have been granted access, along with associated field activities, laboratory results, regulatory criteria, deadlines and deliverables required by regulatory agencies. It will initially focus on oil spill response workflows while establishing a flexible foundation that can support additional environmental services over time. Data will be organized hierarchically around clients, with each client containing one or more sub clients, each sub client containing a collection of projects and each project requiring one or many environmental services that occur at one or more sites. Each project will store associated field activities, laboratory results, and project deliverables, including reports, tables, photologs and GIS figures. This structure will provide a consistent way to organize environmental data and project work while maintaining clear relationships between the client, project, service(s), sites, and relevant project documents. The platform must ingest Electronic Data Deliverable (EDD) data received from a variety of laboratory sources, transform the data into a standardized format and load it into a custom, project specific template. Templates will provide functionality to compare analytical results against applicable regulatory criteria and flag potential exceedances for review. Pending approval and lab QC validation, the table, or updates to the table will be added as a project deliverable. The platform must provide standard data tables and customizable data tables and completed deliverables must be exportable as CSV and XLSX. The platform must be able to integrate directly with ArcGIS to obtain coordinates and associated metadata for point, line, and polygon features collected through Field Maps. This integration will enable laboratory sample data to be spatially associated with corresponding field locations, providing a unified view of sample results, field activities, and spatial information within the project. The successful candidate or team will be responsible for both the underlying platform and the user experience. The application must be intuitive for environmental consultants who work with complex data but may not be technical users. **Key Responsibilities** **Product and UI/UX** * Design clear, efficient workflows for project setup, field data, EDD review, approvals, reporting, and GIS access * Develop responsive, accessible, and consistent user interfaces * Create dashboards, data tables, filters, search, maps, review queues, forms, and approval screens * Make data\-quality errors and regulatory exceedances easy to understand and resolve * Incorporate user feedback from the internal team and pilot clients **Full\-Stack Development** * Design and implement the frontend application and backend services * Build the EDD upload, parsing, transformation, validation, and approval workflow * Implement configurable QA/QC and regulatory rules * Design database relationships among clients, projects, sites, samples, documents, and deliverables * Integrate with ArcGIS for spatial data, coordinates, features, and sample relationships * Support CSV, XLSX, PDF, image, and other project\-related files * Implement role\-based access, tenant isolation, audit trails, versioning, and approvals * Develop report and deliverable\-generation features * Develop a custom data analytics system for sorting and viewing data to look for trends in projects, locations and over time * Support deployment, monitoring, troubleshooting, and future enhancements **Preferred Experience** * Strong full\-stack web application development experience * Excellent frontend skills and demonstrated UI/UX judgment * Experience building data\-heavy business applications * PostgreSQL database design and optimization * PostGIS or other spatial\-data experience * API design and third\-party integrations * Workflow, approval, and data\-validation systems * GIS or ArcGIS integration * Multi\-tenant SaaS architecture and access control * Cloud deployment, testing, version control, and security practices · Experience with environmental, laboratory, regulatory, engineering, or GIS applications is highly desirable. **Engagement Details** * **Role:** Senior Full\-Stack Developer / Product Engineer * **Engagement:** Contract * **Start date:** November 2026 Applicants should provide: * A brief description of relevant experience * Frontend and UI/UX work samples * Relevant backend, database, or integration experience * Experience with GIS, laboratory, regulatory, or workflow systems * Recommended technology stack * Availability and expected engagement terms * Cost and time estimates Job Type: Contract Pay: From $1\.00 per year Work Location: Remote

jobs.description: **Location:** Miami (in\-office 4 days per week) **Team:** Engineering **Reports to:** Head of Engineering **About Extenteam** Extenteam is the AI\-driven operations platform for short\-term rental property management, headquartered in Miami and founded in 2021\. Our platform, Shared Services, handles guest communication and daily operational workflows for 80,000\+ properties by pairing an AI orchestration layer with a shared\-services team of hospitality\-trained specialists, so no guest inquiry goes unanswered, day or night, and no property manager has to staff for the 2am cancellation themselves. We're industry\-only: every workflow, integration, and agent we hire is built around property management specifically, not bolted on from a generalist platform. As we push more of that platform toward AI\-led automation and self\-serve tools, the software our own Shared Services team works in every day has to keep pace, that's this role. **Why This Role Exists** Shared Services' guest communication runs on two things: an AI layer that handles as much of a conversation as it safely can, and a shared\-services team of hospitality\-trained agents who catch what the AI shouldn't touch alone. Every day, that team hits walls in the platform they use to do the work; bugs, missing tooling, workflows that don't match how a busy overnight shift actually runs. Some of that is a quick fix. Some of it is a signal that the platform is failing at scale, and by the time it reaches Engineering it's already cost real client trust. We don't have a layer of PMs pre\-chewing every one of those signals into a spec. We're hiring an engineer who can sit close to Operations, tell the difference between a one\-off bug and a systemic gap, and ship the fix with no handoff required. **The Role** You'll report to the Head of Engineering. Priorities are set jointly with the Head of Operations, who owns the operational signal driving what gets built. You'll do two things: * **Close incoming platform tickets from Shared Services.** Agents, Team Leads, and Operations report issues daily; quick fixes, workflow bugs, configuration problems. You triage, diagnose, and ship. * **Find the pattern and fix it at the source.** When multiple agents report the same friction, that's not a ticket, it's a product problem. When a client complaint traces back to repeated agent failures, you ask why the platform is allowing it, and you close that gap for good. Every ship goes through the same process as any other engineer's here: product filters for coherence, design filters for UX consistency, standard code review. This role works inside those guardrails, not around them. **What You Will Do** * Own features end to end; problem framing, design, backend, frontend, instrumentation, rollout, and the follow\-up fixes nobody filed a ticket for. * Work with founders, product, and design at the whiteboard stage, before anything is written down, and help decide what's worth building. * Build the AI surfaces of the product; prompt and agent architecture, tool calling, retrieval, guardrails, and the human\-in\-the\-loop escape hatches that make automation safe to ship. * Build and maintain evals. Treat "does this actually work" as an engineering artifact with a regression suite, not a vibe check before launch. * Watch real usage. Session replays, logs, transcripts, support tickets, and customer calls. Bring back what you learn as shipped changes, not as a document. * Own the details that make software feel good; latency budgets, token cost, empty states, error copy, loading behavior, keyboard paths. These are part of the feature, not a separate polish phase. * Cut scope and kill things. Argue a feature is wrong before you build it well. * Compound the team's velocity; CI, preview environments, internal tools, seed data, debugging surfaces. Leverage counts as product work. **What This Role Is Not** * **Not a ticket queue firefighter.** That's other roles on the Operations side. * **Not a shadow engineering team.** You report to and work within Engineering. * **Not an independent operator building outside the platform.** Everything you ship goes through product. **Anti\-Signals** * You want a ticket fully spec'd before you'll touch it * You treat "why does this keep happening" as someone else's question to answer * You measure your work by whether you closed the ticket, not whether the pattern stopped * Your AI/LLM experience is prompting a demo — never held to a reliability bar with a real agent depending on it at 2am **Required Experience** * 4\+ years of **full stack** (stronger on the BE) software engineering experience shipping production enterprise software * Direct experience building internal tools, agent\-facing platforms, or operational systems * Product mindset: comfortable scoping problems, asking the right questions, and communicating/prioritizing tradeoffs * Track record of shipping fast while working inside a product and design process * Experience working asynchronously with distributed teams **Required Technical Skills** * Strong fluency in TypeScript. We currently use: + Next JS + NestJS + TypeORM with Postgres + BullMQ * Comfortable with agentic coding tools (Claude Code, Cursor, Replit Agent) * API integration experience (REST, webhooks, third\-party SaaS APIs) * Prompt engineering experience with production AI systems (OpenAI, Anthropic, or similar) **Strongly Preferred** * Experience building tools for contact center, customer support, or operations teams * Short\-term rental, hospitality, or property management domain knowledge * Track record of deploying AI agents in production **How You'll Work** * Reports to the Head of Engineering * Priorities set jointly with the Head of Operations, based on operational signal * Product decisions filter through the Head of Product * Design decisions go through our design team * Weekly syncs with Engineering, Operations, and Product * Miami\-based, in\-office 4 days per week

We're committed to supporting work\-life balance while maintaining strong team connection and project delivery.### **Why You’ll Love Working with Us** * **Schedule Flexibility**: Customize your work schedule to fit your life. * **Health \& Wellness**: Comprehensive health benefits to keep you and your family healthy. * **Continuous Learning**: Access to online courses, conferences, and learning materials to fuel your professional growth. * **Paid Time Off**: Take the time you need to recharge with our generous paid time off policy. * **Career Advancement**: Clear paths for promotions and the opportunity to take on new challenges. * **Fun Team Culture**: Regular team\-building activities, happy hours, and company outings. *The base salary range for this role is indicated in the posting. This range reflects the company’s good faith estimate of the compensation for this position at the time of posting. Final compensation will be determined based on factors such as experience, skills, qualifications, internal equity, and geographic location.* **Visa sponsorship is NOT available for this position** All offers are contingent upon a successful criminal background check. jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer, Full Stack (FES)
jobs.description: **About Us** ------------ Fanatics is building a leading global digital sports platform. We ignite the passions of global sports fans and maximize the presence and reach for our hundreds of sports partners globally by offering products and services across Fanatics Commerce, Fanatics Collectibles, and Fanatics Betting \& Gaming, allowing sports fans to Buy, Collect, and Bet. Through the Fanatics platform, sports fans can buy licensed fan gear, jerseys, lifestyle and streetwear products, headwear, and hardgoods; collect physical and digital trading cards, sports memorabilia, and other digital assets; and bet as the company builds its Sportsbook and iGaming platform. Fanatics has an established database of over 100 million global sports fans; a global partner network with approximately 900 sports properties, including major national and international professional sports leagues, players associations, teams, colleges, college conferences and retail partners, 2,500 athletes and celebrities, and 200 exclusive athletes; and over 2,000 retail locations, including its Lids retail stores. Our more than 22,000 employees are committed to relentlessly enhancing the fan experience and delighting sports fans globally.**About the Team** ------------------ Every time a fan places a bet, earns a reward, or checks out on Fanatics — Fanatics Core made that possible. We build the shared foundations — identity, payments, loyalty, wallet, data, and platform — that power sports betting, ecommerce, collectibles, and beyond. We supercharge the business by providing products and capabilities so that teams can focus on what matters most: building delightful experiences for the fans. Fanatics is uniquely positioned at the intersection of sports commerce, betting, and collectibles, and Fanatics ONE is the loyalty and identity program that ties it all together. **Overview** As a Senior Software Engineer at Fanatics, you will design, build, and operate the platforms and services that power the Fan Ecosystem — the systems that connect fans to every Fanatics product and experience. You will own significant technical surface area end to end, set the technical direction for projects that span multiple services and teams, and raise the engineering bar for those around you through mentorship, design leadership, and hands\-on delivery. This is a hands\-on, full\-stack role with a backend center of gravity. The majority of your work will be building high\-throughput, high\-availability services in Go, with meaningful contributions to the TypeScript/React front ends those services support. **Responsibilities** * Design, build, test, document, and operate high\-quality, production\-grade software with a focus on Go services and APIs * Own the technical design of medium\-to\-large features and systems: define the approach, weigh trade\-offs, document decisions, and drive them to completion * Break down ambiguous problems into well\-scoped, deliverable work for yourself and other engineers on the team * Lead and participate in design and architecture reviews; provide clear, constructive feedback that improves both the design and the designer * Set the standard in code reviews — for correctness, readability, testability, and operational safety * Mentor and grow engineers on the team; onboard new hires and act as a technical point of contact for your systems * Participate in and improve the on\-call rotation: instrument your services, drive incident response, and lead blameless postmortems that result in real fixes * Improve reliability, performance, and cost of the systems you own; define and act on SLOs and operational excellence metrics * Identify and pay down technical debt, and make the case for the investments worth making * Partner closely with product managers, designers, and stakeholders to shape the roadmap and make technology decisions that grow the business * Influence and help define the principles, guidelines, and best practices of our engineering strategy — then hold the team to them * Develop deep understanding of our industry, product, feature set, and roadmap, and use it to make better technical decisions **Required Qualifications** * **5\+ years** of professional software engineering experience building and operating production systems * **Strong, demonstrated proficiency in Go (Golang) — required.** You have built and shipped production services in Go and can speak to concurrency patterns, error handling, testing, profiling, and performance tuning in the language * Proven experience designing, building, and scaling backend services and APIs (REST and/or gRPC) in a distributed, microservices environment * Demonstrated proficiency in JavaScript or TypeScript, and experience with React or another modern front\-end framework * Solid grounding in data stores and messaging: relational and/or NoSQL databases, caching, and event streaming (e.g. Kafka, SQS/SNS) * Experience with cloud infrastructure (AWS, GCP, or Azure), containers, CI/CD, and infrastructure\-as\-code * Strong operational instincts: observability, monitoring, alerting, debugging production issues under pressure * Track record of leading projects with multiple contributors and delivering them on time without sacrificing quality * Familiar with Agile software product delivery and SCRUM methodology * Able to effectively work cross\-functionally within an enterprise environment **Preferred Qualifications** * Experience building or integrating with identity and access management systems — authentication, authorization, SSO, and account lifecycle * Hands\-on familiarity with identity standards and protocols: OAuth 2\.0, OpenID Connect, SAML, JWT, MFA, session and token lifecycle management * Experience with identity providers and CIAM platforms (e.g. Okta, Auth0, ForgeRock, AWS Cognito, Ping) or with building an in\-house identity platform * Experience with account security, fraud prevention, PII handling, or regulatory/compliance\-driven engineering (KYC, GDPR, CCPA) * Experience designing systems that serve high\-traffic, consumer\-facing products with spiky, event\-driven load * Experience with platform or shared\-services work where your consumers are other engineering teams * Experience working in a start\-up environment * Experience in sports, commerce, media, or another consumer\-scale domain *If you possess some of these qualifications but not all of them, we still encourage you to apply!* Depending on the role, your interview and onboarding experience may include in\-person components, such as onsite interviews or Launching into Better: LIVE—a multi\-day cultural immersion in New York City for full\-time, non\-seasonal hires. These sessions are designed to build connection and bring our culture to life, though specific travel and participation requirements will be confirmed based on your role and location. Your recruiter will provide clear guidance at each stage of the process. For information about our benefits, please visit https://benefitsatfanatics.com/ \#LI\-KR1 By submitting your application, you agree to our terms of service and acknowledge you have read our Candidate Privacy Policy.

jobs.title: Network Engineer I
jobs.description: Description: As a Network Engineer I, you will support the design, implementation, and maintenance of FiberLight’s network infrastructure under the guidance of senior engineers. You will collaborate with engineering teams to help ensure the stability, security, and scalability of our network. This role offers hands\-on learning opportunities in routing protocols, basic network automation, and Layer 2 networking, helping you build a foundation in telecommunications engineering. Key Responsibilities: * Assist in the design, implementation, and maintenance of network infrastructures. * Follow process documents to configure network devices * Help configure and troubleshoot basic routing protocols such as BGP, OSPF, and IS\-IS. * Support the development of simple network automation scripts using Python and Ansible. * Learn to use GitHub for version control and collaboration on network projects. * Participate in network performance monitoring and basic optimization tasks. * Assist in maintaining network security and compliance with industry standards. * Help document network configurations, procedures, and basic designs. Requirements: Required Skills and Qualifications: * 2 years of relevant experience in networking or telecommunications (internships or entry\-level roles count). * Layer 1\- Experience troubleshooting physical network equipment and cabling * Layer 2\- Understanding of networking technologies, such as MPLS and EVPL. * Layer 3\- Basic familiarity with BGP, OSPF, and IS\-IS routing protocols. * Introductory knowledge of Python and Ansible for network automation. * Awareness of GitHub for version control. * Good problem\-solving and analytical skills. * Experience creating and maintaining documented processes * Strong communication and interpersonal skills. * Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field (or equivalent experience). * Experience with Cisco, Juniper, or other network equipment is a plus. * Entry\-level certifications (e.g., CCNA, JNCIA, Network\+) are a plus. * Basic knowledge of network security practices. * Familiarity with cloud networking (AWS, Azure, GCP) is a plus. * Interest in SDN (Software\-Defined Networking) technologies. * Experience working with remote Technicians on site

jobs.title: Associate Legal Counsel
jobs.description: **About MISUMI Americas** MISUMI Americas, a division of MISUMI Group, is a leading provider of standard, configurable, and custom manufacturing solutions. By integrating a vast catalog of components with a world\-class digital manufacturing platform, MISUMI Americas empowers engineers and procurement teams to accelerate innovation across the entire product lifecycle. With operations in the San Francisco Bay Area and Chicago, the company serves as a vital partner for the most innovative companies in the Americas. **Impact in this role** The Associate Counsel provides legal support in general corporate and commercial matters that include but are not limited to contract negotiation and management as well as regulatory compliance. The Associate Counsel will mitigate legal risk while considering business and operational needs. **Areas of Responsibility:** * Advise on various legal issues relating to company business practices. * Review, draft, and assist in the negotiation of various contracts and agreements, corporate policies, and standard operating procedures. * Assist with regulatory compliance issues. * Review and update confidentiality agreements. * Assist in developing legal training materials. * Provide support in maintaining executed agreements and other corporate documents. * Additional duties as required. Desired Traits * Bachelor's Degree required (Engineering or other technical degrees are a plus). * Juris Doctorate is required. * Must be a licensed attorney and in good standing to practice law in the United States. * Previous legal experience is a plus, but not required. * Self\-starter who can work independently and collaboratively in a fast\-paced, multi\-cultural environment. * Exceptional written and verbal communication skills required. * Strong analytic, critical thinking and sound judgment abilities with meticulous attention to detail required. * Spanish/Japanese bilingual abilities and/or experience living in Japan or working with Japanese companies are a plus. * Position can be 100% remote, but the ability to work at least one day a week from one of our facilities (Schaumburg, IL; Dayton, OH; Fraser, MI; Bellaire, MI; or Queretaro, Mexico) is a plus. **Salary Range for this role is $63,000 \- $68,000 per year based on experience** **Physical Demands** Travel: Ability to travel up to 5% annually (globally) for meetings and conferences. We're actively seeking teammates who: * Bring diverse perspectives and experience to our culture and company. * Excel at being part of a strong, empathetic team. * Thrive in an environment emphasizing respect, honesty, collaboration, and growth. * Have an 'always learning' mindset that celebrates learning, not just wins. * Help us continue to build a world\-class organization that values the contributions of all of our teammates We encourage applications from members of underrepresented groups, including but not limited to women, members of the LGBTQ community, people of color, people with disabilities, and veterans.

Our technology powers mission‑critical solutions across Lending, Payments and Universal Banking, supporting over 7,000 customers, including 80% of the world’s top 50 banks, in more than 110 countries. **What will you contribute?** We are seeking a **Back\-End Engineer** to design and implement robust backend services, APIs, and processes. jobs.title: Ecommerce Architect
jobs.description: **Purpose:** The eCommerce Architect owns the technical architecture and integration strategy for flooranddecor.com and the broader eCommerce technology ecosystem. This role sets the standards for how the platform is built, integrated, and scaled — spanning front\-end architecture (React and modern web frameworks), back\-end services, and large\-scale commerce platforms such as Salesforce Commerce Cloud or Websphere Commerce. Partnering closely with the eCommerce Leadership, the eCommerce Architect translates long\-term technology strategy into a coherent, extensible architecture and provides technical authority across engineering pods without direct people\-management responsibility. This individual also leads the organization's adoption of modern, AI\-augmented engineering practices — including the responsible use of AI\-assisted (“vibe coding”) development tools — to improve delivery speed while safeguarding quality, security, and long\-term maintainability. **Essential Functions / Key Responsibilities:** **Enterprise \& Solution Architecture** * Define and maintain the target\-state architecture for flooranddecor.com, including front\-end, back\-end, integration, and data layers * Establish architecture patterns and standards for React\-based front\-end applications and full\-stack service design * Lead architecture reviews for major initiatives, ensuring solutions are scalable, secure, and aligned with enterprise architecture principles **Platform Strategy \&
