jobs.title: Sr. Engineering Manager - Data Platform
jobs.description: **About HighLevel:** HighLevel is an AI\-powered business operating system that gives agencies, entrepreneurs and SMBs the infrastructure to build, automate and scale. Today, HighLevel supports SMBs across 150\+ countries, fueling community\-driven growth rooted in real customer outcomes. To date, businesses operating on HighLevel have generated over $7 billion in ecosystem value, demonstrating the impact of shared infrastructure at scale. By centralizing conversations, automation and intelligence into one system, we help businesses move faster, reduce complexity and execute efficiently. Behind the platform, HighLevel powers more than 4 billion API hits and 2\.5 billion message events daily. With 250 terabytes of distributed data, 250\+ microservices and over 1 million domain names supported, our architecture is built for performance, resilience and long\-term scalability. **Our People** With over 2,000 team members across 10\+ countries, HighLevel operates as a global, remote\-first organization built for speed and ownership. We value initiative, clarity and execution, creating space for ambitious people to build systems that support millions of businesses worldwide. Here, innovation thrives, ideas are celebrated and people come first, no matter where they call home. **Our Impact** Every month, HighLevel enables more than 1\.5 billion messages, 200 million leads and 20 million conversations for the more than 1 million businesses we support. Behind those numbers are real people building independence, expanding opportunity and creating measurable impact. We’re proud to be a part of that. Learn more about us on our YouTube Channel or Blog Posts. ### **About the Role:** We are looking for a Senior Engineering Manager to lead our Data Platform \& Infrastructure team. This leader will own the strategy, execution, and evolution of the foundational data systems that power insights and our ecosystem. You will lead a team of highly capable engineers responsible for building reliable, scalable, secure, and developer\-friendly data infrastructure. This includes data ingestion and processing, data platforms, storage and compute, orchestration, observability, and the infrastructure that enables teams across the company to efficiently build and operate data\-intensive products and applications. This is a hands\-on leadership role: you will set technical direction and organizational strategy while remaining close enough to the technology to make high\-quality architectural decisions and guide the team through complex technical challenges.### **Responsibilities:** **Leadership \& Team Management** * Lead, recruit, and mentor an exceptional engineering team. * Direct data infrastructure strategy to drive business and product success. * Oversee resource allocation, including headcount and vendor budget planning. * Establish operational rhythms, goals, and execution frameworks aligned with core business outcomes. * Cultivate an inclusive environment focused on ownership, technical rigor, and continuous professional development. * Champion team morale, engagement, learning opportunities, and delivery velocity. **Data Engineering Strategy** * Guide system architecture, data flow design, quality standards, and platform roadmaps. * Partner with Product and Data leadership to plan, sequence, and execute multi\-quarter initiatives. * Define robust platform abstractions, APIs, and SLAs to streamline developer workflows and increase adoption. * Ensure infrastructure resilience through comprehensive monitoring, incident management, disaster recovery, and cost optimization. * Work cross\-functionally with Security, Audit, and Analytics Engineering to deploy key capabilities and compliance controls. **Cross\-Functional Partnership** * Engage with Data, Product, and Finance partners to enable machine learning, experimentation, and business reporting. * Establish and enforce organization\-wide standards for pipeline reliability, data security, and quality. **Technical Leadership** * Advocate for automation, engineering best practices, and thoughtful trade\-offs between execution speed and long\-term scalability. * Thrive in fast\-paced, ambiguous settings while cultivating senior technical leaders and building leadership succession through delegated autonomy, developing senior technical leaders and succession depth. ### **Requirements:** **Required Qualifications** * 10\+ years of experience in software engineering, SRE or infrastructure, data platform engineering, or related fields. * 4\+ years managing high\-performing technical teams, growing and developing people * Deep expertise with Snowflake/Google BigQuery/Databricks or equivalent modern data warehousing systems and ecosystem of tools including Airflow, DBT etc. * Familiarity with Git and CI/CD workflows * Strong understanding of data warehousing concepts and infrastructure workload management. * Experience defining data security, platform SLAs and governance frameworks. * Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills. * Demonstrated ability to influence technical strategy across multiple organizations. **Preferred Qualifications** * Experience delivering customer\-facing data products is a plus * Experience scaling platform organizations through rapid company growth. * Familiarity with event\-driven data architectures, data science \& product analytics computational needs and patterns is a plus. * Experience supporting experimentation platforms and machine learning initiatives. * Knowledge of metrics governance and executive KPI frameworks. ### **Success in your First Year:** **Within your first 12 months, you will:** * Build strong relationships with leaders across Product, Engineering, Finance, and Go\-to\-Market. * Improve trust in data through stronger governance and controls. * Increase data consumptions and data\-powered products across the organization. * Establish scalable development standards and improve engineering velocity. * Grow and mentor a high\-performing data platform engineering team. * Deliver a roadmap that supports both current business needs and future scale. **EEO Statement:** The company is an Equal Opportunity Employer. jobs.title: Director, UX & Product Design
jobs.description: About HireRight: HireRight is the premier global background screening and workforce solutions provider. We bring clarity and confidence to vetting and hiring decisions through integrated, tailored solutions, driving a higher standard of accuracy in everything we do. Combining in\-house talent, personalized services, and proprietary technology, we ensure the best candidate experience possible. PBSA accredited and based in Nashville, TN, we offer expertise from our regional centers across 200 countries and territories in The Americas, Europe, Asia, and the Middle East. Our commitment to get it right every time, everywhere, makes us the trusted partner of businesses and organizations worldwide. Overview: HireRight is redefining its design function, and we’re looking for a Director, UX \& Product Design to join us on this journey. We are looking for a player\-coach that’s senior enough to raise the bar and hands\-on enough to demonstrate the value firsthand. The core of this job is evangelizing design thinking globally, starting with the Product and Engineering org and expanding to other departments as influence grows. This includes building the reusable systems that let anyone at HireRight produce good experiences: component libraries, research practices, content and copy standards, AI\-assisted design workflows, and the decision frameworks that turn process into impact. This means orchestrating the creation of artifacts for designers, product managers, engineers, and even cross\-functional partners that contribute to the customer or candidate experience. *If you have ever been the person who fixed the system instead of the ticket, this is that job.* Responsibilities: **What Makes This Role Different** ================================== * **Greenfield with air cover.** You are not inheriting a mature system to maintain. You are defining what design means here and evangelizing the value it brings beyond visuals with Product and Engineering leaders who have already made the case for the investment. * **Systems over throughput.** Roughly two\-thirds of your time is building repeatable capability; roughly one\-third is high\-leverage delivery work you take on yourself. * **AI as a force multiplier.** We expect you to use AI responsibly to scale design thinking across the company: reusable prompts and skills for copywriting, research synthesis, accessibility review, and pattern generation. * **Scope beyond the customer\-facing surface.** Candidate experience, employer and recruiter workflows, internal operations tooling, and partner\-facing integrations are all in scope. **What You'll Own** =================== Everything below is an opportunity, not a day\-one checklist. We do not expect all of it at once. A meaningful part of this role is deciding what matters most, in what order, and bringing others along. **Design Systems \& Scalable Capability** ----------------------------------------- * Build and govern HireRight’s design system with Branding (components, patterns, tokens, content standards, etc.) including the intake, review, rollout, and deprecation processes that keep it useful, not burdensome. * Align with Engineering’s front\-end platform. * Create AI\-assisted workflows and templates (copy, accessibility checks, research synthesis, pattern generation) that non\-designers can use safely, and drive adoption by making them genuinely useful rather than mandatory. **Design Tooling \& Vendor Management** --------------------------------------- * Own the toolchain: audit what we license today and go\-forward across design, prototyping, research, analytics, and accessibility, and assess what is actually used, duplicated, or wasted. * Run selection and renewal with Procurement, InfoSec, and Finance, and propose a forward\-looking roadmap where AI\-native tools earn a place, what we pilot before we buy, and what we retire. **Craft, Quality, \& Coaching** ------------------------------- * Set and hold a high bar across interaction, visual, content, and accessibility. * Coach designers, PMs, and engineers on craft and responsible design; give specific, actionable critique and teach others to give it. * Install lightweight quality controls that hold without policing: critique rhythms, definition of done, accessibility checklists, and release validation. **Research, Continuous Discovery, \& Measurement** -------------------------------------------------- * Establish research standards, templates, and learning loops with Product and Data so discovery is repeatable rather than heroic. Ensure learnings get shared and applied rather than forgotten. * Raise the floor on problem framing: journey maps, principles, and artifacts that keep teams solving the right problem at the right scope. * Define UX health in a few measures the team, stakeholders, and customers understand and instrument for them during design rather than after launch. * Make user testing and evaluation routine: a standing participant pipeline, lightweight  lated\-experience guardrails with Legal, Compliance, and Risk: disclosure patterns, consent and authorization flows, adverse action communication, and easy\-to\-understand copy. * Communicate design decisions in ways that move Executives, Sales, and Engineering, and create the repeatable formats that let others do the same. Qualifications: **What We're Looking For** ========================== * **Senior leadership experience.** Substantial experience as a senior design leader, including work that scaled beyond the products you personally designed. * **Systems thinking.** You can point to patterns, components, or practices you created that other people adopted and are still using today. You naturally orient towards themes and systems over bespoke solutions. * Given a wide field of opportunity, you comfortably sift through ambiguity and noise to decide what matters most now, what waits and why, and you can make that case to the people it affects. * **Player\-coach range.** You are comfortable with your directs and peers and comfortable in front of a leadership team, and you know which one the moment calls for. * **Strong current Figma skills.** We use Figma today; we want your influence on what we use tomorrow, so we are looking for someone fluent in the tool but not married to it. * **AI fluency.** Practical experience with AI tools in a design workflow plus judgment about where they help and where they quietly degrade quality. * **Accessibility depth.** Real WCAG 2\.1 AA fluency and beyond, applied to shipped products rather than audited after the fact. * **Influence without authority.** Across Product, Engineering, Compliance, Sales, and Operations, translating design decisions into the language each of those functions use. * **Bias towards action.** You know when to plan and when to just do. You get things done. **Nice to Have** ================ * You have built and implemented a design system or component library from zero inside an organization or team that did not have one. * You have created AI design templates, prompt libraries, and Claude skills that others use in production work and can speak to the business and customer impact. * Experience adapting systems across varied platforms and stacks: you have opinions, but they travel. * Background in regulated, high\-trust, or compliance\-heavy domains (HR tech, background screening, financial services, healthcare) where clarity and comprehension carry legal weight. * Experience designing for multiple audiences with different incentives (in our case, candidates, the employers screening them, and internal team members driving the work). * Enterprise B2B experience, including complex workflows and configuration\-heavy products. **Who This Role Is Not For** ============================ * You want a large reporting line. * You don’t enjoy doing some IC work. * Your best work happens only when requirements are settled. * You wait to be told what to work on and have others chase you for progress. * You’re strong on theory but have not actually put lasting systems into practice. What do we offer: In exchange for your expertise, HireRight offers an excellent employee benefit package which includes:* Medical * Dental * Vision * Paid Life/AD\&D Insurance * Voluntary Life Insurance * Short \& Long Term Disability * Flexible Spending Accounts * 401K * Generous Vacation and Sick Program * 10 Paid Holidays * Education Assistance Program * Business Casual Attire * Generous Referral Program * Employee Discounts and Rewards * And much more! * *All resumes are held in confidence. Only candidates whose profiles closely match requirements will be contacted during this search.* *HireRight does not accept unsolicited resumes through or from search firms or staffing agencies. All unsolicited resumes will be considered the property of HireRight and HireRight will not be obligated to pay a placement fee.* HireRight, LLC is an Equal Opportunity Employer Minorities / Females / Veterans / Disabilities

jobs.title: Civil Project Manager
jobs.description: About the Role Honor Engineer Company is seeking an experienced Civil Project Manager to lead meaningful site\-development and infrastructure projects for government clients, from initial planning through construction. This position combines client management, technical oversight, team coordination, and financial responsibility. The ideal candidate is a practical problem\-solver who communicates clearly, develops strong client relationships, and takes ownership of project quality, schedule, and budget. Responsibilities * Manage civil engineering projects from proposal through closeout. * Serve as the primary point of contact for clients, agencies, subconsultants, and project partners. * Develop project scopes, budgets, schedules, and work plans. * Coordinate assignments with civil designers, CAD technicians, surveyors, environmental staff, and specialty teams. * Lead site planning, grading, drainage, utility, erosion and sediment control, and permitting efforts. * Review calculations, plans, specifications, reports, and permit applications. * Monitor project performance, budgets, schedules, and contract requirements. * Review draft invoices and support timely billing and collection. * Identify scope changes and prepare additional\-service requests. * Mentor junior staff and help strengthen internal project\-management practices. * Support proposal development, client relationships, and business development. Qualifications * Bachelor’s degree in civil engineering or a related field. * At least five years of relevant civil engineering experience. * Demonstrated experience managing projects, budgets, schedules, and multidisciplinary teams. * Working knowledge of land development, municipal infrastructure, stormwater management, utilities, permitting, and construction documents. * Strong written, verbal, organizational, and client\-service skills. * Proficiency with Microsoft Office; experience with Bluebeam, AutoCAD Civil 3D, and project\-management software is beneficial. * Professional Engineer license preferred. Candidates actively pursuing licensure may also be considered. * Valid driver’s license and ability to attend project sites and client meetings. About Honor Engineer Company Honor Engineer Company is a Service\-Disabled Veteran\-Owned Small Business providing civil engineering, surveying, geospatial, environmental, landscape architecture, and construction\-related services. We serve public\- and private\-sector clients throughout the Mid\-Atlantic and Northeast. We value accountability, practical solutions, strong teamwork, and professionals who take pride in delivering quality work. Honor Engineer Company is an equal opportunity employer. We invite you to find out more, and together we can continue to provide vision for a lifetime.

jobs.title: Lead AI Engineer
jobs.description: **Become a part of our caring community** ========================================= You have shipped AI products before. You understand the difference between a demo and a production system. You have strong opinions about evaluation frameworks because you have experienced the consequences of operating without them. You are at your best when you own architecture decisions while continuing to build and deliver critical code yourself. We build the platform that transforms millions of clinical documents into trusted, actionable data. Our systems use large language models (LLMs) to read medical records, extract structured facts, answer complex questions with citations back to source documents, and route complex cases to human experts. The output of these systems supports healthcare decisions that impact real members. As a Lead AI Applied Engineer, you will provide technical leadership for AI\-enabled products and platforms, define architectural direction, establish engineering standards, and personally design and build the most critical components of our systems. You will lead through both technical expertise and execution, helping the team deliver reliable, scalable, and auditable AI solutions in a highly regulated healthcare environment.**Why Join Us** * Lead the architecture of production AI systems where LLMs are foundational to the product experience. * Make key technical decisions regarding model selection, system boundaries, platform architecture, and build\-versus\-buy strategies. * Own the highest\-risk and highest\-impact technical challenges involving reliability, explainability, and correctness. * Influence engineering culture and establish standards that shape how the team builds and ships AI products. * Work on systems operating at meaningful scale, processing millions of documents and supporting healthcare decisions across a large member population. * Partner with highly skilled engineers while remaining deeply hands\-on in coding, design, and production operations. * Simplify complex solutions and drive pragmatic engineering decisions that maximize business value. **Key Responsibilities** * Own the architecture, design, and evolution of full\-stack AI applications, including LLM pipelines, retrieval systems, agentic workflows, human\-in\-the\-loop processes, and supporting platform services. * Design and implement scalable AI solutions that prioritize reliability, accuracy, auditability, performance, and cost efficiency. * Build and maintain the most complex and high\-risk system components where architecture and implementation decisions have significant business impact. * Define and enforce engineering standards for AI systems, including evaluation methodologies, structured outputs, observability, testing, fallback strategies, latency optimization, and cost controls. * Lead technical design reviews and guide architecture decisions related to platform capabilities, AI systems, integrations, infrastructure, and software patterns. * Evaluate and recommend technologies, frameworks, AI models, and third\-party solutions based on technical and business requirements. * Translate ambiguous business goals into clear technical strategies, roadmaps, and executable workstreams. * Provide technical leadership across multiple projects, ensuring alignment with architectural standards and long\-term platform objectives. * Mentor and coach engineers through design reviews, code reviews, pair programming, and technical guidance. * Partner with product, engineering, clinical, and operational stakeholders to deliver solutions that meet business and regulatory requirements. * Own operational excellence, including deployment strategies, monitoring, incident management, and production reliability. * Ensure all solutions comply with privacy, security, governance, and audit requirements within a regulated healthcare environment. **Use your skills to make an impact** ===================================== **Required Qualifications** * Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience. * 8\+ years of software engineering experience, including experience designing and operating production systems at scale. * Proven track record of delivering AI\-enabled products or platforms into production environments. * Deep hands\-on experience integrating and operating LLMs within business\-critical workflows. * Experience designing systems that leverage structured outputs, tool calling, retrieval\-augmented generation (RAG), agentic workflows, orchestration frameworks, and evaluation pipelines. * Experience making architectural decisions for systems where AI is a core component of the product experience. * Demonstrated success leading technical initiatives across engineering teams, including architecture reviews, technical planning, mentoring, and delivery execution. * Strong programming skills in Python and/or TypeScript/JavaScript. * Experience designing and operatin  successful delivery of strategic initiatives. **Success in This Role** Successful candidates are passionate about building production\-grade AI systems where correctness, transparency, and reliability matter. You enjoy solving difficult engineering problems, making thoughtful architectural decisions, and helping teams deliver high\-impact solutions. You are equally comfortable defining system architecture, mentoring engineers, reviewing designs, responding to production incidents, and writing code for the most critical parts of the platform. **Technology Stack** * TypeScript * React / Next.js * Python * PostgreSQL * Gemini on Vertex AI * OCR and Document AI technologies * Docker * Kubernetes * Modern CI/CD platforms and tooling **Additional Information** This role operates in a highly regulated environment. Responsible handling of sensitive and protected data is a fundamental requirement and a core part of our engineering culture. Success in this role requires a commitment to building secure, compliant, auditable, and trustworthy AI systems. **Work Style:** This position follows a hybrid work schedule, requiring employees to work three days per week in the office and the remaining days remotely. Qualified candidates must currently reside within, or be willing to relocate to, a commutable distance from one of the talent markets. **\#enterpriseAI** **Scheduled Weekly Hours** 40**Pay Range** The compensation range below reflects a good faith estimate of starting base pay for full time (40 hours per week) employment at the time of posting. The pay range may be higher or lower based on geographic location and individual pay will vary based on demonstrated job related skills, knowledge, experience, education, certifications, etc. $170,800 \- $234,800 per year This job is eligible for a bonus incentive plan. This incentive opportunity is based upon company and/or individual performance.**Description of Benefits** Humana, Inc. and its affiliated subsidiaries (collectively, “Humana”) offers competitive benefits that support whole\-person well\-being. Associate benefits are designed to encourage personal wellness and smart healthcare decisions for you and your family while also knowing your life extends outside of work. Among our benefits, Humana provides medical, dental and vision benefits, 401(k) retirement savings plan, time off (including paid time off, company and personal holidays, paid parental and caregiver leave), short\-term and long\-term disability, life insurance and many other opportunities.**About Us** ============ About Humana: Humana Inc. (NYSE: HUM) is a leading U.S. healthcare company. Through our Humana insurance services and our CenterWell healthcare services, we make it easier for the millions of people we serve to achieve their best health – delivering the care and service they need, when they need it. These efforts are leading to a better quality of life for people with Medicare and Medicaid, families, individuals, military service personnel, and communities at large. Learn more about what we offer at Humana.com and at CenterWell.com. **Equal Opportunity Employer** It is the policy of Humana not to discriminate against any employee or applicant for employment because of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, marital status, genetic information, disability or protected veteran status. (for example, but not limited to, linear motors, sensors, bearings, gearboxes, belts, seals, servo motors, pneumatic and hydraulic components, etc.) as well as material selection and application of design standards. * Well\-rounded – hands\-on mechanical ability and passion for interests and hobbies outside of work. jobs.title: Principal, AI Operations & Infrastructure Automation
jobs.description: Overview: **About the Role \& Team** IDC is the premier global provider of market intelligence, advisory services, and events for the technology markets. For more than 60 years, we've helped technology suppliers, buyers, and investors make the right decisions with evidence, not guesswork. Our analysts turn data into the clarity our clients need to navigate their next move with confidence. That standard applies internally too. The infrastructure our analysts, sales teams, and clients depend on has to be fast, reliable, and quietly excellent — at a scale manual operations can no longer reach. **What You’ll Do** IDC is modernizing how infrastructure is run — shifting from manual, ticket\-driven operations to an automated, AI\-informed model that keeps pace with the speed of the business. We're looking for a Principal of AI Operations \& Infrastructure Automation to lead this transformation: designing and standing up the automation, tooling, and operating model that will define how IDC's infrastructure team works going forward. This is a hands\-on, high\-velocity leadership role for someone who has actually built AIOps and infrastructure\-as\-code capability before — not just overseen it. You'll personally write and review automation, get into the tooling directly, and lead by example for the team you manage. You'll partner closely with the CIO, Cyber \& Infrastructure leadership, and AWS as a strategic cloud and co\-development partner to re\-architect how infrastructure operations get done. This role builds and leads the team responsible for automation — setting technical direction, reviewing their work, and growing their skills as the operating model evolves. Additional responsibilities include:* Own the end\-to\-end redesign of the infrastructure operating model, moving core workflows (provisioning, monitoring, incident response, patching, capacity management) from manual execution to automated, self\-healing pipelines. * Define a phased transformation roadmap with clear milestones, automation\-coverage targets, and go\-live gates — and drive execution against it at pace. * Lead change management for the infrastructure team through the transition — defining new roles, skills, and ways of working as automation is adopted. * Build the AIOps layer; evaluate, select, and deploy AIOps platforms and agentic tooling — anomaly detection, predictive alerting, automated remediation — suited to IDC's AWS\-centric environment. Implement event correlation and noise reduction so a hundred alerts resolve into one actionable incident with a probable root cause attached. * Stand up LLM (large language model)\-assisted triage that classifies, enriches, and routes incidents, pulling relevant runbooks, past resolutions, and change history into the ticket automatically. * Develop predictive capacity and failure models for critical services, and act on them before thresholds are breached. * Automate end to end, build and champion an infrastructure\-as\-code (IaC) standard across the organization, converting legacy manual processes into version\-controlled, repeatable automation. * Deliver self\-healing automation and closed\-loop remediation for the highest\-volume recurring incidents — restart, rollback, scale, reroute, and verify without a human in the loop. Automate service request fulfillment: access provisioning, environment setup, onboarding and offboarding, and routine change execution. * Own CI/CD (continuous integration/continuous delivery\-deployment) pipelines for operational tooling, including testing and safe rollback for automations that touch production. * Lead the team and prove the results Directly manage and develop a team of infrastructure and automation engineers — hiring, coaching, and setting technical direction — while staying hands\-on in the tooling and code yourself. * Partner with AWS and other strategic vendors to pilot and scale automation and AI\-driven operations capabilities, including Bedrock/AgentCore\-based tooling where relevant. * Establish new operational KPIs — automation coverage, mean time to detect and resolve, deployment frequency, toil eliminated — and report progress in concise, executive\-ready formats. * Set guardrails for AI in operations: human\-in\-the\-loop thresholds, blast\-radius limits, audit logging, evaluation of model output quality, and clear rollback paths. * Ensure automated operations meet IDC's security, compliance, and resiliency standards, working closely with Cyber \& Compliance. **What You Bring** Required * 8\+ years in infrastructure, platform engineering, or IT operations, including 3\+ years leading automation or AIOps initiatives. * Demonstrated track record of redesigning an operations function around automation — not just introducing point tools but changing how a team works. * Deep hands\-on experience with cloud infrastructure automation (AWS strongly preferred), infrastructure\-as\-code (Terraform, CloudFormation, or similar), and CI/CD pipelines. * Wor ty with FinOps practices and cloud cost automation. * Relevant certifications (cloud architect or engineer, Kubernetes, ITIL v4, Terraform). **What success looks like** *First 90 days* You know our estate — tooling, telemetry, ticket volume, and the top recurring incident categories. The transformation roadmap is published with milestones and automation\-coverage targets, and at least one automation is live and measurably reducing manual work. *First two quarters* A documented automation\-first operating model is adopted across the infrastructure team. Intelligent alert correlation is live on our highest\-noise services, and baseline AIOps KPIs are instrumented and reported to the CIO. *One year* Measurable improvement in mean time to detect and resolve incidents. A growing share of routine operational workflows runs without manual intervention, and infrastructure changes are consistently deployed through version\-controlled, automated pipelines. **Why This Role Stands Out** At IDC, your work helps shape how the world understands technology and where it goes next. You collaborate with curious, high\-caliber colleagues who value rigor, integrity, and shared success. As the premier global provider of trusted technology intelligence, IDC equips business and technology leaders with the evidence they need to make confident decisions. Our insights inform strategy, investment, and innovation across industries and regions. Recognized by IIAR as Analyst Firm of the Year for five consecutive years, IDC sets the standard for credibility and impact. With more than 1,000 analysts worldwide and a truly global perspective, we combine deep expertise with practical relevance. Here, your ideas matter, your voice is heard, and your contributions provide the insights leaders rely on every day. It is meaningful work, backed by a culture that supports growth, collaboration, and long\-term career development with a globally respected brand. **What We Offer** 15 vacation days (prorated based on start date) 12 company\-paid holidays 6 paid sick days (prorated based on start date; may vary by state) Medical, dental, and vision coverage 2 floating holidays (prorated based on start date) 1 volunteer day 401(k) company match (IDC matches 3% on the first 6% of employee contributions) Company\-paid short\-term disability Company\-paid life insurance Company\-paid parental leave Compensation Transparency At IDC, we are committed to fair and equitable pay practices. Employees are compensated equitably for their work, aligned with their skills and experience. Salary and incentive structures are determined through a rigorous process that considers experience, education, certifications, role\-specific requirements, internal equity, and verified U.S. market data from an independent third\-party partner. The expected total annual compensation, depending on location and experience, is between $139,000\-$240,000, inclusive of base salary and variable compensation. If this role relocates to a different country, the salary range will be updated to reflect that country's range, rather than a currency conversion of the original range. **Equal Opportunity Employer** IDC is committed to providing equal employment opportunities for all qualified persons. Employment eligibility verification required. We participate in E\-Verify. IDC is currently able to employ remote workers in the following states: Arizona (AZ), California (CA), Colorado (CO), Connecticut (CT), Washington D.C. (DC), Florida (FL), Georgia (GA), Illinois (IL), Indiana (IN), Kansas (KS), Massachusetts (MA), Maryland (MD), Maine (ME), Michigan (MI), Minnesota (MN), Missouri (MO), Mississippi (MS), North Carolina (NC), New Hampshire (NH), New Jersey (NJ), New York (NY), Ohio (OH), Oregon (OR), Pennsylvania (PA), Rhode Island (RI), South Carolina (SC), Tennessee (TN), Texas (TX), Utah (UT), Virginia (VA), Vermont (VT), Washington (WA), and Wisconsin (WI). jobs.title: Assoc Director - Responsible AI
jobs.description: Posted Date 9/21/2026 Description #### **When you join Verizon** You want more out of a career. A place to share your ideas freely — even if they’re daring or different. Where the true you can learn, grow, and thrive. At Verizon, we power and empower how people live, work and play by connecting them to what brings them joy. We do what we love — driving innovation, creativity, and impact in the world. Our V Team is a community of people who anticipate, lead, and believe that listening is where learning begins. In crisis and in celebration, we come together — lifting our communities and building trust in how we show up, everywhere \& always. Want in? Join the \#VTeamLife. **What you'll be doing…** As the Associate Director of Responsible AI, you will lead Verizon’s enterprise\-wide efforts to ensure our artificial intelligence and machine learning technologies are developed, deployed, and scaled safely, ethically, and equitably. Sitting at the intersection of technology, law, and business, you will serve as the central authority on AI risk and governance as Verizon continues to integrate advanced AI across our global 5G network and customer experiences. * Defining, scaling, and managing Verizon’s enterprise\-wide Responsible AI (RAI) framework to align with global standards like the NIST AI RMF. * Co\-chairing the AI Governance Council, facilitating strategic reviews of high\-impact AI use cases, and establishing clear "go/no\-go" criteria for model deployment. * Designing and implementing AI auditing processes focused on bias mitigation, algorithmic fairness, transparency, and explainability. * Partnering with Legal, Privacy, and Public Policy teams to navigate the rapidly evolving AI regulatory landscape (e.g., EU AI Act, FTC guidelines) and ensure strict compliance. * Leading cross\-functional AI "red\-teaming" and stress\-testing initiatives to identify vulnerabilities and edge\-case failures in production models. * Collaborating with ML engineers and product managers to embed RAI checkpoints directly into the CI/CD pipeline and ML lifecycle (MLOps). * Developing comprehensive training programs to upskill Verizon’s workforce on AI ethics, data privacy, and responsible development practices. **What we're looking for…** You are a strategic leader who seamlessly bridges the gap between complex technical algorithms and enterprise risk. You have a deep passion for technology ethics and possess the unique ability to translate abstract principles—like fairness and privacy—into measurable engineering metrics and operational workflows. With exceptional stakeholder management skills, you are just as comfortable discussing prompt injection risks with data scientists as you are presenting governance strategies to C\-suite executives. **You'll need to have:** * Bachelor’s degree or four or more years of work experience. * Eight or more years of relevant work experience in technology policy, data governance, legal, risk management, or data science. * Three or more years of direct leadership experience in AI Governance, Responsible AI, Tech Ethics, or AI/ML Risk Management at an enterprise scale. * Deep understanding of machine learning lifecycles, generative AI technologies, and the specific ethical risks associated with Large Language Models (LLMs). * Demonstrated experience translating global AI and data regulations (e.g., NIST AI RMF, EU AI Act, GDPR, CCPA) into enterprise compliance strategies. **Even better if you have one or more of the following:** * A Master’s degree, JD, or PhD in Law, Public Policy, Computer Science, Data Ethics, Human\-Computer Interaction, or a related field. * Experience operating within highly regulated industries such as Telecommunications, Financial Services, or Healthcare. * Active certifications in privacy or risk (e.g., CIPP/US, CIPT) or relevant AI ethics credentials. * A proven track record of representing your organization in industry consortiums, academic partnerships, or standard\-setting bodies focused on AI ethics and safety. #### **Where you’ll be working** In this hybrid role, you'll have a defined work location that includes working from home and a minimum of three days per week in the office, which will be set by your manager. Employees are responsible for maintaining compliance with hybrid work policies. #### **Scheduled Weekly Hours** 40 #### **Equal Employment Opportunity** Verizon is an equal opportunity employer. We evaluate qualified applicants without regard to veteran status, disability or other legally protected characteristics. #### **Benefits and Compensation** Our benefits are designed to help you move forward in your career, and in areas of your life outside of Verizon. From health and wellness benefit options including: medical, dental, vision, short and long term disability, basic life insurance, supplemental life insurance, AD\&D insurance, identity theft protection, pet insurance and group home \& auto insurance. We also offer a matched 401(k) savings plan, up to 8 company paid holidays per year and up to 6 personal days per year, paid parental leave, adoption assistance and tuition assistance, plus other incentives, we’ve got you covered with our award\-winning total rewards package. Depending on the role, employees have the opportunity to receive compensation in the form of premium pay such as overtime, shift differential, holiday pay, allowances, etc. Newly hired employees receive up to 15 days of vacation per year, which grows with additional service. For part\-timers, your coverage will vary as you may be eligible for some of these benefits depending on your individual circumstances. The salary will vary depending on your location and confirmed job\-related skills and experience. This is an incentive based position with the potential to earn more. For part\-time roles, your compensation will be adjusted to reflect your hours.The annual salary range for the location(s) listed on this job requisition based on a full\-time schedule is: $126,000\.00 \- $242,000\.00\. Salary126,000\.00 \- 242,000\.00 Annual Type Full\-time

jobs.title: Staff Product Manager, Buy Now Pay Later
jobs.description: **Overview** ------------ Intuit is a global technology platform company that helps our customers and communities overcome their most important financial challenges. We help give over 50 million consumers, small businesses, and self\-employed customers around the world the opportunity to prosper. The Mission Small businesses fuel the global economy. In the US alone, they employ 60% of the workforce and create 80% of new jobs. Yet, the odds are stacked against them: one in two fails within five years. One of the most severe challenges a small business faces is managing cash flow: balancing inflows and outflows, late customer payments, funding growth, and making payroll — all while hoping there is enough left over for profit or a rainy day. At QuickBooks, we aren't just building software; we are increasing the survival rate of entrepreneurship globally. QuickBooks Capital provides small businesses with access to credit products that improve their prospects and help them thrive. Our data shows that customers who take capital grow revenue more quickly than their peers, and our lending products ensure that customers have flexible, on\-demand access to capital whenever they need it. The Opportunity This role owns the strategy and execution of QuickBooks Capital's Buy Now Pay Later (BNPL) product — from merchant/customer experience through funnel optimization and long\-term expansion. We're at an inflection point where AI is reshaping how financial products are built and experienced, and this role sits at the center of that transformation. We need a product lead who is deeply curious, moves with urgency, thrives in ambiguity, and can translate emerging capabilities into measurable outcomes for small businesses. Why Join Us? Impact at Scale: BNPL is a strategic new growth bet for QuickBooks Capital, one of the largest providers of financing for small businesses. Your work will shape how millions of small businesses and their customers access flexible payment options. Autonomy: You will own the BNPL product end\-to\-end with the freedom to drive bold bets, run experiments, and define the strategy. Culture: You'll join a team where the bar is high, the customer impact is real, and the opportunity to innovate is at a massive scale. And we have fun doing it! **Responsibilities** * Own the strategy, roadmap, and execution for QuickBooks Capital's BNPL product, from customer acquisition, customer activation to checkout experience and performance measurement * Identify growth opportunities and innovate on the customer experience across the full funnel using AI to move faster, personalize at scale, and uncover insights * Define and launch bold new expansion strategies for BNPL to help fuel growth of the Intuit ecosystem * Champion the customer experience through deep empathy, research, and data * Lead cross\-functional partners from engineering to compliance to risk to ship delightful, intelligent, and responsible lending experiences for customers * Stay current with the AI landscape, including new model capabilities, emerging tools, and research and bring a point of view on how they apply to our customers **Qualifications** * 5\+ years designing and delivering world\-class products in a Product Management role, with a proven track record for results. Experience with growth and funnel\-optimization product management, and Fintech experience, strongly preferred. * Fluency with AI tools. You use them daily to research, analyze, prototype, and accelerate your work. Experience building or shipping AI\-powered product features is a plus. * Comfort with ambiguity. You can define the customer problem, set direction without a complete map, and make high\-quality decisions with imperfect information. * Relentless curiosity. You follow AI developments closely, experiment with new tools and models as they emerge, and have a tinkerer's instinct for what's possible. * Ownership mentality. You treat the product as yours, hold a high bar, and don't wait to be told what to do next. * Technically credible. you can hold substantive conversations with engineers about LLM trade\-offs, system design, and implementation complexity without needing to write the code yourself. * Bachelor's degree required. A major in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, or a related technical discipline is a plus Intuit provides a competitive compensation package with a strong pay for performance rewards approach. This position may be eligible for a cash bonus, equity rewards and benefits, in accordance with our applicable plans and programs (see more about our compensation and benefits at Intuit®: Careers \| Benefits). Pay offered is based on factors such as job\-related knowledge, skills, experience, and work location. To drive ongoing fair pay for employees, Intuit conducts regular comparisons across categories of ethnicity and gender. The expected base pay range for this position is: Mountain View $188,500 \- $255,000

jobs.title: Engineering Director, Focal Therapies
jobs.description: * Sunnyvale, CA, United States * Not Remote * Future Forward * JOB218419 ### **Company Description** It started with a simple idea: what if surgery could be less invasive and recovery less painful? Nearly 30 years later, that question still fuels everything we do at **Intuitive**. As a global leader in **robotic\-assisted surgery** and **minimally invasive care**, our technologies—like the **da Vinci surgical system** and **Ion**—have transformed how care is delivered for millions of patients worldwide. We’re a team of engineers, clinicians, and innovators united by one purpose: to make surgery smarter, safer, and more human. Every day, our work helps care teams perform with greater precision and patients recover faster, improving outcomes around the world. The Future Forward organization is Intuitive’s advanced concepts group. We explore emerging technologies, prototype next\-generation solutions, and build software experiences that shape the future of robotic\-assisted surgery. The problems we solve demand creativity, rigor, and collaboration. The work is challenging, but deeply meaningful—because every improvement we make has the potential to change a life. If you’re ready to contribute to something bigger than yourself and help **transform the future of healthcare**, you’ll find your purpose here. ### **Job Description** **Primary Function of the Position** The Engineering Director, Focal Therapies will report to the Senior Director, Advanced Product Development, Focal Therapies, who oversees the new Focal Therapies Platform in Future Forward. Future Forward is responsible for integrating new technologies and capabilities into new and existing Intuitive products aligned with our patient first mission. This is a unique opportunity to lead cross\-functional teams focused on developing new solutions to address significant unmet patient needs. The Engineering Director, Focal Therapies leads the strategy, design, development, documentation, and verification of new and derivative complex robotic platforms, flexible medical instruments, and system accessories in support. The will take full ownership of end\-to\-end technical development from early concept through launch. They will lead multiple managers and are responsible for helping lead the identification and creation of product requirements and driving the design, development, project schedules, and product performance against those requirements as well as the management of multiple groups of managers and engineers to ensure efficient product development that meets market, patient, user, and business needs. The successful candidate will coordinate team efforts across multiple projects, manage personnel efficiently, and ensure project milestones are met despite time constraints and evolving information typical of new product development. In addition to being a proven people leader, success in this role will require strong patient\-focused product definition and engineering acumen within the area of medical robotics and instrumentation. Previous experience successfully managing the development of medical technologies from early concept to product readiness is essential for success in this role. The successful candidate must have substantial people\-management experience across multiple teams or programs, strong technical depth in relevant areas, and a proven track record leading complex product development efforts to successful outcomes. They must excel in a high\-energy, focused, team environment, and have a commitment to high quality products with a patient first focus. **Key Responsibilities** * Set long\-term strategic technical product vision aligning team goals with business priorities * Direct the HW/SW, Systems technical development of multiple programs concurrently, including oversight for early stage NPI, Supply chain and test engineering. * Own and lead multiple technical product development teams through early\-stage de\-risking, product development, and business validation of priority product opportunities, using resource aligning, goal setting and tracking, career growth, performance management, hiring, budgeting and spend management. * Set direction for hardware and software engineering teams on the best methods to satisfy and verify design requirements, ensuring design outputs are successfully integrated into effective system designs across programs. * Define performance expectations and ensure effective communication across all team levels * Anticipate roadblocks and remove silos for seamless execution of priorities * Represent program status ably in interactions externally with key customer collaborators and internally within the company. * Provide regular updates to senior leadership through informal and formal meetings and communication. * Be a member of the leadership team of Future Forward Growth Opportunities. ### **Qualifications** **Experience and Abilities** * Successful experience in hospital\-based medical technology realization f bust problem\-solving skills and critical thinking. **Additional helpful attributes/experiences** * Bachelor’s degree or higher in an engineering, scientific or healthcare\-related discipline * Requires 15\+ years of relevant progressive people and operations leadership experience * Leadership of medical technology projects from inception through field validation to launch; Strong understanding of medical product ecosystem services * Proven skills in quantitative analysis and data\-driven decision making * Experience with intellectual property fundamentals * Demonstrated capacity to relate to all levels of employees * Willingness to travel: 20% travel / some Intl. ### **Additional Information** Due to the nature of our business and the role, please note that Intuitive and/or your customer(s) may require that you show current proof of vaccination against certain diseases including COVID\-19\. Details can vary by role. Intuitive is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We provide equal employment opportunities to all qualified applicants and employees, and prohibit discrimination and harassment of any type, without regard to race, sex, pregnancy, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, color, age, religion, protected veteran or disability status, genetic information or any other status protected under federal, state, or local applicable laws. jobs.title: Lead PLM & Configuration Engineer - Data Center Infrastructure
jobs.description: At Jabil (NYSE: JBL), we are proud to be a trusted partner for the world's top brands, offering comprehensive engineering, supply chain, and manufacturing solutions. With 60 years of experience across industries and a vast network of over 100 sites worldwide, Jabil combines global reach with local expertise to deliver both scalable and customized solutions. Our commitment extends beyond business success as we strive to build sustainable processes that minimize environmental impact and foster vibrant and diverse communities around the globe. The Lead PLM \& Configuration Engineer is a n individual contributor responsible for disciplined configuration control and lifecycle governance of all CAD models, BOMs, and technical documentation within the PLM system. This role acts as the system authority ensuring data integrity, traceability and alignment across mechanical, electrical, and documentation domains throughout concept, NPI, production and sustaining phases. The position owns revision management, baselining, effectiveness, and ECR/EC N workflows, preventing data divergence while enabling scalable, repeatable engineering operations. The role is critical to supporting customer audits, compliance requirements, and product lifecycle traceability in complex, configuration\-driven product environments. **Key Responsibilities** **Configuration Control** **\& PLM Governance** * Own end\-to\-end configuration control for CAD models, BOMs, and technical documentation within the PLM system. * Ensure accurate revision management, baselining, effectivity, lifecycle states, and release readiness across all engineering artifacts. * Maintain alignment between CAD structures, EBOMs, MBOMs, and released documentation. * Serve as the authoritative source for released product data, ensuring integrity, traceability, and audit readiness. **Engineering Change \&** **Release** **Execution** * Own and enforce ECR/ECN workflows, ensuring changes are properly reviewed , approved, and traceable. * Manage as\-designed versus as\-built alignment across product variants and lifecycle phases. * Coordinate engineering release activities across mechanical, electrical, manufacturing, quality, and documentation teams. * Drive resolution of configuration, release, and data quality issues to support program schedules and business objectives . **Cross\-Functional Leadership \& Agile Execution** * Lead release readiness reviews, change control boards, and cross\-functional working sessions. * Facilitate prioritization, action\-item tracking, and issue resolution across engineering teams. * Identify and remove blockers, manage dependencies, and drive accountability without direct supervisory authority. * Apply Agile, Scrum, Kanban, or similar execution methodologies to improve engineering workflow efficiency and predictability. **Data Governance \& Continuous Improvement** * Define and enforce naming conventions, metadata standards, classification structures, and release criteria. * Resolve configuration discrepancies, duplicate records, and data integrity issues. * Continuously improve PLM, configuration management, and release processes to increase engineering velocity and data quality. * Develop and maintain configuration management standards, best practices, and governance procedures. **Audit Readiness \& Traceability** * Ensure PLM data structures support customer audits, compliance requirements, and quality management systems. * Maintain traceable records linking requirements, designs, changes, configurations, and released products. * Support customer, regulatory, and internal audits through configuration history, impact analysis, and documentation retrieval. **Required Qualifications** * B achelor's degree in Engineering , Manufacturing, or equivalent professional experience . * 8\+ years of experience in PLM, configuration management, or product data governance within complex engineering environments. * Deep understanding of PLM systems, engineering change processes, and release workflows. * Demonstrated experience coordinating cross\-functional engineering activities across multiple disciplines. * Strong understanding of CAD, BOM, document control, and lifecycle relationships. * Proven ability to drive technical execution, prioritize work, and achieve closure without formal management authority. **Preferred Experience** * Experience supporting complex electromechanical products, such as cooling systems, power distribution equipment, or industrial infrastructure. * Background in NPI and sustaining engineering environments with frequent design changes. * Experience with Agile, Scrum, Jira, Azure DevOps, or similar project execution tools. * Familiarity with product variants, regional configurations, and effectivity management. * Experience supporting customer, regulatory, or quality audits. **Core Competencies** * PLM and configuration management expertise * Configuration integrity and governance * Agile execution and task leadership * Cross\-functional influence and coordination * Systems thinking across engineering domains * Risk\-based decision making * Attention to detail and operational rigor The pay range for this role is $110,100 \- $198,200\. Job\-related, non\-discriminatory factors used to determine the actual offered rate include qualifications and experience, geographic location, education, external market data, and consideration of internal equity. The anticipated close date of this job requisition is: . As part of the total rewards package, this position is eligible for a short\-term incentive based on performance. In addition, Jabil offers benefits to enhance your health, wealth, and resilient self. These include medical, dental, and vision insurance plans; paid time off accruing at a rate of 3\.07 hours during your first year of employment; 4 weeks of paid parental leave; in 2027, 11 company\-paid holidays (9 fixed holidays and 2 optional floating holidays), subject to change yearly; 401(k) retirement plan; and employee stock purchase plan. jobs.title: Software Engineer II
jobs.description: Overview Kimedics, LLC is one of LocumTenens.com families of companies. Kimedics is building workforce solutions for healthcare staffing to help operations teams and clinicians spend less time on administrative tasks and more time on patient care. With the growing clinician shortage, medical groups have to rely on collaboration with their clinician networks and staffing partner organizations to fill their schedule efficiently \- and without the right tool this can get incredibly complicated and expensive fast. We help them organize and optimize their practice staffing and scheduling operations! We have built a full\-stack end\-to\-end solution consisting of roster management, credentialing and document task templates, scheduling apps, pay calculation automation and analytics dashboards that empower healthcare organizations to optimize their schedule and rosters for the best fit and cost optimized schedule. We are a Jackson Healthcare company and we are now the third largest healthcare staffing company in the U.S., serving more than 7 million patients in over 1,400 healthcare facilities. The Engineer II is a developing software engineer who implements features and fixes independently with minimal guidance. This role owns small\-to\-medium tasks end\-to\-end, writes well\-tested code, and begins contributing meaningfully to code reviews and team processes. The Engineer II spends the large majority of their time writing and improving code while growing their understanding of system architecture, software design, and professional engineering practices. **ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS AND BASIC DUTIES:** **Technical Execution \& Excellence \- 85%** * Implement features, bug fixes, and improvements independently with minimal day\-to\-day guidance * Own small\-to\-medium features end\-to\-end from implementation through production deployment * Write clean, readable, maintainable code that follows team standards and design patterns * Write unit and integration tests independently; ensure code is adequately covered before review * Debug issues within their scope, escalating complex cross\-system problems appropriately * Participate actively in code reviews, providing meaningful and constructive feedback * Learn and apply new technologies, frameworks, and patterns relevant to the team's domain * Develop a working understanding of the broader system architecture and component interactions * Manage own work within the team's workflow with predictable throughput * Identify and flag technical debt and code quality issues within their area of ownership * Contribute to technical documentation for features and components they own * Pair program with senior engineers to accelerate technical growth **Team Collaboration \& Communication \- 15%** * Communicate progress, blockers, and questions clearly and proactively * Participate in team ceremonies (standups, planning, retrospectives, design discussions) * Provide substantive and respectful feedback during code reviews * Assist in onboarding and orienting Engineer I teammates * Collaborate with Product and QA on feature requirements and acceptance criteria * Seek and apply feedback from mentors and senior engineers to drive personal growth Contribute to a positive, collaborative, and inclusive team culture **SECONDARY FUNCTIONS (IF APPLICABLE)** * May work on special projects or other duties as assigned * Research and develop necessary skills to support organizational objectives **SUPERVISORY/BUDGETARY/EXTERNAL** **COMMUNICATION RESPONSIBILITY** * No direct Degree in Computer Science, related technical field, or equivalent practical experience, required * 2\-4 years of professional software engineering experience * Experience with version control workflows (e.g. Git, pull requests, branching strategies) **KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS, AND ABILITIES:** * Ability to adhere to and exhibit the Company Values at all times * Understanding of fundamental computer science concepts (data structures, algorithms, basic design patterns) * Growing proficiency in at least one programming language and domain relevant to the team (e.g. application development, data engineering, or cloud/infrastructure engineering) * Familiarity with testing practices (unit and integration tests) and CI/CD pipelines * Basic understanding of cloud platform concepts, web APIs, or relational databases relevant to the team's domain * Growing proficiency in a programming language and technology stack relevant to the team's domain * Working knowledge of Microsoft Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook, and Teams * Solid understanding of software design fundamentals (data structures, algorithms, design patterns) * Ability to implement features independently within well\-understood domains * Experience writing unit and integration tests; understands the value of test coverage * Familiarity with version control workflows and code review processes * Basic understanding of cloud platform concepts, APIs, and data storage relevant to their discipline * Eagerness to learn and apply new technologies and frameworks * Strong communication skills \- can articulate blockers, progress, and questions clearly * Collaborative mindset; seeks and applies feedback constructively * Solid critical thinking and problem\-solving skills * Strong organizational and time management skills * Basic understanding of version control (Git) and code review processes * Familiarity with web development, databases, or cloud platform concepts * Self\-motivated with
