jobs.title: Director of Embedded Software & FPGA Engineering
jobs.description: **Wanna join the adventure?** Loft Orbital is making space simple, giving commercial, defense, and government customers fast, reliable access to orbit through a standardized satellite platform. Our Hub and Cockpit products cut the complexity of traditional satellite missions, reducing time\-to\-orbit from years to months as we build a growing, heterogeneous fleet in LEO with increasing onboard AI and compute. As Director, Embedded Systems \& FPGA Engineering, you will shape the technical foundations that determine how Loft’s hardware, embedded software, onboard software, and operational systems work together. This is an opportunity to define the abstraction layers and engineering interfaces that let teams move faster without sacrificing robustness, reliability, or system understanding. You will help create a platform that can evolve across processors, FPGAs, operating systems, hypervisors, RISC\-V, Rust, and future technologies without forcing unnecessary changes through every layer of the stack. You will lead experienced engineers who work at the intersection of hardware, firmware, software, systems, and operations. The role is hands\-on in the technical sense: you will not write production code every day, but you should be comfortable going deep into architecture, Linux and build environments, debugging, security boundaries, integration problems, and technical trade\-offs alongside the team. ### **About this role:** * Own the ESW and FPGA roadmap and technical direction across Loft’s satellite platforms. * Define HW\-abstraction architecture and interfaces across FPGA, embedded software, onboard software, and operational layers. * Drive hardware\-agnostic and reusable platform capabilities where they improve team independence and allow HW and technology to evolve. * Enable the ESW and FPGA leads through clear direction, decision context, coaching, and removal of organizational or technical blockers. * Set expectations for architecture, design reviews, code quality, testing, verification, documentation, and operational readiness. * Build the core engineering foundation for Linux, Yocto/OpenEmbedded, CI/CD, reproducible builds, and secure or sovereign environments. * Guide technology choices involving hypervisors, RISC\-V, Rust, and other platform technologies when they create durable value. * Act as the face of ESW and FPGA and the triage point for company\-wide technical issues, dependencies, and trade\-offs. * Manage and develop geographically distributed leads and teams, including hiring, mentorship, performance management, and team health. * Represent the organization with customers, partners, and government or defense stakeholders when formal assurance and documentation are required. ### **Must Haves:** * 10\+ years of experience in embedded systems, FPGA, firmware, or closely related engineering, including delivery of mission\-critical hardware or software. * Proven experience leading and managing technical teams, including geographically distributed teams. * Deep experience with FPGA design, embedded C/C\+\+, real\-time systems, and HW/SW integration. * Experience designing HW abstractions and hardware\-agnostic interfaces from both technical and architectural perspectives. * Strong Linux kernel and embedded Linux experience, including low\-level integration, drivers, boot, or system debugging. * Strong Yocto/OpenEmbedded and CI/CD experience, including build infrastructure, automated testing, and reproducible releases. * Experience building secure and sovereign environments, including trust boundaries, secure boot, signing, controlled dependencies, or related security architecture. * Experience with hypervisors, RISC\-V, ARM and Rust development environments. * Track record of making sound trade\-offs across reliability, performance, security, schedule, and technology evolution. * Collaborative, solution\-minded leadership with the ability to enable leads, manage people with empathy and accountability, and act as a trusted cross\-company technical representative. ### **Nice to Haves:** * Experience with spacecraft avionics, command and data handling (C\&DH), payload interfaces, or satellite flight systems. * Experience in New Space or satellite manufacturing, particularly standardized, modular, or repeatable satellite platforms. * Experience with radiation\-tolerant or radiation\-hardened design and an understanding of the space environment. * Experience with real\-time operating systems such as RTEMS, jobs.title: Product Designer
jobs.description: **About Luma Financial Technologies** Founded in 2018, Luma Financial Technologies (“Luma”) has pioneered a cutting\-edge fintech software platform that has been adopted by broker/dealer firms, RIA offices, and private banks around the world. By using Luma, institutional and retail investors have a fully customizable, independent, buy\-side technology platform that helps financial teams more efficiently learn about, research, purchase, and manage alternative investments as well as annuities. Luma gives these users the ability to oversee the full, end\-to\-end process lifecycle by offering a suite of solutions. These include education resources and training materials; creation and pricing of custom structured products; electronic order entry; and post\-trade management. By prioritizing transparency and ease of use, Luma is a multi\-issuer, multi\-wholesaler, and multi\-product option that advisors can utilize to best meet their clients’ specific portfolio needs. Headquartered in Cincinnati, OH, Luma also has offices in New York, NY, Miami, FL, Zurich, Switzerland and Lisbon, Portugal. For more information, please visit Luma’s website. **About the role** The right person for this role will be comfortable switching and juggling priorities across multiple Luma initiatives at once, moving to wherever the platform needs support most. They will act as a design coach to product owners, helping them stay aligned with Luma's design standards as they build their own prototypes in Claude. A core and ongoing part of the job is front\-end fluency: generating and understanding front\-end code, then building and managing components in Storybook via GitHub so every component stays aligned to Luma's Claude Design Kit. Components vetted and approved by engineering are a good reference point for the caliber and independence expected in this role. Success looks like that becoming the norm rather than the exception: a well\-documented Storybook library, managed through GitHub, where every component is aligned to the Claude Design Kit and any front\-end engineer can pick one up and know exactly what to expect, cutting the current multi\-week variance down to a consistent, predictable turnaround. Success also looks like working and collaborating closely with engineers throughout the build, so that production consistently adheres to the prototypes that are created and rework is reduced. **What you'll do** * Own the hand\-off between product owners' and engineering, coaching them to build in line with Luma's design standards * Act as the primary point of accountability for component accuracy: making sure what ships to production matches the approved design by working closely with FE engineers * Create and manage components in Storybook via GitHub, with each one aligned to Luma's Claude Design Kit * Partner with front\-end and full\-stack engineers to define and continually refine a consistent, documented process for how prototypes get consumed. * Act as a design coach and consultant across Luma's initiatives, comfortable switching and juggling multiple initiatives at once across different parts of the platform, guiding others on design best practices and advising product owners on how to get the best results from Claude prototypes. * As the component hand\-off process matures, take on user research work: persona development, usability testing, and workshops **Qualifications** *Required* * 3\-5 years experience building or maintaining a design system or component library. Component creation and management within Storybook and GitHub is central to the job. * Hands\-on experience using AI\-assisted design/dev tools such as Claude to build and iterate on UI components that stay aligned to a defined design system (Luma's Claude Design Kit). * Strong product design fundamentals: UX/UI judgment, and the ability to preserve design intent and fidelity when translating a design into functioning code. *Preferred* * Background in financial services or fintech, ideally direct exposure to financial advisor software or wealth management platforms (structured products, annuities, life insurance, brokerage/advisory tools). * Experience with user research methods (interviews, persona development, usability/workshop facilitation) and interest in growing that side of the role over time. **The pay range for this role is:** 150,000 \- 170,000 USD per year(New York) 115,000 \- 140,000 USD per year(Cincinnati)

Success also looks like working and collaborating closely with engineers throughout the build, so that production consistently adheres to the prototypes that are created and rework is reduced. **What you'll do** * Own the hand\-off between product owners' and engineering, coaching them to build in line with Luma's design standards * Act as the primary point of accountability for component accuracy: making sure what ships to production matches the approved design by working closely with FE engineers * Create and manage components in Storybook via GitHub, with each one aligned to Luma's Claude Design Kit * Partner with front\-end and full\-stack engineers to define and continually refine a consistent, documented process for how prototypes get consumed. * Act as a design coach and consultant across Luma's initiatives, comfortable switching and juggling multiple initiatives at once across different parts of the platform, guiding others on design best practices and advising product owners on how to get the best results from Claude prototypes. * As the component hand\-off process matures, take on user research work: persona development, usability testing, and workshops **Qualifications** *Required* * 3\-5 years experience building or maintaining a design system or component library. Component creation and management within Storybook and GitHub is central to the job. * Hands\-on experience using AI\-assisted design/dev tools such as Claude to build and iterate on UI components that stay aligned to a defined design system (Luma's Claude Design Kit). * Strong product design fundamentals: UX/UI judgment, and the ability to preserve design intent and fidelity when translating a design into functioning code. *Preferred* * Background in financial services or fintech, ideally direct exposure to financial advisor software or wealth management platforms (structured products, annuities, life insurance, brokerage/advisory tools). * Experience with user research methods (interviews, persona development, usability/workshop facilitation) and interest in growing that side of the role over time. **The pay range for this role is:** 150,000 \- 170,000 USD per year(New York) 115,000 \- 140,000 USD per year(Cincinnati)

jobs.title: Sr. Software Engineer - Full Stack Java
jobs.description: **Overview** ------------ Join M\&T Bank's API Services organization as a Full Stack Software Engineer supporting the Development Portal Team, where you'll help power and evolve the technology behind the bank's enterprise API ecosystem. This highly visible role offers the opportunity to develop and support solutions that handle millions of API requests across internal and external banking applications while contributing to strategic initiatives involving API gateway technologies, enterprise integration platforms, and AI\-enabled development. You'll work alongside a collaborative, high\-performing engineering team with broad technical exposure and the opportunity to influence some of the bank's most progressive technology initiatives. This role is ideal for a versatile engineer who enjoys working across the full technology stack and contributing to both development and platform support functions. **Primary Responsibilities** ---------------------------- * Work independently and within the boundaries of the approved Software Development Lifecycle (SDLC) to process, design, develop, and support applications that solve business needs and minimize risk to the Bank by writing clean, resilient, and maintainable code. * Design, develop, and enhance Java\-based backend services and Angular front\-end applications supporting the bank's API ecosystem. * Build and support API\-driven solutions, integrations, and services that enable internal and external banking applications. * Regularly review pull requests, provide feedback, and execute change management activities to ensure code quality and maintainability. * Author organized, clean, efficient, and secure source code in one or more programming languages, applying appropriate data structures and algorithms to solve business problems. * Utilize source code management tools to manage and deploy applications, ensure compliance with SDLC policies, and support merge conflict resolution. * Independently analyze and critique technical and business requirements to ensure completeness, accuracy, and feasibility. * Troubleshoot and provide support for platform\-related issues across development and production environments. * Collaborate with engineers, architects, product owners, and business stakeholders to document and communicate technical implementation details. * Conduct code reviews and provide constructive feedback to improve code quality, performance, and security. * Contribute to application architecture discussions and technology decisions supporting API platforms and enterprise integration services. * Participate in AI\-assisted development initiatives and contribute to innovation efforts across the engineering organization. * Support highly available, enterprise\-scale platforms and applications that process significant transaction and API volumes. * Understand and adhere to the Company's risk and regulatory standards, policies, and controls in accordance with the Company's Risk Appetite. Identify risk\-related issues needing escalation to management. * Promote an environment that supports a culture of belonging and reflects the M\&T Bank brand. * Maintain M\&T internal control standards, including timely implementation of internal and external audit points together with any issues raised by external regulators as applicable. Complete other related duties as assigned. * **Supervisory/Managerial Responsibilities** ------------------------------------------- No supervisory responsibilities. **Education and Experience Required** ------------------------------------- * Associate's degree and a minimum of 5 years' systems analysis and/or application development work experience or Bachelor's degree and a minimum of 3 years' systems analysis and/or application development work experience. In lieu of degree, a combined minimum of 7 years' education and/or relevant work experience, including a minimum of 3 years' systems analysis and/or application development work experience. * Advanced proficiency in a minimum of one relevant programming language. * Experience developing Java\-based applications and services. * Experience with Angular or similar modern front\-end frameworks. * Full Stack software engineering experience across frontend, backend, and integration layers. * Experience working with APIs, RESTful services, and API\-driven architectures. * Experience utilizing source control and software development lifecycle tools. * Ability to work across multiple technology domains, including software development and platform support. Experience supporting complex enterprise applications and technology platforms. * **Education and Experience Preferred** -------------------------------------- * Advanced analytical skills specific to application development. * Experience working in a collaborative Agile team environment. * Strong Full Stack engineering background with both backend and frontend development expertise. * Experience with API management, API gateway technologies, or enterprise integration platforms. * Exposure to cloud\-native technologies and modern software development practices. * Experience supporting enterprise\-scale applications with high transaction volumes. * Exposure to AI\-related development initiatives and AI\-assisted engineering tools. * Ability to work autonomously while managing multiple priorities and complex projects. * Strong troubleshooting and problem\-solving skills. * Ability to adapt quickly and contribute across multiple technical disciplines. * Strong organizational and time management skills. * Proficient verbal and written communication skills. Financial services experience preferred. * M\&T Bank is committed to fair, competitive, and market\-informed pay for our employees. The pay range for this position is $97,100\.00 \- $161,800\.00 Annual (USD). The successful candidate’s particular combination of knowledge, skills, and experience will inform their specific compensation. **Location** ============ Buffalo, New York, United States of America

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer
jobs.description: Senior Software Engineer Job Overview We are seeking a highly skilled Senior Software Engineer to join our client's innovative team within a leading cloud\-based software company serving the energy sector. This role involves developing and maintaining complex web applications and APIs that support critical functions such as acquisitions and divestitures, reservoir management, and forecasting. The ideal candidate will have strong expertise in software engineering, cloud infrastructure, and agile development practices, with a focus on delivering scalable and reliable solutions in a fast\-paced environment. Duties * Design, develop, and maintain web applications utilizing JavaScript, TypeScript, and Python to meet client requirements. * Build and optimize RESTful APIs to facilitate seamless data exchange across systems. * Collaborate with cross\-functional teams to translate business needs into technical solutions within an agile development framework. * Work extensively with SQL databases to manage and analyze large datasets efficiently. * Contribute to the deployment and management of cloud infrastructure, primarily on AWS, ensuring high availability and security. * Participate in code reviews, testing, and continuous integration processes to uphold quality standards. * Communicate effectively with team members and stakeholders to ensure project alignment and timely delivery. * Support the ongoing improvement of development processes and technical documentation. Requirements * Proven experience in web development with strong proficiency in JavaScript, TypeScript, and Python. * Hands\-on experience designing and implementing APIs. * Solid understanding of SQL databases and data management techniques. * Experience working with cloud infrastructure, especially AWS services. * Familiarity with microservice architecture principles. * Strong background in software engineering best practices within an agile environment. * Excellent communication skills for effective collaboration with team members and clients. * Prior experience in the energy sector or related industries is a plus but not mandatory. * Ability to adapt quickly to evolving project requirements while maintaining high\-quality standards. This position offers an exciting opportunity to contribute to cutting\-edge solutions that impact the energy industry. If you are passionate about innovative technology, cloud infrastructure, and collaborative development, we encourage you to apply. Job Type: Contract Pay: $120,000\.00 \- $170,000\.00 per year Benefits: * 401(k) * Dental insurance * Flexible schedule * Health insurance * Paid holidays * Vision insurance Experience: * AWS: 4 years (Preferred) License/Certification: * AWS Certification (Preferred) Shift availability: * Day Shift (Preferred) * Night Shift (Preferred) * Overnight Shift (Preferred) Work Location: Remote

jobs.title: Estimator II
jobs.description: Overview: The **Estimator** plays a critical role in shaping the future success of major EPC projects by leading the development of complex, high\-value conceptual estimates and competitive bid strategies. Leveraging deep industry expertise and strong commercial acumen, this position transforms early project concepts into accurate, executable cost models that drive sound business decisions and winning pursuits. Reporting to the Estimating Manager, the Estimator serves as a key leader within their assigned service line, providing strategic estimating guidance across targeted industries and markets. This role takes ownership of all aspects of major project pursuits, including RFP analysis, estimate development, proposal strategy, alternative contracting approaches, and risk assessment. Working closely with multidisciplinary teams, the Estimator helps position the organization for success by identifying opportunities, mitigating risks, and delivering compelling, competitive solutions that align with client objectives and company growth goals. **Location \& Travel Details: Preference for candidates living in the Denver, CO area or Vancouver, WA region.** This is can be a hybrid or remote role. Must be able to travel up to 30% of the time. **COMPANY OVERVIEW:** MasTec Industrial, alongside its sister companies Casey Industrial and Phoenix Industrial, has been in operation since 1947\. We serve a diverse clientele, including utilities, independent power producers, developers, and municipal utilities. Specializing in projects using natural gas, oil, biomass, and other combustible fuels, our team boasts over 30 years of expertise in the power industry. We provide EPC (Engineering, Procurement, and Construction) services and assist in project development. Our experience spans various systems for utility and industrial facilities, including simple and combined cycle plants, reciprocating engines, and waste\-to\-energy projects. MasTec Industrial delivers value throughout all project phases, from conceptual design to operations and maintenance. At MasTec Industrial, we are dedicated to delivering the highest quality, safety, and value in every project. We focus on attracting, developing, and retaining top talent within our organization. Our goal is to foster a respectful work environment where all employees feel valued, included, and empowered to become innovative leaders in the industry. The MasTec Industrial market sector is part of the MasTec Clean Energy \& Infrastructure business segment. MasTec’s Clean Energy \& Infrastructure (CE\&I) segment generates over $4 billion in annual revenue, providing construction services across industrial, renewables and infrastructure sectors. In addition to our industrial market sector; In infrastructure, we specialize in general heavy civil construction, underground utilities, structures, electrical work, material production, roadways, bridges, specialty pavement overlays, environmental projects and commercial buildings. Our renewables sector focuses on solar, wind and battery storage. Sustainability and safety are foundational to our culture and influence everything we do. MasTec, a minority\-owned Fortune 500 company, has shaped the construction industry for more than 90 years. With over 35,000 employees and 400 offices nationwide, we provide flexibility and career growth in dynamic work environments. Responsibilities: **ESSENTIAL JOB FUNCTIONS:** * Prepare accurate quantity surveys and estimates for those divisions of the project as assigned * Complete assignments in agreed upon time frame * Solicit subcontractor and/or supplier quotations or scheduling input as required for the assignments * Participate in plan review and estimate reviews for respective projects * Assist in compiling historical cost data for projects * Confirm list of subcontractors/suppliers proposing on the project * Collaborate with Architects/Engineers to request clarifications or additional information * Attend project meetings and perform site investigations as assigned * Become familiar with all estimating software **Lead Estimator Designation:** When the Estimator is designated as the Lead Estimator on an estimate, the following additional responsibilities will be required:* Supervise and line out all people on the bid team, provide adequate information to team members and establish bidding schedule with deadlines. * Assure successful kick off meetings, mid\-bid reviews, and final reviews. Get the Regional VP of Operations involved if they are available. * Review and understand owner provided specifications and documentation for all portions of the work and ensure the needed costs have been incorporated into the estimate. * Perform final reviews at least two (2\) days before bid due date. * Review all work performed by team members. * Critically analyze each aspect of the estimate to ensure a competitive bid. Apply appropriate labor rates and methods of construction based on provided information and expected site conditions. Explore options which could shorten the construction schedules and minimize indirects and construction equipment. Recognize risks and apply contingency and escalation when appropriate. Know when and how to capitalize on opportunities. Qualifications: **EDUCATION AND WORK EXPERIENCE REQUIREMENTS:*** Associates degree in Architectural Drafting \& Estimating. * Bachelor’s degree in construction management or engineering or equivalent experience preferred. * 2\-5 Years of estimating experience. **KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS, AND ABILITIES REQUIRED:*** Be knowledgeable of MIC Health and Safety programs and project specific regulations. * When on\-site, actively participate in daily toolbox meetings with crews and subcontractors. * Set a personal example of safe behavior. * Other may duties may be assigned **What's in it for you:** Financial Wellbeing* Compensation $100,000 \- $150,000 per year, commensurate with experience. * Competitive pay with ongoing performance review and merit increase * 401(k) with company match \& Employee Stock Purchase Plan (ESPP) * Flexible spending account (Healthcare \& Dependent care) Health \& Wellness* Medical, Dental, and Vision insurance (plan choice) \- coverage for spouse, domestic partner, and children * Diabetes Management, Telehealth Coverage, Prescription Drug Plan, Pet Insurance Family \& Lifestyle* Paid Time Off, Paid Holidays, Bereavement Leave * Military Leave, including Differential Pay and Benefits Continuation * Employee Assistance Program Planning for the Unexpected* Short and long\-term disability, life insurance, and accidental death \& dismemberment * Voluntary life insurance, accident, critical illness, hospital indemnity coverage * Emergency Travel Assistance Program * Group legal plan *Position may be subject to pre\-employment screening, which may include background check and drug testing. Accessibility: If you need an accommodation as part of the employment process, contact ceicareers@mastec.com. Due to the high volume of applications received, we are unable to respond to individual requests regarding application status. Please log into your candidate profile for up\-to\-date information.* ***MasTec, Inc. is an Equal Employment Opportunity Employer/Disability/Veteran. The Company's policy is not to unlawfully discriminate against any applicant or employee on the basis of race, color, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, religion, national origin, age, disability, genetic information, military status, or any other consideration made unlawful by applicable federal, state, or local laws. The Company also prohibits harassment of applicants and employees based on any of these protected categories. It is also MasTec's policy to comply with all applicable state, federal and local laws respecting consideration of unemployment status in making hiring decisions.*** ***Disclaimer: MasTec and our Subsidiaries will never ask prospective employees for any form of payment or money transfer as part of job application or onboarding. We do not ask prospective employees for information about credit cards or personal passwords, and it does not require applicants to purchase equipment or software. Ensure that all recruiter email addresses end in @mastec.com or @talent.icims.com. If you suspect you are the target of a scam, we advise you to contact your local law enforcement agency and report fraud at*** ***https://reportfraud.ftc.gov/******.*** *MasTec Clean Energy \& Infrastructure and our subsidiaries do not work with any third\-party recruiters or agencies without a valid signed agreement and partnership with the Corporate Talent Acquisition Team.* \#LI\-MH1 \#LI\-Remote

jobs.description: Site: Mass General Brigham Health Plan Holding Company, Inc. Mass General Brigham relies on a wide range of professionals, including doctors, nurses, business people, tech experts, researchers, and systems analysts to advance our mission. As a not\-for\-profit, we support patient care, research, teaching, and community service, striving to provide exceptional care. We believe that high\-performing teams drive groundbreaking medical discoveries and invite all applicants to join us and experience what it means to be part of Mass General Brigham. **Job Summary** Mass General Brigham Health Plan is an exciting place to be within the healthcare industry. As a member of Mass General Brigham, we are at the forefront of transformation with one of the world’s leading integrated healthcare systems. Together, we are providing our members with innovative solutions centered on their health needs to expand access to seamless and affordable care and coverage. Our work centers on creating an exceptional member experience – a commitment that starts with our employees. Working with some of the most accomplished professionals in healthcare today, our employees have opportunities to learn and contribute expertise within a welcoming and supportive environment that embraces their unique and varied backgrounds, experiences, and skills. We are pleased to offer competitive salaries and a benefits package with flexible work options, career growth opportunities, and much more. The Mass General Brigham Health Plan Digital and Customer Experience team believes that by meeting our customers' needs with intuitive, impactful, and inclusive solutions, we will earn their loyalty, drive continuous improvement, and achieve growth across the organization. More simply stated, we are a team of passionate people who want to improve the lives of our members and the people that support them. Belief in a better healthcare system is core to what drives us, and we hope it is what drives you too. Our team’s guiding principles are to improve lives, design for ease, and build for scale. Everything we do is filtered through that lens and our solutions must meet the bar of being desirable for our customers, viable for our business, and feasible to implement. If you’re interested in joining a team of passionate and customer\-focused innovators, we would love to have you. Responsible for helping define MGBHP Digital products' defined strategy, managing related product launches, and subsequent release cycles for the Business Solutions portfolio (e.g. CRM and website). Work with users to identify high\-value opportunities. * Lead product design and development for innovative solutions. * Work collaboratively with data scientists, software engineers, infrastructure, and high\-performance computing experts, and business development in cross\-functional teams on cutting\-edge technologies. * Adhere to and support a quality management framework. **Qualifications** required * Demonstrated experience in digital product management, product ownership, or a related discipline * Experience developing product strategies, roadmaps, and prioritized backlogs * Strong experience working with software development teams and cross\-functional stakeholders * Ability to translate complex business needs into clear product requirements and outcomes * Strong communication, AI\-enabled digital solutions is a plus **Skills and Abilities** * Excellent understanding of the industry landscape (competitors and partners). * Excellent written and verbal communication skills. * organizational and multitasking skills. * Excellent team and relationship\-building abilities, with both internal and external parties (engineers, business stakeholders, partners, etc.). * Ability to jobs.title: Principal Test Development Engineer
jobs.description: Responsibilities: MaxLinear is seeking a Principal Test Development Engineer to join our team. In this role, you will focus on the following: * Develop ATE test solutions for highly integrated RF SoC ICs for Wireless, Cable, and High\-Speed Interconnect transceiver applications * Lead cross\-functional discussions on testability architecture, design for test, efficient test solution development, and ATE test HW design * Define, document, and drive best practices within test engineering team * Drive R\&D experiments for new hardware and software design concepts * Evaluate new software/automation tools to improve test development efficiency * Provide training and technical guidance to junior test engineers in the team * Interact with test ecosystem to enable test solutions that meet our business needs * Communicate clearly with all levels within the company * Assist with attracting and hiring top talent * Accountable for the KPIs (test coverage, test cost, product spec compliance) for test engineering Qualifications: * Strong background in RF, Mixed Signal, and Digital principles * Expertise in developing multi\-site production test solutions for complex RF SoCs using Advantest 93K wave scale and port scale test system. Experience with other test systems is a plus * Experience in C, C\+\+, Java, VB, LabView, or automation scripting (PERL, PYTHON, or MATLAB) * Experience in developing high\-performance RF ATE hardware * Experience with electronic bench\-test equipment \- oscilloscopes, logic analyzers, pulse and signal generators, power supplies, DC source/measure * Proven track record of leading test development and taking multiple RF SOCs to high\-volume production * BS in Electrical Engineering or related \+ 9 years of experience, or MS \+ 7 years of experience Compensation and Benefits: MaxLinear has a Total Compensation philosophy which includes base salary and annual discretionary bonus eligibility and many positions also include stock\-based compensation. MaxLinear's good faith estimate starting base salary range is: $142,000to $191,000 Annually We offer competitive benefits designed to support employee health, welfare, and retirement and some highlights are: health care benefits, 401k savings plan, Employee Stock Purchase Plan (ESPP), and paid time off. The actual starting base salary will be determined by the match to certain role\-related criteria such as educational degree(s) or equivalent, relevant work experience, skillset needed for the role, and geographic location; this is not an all\-inclusive list as some roles may require unique skills or experience. Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to, and will not be discriminated against based on race, sex, religion, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability, or protected veteran status. Company Overview: MaxLinear is a global, NASDAQ\-traded company (MXL) where the entrepreneurial spirit is alive and well. We are a fabless system\-on\-chip product company, striving to improve the world’s communication networks for everyone through our highly integrated radio\-frequency (RF), analog, digital, and mixed\-signal semiconductor solutions for access and connectivity, wired and wireless infrastructure, and industrial and multi\-market applications. We hire the best people in the industry and engage them in some of the most exciting opportunities that connect the world we live in today. Our growth has come from innovative, bold approaches to solving some of the world’s most challenging communication technology problems in the most efficient and effective manner. MaxLinear began by developing the world’s first high\-performance TV tuner chip using standard CMOS process technology. Others said we couldn’t achieve the extremely high\-performance requirements using CMOS, but we proved them wrong and achieved enduring global market leadership with our designs. Since then, we’ve developed a full line of products that drive 4G and 5G infrastructure; enable data center, metro and long\-haul optical interconnects; bring 10Gbit to the home; power the IoT revolution; and enable robust and reliable communication in harsh industrial environments. Over the years, we’ve expanded through organic growth and through several acquisitions that have perfectly complemented our existing portfolio and enabled us to deliver complete end\-to\-end solutions in our target markets. One such example was the acquisition of Intel’s Home Gateway Platform Division that added Wi\-Fi, Ethernet, and Broadband Gateway Processor SoC technology to our connected home portfolio creating a complete and scalable platform of connectivity and access solutions to fully address our customers’ needs. Our headquarters are in Carlsbad, near San Diego, California. We also have major design centers in Irvine and San Jose, California; Valencia, Spain; Bangalore, India; Munich, Germany; Israel; and Singapore. We have approximately 1,200 employees, a substantial majority of whom have engineering degrees and include masters and Ph.D. graduates from many of the premiere universities around the world. Our employees thrive on innovation, outstanding execution, outside\-the\-box thinking, nimbleness, and collaboration. Together, we form a high\-energy business team that is focused on building the best and most innovative products on the market.

jobs.title: Software Engineer 3
jobs.description: The Software Engineer 3: Architects, designs, codes, tests, documents, implements, and maintains complex applications, integration components, application interfaces, scripts, and/or automation solutions. This role supports both development and operational functions by performing day‑to‑day middleware administration, troubleshooting, patching, performance tuning, and configuration management while identifying opportunities to create automation to improve reliability and efficiency. In addition to optimizing system performance through capacity analysis, tuning activities, and identification of constraints, the engineer ensures enterprise‑grade observability by implementing and maintaining monitoring dashboards, alerts, and logging strategies that enhance visibility across distributed systems. Provides technical support and root‑cause analysis for middleware and application issues, implements upgrades and enhancements, and collaborates with vendors to evaluate product quality and compatibility. Acting as a senior contributor or technical lead on small to mid\-sized initiatives, this position provides leadership on highly complex Oracle projects related to new systems, architectures, and integration capabilities aligned with business goals. Responsibilities include conducting system analysis, participating in design and code reviews, enhancing existing systems, supporting stakeholders and application teams, and ensuring that all middleware and automation solutions meet performance, security, and interoperability standards. Serves as a subject\-matter expert, consulting with stakeholders on integration strategy, reliability engineering, and technology improvements, and works across IT teams to identify deficiencies, drive process improvements, and contribute to planning, documentation, and the continuous enhancement of enterprise middleware environments. Mentor and support junior team members. **Education and Experience Requirements:** Bachelor’s degree or foreign equivalent in Computer Science, Computer Information Systems, Electronics and Communication Engineering, Electronics Engineering, or related field **Specific skills or other requirements:** 6 years of experience with: designing, developing, integrating and installing Oracle business software applications, automation tooling, and enterprise middleware solutions; Oracle middleware technologies, including Oracle Integration Cloud, Oracle SOA Suite, WebLogic Server, and/or Oracle Managed File Transfer; developing and supporting enterprise integrations, including messaging, orchestration, file\-based flows, and middleware\-driven automation; Python, Bash, Shell Scripting, and/or PowerShell; Oracle databases; and SQL and PL/SQL. 3 years of experience with: implementing security and access controls, including RBAC/LBAC models, certificate lifecycle management, and PGP/GPG encryption and key management; OEM, SolarWinds, Splunk, and/or Grafana; Linux environment administration; supporting and troubleshooting IAM solutions across Oracle IDCS, OCI‑IAM, Azure SSO, and enterprise identity providers using SAML, OAuth, OpenID Connect, and Basic authentication; OCI, Microsoft Azure, or AWS; DevOps; CI/CD pipeline design, automated testing, artifact management, and deployment automation. 2 years of experience with Git/GitHub. 1 year of experience with: Oracle Fusion; and Kubernetes, Nutanix NKE, or Docker. **Locations** : 1615 Locust St., Des Moines, IA 50309 and/or work from a home office located anywhere in the U.S. **Salary Range:** $141,232 to $141,232 **Sponsorship:** No \- Must be authorized to work in the United States without the need for current or future sponsorship. **Apply to:** Jamie Huygens, MidAmerican Energy Company, 1615 Locust St., PO Box 657, Des Moines, IA 50309 or jamie.huygens@midamerican.com. jobs.title: Senior Data Center Operations Engineer
jobs.description: **Company Overview** -------------------- Milestone Technologies is a global IT managed services firm that partners with organizations to scale their technology, infrastructure and services to drive specific business outcomes such as digital transformation, innovation, and operational agility. Milestone is focused on building an employee\-first, performance\-based culture and for over 25 years, we have a demonstrated history of supporting category\-defining enterprise clients that are growing ahead of the market. The company specializes in providing solutions across Application Services and Consulting, Digital Product Engineering, Digital Workplace Services, Private Cloud Services, AI/Automation, and ServiceNow. Milestone culture is built to provide a collaborative, inclusive environment that supports employees and empowers them to reach their full potential. Our seasoned professionals deliver services based on Milestone’s best practices and service delivery framework. By leveraging our vast knowledge base to execute initiatives, we deliver both short\-term and long\-term value to our clients and apply continuous service improvement to deliver transformational benefits to IT. With Intelligent Automation, Milestone helps businesses further accelerate their IT transformation. The result is a sharper focus on business objectives and a dramatic improvement in employee productivity. Through our key technology partnerships and our people\-first approach, Milestone continues to deliver industry\-leading innovation to our clients. With more than 3,000 employees serving over 200 companies worldwide, we are following our mission of revolutionizing the way IT is deployed. **Job Overview** ---------------- Senior Data Center Operations Engineer **Job Overview** ---------------- The Senior Data Center Operations Engineer plays a critical, hands\-on role in supporting the build\-out and long\-term operation of a high\-performance, enterprise\-scale data center environment supporting advanced compute and large\-scale infrastructure deployments. This position is designed for an experienced engineer with deep expertise in server hardware, Linux systems, and data center operations, operating within environments that demand high availability, precision, and performance. You will contribute during the initial deployment phase, supporting infrastructure bring\-up, validation, and hardware readiness. As the environment transitions into steady\-state operations, you will take ownership of ongoing reliability, advanced troubleshooting, and continuous improvement initiatives. This role requires a strong operator mindset—someone who thrives in complex, production\-critical environments and takes pride in resolving issues at their root. You will serve as a primary technical escalation point, working closely with engineering and infrastructure teams to maintain system stability and performance. You will collaborate with cross\-functional teams, making clear and professional communication in English (written and verbal) essential for success in this role. This role offers continuity across both deployment and operational phases and provides exposure to large\-scale, modern infrastructure environments, with a clear path for progression into advanced technical or engineering roles. **Key Responsibilities** ------------------------ ### **Advanced Hardware Troubleshooting \& Repair** * Diagnose and resolve complex hardware failures across server platforms (motherboards, CPUs, memory, storage) * Perform component\-level repairs and replacements on servers and data center hardware * Execute break/fix processes with a focus on minimizing downtime and meeting SLAs * Conduct root cause analysis (RCA) of hardware failures and implement preventative improvements * Identify recurring failure trends and contribute to tooling, automation, and process enhancements ### **Linux Systems \& Platform Support** * Utilize Linux command\-line tools for system monitoring, diagnostics, and troubleshooting * Support provisioning and deployment of servers across Linux distributions (RHEL, Ubuntu, etc.) * Troubleshoot boot\-level and OS\-level issues in production environments * Collaborate with engineering teams to resolve complex hardware/software interaction issues ### **Data Center Operations** * Support hardware installation, structured cabling, and infrastructure validation * Maintain accurate inventory of spare parts, assets, and retired equipment * Document repairs, changes, and configurations in ITSM/DCIM systems * Ensure adherence to safety, security, and operational protocols * Serve as a primary escalation point for complex infrastructure issues * Participate in on\-call rotation supporting 24x7 operations ### **Collaboration \& Mentorship** * Provide guidance and mentorship to technicians on hardware troubleshooting and best practices * Collaborate with network, storage, and infrastructure teams to resolve cross\-functional issues * Contribute to knowledge sharing, documentation, and operational excellence initiatives * Support continuous improvement efforts across processes, tooling, and operational workflows **Required Skills** ------------------- * Strong English communication skills (written and verbal) are required for coordination with cross\-functional teams * Expert\-level knowledge of server hardware architecture and component\-level troubleshooting * Strong proficiency with Linux systems and command\-line diagnostics * Solid understanding of networking fundamentals and infrastructure components * Experience working within structured operational environments (SOPs, SLAs, ticketing systems) * Familiarity with ITSM/DCIM tools (ServiceNow, Jira, or similar) * Experience with structured cabling and fiber optic connectivity * Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills with attention to detail * Ability to operate effectively in high\-pressure, high\-availability environments * Strong organizational and documentation skills **Required Experience** ----------------------- * 5\+ years of experience in data center operations or similar infrastructure environments * Significant hands\-on experience with server hardware troubleshooting and repair * Minimum of 2 years of experience working with Linux operating systems in production environments * Experience supporting enterprise server platforms and infrastructure environments * Demonstrated experience performing root cause analysis and resolving complex hardware issues * Experience working within ticketing systems and operational workflows * Exposure to data center build\-outs, deployments, or infrastructure upgrades (preferred) **Preferred Certifications** ---------------------------- * CompTIA A\+, Server\+, or Linux\+ * LPI certification or equivalent * Vendor\-specific hardware certifications **Physical Requirements** ------------------------- * Ability to lift and move equipment up to 50 lbs * Ability to work in a temperature\-controlled environment with moderate noise levels * Ability to perform physical tasks such as standing, walking, bending, and kneeling for extended periods **Compensation** ---------------- Estimated Pay Range: $46\.17 \- $68\.00 USD Exact compensation and offers of employment are dependent on circumstances of each case and will be determined based on job\-related knowledge, skills, experience, licenses or certifications, and location. **Our Commitment to Diversity \& Inclusion** -------------------------------------------- *At Milestone we strive to create a workplace that reflects the communities we serve and work with, where we all feel empowered to bring our full, authentic selves to work. We know creating a diverse and inclusive culture that champions equity and belonging is not only the right thing to do for our employees but is also critical to our continued success.* *Milestone Technologies provides equal employment opportunity for all applicants and employees. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment and will not be discriminated against on the basis of race, color, religion, gender, gender identity, marital status, age, disability, veteran status, sexual orientation, national origin, or any other category protected by applicable federal and state law, or local ordinance. Milestone also makes reasonable accommodations for disabled applicants and employees.* *We welcome the unique background, culture, experiences, knowledge, innovation, self\-expression and perspectives you can bring to our global community. Our recruitment team is looking forward to meeting you.*

jobs.title: Principal Engineer
jobs.description: **Company Description** Mirantis, an IREN company, is the Kubernetes\-native AI infrastructure company, enabling organizations to build and operate scalable, secure, and sovereign infrastructure for modern AI, machine learning, and data\-intensive applications. By combining open source innovation with deep expertise in Kubernetes orchestration, Mirantis empowers platform engineering teams to deliver composable, production\-ready developer platforms across any environment—on\-premises, in the cloud, at the edge, or in sovereign data centers. As enterprises navigate the growing complexity of AI\-driven workloads, Mirantis delivers the automation, GPU orchestration, and policy\-driven control needed to manage infrastructure with confidence and agility. Committed to open standards and freedom from lock\-in, Mirantis ensures that customers retain full control of their infrastructure strategy. https://www.mirantis.com/ **Job Description** As a Sr. Principal Engineer for k0rdent, you will set the technical direction across the entire k0rdent engineering department — spanning core k0rdent, AI Infrastructure, and AI Applications. You are the most senior individual contributor in the organization and the technical counterpart to the engineering leadership team. You will own end\-to\-end architectural coherence across these three areas, ensuring that the platform they collectively produce is greater than the sum of its parts: a unified, production\-grade system for running modern and AI workloads on Kubernetes at enterprise and service provider scale. This role is deeply technical and deliberately broad. You will write code, design systems, prototype the hardest problems, and resolve the architectural decisions. You will partner with the Director(s) of Engineering and Engineering Managers and across the department to translate product strategy into durable technical execution, and you will be the engineering organization's senior technical voice with customers, partners, and upstream communities. **Technical Leadership Scope:** Provide cross\-departmental technical leadership without direct supervisory authority. Mentor and grow Staff and Principal engineers across all three pillars (Core k0rdent, AI Infrastructure, AI Apps), raise the technical bar through architecture and code review, and serve as the department's senior technical representative in cross\-functional, customer, and external forums. **Main Responsibilities:** * **Own Cross\-Departmental Technical Strategy**: Define and evolve the multi\-quarter technical roadmap for k0rdent as a whole. Ensure that decisions made in core k0rdent, AI Infrastructure, and AI Apps compose into a coherent platform rather than four parallel tracks. Identify the architectural bets that will let k0rdent scale across customers, clouds, hardware generations, and workload types, and drive consensus on which to make. * **Architect Across Pillars**: Lead the design of the highest\-risk, cross\-cutting components and contracts in the platform — the cluster and state management primitives in KCM/KSM, the GPU/accelerator and AI runtime layer in AI Infrastructure, the application and serving experience in AI Apps, and the telemetry, signal, and SLO surface in Observability. Own the interfaces and abstractions that connect them. * **Set Engineering Standards**: Establish department\-wide patterns and quality bars — API design, testing strategy, observability requirements, performance, security, multi\-tenancy, and operational readiness. Drive their adoption through example, review, and direct collaboration with Engineering Managers and tech leads. * **Mentor and Grow Engineers:** Coach Staff and Principal engineers across all four pillars and partner with Engineering Managers on technical career development throughout the department. Help calibrate and raise the bar for senior IC hiring. * **Drive Alignment with the Broader Ecosystem**: Partner with engineering leaders outside k0rdent and with upstream communities (Kubernetes, CNCF, OpenTelemetry, CNCF AI/ML projects, model\-serving runtimes) to ensure k0rdent's decisions compose cleanly with the broader cloud\-native landscape that customers run alongside it. * **Inform Product and Business Strategy:** Work directly with product management and executive leadership to translate customer problems into technical options, and surface the technical realities — risks, costs, time horizons — that should shape product decisions across the department. * **Represent Mirantis Externally**: Engage with customers on the deepest technical questions, contribute to upstream projects, and represent Mirantis in conferences, standards bodies, and technical publications. **Business Impact:** * **Architectural Coherence:** Ensure that work done across engineering pillars adds up to one platform. This is the single largest source of leverage — and the largest source of risk — at this stage of k0rdent's growth. * **Revenue Enablement**: Unblock and accelerate revenue\-driving capabilities by personally owning the cross\-cutting technical risks that would otherwise stall product delivery or force costly rewrites. * **Quality and Reliability:** Establish the engineering standards and review practices that keep a platform spanning core orchestration, AI workloads, and observability production\-ready. * **Risk Mitigation:** Identify and resolve architectural, security, scalability, and integration risks before they become customer\-visible incidents or block strategic deals. * **Talent Density:** Raise the technical ceiling of the entire k0rdent engineering organization by mentoring senior ICs and shaping Staff\- and Principal\-level hiring. **Qualifications** **Required Skills/Abilities:** * **Deep Technical Breadth**: Expert\-level proficiency across the surface area k0rdent covers — Kubernetes internals and cluster lifecycle, distributed systems, AI/ML workload runtimes (model serving, GPU scheduling, autoscaling under bursty inference traffic), and modern observability (metrics, logs, traces, SLOs). You don't need to be the deepest expert in all four, but you must be credible and effective in each. * **Systems Architecture**: Demonstrated ability to design large\-scale, multi\-tenant systems that span multiple subsystems and hold up under real production conditions, and to communicate those designs clearly in writing. * **Technical Strategy:** Ability to look two to three years ahead, identify the architectural decisions that matter most across a broad surface area, and sequence them against business reality. * **Influence Without Authority**: Track record of driving technical direction across multiple teams and organizations through clarity, credibility, and collaboration rather than reporting lines. * **Mentorship:** Demonstrated success developing senior engineers — Staff, Principal, and Tech Lead level — and raising the technical bar of an organization. * **Communication:** Ability to explain complex technical tradeoffs clearly to engineers, executives, customers, and the broader community, in both writing and conversation. * **Business Judgment:** Solid understanding of how engineering decisions translate into cost, revenue, and risk, and willingness to weight technical choices accordingly. * **Decision\-Making Under Uncertainty:** Strong judgment in fast\-moving domains where the technology — particularly AI infrastructure — is evolving as quickly as the product. * **Cross\-Functional Collaboration:** Effective partnership with product management, design, sales engineering, and customer\-facing teams across a broad portfolio. **Education and Experience:** * Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or related field or 10 years related experience. * At least five years in a technical leadership role preferred. **Additional Information** **What does Mirantis offer you?** * Work with an established Silicon Valley leader in the cloud infrastructure industry; * Work with exceptionally passionate, talented and engaging colleagues, helping Fortune 500 and Global 2000 customers implement next\-generation cloud technologies; * Be a part of cutting\-edge, open\-source innovation; * Thrive in the high\-energy environment of a young company where openness, collaboration, risk\-taking, and continuous growth are valued; * Professional development and training; * Attend conferences and working groups; * Company outings, happy hours, hackathons, and tech talks; * Receive a competitive compensation package with a strong benefits plan. We are a Leader for Container Management in G2 (\#2 after AWS)!

jobs.title: Solutions Architect
jobs.description: **Job Description** At Mission Pet Health, our passion for pets and their families fuels our ambition to build the world's greatest veterinary organization. We are scaling toward 1,000 hospitals and 20,000\+ teammates, and the data behind that growth runs across hundreds of clinical, financial, HR, and marketing systems. We're hiring a Solutions Architect to own the end\-to\-end design of the platform that ties it all together — and to stay hands\-on while doing it. **This is a hybrid opening in Birmingham, AL.** **KEY RESPONSIBILITIES** * Own the target\-state architecture for the data platform end\-to\-end — ingestion, storage, modeling, serving, and governance. * Set the direction for our analytical layer on SQL Server, SSAS, and ClickHouse, and for our integration fabric across Azure Data Factory, REST APIs, NATS, and CDC. * Design and operate event\-driven, service\-oriented workloads on Kubernetes in Go and Python. * Make AI\-driven development a core focus of the team: build and adopt agentic tooling (code\-aware agents, retrieval over our own schemas and lineage) so engineers ship faster, with better tests and documentation, and so routine work gets automated rather than repeated. * Define the data contracts, schema standards, and quality SLAs that engineering and analytics teams build against. * Embed PII/PHI handling, access control, and auditability into the platform * Mentor engineers, lead design reviews, and translate executive intent into delivery roadmaps. **Responsibilities and Benefits** **REQUIRED EXPERIENCE** * 8\+ years across data engineering, software engineering, or platform architecture * Deep hands\-on experience with T\-SQL, SQL Server at scale, SSAS, and Azure Data Factory. * Production experience with ClickHouse (or a comparable columnar engine such as Snowflake, BigQuery, or Databricks). * Strong production\-grade skills in Python, Go, or a comparable backend language — and the discipline to write the code, not just the diagrams. * Comfort designing event\-driven systems (REST, NATS or Kafka, CDC) and operating workloads on Kubernetes. * Genuine fluency with AI\-assisted engineering — coding agents, LLM tooling, retrieval, evals — and a point of view on how to do it responsibly inside a regulated, multi\-site business. * A track record of partnering with executives and turning ambiguous business problems into durable technical designs. * Reside in or be willing to relocate to Birmingham, Alabama and work onsite. **NICE TO HAVE** * Veterinary, healthcare, or multi\-site retail/services experience, particularly with Practice Information Management Systems (PIMS). \#INDHQ

accessories, heating loop systems, pumps, compressors, valves, motors, meters, heat exchangers. * The person in this position may work individually or as a team member as job conditions demand. * Position duties require inspecting, maintaining and repairing building and utility distribution systems located throughout the campus and performing related duties as required. **Required Qualifications – Experience, Education, Knowledge \& Skills** * High school graduation or G.E.D. plus ONE of the following: + Two (2\) years full\-time (or part\-time equivalent) work experience in the HVAC industry. + Successful completion of Vocational/Technical institute training (minimum of two years) * Familiar with air\-handling and heating system preventative maintenance, troubleshooting, repair and installation. * Familiar with tools of the HVAC industry such as test equipment, and hand and power tools. * Familiar with computerized building management and digital control systems. * Working knowledge of work safety procedures, such as lockout/tagout and asbestos safety. * Demonstrated competence using personal computers and software. **Preferred Qualifications – Experience, Education, Knowledge \& Skills** * Experience with computerized maintenance systems. * Demonstrated knowledge of boiler operation and maintenance such as chemical treatment. * Experience working with pneumatic control systems. * Demonstrated knowledge of air and water system balancing. * Demonstrated knowledge or experience in the maintenance of Biological/Chemical Safety Laboratories. * Experience working in a University or institutional environment. **The Successful Candidate Will** * Consistently exercise initiative and good judgment. * Effectively operate work\-related equipment. * Maintain computerized records, work independently with minimal supervision, and work proficiently in the use of a computerized maintenance management system, e\-mail, and other computer applications as assigned or required. * Communicate effectively with employees and the public both in person and over the phone. * Establish and maintain effective working relations with supervisor, coworkers and the public. * Be a successful team player. * Represent the department and MSU to others in a professional and courteous manner. **Position Special Requirements/Additional Information** Must possess a valid driver’s license, an acceptable driving record, and meet all State of Montana requirements to operate State/University vehicles. (If successful candidate possesses a valid out\-of\-state driver’s license, must obtain a valid Montana driver’s license within 60 days of hire.) * This position can be hired at one of five levels: Repair Maintenance Engineer (RME) – $37\.68/hour + **Staff at this level meet the minimum qualifications listed above.** * Maintenance Engineer I (ME I) – $39\.19/hour + **ME I includes the position requirements of the Repair Maintenance Engineer and the candidate must possess a minimum Montana Third Class Boiler Engineer license. jobs.title: AI Engineer
jobs.description: Minneapolis, MN, United States \| HQ Business Support **SUMMARY** Mortenson is currently seeking an **AI Engineer** that will play a key role in developing, testing, and deploying AI solutions that enhance decision\-making, automate workflows, and unlock new value across the enterprise and with project teams. This role will integrate models and AI solutions into enterprise systems and field applications, working closely with cross\-functional teams, to ensure alignment between business needs and data architecture, defining data models for specific focus areas. **RESPONSIBILITIES** * Test and evaluate AI solutions and functionalities within and beyond enterprise solutions * Translate business requirements into business\-ready AI solutions * Collaborate with business partners, presenting goals, objective and findings to non\-technical audiences to promote innovation aligned with R\&D efforts of the organization * Work with structured and unstructured data from construction platforms (eg. Procore, Autodesk) * Partner with Data Solutions to apply reusable components and pipelines to support and implement scalable AI solutions for team members, supporting domain experts across ITS and operations * Ensure AI solutions meet Mortenson’s standards for security, privacy, and responsible use * Effectively work and build relationships with those of diverse backgrounds and organizational levels * (If applicable) All other duties as assigned **QUALIFICATIONS** * Bachelor’s or Master’s in Computer Science, Data Science, Engineering or related field. * 2\+ years in experience in AI/ML engineering or applied data science * Prior work in construction, architecture, engineering, or real estate development, preferred * Experience with LLMs, multimodal models, or generative AI (eg. Azure AI Foundry, Google Vertex) * Familiarity with agent frameworks, agentic workflows, and knowledge graph, preferred * Strong proficiency in Python, ML frameworks, PowerBI, and data tools * Exposure to enterprise construction platforms or solutions (eg. Procore, Autodesk, Oracle) * Active listening skills and effective communication including an openness to diverse input and feedback * Ability to travel up to 15% * Driver’s license required **A few benefits offered include:** *(for Non\-Craft \& Non\-Union Craft working 25\+ hours / week)* * Medical and prescription drug plans that includes no additional cost vision coverage * Dental plan * 401k retirement plan with a generous Mortenson match * Paid time off, holidays, and other paid leaves * Employer paid Life, AD\&D, and disability insurance * No\-Cost mental health tool and concierge with extensive work\-life resources * Tuition reimbursement * Adoption Assistance Gym Membership Discount Program * **The base pay range for this role** is **$85,300 \- $128,000\.** . (Actual range is higher for the following office locations: Denver, CO and Chicago, IL – 5%, Seattle, WA, and Portland, OR – 10%). If applicable: This position is eligible for Mortenson’s incentive plan. Base pay is positioned within the range based on several factors including an individual’s knowledge, skills, and experience, with consideration given to internal equity. **\#LI\-BS1 \#Onsite** **Please make note:** * Visa sponsorship is not offered for this position. * Our postings are typically open a minimum of 5 days and an average of 44 days. **ABOUT MORTENSON** As a top builder, developer, and EPC (Engineering, Procurement, and Construction), our expertise spans markets like sports, renewable energy, data centers, healthcare, and more. We are builders at heart, working to ensure the built environment has a lasting positive impact. Let’s Redefine Possible® **Equal Employment Opportunity** Your uniqueness brings new and creative perspectives to the team. Mortenson is committed to providing equal opportunities of employment (EOE) to all individuals, regardless of your race, religion, gender, national origin, age, veteran status, disability, marital status or any other legally protected category. **Other Items to Note** * Mortenson reserves the right to hire any individual without legal or financial obligation on unwanted solicitations. *No agency emails, calls, or solicitations are accepted* without a valid agreement. * Must be currently legally authorized to work in the U.S. without sponsorship for employment visa status (e.g., H1B status, 0\-1, TN, CPT, OPT, etc.). We are unable to sponsor or take over sponsorship of an employment Visa at this time.

jobs.title: Data Engineer I
jobs.description: **GENERAL DESCRIPTION OF POSITION** The Data Engineer is responsible for development and support of data products on a modern cloud\-based data lake, leveraging expertise and knowledge of multiple technologies \& data domains to help build a robust, scalable, and reliable data engineering platform. Additionally, a Data Engineer is responsible for providing data services for enterprise\-grade analytical environments, utilizing automated data pipelines at scale, and streamlining efficient data transformations for priority use cases**.** This role can be involved hands on in development of the codebase and partners with business units and peer technology groups to support analytics execution. **ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES** * Partner across the organization to architect, implement, deploy, and maintain data\-driven systems solutions * Build, maintain and simplify enterprise data pipelines with emphasis on security, reusability \& data quality. * Perform debugging and fixing application issues, root cause analysis, and help in proactive/preventive maintenance. Help in technical debt reduction and follow clean code principles * Development experience in one or more languages (e.g. Python, SQL, PySpark) * Experience in the use of Infrastructure as Code tools (Databricks Asset Bundled,Terraform) * Engagement in data governance council to define, develop, and review standards, guidelines, and data models to promote data quality and best practices * Leverage DevOps tools to automate deployment and validation/test automation of data engineering pipelines. * Writes and executes complete testing plans, protocols, and documentation for assigned portion of data system or component; identifies defects and creates solutions for issues with code and integration into data system architecture. * Effectively plan and collaborate with technical and non\-technical teams on business initiatives **QUALIFICATIONS** To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty mentioned satisfactorily. The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skill, and/or ability required: * + Technical knowledge of BI systems design + Big data architecture and technology landscape + ETL orchestrations + Strong communications skills + Comfort working in a fast\-paced, multi\-task environment **EDUCATION AND EXPERIENCE** Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, or a related field, or an equivalent combination of education and relevant experience. Demonstrated understanding of core technology disciplines, including but not limited to software development, database administration, systems architecture, cloud technologies, infrastructure, and related technical domains. **1\-2 years of relevant experience** in data engineering, data analytics, software development, database administration, or a related technical field. Compensation: $59,800 \- $69,400

jobs.title: Storage and Backup Enterprise Services Architect @Advizex (Remote)
jobs.description: This position will join the **Advizex** team, a Myriad360 company. **About Advizex** Advizex, a Myriad360 company, brings together over 50 years of innovation and client commitment. As part of Myriad360's growing portfolio, Advizex continues to operate with the same trusted expertise and customer\-first philosophy—now strengthened by broader resources and reach. For over 50 years, Advizex has done more than simply keep pace with technology—it has helped organizations stay ahead of it. With deep, real\-world experience across healthcare, education, government, manufacturing, and retail, Advizex delivers IT solutions that solve meaningful business challenges across infrastructure, cloud, cybersecurity, automation, and AI. This role will join the Advizex team and play a key part in continuing that legacy. Learn more about Advizex here! **ROLE OVERVIEW** This is an opportunity to join a fast\-growing Managed Services Provider. We are seeking a highly skilled and experienced **Level 5 Storage \& Backup Enterprise Services Architect** to join our dynamic IT team. The ideal candidate will possess in\-depth knowledge of storage and backup systems and demonstrate strong leadership and problem\-solving skills. This is a senior\-level position that requires extensive experience in designing, implementing, and maintaining complex storage and backup environments. This position is supported by a 24x7x365 team, but occasional evening and weekend work may be required to handle emergencies or perform system maintenance. Candidates must be based in the United States. **KEY RESPONSIBILITIES** * **Architecture \& Managed Services Leadership** + Define and own customer\-facing hybrid cloud architectures for Azure\-based managed services. + Design, standardize, and evolve multi\-tenant managed service platforms supporting multiple enterprise customers. + Ensure architectures align with contractual SLAs, SLOs, and support models. + Establish and enforce architecture, security, and operational standards across customer environments. * **Hands\-On Technical Leadership** + Maintain hands\-on involvement with storage and backup systems in production. + Lead troubleshooting and serve as the highest\-level escalation point for complex customer issues. + Architect resilient platforms with strong monitoring, alerting, backup, and disaster recovery. * **Customer Engagement \& Advisory** + Act as a technical lead and trusted advisor for enterprise customers. + Participate in customer architecture reviews, technical workshops, and QBRs (Quarterly Business Reviews). + Translate customer business requirements into secure, supportable cloud architectures. + Support presales and solution design, including architecture validation, scoping, and risk assessment. + Guide customers through cloud adoption, modernization, and hybrid integration strategies. * **Operations \& Reliability** + Provide architectural leadership for 24×7 managed service operations, including on\-call participation. + Lead major incident response efforts, including customer communication and post\-incident reviews. + Drive reliability, performance, and cost optimization improvements across customer platforms. + Ensure operational readiness for new customers and onboardings. * **Mentorship \& Influence** + Mentor senior engineers and architects within the MSP organization. + Influence technical strategy, tooling, and service offerings across the managed services portfolio. + Evaluate Azure services and technologies to improve customer outcomes. **REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS** **Required:** * **Education:** Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field. Master's degree preferred. * **Experience:** + 15\+ years of experience in storage and backup system administration and engineering in enterprise environments. + 5\+ years designing and operating Microsoft Azure for enterprise or MSP customers. + Deep, hands\-on storage and backup system administration experience in enterprise production environments. + Proven experience managing Dell storage and backup solutions. + Deep expertise in the administration of storage and backup systems. + Experience with backup and recovery processes. * **Certifications:** + **Required:** One Dell backup/data\-protection certification, such as **Dell Avamar, Data Domain, or PowerProtect**; **and** + One specialized Dell enterprise storage certification in either: - **Dell PowerScale** *(formerly Isilon)*; or - **Dell PowerMax** *(formerly VMAX)*. + Azure Architect Certification (nice to have). * **Problem\-Solving:** Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills, with the ability to troubleshoot complex issues. * **Leadership:** Demonstrated leadership abilities, including project management and team mentoring. * **Communication:** Excellent communication skills, both written and verbal, with the ability to convey technical information to non\-technical stakeholders. * **Adaptability:** Ability to thrive in a fast\-paced, dynamic environment and adapt to changing priorities and technologies. **Preferred:** * 15\+ years of prior Storage and Backup administration experience in complex corporate or enterprise environments. * Extensive experience delivering customer\-facing managed services in SLA\-driven environments. * Strong expertise in hybrid cloud architecture, enterprise networking, identity, and security. * Strong expertise in Cisco products. * Extensive background in 24×7 cloud and infrastructure operations, including incident response. * Experience with containers and orchestration at scale (Docker, Kubernetes / AKS). * Additional Azure certifications (Azure Security Engineer Associate, Azure DevOps Engineer Expert). * Experience working in MSPs or consulting organizations supporting multiple enterprise customers. * Familiarity with ITIL, SRE, or service management frameworks. * Experience supporting regulated, high\-availability, or compliance\-driven environments. * Exposure to cloud migration and modernization engagements. **As an Advizex employee, you will be eligible for the following benefits and perks:** * Company\-subsidized medical benefits * Dental and vision coverage offered * 17 PTO days * Flexible Work Arrangements * Retirement Savings Plans * Paid Long Term Disability * Basic Life Insurance offered **Pursuant to the NYC Pay Transparency Law, the base salary range in New York City for this position is $145,000\-170,000 base salary, plus opportunities for bonus and/or commission. Compensation in other geographies may vary.** Myriad360 is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, race, color, religion, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, age, or any other characteristic protected by law.
