Our team works at the intersection of compilers, agentic systems, numerical correctness, and verification to create systems that can reason about, generate, optimize, and validate code transformations across software and hardware boundaries. This is an excellent opportunity for new graduates who are excited about coding agents, AI\-assisted software engineering, developer tools, and GPU computing. In this role, you will work with experienced engineers and researchers to build agentic systems and compiler\-aware tooling that improve developer productivity, code quality, and system performance across NVIDIA's software and hardware stack. **What you'll be doing:** * Build and improve coding\-agent systems for tasks such as code generation, transformation, debugging, optimization, validation, and developer assistance. * Develop agent workflows involving tool use, planning, memory, execution, and feedback loops for software engineering and compiler\-related tasks. * Help create training, evaluation, and verification environments to improve agent quality, correctness, robustness, and usefulness in real\-world developer workflows. * Work on systems that reason about source code, intermediate representations, low\-level performance behavior, and optimization opportunities across GPU\-centric workloads. * Collaborate with compiler, CUDA, runtime, library, and hardware teams to develop and productize new agentic and compiler\-aware capabilities. * Analyze failures, investigate correctness issues, and improve system reliability, scalability, and performance in production\-oriented settings. **What we need to see:** * Bachelor's, Master's, or PhD degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Applied Mathematics, or a related field, or equivalent experience. * Academic, research, or internship experience in one or more of the following areas: coding agents, AI systems, machine learning systems, developer tools, compilers, programming systems, or high\-performance computing. * Strong Python and C/C\+\+ programming skills, with solid software engineering fundamentals; experience with Rust is a plus. * Strong interest in coding agents, agent systems, compiler automation, AI\-assisted software engineering, or program analysis. * Exposure to one or more of the following is highly desirable: compilers, LLVM/MLIR, program analysis, code generation, CUDA, GPU programming, parallel computing, or performance optimization. * Strong problem\-solving skills and the ability to work effectively across software layers and multidisciplinary teams. **Ways to stand out from the crowd:** * Internship, research, or project experience building coding assistants, software engineering agents, autonomous developer tools, or AI\-assisted programming workflows. * Experience with compiler infrastructure such as LLVM, MLIR, Triton, PTX, or related IR/codegen frameworks. * Experience with evaluation, testing, verification, or feedback systems for AI or agentic workflows. * Hands\-on experience with CUDA, GPU systems, or performance tuning for parallel workloads. * Publications, open\-source contributions, or strong academic projects in coding agents, AI systems, compilers, programming systems, or high\-performance computing. jobs.title: Data and Platform Engineer
jobs.description: NVIDIA’s DGX Cloud organization is seeking a Senior Data Engineer to become part of its data team! We develop the reliable data foundation that supports fleet health, capacity, utilization, cost, reliability, and operational decision\-making throughout DGX Cloud. Our platform supports engineering, operations, finance, and product teams managing and expanding large GPU fleets across cloud service providers and NVIDIA Cloud Partners. We are looking for a practical engineer and technical lead to take charge of a key part of the Navigator data platform. We develop the systems that transform distributed infrastructure telemetry and operational data into dependable, managed data products that support fleet health, capacity, utilization, cost, and operational decisions. You will be responsible for the architecture, technical plan, and production results of a major platform area like ingestion and orchestration, data quality and reconciliation, or data serving and consumption. You will clarify requirements with customers, define technical objectives, guide design and development among engineers and partner teams, and stay actively engaged in coding, debugging, and production tasks. Successful candidates have already led complex technical work across team boundaries and delivered improvements that other groups adopted. Our primary implementation environment is Python, SQL, Databricks, and Spark. **What you’ll be doing:** * You will own a major platform component and its roadmap. For example, define its architecture, interfaces, technical goals, and evolution. Anticipate capacity, compatibility, and operational needs over a multi\-year horizon, and translate them into achievable breakthroughs that balance immediate delivery with long\-term maintainability. * Lead technical delivery across teams. Work with customers and interested parties to clarify vague requirements. Break down design and implementation work for contributing engineers. Establish release turning points and manage dependencies and delivery risks. Guide the work process, revise plans when requirements shift, and keep management and partner teams informed and aligned. * Build data pipelines and products. Plan and carry out batch and streaming ingestion, transformation, reconciliation, and serving processes for fleet, capacity, utilization, cost, scheduling, and operational telemetry. Establish data models and agreements that remain stable as sources, consumers, and scale progress. * Develop shared platform capabilities. Direct the creation and adoption of libraries, workflow and DAG or comparable experience abstractions, deployment tools, and standard implementation approaches. Partner with related teams to solve shared challenges and evaluate progress in onboarding time, engineering effort, reliability, and cost. * Lead complex production investigations. Serve as the technical point of accountability for issues spanning pipelines, applications, SQL engines, Spark, storage, networks, and cloud services. Coordinate investigations across owners, drive resolution of release blockers and critical issues from partners, and implement preventive measures. * Define quality, security, and operational expectations. Establish and implement testing, data\-quality, reconciliation, lineage, SLO, and release\-readiness standards for your platform area. Partner with security and infrastructure teams on trust boundaries, service identities, least privilege, secrets, environment isolation, and auditability, and drive adoption across contributing teams. * Make trusted data usable. Deliver well\-modeled tables, APIs, automation, dashboards, and focused internal applications. Align with consumers on semantics, access patterns, freshness, compatibility, and ownership so that shared capabilities support dependable operational decisions. * Provide technical leadership through others. Guide design reviews, mentor engineers taking on larger ownership, and resolve technical disagreements using evidence and clear tradeoffs. Partner with leadership on priorities and explain how technical investments support DGXC objectives. **What we need to see:** * BS or MS in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field (or equivalent experience), and at least 12\+ years of equivalent experience * A sustained record of building and operating production software, data platforms, databases, or distributed systems. This includes owning a major component or complex project from requirements and architecture through release and ongoing operation. * Proven ability to outline a component’s technical plan, establish objectives for engineers, assign design and implementation tasks, and guide delivery within your team and nearby teams with little supervision. * Extensive practical experience in one or more of these areas: distributed processing using Spark or a similar system; relational, distributed, or analytical databases; production ETL, change\-data capture, streaming, or event handling; or backend and cloud platforms managing large data volumes. You must grasp the interfaces and failure modes of nearby layers thoroughly to inform solid architectural choices. * Strong software\-engineering fundamentals and production proficiency in Python or another backend or systems language, with the ability and willingness to work primarily in Python and SQL. Experience designing reusable abstractions, reviewing substantial changes, and personally implementing and debugging critical code paths. * Strong SQL and data\-modeling skills, with practical depth in query execution, incremental processing, schema evolution, consistency, and analytical consumption. Ability to reason about idempotency, replay, late\-arriving data, partial failure, and correctness across system boundaries. * Experience leading complex investigations involving multiple components and teams. jobs.title: Distinguished Engineer, Security Architecture - DGX Cloud
jobs.description: NVIDIA DGX Cloud is an AI Factory designed to power the next generation of AI and industrial\-scale breakthroughs. As the Distinguished Engineer for Security Architecture, within our Security Engineering organization, you will set the security design bar for an AI factory of hundreds of thousands of GPUs, and then build against it alongside the teams. This is the founding architecture seat in a new organization. Security Engineering is a new organization at DGX Cloud, accountable for the security outcome of the platform, and this is the architecture function inside it. You will define the security design standard for DGX Cloud, a bar that sits above the company floor, and hold it from inside the teams doing the building. Security here is fleet horizontal and stack vertical, so your scope runs from the hardware root of trust and the hardened baseline, through tenancy and GPU workload isolation, to the services and APIs built on top, across every DGX Cloud engineering organization. A small team of Principal Engineers will report to you and hold the bar at domain depth. This is still a hands\-on seat, and you stay in the design with them. You will also serve as DGX Cloud's technical interface into NVIDIA's central security organization. There is no architecture review board here and no approval queue; the bar holds because the strongest security engineers in the room helped set it and helped ship it. **What You Will Be Doing:** * Set the DGX Cloud Security Bar: Own the security design standard across DGX Cloud (tenancy, GPU workloads, identity, supply chain, and isolation) and make it concrete. Reference architectures, golden paths, and requirements engineers can actually build against, not a policy library. * Hold the Bar by Building: Embed with engineering teams on real work: join the design, learn the code, help ship the thing rather than grade it afterward. The posture is not "you did this wrong." It is "here are the considerations we need to meet, I will help, let's go to work." * Architect the Security Platform: Drive the multi\-year architecture for the common security infrastructure the fleet runs on: hardened baselines and patch SLOs, deploy\-time policy and admission control, workload identity, supply\-chain provenance through signing and attestation, and detection and response tuned to GPU workloads. * Engineer Classes of Risk Out of Existence: Finding a vulnerability is 4% of the work; building the system where it cannot happen again is the other 96%. Set their technical direction, hire into the gaps, and grow each of them into deeper scope than they arrived with. * Multi\-Functional Collaboration: Serve as DGX Cloud's primary technical connection into NVIDIA's central security organization, and partner across platform, production engineering, and network security teams. jobs.title: Research Intern, Robotics - Summer 2027
jobs.description: NVIDIA is at the forefront of the AI and robotics revolution, and NVIDIA’s robotics teams are on a mission to build the essential technology that can enable any company to become a robotics company. The Seattle Robotics Lab is uniquely positioned at the intersection of open academic research and real\-world industry impact, pursuing fundamental and applied robotics research across the full robotics stack, including perception, planning, control, reinforcement learning, imitation learning, simulation, and robotics foundation models. This research aims to transform research paradigms, transfer into NVIDIA’s robotics and simulation products, and create new robotics markets for the world. The Seattle Robotics Lab has published over 500 research papers, including many influential works that have been presented at top robotics, AI, and computer vision conferences. These works include BayesSim, cuRobo, DeXtreme, DiSECT, Factory, GraspNet, IndustReal, ITPS, LAPA, MimicGen, NeRD, RoboLab, RVT, ScheduleStream, and SHAC. (See our publications page for a complete list.) The work has deeply impacted the research community and NVIDIA products, including Isaac Sim, Isaac Lab, Isaac Manipulator, Isaac Lab\-Arena, Cosmos, and Newton amongst others. We are looking for PhD\-candidate interns to play a pivotal role in our research efforts, providing deep, hands\-on technical contributions. Our interns must have exceptional research and engineering skills, a strong research track record, and a team\-first mindset. You will have the opportunity to achieve real impact, while working with some of the most creative, brilliant, and motivated researchers in the world. Interns can either be working on their own projects typically aligned with one of our internal efforts, or in some cases directly contribute to one of our efforts. Our former interns have gone on to become full\-time researchers and engineers at NVIDIA and other world\-leading tech companies, started academic careers at top universities, and launched frontier robotics and AI companies. **What you will be doing:** * Developing algorithms, foundation models, and methods for robotic manipulation and/or loco\-manipulation, for industrial, scientific, and household applications; * Integrating these methods into real\-world robotic manipulation systems, including those consisting of collaborative robot arms, industrial robot arms, mobile manipulators, humanoids, and dexterous hands; * Contributing to multi\-person research projects that require a diverse set of skills across the robotics and machine learning stack; * Engaging with the academic community through high\-impact publications, conferences, workshops, and/or code releases; * Developing AI agents to accelerate research and engineering while ensuring correctness, reproducibility, and security. **What we need to see:** * Enrolled in a PhD program in Robotics, Machine Learning, Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or a related field; * Knowledge of both the theory and practice of robotics and AI, with a strong interest in connecting your work to real\-world robotics applications; * A demonstrated track record, with first\-author work published in top robotics and AI conferences and journals such as RSS, CoRL, ICRA, IJRR, T\-RO, Science Robotics, NeurIPS, ICML, ICLR, CVPR, ICCV, ECCV, and EMNLP; * Exceptional communication, collaboration, and interpersonal skills, with significant experience working on a team; * Exceptional programming skills in Python; in addition, familiarity with C\+\+, CUDA, and Warp is a plus; * Fluency in modern deep learning frameworks such as PyTorch or JAX; * Experience in AI coding and research agents, including critical validation of their outputs; * Experience with robotics frameworks such as ROS2 and physics simulation frameworks such as Isaac Sim, Isaac Lab, Newton, and/or MuJoCo; * Comfort in working through the complexities of simulation and real\-world robotics, including debugging physics simulators and renderers under rapid development; selecting, setting up, maintaining, and enhancing complex robotics hardware; debugging communication systems; and designing robust workflows for model training and evaluation. The following research areas and applications are of particular interest: * Bimanual and dexterous manipulation * Mobile manipulation and humanoid loco\-manipulation * Multimodal robot learning (e.g., vision, tactile, and force/torque sensing) * Simulation (classical and neural), sim\-to\-real, real\-to\-sim, and world models * Learning in the real world (e.g., imitation learning, RL) * Robot foundation models (e.g., VLAs, WAMs, world models): pre\-training, mid\-training and post\-training (SFT, RL, etc.) using various data sources (e.g., simulation, teleoperation, egocentric data) * Agentic robotics * Robot learning theory * High\-precision manipulation and reliable policy deployment * Scientific lab automation The Seattle Robotics Lab is primarily located in the vibrant Fremont neighborhood of Seattle. jobs.title: AI/ML Engineer
jobs.description: Optum Insight is improving the flow of health data and information to create a more connected system. We remove friction and drive alignment between care providers and payers, and ultimately consumers. Our deep expertise in the industry and innovative technology empower us to help organizations reduce costs while improving risk management, quality and revenue growth. Ready to help us deliver results that improve lives? Join us to start **Caring. Connecting. Growing together.** Optum is a global organization that delivers care, aided by technology, to help millions of people live healthier lives. The work you do with our team will directly improve health outcomes by connecting people with the care, benefits, data and resources they need to feel their best. Here, you will find a culture guided by diversity and inclusion, talented peers, comprehensive benefits, and career development opportunities. As an AI/ML Engineer at Optum AI, you'll be designing and developing AI systems to improve patient care. **About the AI Platform Team** We often deliver the entire solution, from healthcare data ingest, generative agents and AI models deployment, data extraction, agent/model results and analytics, to the applications used for reviewing clinical data and AI results. Our current projects involve both leveraging and building cutting edge Generative AI and Agentic AI technologies from scratch. We have the data and resources to make an impact on a scale. When our solutions are deployed, they benefit millions of people. We are a globally distributed and diverse team with the shared passion to improve patient outcomes, improve healthcare operations, and streamline payments. We pay attention to the details to make sure we deliver quality, the first time. You'll enjoy the flexibility to work remotely\* from anywhere within the U.S. as you take on some tough challenges. For all hires in the Minneapolis or Washington, D.C. area, you will be required to work in the office for a minimum of four days per week. **Primary Responsibilities:** * Contribute to the design and hands\-on implementation of the AI/ML platform that enables Optum to derive information from patient data in a scalable, reliable, and cost\-effective manner * Partner with product managers, data scientists, prompt designers, engineers, and business stakeholders to translate business requirements into scalable AI systems * Leverage AI assisted tools for design, implementation, code reviews, and testing * Ensure the delivery of high\-quality, maintainable, and efficient code and specifications. * Help drive architectural decisions and contribute to our long\-term technical strategy for AI/ML systems * Partner with cross\-functional teams to define scope, success criteria, and delivery milestones, then execute with solid engineering rigor through CI/CD, environment readiness, and quality gates to deliver on schedule without compromising reliability or maintainability * Stay ahead of the curve on emerging AI/ML technologies, tools, and research, and evaluate their applicability to business problems. Embrace and promote a culture of innovation through rapid iteration, experimentation and data driven decision\-making You'll be rewarded and recognized for your performance in an environment that will challenge you and give you clear direction on what it takes to succeed in your role as well as provide development for other roles you may be interested in. **Required Qualifications:** * Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or related field, or 2\+ years of equivalent experience * 2\+ years of experience in Python programming * 2\+ years of hands\-on experience in modern cloud infrastructure (AWS, Azure or Google. GCP is a plus) * 2\+ years of experience working with various AI/ML infrastructure, tools and platforms across the full stack of AI/ML technology * 1\+ years of experience leveraging Large Language Models (LLMs) * Proven track record of engaging with customers to design and deliver at least one complete AI product, from ideation to product release **Preferred Qualifications:** * Proven solid knowledge and hands\-on experience of CI/CD principles * Proficient with GitHub and GitHub Actions, artifact and dependency management, containerization using Docker, and infrastructure‑as‑code using Terraform to enable reliable, repeatable, and secure deployments * Experience with the challenges of delivering and monitoring LLM based cloud systems into production * Experience in Healthcare * Proven solid communication skills with the ability to explain complex technical concepts to diverse audiences * Demonstrated bias for action * Demonstrated passion for innovation and staying current with emerging AI/ML trends * All Telecommuters will be required to adhere to UnitedHealth Group's Telecommuter Policy. jobs.title: Principal Software Engineer, Platform
jobs.description: Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI) delivers mission\-critical applications for leading enterprises worldwide. Our cloud offers hyperscale, multi\-tenant services deployed across more than 50 regions globally. OCI continues to expand beyond traditional public\-cloud boundaries to support dedicated, hybrid, and multicloud solutions, edge computing, and more. As a Principal Platform Software Engineer, you will shape the platform foundations that allow OCI services and their consumers to work together reliably at scale. You will lead cross\-team initiatives involving APIs, middleware, runtimes, integration frameworks, and developer tooling—setting technical direction while delivering durable solutions that improve consistency, compatibility, and developer experience. **This position is office\-based and requires onsite presence in Nashville, Tennessee. Relocation assistance may be available in accordance with Oracle's relocation policies.** **What You'll Do** * Lead the design, development, and evolution of backend platform services, APIs, middleware, runtimes, and integration frameworks used across OCI. * Define and drive API versioning, lifecycle, deprecation, and safe\-rollout strategies that protect downstream consumers. * Establish reusable patterns for interoperability, multi\-tenant scale, resilience, and secure software development across multiple services. * Drive shared observability practices, including service\-level objectives, error budgets, monitoring, and capacity planning. * Diagnose and resolve complex cross\-service issues; lead durable remediation and compatibility\-safe migration plans. * Influence architecture and technical decisions across teams through design reviews, code reviews, technical guidance, and hands\-on engineering. * Create migration guides, adoption playbooks, documentation, and examples that make platform capabilities straightforward to adopt. Mentor engineers and raise the quality of designs, code, operational practices, and technical decision\-making across the organization. * **What You'll Bring** * Bachelor's or master's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. * 7\+ years of professional software\-engineering experience, with demonstrated impact on backend, platform, or cloud services. * Strong experience designing highly available, scalable distributed systems and evolving production APIs or platform interfaces. * Proficiency in one or more object\-oriented or systems programming languages, such as Java, C\+\+, C\#, or Go. * Deep understanding of distributed\-systems fundamentals, object\-oriented design, data structures, algorithms, and secure software\-development practices. * Demonstrated experience leading or influencing architecture and technical design across teams. * Strong judgment in ambiguous environments, a high degree of ownership, and clear written and verbal communication skills. **Preferred Qualifications** * Experience with microservices, SDKs, RESTful APIs, containers, cloud\-native deployments, or developer\-platform products. * Experience defining or operating SLOs, error budgets, observability standards, and capacity plans. * Experience with API interoperability, backward compatibility, migrations, or platform\-adoption programs. * Experience mentoring engineers and improving engineering practices across multiple teams

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer, Core Infrastructure
jobs.description: Are you interested in working on the Storage Infrastructure team that operates with Exabytes of data in 60\+ regions? Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI) customers run their businesses on our cloud, and our mission is to provide them with industry\-leading computing, storage, networking, database, security, and an ever\-expanding set of foundational cloud\-based services. Our team seeks hands\-on engineers with expertise and passion for solving complex problems in distributed systems, large\-scale storage, and scaling services to meet future growth. If this is you, you can be part of the team that drives the best\-in\-class Storage platform into its next development phase. These are exciting times for the service \- we are growing fast and delivering innovative, enterprise\-class features to satisfy various customer workloads. As a member of the Block Storage Data plane team, you will own the software design and development for core components and features on the I/O path of the Block Storage Service. It would be best if you were a strong programmer and a distributed systems generalist, able to dive deep into any part of the stack and low\-level systems and design broad distributed system interactions. You should value simplicity and scale, work comfortably in a collaborative, agile environment, and be excited to learn. https://www.oracle.com/cloud/storage/block\-volumes/ We’re looking for hands\-on engineers with expertise and passion in solving difficult problems in distributed systems, virtualized infrastructure, and highly available storage services. As a Senior Member of Technical Staff, you will own the software design and development for major components of the Block Storage Service Infrastructure. You should be both a rock solid coder and a distributed systems generalist, able to dive deep into any part of the data plane stack and low level systems, as well as design broad distributed system interactions. You should value simplicity and scale, work comfortably in a collaborative, agile environment, and be excited to learn. **Minimum Qualifications:** • 5\+ years experience delivering large scale, highly available distributed systems and backend services. • Extensive experience developing clean code in C\+\+ and scripting languages such as Python, etc. • Strong knowledge of data structures, algorithms, multi\-threading, I/O paths, operating systems, and distributed systems fundamentals. • Strong understanding of block storage systems and distributed persistence technologies. • Working familiarity with networking protocols (TCP/IP, HTTP) and standard network architectures. • Strong troubleshooting and performance tuning skills. • Experience building multi\-tenant, virtualized storage infrastructure, data management

jobs.title: Machine Learning Platform Engineer
jobs.description: Oxipital AI is on a mission to revolutionize the manufacturing industry with its cutting\-edge AI\-enabled machine vision solutions. These solutions drive greater resilience, operational efficiency, and sustainability in the most complex and critical manufacturing processes. As a fast\-growing company striving to make a difference every day, we are seeking a **Machine Learning Platform Engineer** to help build and maintain our V\-CORTX platform and the critical tools and infrastructure that support it. This role entails a particular focus on AWS architecture, containerized CI/CD workflows, full\-stack software engineering, deep neural network optimization, cloud\-based model training, and data management. You’ll work in a small group of machine learning scientists, collaborating with the cloud engineering team and others in our cross\-functional organization. The ideal candidate will have 3\-5 years of professional experience designing and implementing high\-performance software products in a production environment, and is comfortable working in a fast\-paced dynamic environment. We are looking for hands\-on work experience in several of the following areas: ML model training using AWS resources, CI/CD pipelines for machine learning, vision\-based deep learning, edge deployment, neural network optimization, and full\-stack development. Primary Responsibilities: * Expand the capabilities of our V\-CORTX cloud platform with new features around model training infrastructure, evaluation, deployment, managing isolated real and synthetic multi\-tenant data, and annotation. * Use best practices to minimize the cost footprint of model development. * Optimize the efficiency of our machine learning models at training and inference time. * Design, develop, and maintain tools and infrastructure for training, deploying, and evaluating vision\-based machine learning models. * Contribute to a robust and scalable product pipeline. Requirements: * Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or related technical field; graduate degree preferred. * 3\-5 years of professional software development experience. * Experience with AWS services such as EC2, S3, ECS, and Batch. And database services like DynamoDB. * Experience with training and deploying machine learning models using cloud\-based resources. * Experience with full\-stack development, especially serverless architecture on AWS * Experience with Infrastructure as Code frameworks, CloudFormation preferred. * Strong proficiency in Python, particularly with libraries like PyTorch, NumPy, or OpenCV. * Experience with software development and deployment in a Linux environment. * A solid foundation of software development best practices such as issue tracking, static code checking, and automated testing preferred. * Experience with deep neural networks for computer vision applications preferred. * Strong mathematical and analytical skills. * Excellent written and verbal communication skills. * Ability to work both independently and collaboratively on a cross\-functional team. * Strong attention to detail.

jobs.title: Process Engineer I
jobs.description: Description: **The Company:** Pacific Aerospace \& Electronics (PacAero) is seeking 2 Process Engineers to join our team! A successful candidate is committed to pushing the boundaries of technology, performance, and innovation. Join us and connect your career to the future! PacAero’s core businesses include an array of electronic connectors and housings for the world’s most extreme environments. PacAero is primarily located in Wenatchee, WA with a remote manufacturing site, Bonded Metals, located in Sequim, WA. Working together, we employ proprietary technologies, best practices engineering, and specialized manufacturing techniques to produce hermetic connectors and electronic packaging that perform in the world’s most extreme environments. PacAero’s products are hard at work in medical components, such as cardiac\-function devices, on key aerospace \& defense programs, in space and deep below the earth's surface. **The Position:** **Job Summary** Process Engineers at PacAero Wenatchee are relied upon as a Subject Matter Experts (SME) and technical solution provider for the manufacturing processes critical to our success. Under the guidance and support of the Process Engineering Manager, while supporting a collaborative and positive working environment companywide, they are creative problem\-solvers provided the freedom to ensure safety and develop the optimal balance of ergonomic, data driven technical and economic factors to maximize first\-pass yield, minimizing rework and attrition within their area of focus. High ethical standards, transparency and honesty are of core importance to the successful candidate. Additionally, they are punctual, organized, detail oriented, methodical thinkers where the scientific approach is second nature. They work well independently while also being excellent communicators understanding the best, most effective, solutions that come from soliciting input from experienced process operators, technicians, and engineering colleagues before implementation. They will conduct continuous process improvement analysis and improvement efforts to attain year\-over\-year reduction in attrition and improvements in first pass yield while achieving our customer partner and PacAero performance requirements. **Schedule:** Mon\-Fri, 6:00am to 2:30pm **Primary Responsibilities** * Work cooperatively with all employees. * Willingness to adapt work schedule to company needs. * Consistently at work and on time. * Observe safety regulations and follow protective equipment requirements. Report hazardous observations to your lead or supervisor. * Comprehend and follow all parts handling requirements. * Maintain a clean, safe, and unobstructed work area. **Process Engineer I Responsibilities** To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each responsibility satisfactorily: * **General:** Dependably and reliably works independently with minimal supervision in performing required tasks while maintaining strong independent thinking, follows instructions and management direction, retains information, possess legible handwriting, effectively communicates process improvements with direct management, and takes ownership of decision and assigned process. * **Agile Support Collaboration:** Ability to effectively work within multi\-functional teams that span the entirety of PacAero to successfully achieve performance targets. Effectively communicating with, and supporting, production personnel is a must, offering help as and when needed. * **Problem\-Solving:** Teaming with senior manufacturing, quality and process engineers, apply your strong root\-cause investigation and analysis skills in identifying and separating variables, collecting data, establishing facts, and drawing accurate conclusions to determine effective corrective actions towards solving production process based technical challenges. * **Process Development:** Assisted by fellow manufacturing, quality and process engineers, after reviewing project objectives, identify and drive design, tool, and applicable testing requirements, create and manage design of experiments (DOE) to test critical process variables in support of process development and optimization towards highest process performance while achieving product quality requirements. * **Documentation:** Create and maintain comprehensive technical documents and files essential to support repeatable and reliable production through process including accurate cost estimating and process reporting toward FDA regulatory submissions and required military contract deliverables. * **Performance Analysis:** Perform analysis of targeted products to determine and implement best course actions toward maximizing first pass yield (FPY), reducing both cost of poor quality (CoPQ), and total processing time. * **Prototype to LRIP Transition:** Team with our product development engineers in transferring new leading\-edge products from prototype to LRIP. **Benefits:** PacAero provi cAero provides equal employment opportunity to all persons regardless of age, color, national origin, citizenship status, physical or mental disability, race, religion, creed, gender, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity and/or expression, genetic information, marital status, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by federal or state law. Requirements: **Qualifications** The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skill and/or ability required. Reasonable accommodation may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essentials functions. * Communication: Strong communication skills, both internal and external. Fluent in speaking, reading and writing the English language required. Support company/management decisions. * Productivity/IT Systems: Microsoft Office Suite specifically Excel, PowerPoint and Teams proficiency, including CAD (Solidworks preferred) with PLM, and ERP (ABAS preferred) systems. * Design and Quality: Proficiency in SolidWorks and statistical tools like Minitab. Strong knowledge and understanding of technical drawings. * Materials: Strong knowledge and understanding of ferrous and non\-ferrous metals and alloys, including but not limited to glasses, ceramics, and thermoplastics. * Process: Strong knowledge and understanding of precision machining, electro\-plating, laser welding, glass\-sealing, ceramic sealing, soldering, and vacuum brazing. * Regulatory: Knowledge and understanding of military and industry standards, specifications, quality and safety requirements (MIL\-STD, IEEE, ASTM, etc.). Advise management of policy violations. * Reasoning: Ability to interpret an extensive variety of technical instructions in mathematical or diagram form and deal with several abstract and concrete variables. **Education/Previous Experience Requirements** * B/S or M/S degree from an accredited university in mechanical or electrical engineering or a related STEM field or proven related experience in lieu of a specific degree demonstrated through a robust portfolio. * Preferred: * Requirements plus 4\+years of applicable experience or an equivalent combination of education and experience in product/process development for manufacturing of precision aerospace/defense assembles, and/or implantable medical devices. **Work Environment** * Noise: Production operational areas vary in noise levels. Hearing protection may be required. * Safety hazards: Exposure to high\-temperature ovens/parts, extreme low\-temperature freezers, powerful fast\-moving machines, near infrared light, chemicals, and sharp tools vary based on production operational areas. * Contaminants: Exposure to airborne particulate like metal dust, solder smoke, and chemical fumes necessitating adequate ventilation and protective measures to minimize health risks vary based on production operational areas. * Protective gear: Personal protective equipment (PPE) is a requirement for safety, including eye, hearing, and breathing protection, and glove use. * Work shift: Five 8(hrs.) days, typically Monday through Friday starting at 6:00am, though actual start time to be determined by manager at time of hire. Overtime is not uncommon within this position. **Physical Requirements:** * Standing/Sitting: Able to sit and/or stand for extended periods of time. * Manual dexterity: Fine motor skills and hand\-eye coordination are necessary for manipulating tools and performing precise measurements with a Microscope. * Precision and vision: Specific vision ability to have natural or corrected near distance acuity in at least one eye. Capable of passing the Jaeger Number 2 test and a color vision test. * Stamina: Physical stamina is required for the duration of a shift to perform all duties of the job. **In addition, all employees of PacAero are expected to** * Promote teamwork and cooperative effort. * Understand and apply appropriate quality improvement processes. * Perform other miscellaneous duties as assigned.

jobs.description: Overview: The **Estimator** plays a critical role in shaping the future success of major EPC projects by leading the development of complex, high\-value conceptual estimates and competitive bid strategies. jobs.title: Software Engineer
jobs.description: **Position Summary** PASCALL is a growing multidisciplinary medical device company building an FDA\-cleared, EEG\-based brain state monitoring platform — a wearable EEG sensor paired with an Android tablet application — now in active clinical use. As our platform matures and enters more hospitals, we are hiring a locally based Software Engineer to strengthen the software that powers it and to build the features that connect it to the clinical environment around it. We are looking for a self\-motivated engineer who treats an open problem as an invitation — someone who invents, prototypes, and champions ideas that create measurable business value. This is a hands\-on role based in Cambridge, embedded with our software team and working closely with our CEO, our product team, and our hardware/device team. You'll work across the platform's backend and extend it outward into the hospital's ecosystem: carrying EEG\-derived data into vital\-signs middleware and the EHR, as well as making our device a well\-behaved citizen on hospital IT networks. Because the team is small and much of the roadmap is still being written, you will have unusual latitude to shape what gets built, to bring creative approaches to problems that have no established answer, and to argue for the bets you believe in. Because our software runs inside customer environments, aspects of this role are customer\-facing. You'll be working directly with hospital IT, clinical engineering and clinical users to scope integrations, pass security reviews, support deployments and go\-lives and troubleshoot issues in the field, feeding what you learn back into the product. This is not a sales or support role; it is an engineering role whose work ships into live clinical settings. **Responsibilities \& Opportunities** * **Build and Strengthen the Backend:** Contribute to PASCALL's backend: the APIs serving the Android client and the data/image\-processing and waveform\-detection pipeline. Improve its reliability, robustness, and observability. * **Support Customers in the Field:** Act as a technical counterpart to customers and clinical engineering teams during integration scoping, security review, deployment, and go\-live; investigate issues arising in live clinical environments and translate site feedback into product improvements. * **Drive Quality \& Reliability:** Strengthen testing, defect prevention, and regression coverage across backend services and integrations. * **Solve Hard Problems:** Investigate and root\-cause complex, intermittent issues across the backend and the app/device data path, working hand\-in\-hand with the hardware/device team. Bring inventive, unconventional approaches when the obvious path is blocked. * **Support Algorithm \& Data Workflows:** Build backend and data infrastructure that supports the algorithm team's modeling, validation, and data\-quality work. * **Support Regulated Development:** Contribute verification, validation, and documentation for design controls and FDA submissions as the software lifecycle matures toward medical\-device standards (IEC 62304, ISO 14971\), in partnership with Quality and regulatory. * **Innovate on the Product:** Prototype new ideas quickly, propose approaches nobody has asked for, and think past the current architecture about what the platform could do for clinicians, hospitals, and the business. * **Connect the Device to the Clinical Environment:** Design and build the integrations that carry EEG\-derived parameters from the PASCALL monitor into hospital systems — vital\-signs middleware and the EHR (e.g., Epic) — using healthcare interoperability standards (HL7 v2, FHIR) and clean, well\-documented interfaces and data contracts. **Qualifications** Education * Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field — or equivalent professional experience. Experience and Skills * 2–5 years of industry experience building commercial, production\-level software (backend or full\-stack); startup experience strongly preferred. * Creativity and independent drive: a track record of thinking outside the box — finding a simpler path, repurposing a tool in an unexpected way, or solving something others had accepted as fixed — and the self\-motivation to pursue it without being asked. * Versatility and initiative: you can take an ambiguous, high\-level objective, scope it yourself, and run it to completion — and you look for the next problem rather than waiting to be assigned one. You are comfortable operating without a detailed spec, and you judge your own work by the value it creates rather than the tasks it closed. * Strong coder in Python and Java at minimum (C\+\+, C\#, or other languages a plus). * Experience connecting systems or devices across a network — designing and consuming APIs, defining data contracts and understanding authentication and network security fundamentals. * Solid command of testing, debugging, and practical design patterns; a systematic, root\-cause approach to problems. * Clear communicator, comfortable working directly with external technical stakeholders such as hospital IT and clinical engineering teams. * Documentation rigor: the discipline to document interfaces, decisions, and test evidence precisely — these become part of a regulated product record.Technical Background (Preferred) * Evidence of building something of your own — a side project, an internal tool that spread, a patent, a publication, or a product idea you took from sketch to something real. * Experience with Firebase/GCP or AWS managed services, and with cloud architecture more broadly. * Exposure to machine learning workflows, DevOps/MLOps practices, or physiological/clinical monitoring data. * Comfort using AI\-assisted development tools (e.g., Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, Cursor) responsibly in a regulated environment. Nice to Have * Hands\-on experience with healthcare interoperability standards — HL7 v2, FHIR, and related messaging/transport patterns. * Direct experience integrating a device or software product with hospital systems (Philips Capsule, Epic Bridges/Interconnect, Cerner, or similar), or familiarity with clinical IT governance and hospital security review processes. **About PASCALL Systems** PASCALL is a Cambridge\-based medical device company focused on advancing neuroscience\-based personalized anesthesia monitoring. Our team includes leading academic and clinical experts from MIT, Harvard, Stanford, and Massachusetts General Hospital. We achieved ISO 13485 certification for medical device design and development and received FDA 510(k) clearance for our first platform system in 2022\. We are now building the next generation of EEG\-based brain state algorithms to improve anesthesia care and patient outcomes worldwide. Our vision is to bring personalized, science\-based anesthesia care to all patients. **How to Apply** *In your Cover Letter, answer each of the following questions clearly:* * What excites you about this role and PASCALL's mission? * Tell us about a time you worked directly with a customer, partner, or external technical team to get software deployed in their environment. * Tell us about something you invented, prototyped, or improved that nobody asked you to build — what made you pursue it, and what value did it create? Benefits: * Bereavement leave * Dental insurance * Health insurance * Military leave * Paid holidays * Paid parental leave * Paid sick time * Paid time off Work Location: Hybrid remote in Cambridge, MA 02139 Compensation Range: $100K \- $130K

jobs.title: Sr. Scrum Master
jobs.description: **Senior Scrum Master / Agile Delivery Lead** ============================================= **Location:** Greenville, SC **Schedule:** Hybrid \- 3 Days in Office/ 2 Days out of Office **Compensation:** $65/hr \- $70/hr Are you the kind of Scrum Master who does more than run meetings? We’re looking for an experienced Senior Scrum Master / Agile Delivery Lead to coach and support two software development squads. This is a hands\-on Agile leadership role for someone who enjoys helping teams deliver better, work smarter, remove roadblocks, and continuously improve how software gets built and delivered. You’ll work closely with Product Owners, Software Engineers, technical leaders, and business stakeholders to improve delivery flow, quality, predictability, and customer value. If you enjoy coaching teams, digging into delivery metrics, challenging outdated processes, and helping teams become more independent and accountable, this could be a great fit. **What You’ll Be Doing** ------------------------ #### **Coach Two Agile Software Teams** You’ll serve as the Agile coach and delivery partner for two software development squads. Responsibilities include: * Coach teams on Agile principles, Scrum, and practical software delivery practices * Help teams become more self\-organizing, accountable, and effective * Facilitate Sprint Planning, Daily Scrums, Sprint Reviews, Retrospectives, and backlog refinement * Identify and remove roadblocks affecting delivery * Help teams manage dependencies across other teams and stakeholders * Encourage open communication, collaboration, and continuous improvement * Keep Agile practices focused on delivering value rather than simply completing ceremonies #### **Partner with Product Owners** You’ll work closely with Product Owners to improve how work moves from an idea to delivered software. This includes: * Backlog management and prioritization * User Story development and refinement * Acceptance criteria * Estimation and planning * Applying principles such as INVEST * Identifying MVPs and opportunities for incremental delivery * Improving collaboration between Product Owners, engineers, customers, and stakeholders ### **Improve Software Delivery** Data should help teams improve, not simply create another report. You’ll help teams use Agile and software delivery metrics to understand where delivery is working and where improvements can be made. Metrics may include: * Lead time * Cycle time * Deployment frequency * Mean time to recovery * Change success/failure rate * Throughput * Sprint predictability * DORA metrics You’ll use this information to help identify bottlenecks, dependencies, risks, and opportunities to improve delivery speed, quality, and predictability. #### **Support Modern Software Development** You don't need to be the person writing the code, but you should understand how modern software teams operate. You’ll work in an environment that includes concepts and technologies such as: * DevOps * CI/CD * Cloud technologies * AWS * Automated testing * Modern SDLC practices * AI\-assisted software development * Generative AI tools You’ll help teams identify practical ways these tools and practices can improve planning, development, testing, troubleshooting, documentation, and software delivery. **What We’re Looking For** -------------------------- The strongest candidates will have: * 5\+ years of experience as a **Scrum Master, Senior Scrum Master, Agile Delivery Lead, Agile Coach**, or similar role * Experience supporting multiple software development squads * Strong understanding of Agile principles and Scrum * Proven experience coaching software development teams * Experience partnering with and coaching Product Owners * Strong backlog management and refinement experience * Experience with User Stories, acceptance criteria, estimation, prioritization, and incremental delivery * Experience identifying and removing delivery impediments * Experience managing cross\-team dependencies * Experience using **DORA metrics, Agile metrics, or software delivery metrics** to drive improvements * Strong Jira and Confluence experience or similar Agile delivery tools * Strong facilitation and stakeholder\-management skills * Ability to work comfortably with both technical and business teams Most importantly, we’re looking for someone who is comfortable asking questions, challenging assumptions, facilitating difficult conversations, and helping teams find better ways to deliver. **Nice to Have** ---------------- Experience in any of the following would be a plus: * DevOps environments * CI/CD * AWS or other cloud platforms * Agile transformation initiatives * AI or Generative AI tools used within software development * Large or complex enterprise organizations * Organizational change or continuous improvement initiatives * CSM, PSM, SAFe Scrum Master, or similar Agile certification **How You'll Know You're Successful** ------------------------------------- Success isn't measured by how many Scrum ceremonies you facilitate. It's measured by whether your teams are getting better. Over time, the squads you support should: * Deliver customer and business value more consistently * Improve delivery speed, quality, and predictability * Become more accountable and self\-organizing * Identify and resolve roadblocks earlier * Use delivery data to make better decisions * Maintain a sustainable development pace * Collaborate effectively across Product, Engineering, and the business * Become less dependent on the Scrum Master to solve routine delivery challenges **Who Will Thrive in This Role?** --------------------------------- You’re likely to enjoy this position if you consider yourself a coach and delivery leader first and a meeting facilitator second. You enjoy working with software teams, understand modern Agile delivery, and know when to coach, when to challenge, and when to get out of the team's way. You’re curious about why things aren't working, comfortable using data to uncover problems, and motivated by seeing teams become stronger and more independent. If that sounds like the way you approach Agile delivery, we'd like to hear from you.

jobs.title: Senior Associate, Strategic Initiatives - Peaksware
jobs.description: **Who We Are** Peaksware is the parent company for industry\-leading brands MakeMusic, Alfred Music, and formerly TrainingPeaks and TrainHeroic. Our software platforms maximize the potential of expert instructors to reach and impact the lives of the world’s committed performers. We empower athletes and musicians to achieve their peak potential through data\-driven software, robust analytics, and expert\-led content. We operate at the intersection of technology, finance, and human performance. As a lean, high\-growth organization, we value execution, intellectual curiosity, and radical candor. This is an opportunity to join a category\-defining software company at an inflection point where AI is reshaping how every team operates. **Position Summary** Reporting to the CFO, the Senior Associate, Strategic Initiatives will serve as a strategic partner to the executive team and leaders across Peaksware’s portfolio of brands, helping drive some of the company’s highest\-priority strategic and operational initiatives. This is a high\-autonomy, high\-impact role for a former top\-tier consultant, financial analyst, or strategy and operations professional who enjoys taking ambiguous business problems and turning them into clear analysis, recommendations, and action. The Senior Associate, Strategic Initiatives will work across Finance, Sales, Marketing, Operations, Product, and Engineering to analyze business performance, build financial models and business cases, identify opportunities to improve growth and efficiency, and drive cross\-functional initiatives from idea through execution. They will also bring a strong understanding of AI and automation, using these tools to accelerate analysis, improve workflows, and unlock new ways of working across the organization. This role offers broad exposure to the business, meaningful access to executive leadership, and the opportunity to make a measurable impact across the Peaksware portfolio. **Key Responsibilities** Strategic \& Executive Support* Partner with Executive Leadership: Work directly with the CFO and executive team on high\-priority strategic questions and decisions across Peaksware and its portfolio of brands. * Turn Ambiguity Into Action: Take complex or loosely defined business questions, structure the problem, run the analysis, and deliver clear recommendations and a path forward. * Prepare Executive Insights: Produce concise analyses, business cases, and presentations that help leadership evaluate opportunities, track initiative progress, and make informed decisions. AI \& Automation* Find the High\-Value Use Cases: Evaluate where AI and automation can meaningfully improve productivity, decision\-making, and business processes across the organization. * Build and Prototype: Use modern AI tools to rapidly build agents, scripts, internal tools, and workflow automations that solve real business problems — and apply those same tools to your own analysis, research, modeling, and reporting. * Scale Adoption: Partner with Engineering, IT, and functional leaders to deploy what works, raise practical AI fluency across teams, and drive adoption. Strategic \& Operational Initiatives* Lead High\-Impact Projects: Own 1–2 high\-priority cross\-functional initiatives at any given time, from initial analysis and recommendation through implementation — coordinating across functions and driving accountability and follow\-through. * Redesign How Work Gets Done: Work with functional leaders to identify inefficient, redundant, or manual processes and determine the right fix: redesign, technology, automation, or elimination. * Solve Cross\-Brand Problems: Identify where shared processes, technology, data, and capabilities can be leveraged across Peaksware's brands, building the relationships needed to surface and scale them. * Measure Impact: Set clear success metrics for strategic initiatives and track results so investments translate into measurable business outcomes. Financial \& Business Analysis* Analyze Business Performance: Evaluate financial and operational performance across brands to identify trends, risks, and opportunities to improve growth, profitability, and efficiency. * Support FP\&A: Partner with Finance on forecasting, budgeting, variance analysis, scenario modeling, and recurring reporting for leadership. * Build Business Cases: Develop financial models and ROI analyses to evaluate investments, headcount, technology, and other strategic decisions. **Requirements** Requirements * 2\+ years of experience in management consulting, financial advisory, corporate strategy, FP\&A, or a similarly rigorous analytical role. Experience in a strategy consulting environment is a plus. * Strong financial and analytical skills: Ability to analyze business performance, build financial models and business cases, evaluate ROI, and turn data into clear recommendations. * Exceptional problem\-solving and business judgment: Comfortable taking ambiguous problems, structuring the a ble to synthesize complex information, communicate clearly with senior leaders, and influence cross\-functional stakeholders without direct authority. * AI fluency: Demonstrated experience using modern AI tools to improve productivity, analyze information, automate workflows, or solve business problems. You don't need to be an AI engineer, but you should be curious, hands\-on, and excited about finding new ways to apply AI. * Bias toward execution and ownership: Comfortable operating with limited direction, rolling up your sleeves, and taking initiatives from analysis and recommendation through implementation and measurable results. Desired Qualifications * SaaS or technology experience, particularly in strategy, operations, finance, or general management. * Experience leading cross\-functional strategic initiatives from initial analysis through implementation. * Technical and data fluency, including experience with SQL, Python, APIs, business intelligence tools, or AI\-assisted development. * Experience working across multiple business units, brands, or markets, ideally within a portfolio or multi\-business environment. * Experience working directly with executive leadership and supporting high\-level strategic decision\-making. *All applicants will receive equal consideration for employment regardless of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, status as a protected veteran, or length of time spent unemployed.* *The work characteristics described here are representative of those an employee encounters while performing the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.* **Benefits** **Compensation** We are committed to fair and equitable compensation practices. The annual salary range for this role is $95,149\-$158,581\. We typically hire at the lower to mid\-point of the range, with the top end reserved for internal growth and exceptional performance. Final compensation for this role will be determined by various factors such as a candidate’s relevant work experience, skills, certifications, and geographic location. In addition to base salary this position will be eligible for an attractive performance based variable compensation plan. **Benefits and Perks:** *Health* * We offer comprehensive health benefits including medical, dental, and vision insurance; health savings and flexible spending accounts, paid parental leave; and an employee assistance program. * Additional coverage options including Accident \& Critical Illness insurance as well as Hospital Indemnity are also available. *Disability and Life* * We offer several company paid options including Short Term Disability, Long Term Disability, as well as Basic Life Insurance and AD\&D. * Additional coverage options including Employee\-paid Supplemental Life Insurance for Employee, Spouse, and/or Child are also available. *Additional* * We offer a 401(K) including a company match. * We observe 12 paid holidays annually and provide discretionary Flexible Time Off. Employees also receive free access to our products, corporate discounts, and professional development resources. * Access to the Performance and Recovery Center (PARC), our on\-site fitness facility, as well as employee only access to on\-site locker rooms and showers. * Employee only access to secure, indoor bike storage and access to e\-bikes exclusively to Peaksware employees. * Access to our onsite Music and Podcast Studio. If you require a reasonable accommodation to review our website or to apply online, please fill out our Candidate Accommodations Request Form *Peaksware adheres to the FLSA Exemption Threshold for minimum wage in all states.* **Recruiting Agency Notice:** We do not accept agency resumes or assistance. Please do not forward resumes to our jobs alias or our employees. We are not responsible for any fees related to unsolicited resumes.

as assigned by the Team Lead, Branch Chief, Division Lead, or Chief Engineer. and present technical reports, briefings, assessments, and recommendations to management and s dgment:** Ability to distinguish critical technical issues from lower\-value areas of investigation and jobs.title: Junior Backend Systems Engineer (Python/C++)
jobs.description: We are seeking a detail\-oriented, highly analytical Junior Systems Software Engineer to join our core engineering team. In this role, you will design, implement, and optimize low\-level application architecture, networking protocols, and performance\-critical systems. The ideal candidate brings a strong foundation in computer science fundamentals, hands\-on experience with C\+\+ and Python, and a passion for building responsive, scalable software. **Key Responsibilities:** · **Systems \& Network Architecture:** Design, implement, and maintain custom networking components, client\-server models, and protocol resolvers (UDP/TCP, DNS, socket communications). · **Algorithm \& Performance Optimization:** Apply data structures, memory management, and graph search heuristics (e.g., A\*, custom hashing, priority queues) to solve complex performance and indexing challenges. · **Testing \& Quality Assurance:** Develop and execute comprehensive unit, integration, and stress tests to validate network state synchronization, catch edge cases, and eliminate execution bottlenecks. · **Debugging \& Problem Solving:** Utilize low\-level debugging tools (GDB, Wireshark) to trace memory leaks, analyze packet flow, and debug asynchronous multi\-threaded or multi\-client execution paths. · **Cross\-Functional Collaboration:** Partner with cross\-functional teams to design clean, modular codebases and maintain version control integrity across all release cycles. **Key Requirements:** · **Education:** Bachelor of Science in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or a related technical discipline (GPA 3\.5\+ preferred). · **Core Languages:** Strong proficiency in **C\+\+** and **Python** . Familiarity with C, C\#, Java, SQL, or x86 Assembly is a plus. · **Systems \& Networking:** Solid understanding of TCP/UDP networking principles, socket programming, caching mechanisms, operating systems, and computer architecture. · **Tools \& Environment:** Hands\-on experience with **Linux/Bash** , **Git/GitHub** , **GDB** , and **Wireshark** . Experience with SFML, Unity, or VR/AR engines is desirable. · **CS Fundamentals:** Proven command of object\-oriented design, algorithmic complexity, recursive problem\-solving, and concurrent state management. **Desired Competencies:** · Self\-starter capable of managing end\-to\-end projects—from requirement mapping to comprehensive testing. · Passion for interactive media, high\-performance computing, or game engine mechanics. · Strong written and verbal communication skills for technical documentation and code reviews.

Together with a selected network of Partners, we generate new knowledge from harmonized datasets, augmented with the collection of longitudinal patient\-reported data and patient\-generated digital biomarkers within a secure and privacy\-preserving environment. We answer the question – is this patient treatment the best it could possibly be? **What’s our purpose** We exist to empower every patient and every health organization on the planet with evidence on the outcomes of care! Why do we get up in the morning? Well, most healthcare professionals have chosen to work in healthcare driven by their desire to make a difference in patients’ lives. And so have we! We have chosen to follow this calling by addressing the biggest problem in healthcare: the lack of real\-world evidence on the outcomes of care. For us, society denying patients better care due to lack of access to data is unethical, in a world where technology improved so many aspects of our world. Making the right evidence available to healthcare organizations to help prevent one lost life, one care complication, one failed treatment is the moral obligation that big tech companies have – it’s our Hippocratic Oath. At Promptly, everything we do is driven by our core purpose: to promote better healthcare at lower costs for patients every day, by making health outcomes available. ### **About the role** **The Momentum** We are looking for a Data Engineer with experience in building SQL\-based extract, load, transform (ELT) pipelines, with a high capability of interpreting source data structures to extract the respective business logic, specifically healthcare, and implementing ELT code that transforms that data into known data standards such as FHIR and OMOP\-CDM. **What you’ll be expected to do** * solutions * Choose the right tool/tech\-stack for the job **Qualifications and work experience** * Advanced SQL and Python skills * Proven experience as a Data Engineer should include a track\-record of scaling data analytics products from small pilots to live, well\-functioning products working for thousands (millions) of people * Experience building and optimizing big data pipelines, architectures and data sets * Strong analytical skills related to working with unstructured data sets * Experience with AWS technologies * Experience with common data science and Big Data * Great numerical and analytical skills * Experience working with Health Data frameworks (e.g. OMOP\-CDM, FHIR) is a plus * Great communication skills. * Data\-oriented personality * Design and write documents * Create quality measurements to track improvement in products * Collaborating with the Engineering team, working with an agile and continuous delivery mindset * You will work across our product squads, collaborating closely with the Head of Product and the CTO * Support and train the development team to improve attention to detail and testing skills * Responsible for the product quality assurance * Create high\-quality documentation that meets applicable standards **Personality and behavioral traits** You are bright, self\-starter with relentless energy and positivity, and You are a good communicator, and you are excellent at establishing contacts and building relationships. You privilege an analytical approach and an ability to identify the strategic dimension of the issues. You are ambitious, enjoy taking ownership and are constantly working to improve your skills, and you’re not afraid to constructively challenge. jobs.description: **About Us** ------------ QISG leverages Quanta’s comprehensive resources to deliver collaborative solutions for our partners' energy infrastructure needs. Our turnkey service capabilities provide our customers with efficiency, consistency, attention to detail and safe execution. The QISG team brings together Engineering, Safety, Quality, Material Procurement, QA/QC, Right\-of\-Way Acquisition, Scheduling, Environmental Planning, Permitting, Title and Land Management expertise that ensure outstanding results for our clients. **About this Role** ------------------- Every moment of every day, people all over the world rely on electricity provided by Quanta Services and its customers. With its highly skilled and innovative workforce, Quanta is the largest specialty contractor in North America that powers modern life. Find your future with us by being a part of something bigger – leading the energy transition in building a better world for generations to come. We encourage and inspire our people to embrace opportunities within our corporate office and 200 operating companies providing solutions for the utility, renewable energy, electric power, industrial, and communications industries worldwide. Quanta’s culture is about creating an environment where all employees can be themselves, are valued, and have an equal opportunity to succeed. When you join our team, you join a dynamic culture in which career development is encouraged, excellence is rewarded, and diversity is valued. **POSITION OVERVIEW:** The Design Engineer \- Substation will perform substation design assignments including physical layout and protection \& control systems while ensuring compliance with safety and construction standards. This role involves designing substation components, selecting materials, preparing design documents, and collaborating with engineers and field personnel to ensure project accuracy and efficiency. This position will report to a Supervising Engineer and be part of a substation design team with other engineers, designers, and drafters supporting substation projects across the QISG platform. There are four bands to this title; an employee moves up in band as they gain experience and demonstrate mastery of new skills. **What You'll Do** ------------------ * Design physical substation components, including yard layouts, grounding, lightning protection, control building arrangements, raceways, and auxiliary AC/DC power systems. * Develop protection and control schematics, wiring diagrams, cable lists and panel layouts. * Develop design drawings, calculations, and bills of material from engineering documents for planning, construction, operation, and maintenance. * Conduct engineering calculations, including voltage drop, cable pulling, flicker analysis, and grounding analysis. * Ensure project team applies engineering standards including NEC, NESC, NEMA, IEEE and ANSI * Perform quality reviews to check for inaccuracies, omissions, or compliance issues, and provide recommendations. * Work collaboratively with engineers and project teams to develop solutions and modifications as needed. * Maintain detailed project documentation and support engineering calculations. * Bring potential project\-related problems and possible solutions to the attention of the stakeholders. * Travel out of town for short periods of time as required by projects and assignments. * Perform other duties as assigned. **What You'll Bring** --------------------- * Bachelor’s degree in electrical, mechanical, or civil engineering from an ABET\-accredited program. * Passing the Fundamentals of Engineering (FE) exam is highly desirable; this is required for the Design Engineer 4 band. * Curiosity for and willingness to learn about the major components of a substation is required. Basic knowledge of these components is a plus. Previous design or construction experience is highly desirable. * No experience required in the electric utility industry for entry level positions. More experience performing detailed design for high voltage substation projects could result in a higher\-level position. * Word processing, spread sheet, and e\-mail software. * Excellent oral and written communication skills * Working in a team environment * Communicating effectively with co\-workers * Able to deal with ambiguity and ability to work independently, manage multiple tasks and determine priorities in a complex environment. **Travel Requirements:** * Role will require travel as necessary to achieve job responsibilities, up to 10\-25% of the time. **What You'll Get** ------------------- * Competitive Compensation * 401(k) Retirement Plan * Holiday Pay * Paid Time Off (PTO) * Comprehensive Health Coverage * Pet Insurance * Employee Assistance Program (EAP) * Professional Development * Education Reimbursement * Employee Discount Program **Compensation Range** ---------------------- The anticipated compensation for this position is \- depending on experience and qualifications. **Equal Opportunity Employer** ------------------------------ All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment and will not be discriminated against on the basis of race, color, religion, national origin or ancestry, sex (including gender, pregnancy, sexual orientation, and/or gender identity), age, disability, genetic information, veteran status, and/or any other basis protected by applicable federal, state or local law.
