jobs.title: Field Service Technician – Medical & Laboratory Instruments
jobs.description: **Do you enjoy figuring out how things work, solving technical problems, and working directly with customers? Would you rather be out in the field than sitting behind a desk all day?** RR Mechatronics is looking for a Field Service Technician based in California to support our customers across California and the Las Vegas area. You will work with specialized medical and laboratory instruments used by hospitals and laboratories and help keep these systems running reliably. This is a hands\-on, field\-based role with a high degree of independence. You will travel to customer locations to install, maintain, troubleshoot and repair our instruments, while also supporting and training the people who use them. You won't be expected to know our equipment on day one. We will train you on our instruments and technology, with your initial product and technical training taking place at our U.S. office in Warwick, Rhode Island. What we are looking for is a technically skilled, hands\-on problem solver who enjoys working independently and providing excellent customer service. **What will you do?** As a Field Service Technician, you will be one of the main technical contacts for our customers. Your responsibilities will include: * Troubleshooting, maintaining and repairing RR Mechatronics instruments at customer locations * Installing new instruments and supporting customers during commissioning * Diagnosing technical issues together with laboratory technicians, biomedical engineers and third\-party service technicians * Providing technical and user support by phone and in the field * Training customers in the correct use and routine maintenance of our instruments * Completing and maintaining service reports and service records * Managing service parts and inventory assigned to your territory * Identifying recurring technical issues and sharing field experience with our team to help improve our products and service * Recognizing potential sales opportunities during customer visits and sharing these with our sales team * Supporting emergency service visits when required **This is a hands\-on technical role** This is an **electromechanical service position, not an IT support role**. We are looking for someone who enjoys working on physical equipment, diagnosing mechanical and electrical issues, replacing or adjusting components and getting instruments back up and running. Our instruments also incorporate software and network connectivity, so a basic understanding of application software and TCP/IP networking is useful. However, the core of this position is hands\-on electromechanical service and troubleshooting. **What are we looking for?** * An Associate's or Bachelor's degree, or comparable technical background, in mechatronics, electrical engineering, mechanical engineering or a related technical field * Hands\-on electromechanical experience * Experience in a technical service or similar position * Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills * A practical, solution\-oriented approach * The ability to work independently and make effective use of the resources available to you * Strong communication skills and a customer\-focused attitude * Willingness and ability to travel regularly throughout the assigned service territory **Travel and your service territory** Travel is an important part of this position. Our customers are located across **Northern California, Southern California and the Las Vegas area**, so you should be comfortable spending a significant part of your working time on the road and occasionally staying overnight. The position is based in California and is field\-based. RR Mechatronics does not have an office in California. You will work independently within your service territory while being part of our U.S. service organization based in Warwick, Rhode Island. Initial product and technical training will take place at our Warwick office. Additional travel to Warwick may be required from time to time for training, meetings or collaboration with colleagues. **What we offer** * Base salary of **$60,000 to $70,000 per year** * Health insurance * 401(k) with company match * Paid time off * Comprehensive training on RR Mechatronics instruments and technology * A high degree of independence and responsibility * The opportunity to work with specialized medical and laboratory technology * A varied field\-based position combining technology, problem\-solving and customer contact **About RR Mechatronics** RR Mechatronics develops, manufactures and supports specialized medical and laboratory instruments. Our headquarters are located in the Netherlands, where we currently employ approximately 47 people. Our U.S. office is located in Warwick, Rhode Island, and currently consists of a team of five employees. We are expanding our U.S. organization and are looking for an additional colleague in Warwick as well as a Field Service Technician based in California. Working for RR Mechatronics means joining a relatively small international organization. You will have direct contact with colleagues across the company and a high degree of independence in your day\-to\-day work. **Our hiring process** Because this is a field\-based position and our team is located across the United States and the Netherlands, our interview process will be conducted remotely. The process will typically consist of two video interviews. The first interview will be with our HR Manager, based at our headquarters in the Netherlands. The second interview will be with members of our U.S. team based in Warwick, Rhode Island. This gives us the opportunity to get to know you from both an organizational and technical perspective, while giving you the opportunity to learn more about RR Mechatronics, the role and the team you will be working with. **Interested?** If you enjoy combining hands\-on technology, problem\-solving, travel and customer contact, and like the idea of taking responsibility for your own service territory, we would like to hear from you. **Applicants must currently be authorized to work in the United States. RR Mechatronics does not provide employment visa sponsorship or relocation assistance for this position.** **Please note:** We are managing the recruitment process for this position directly and are not seeking assistance from staffing agencies, recruitment agencies or third\-party recruiters. We kindly ask agencies not to contact us regarding this vacancy or submit candidates on our behalf. Job Types: Full\-time, Contract Pay: $60,000\.00 \- $70,000\.00 per year Work Location: On the road

Would you rather be out in the field than sitting behind a desk all day?** RR Mechatronics is looking for a Field Service Technician based in California to support our customers across California and the Las Vegas area. You will work with specialized medical and laboratory instruments used by hospitals and laboratories and help keep these systems running reliably. This is a hands\-on, field\-based role with a high degree of independence. You will travel to customer locations to install, maintain, troubleshoot and repair our instruments, while also supporting and training the people who use them. You won't be expected to know our equipment on day one. We will train you on our instruments and technology, with your initial product and technical training taking place at our U.S. office in Warwick, Rhode Island. What we are looking for is a technically skilled, hands\-on problem solver who enjoys working independently and providing excellent customer service. **What will you do?** As a Field Service Technician, you will be one of the main technical contacts for our customers. Your responsibilities will include: * Troubleshooting, maintaining and repairing RR Mechatronics instruments at customer locations * Installing new instruments and supporting customers during commissioning * Diagnosing technical issues together with laboratory technicians, biomedical engineers and third\-party service technicians * Providing technical and user support by phone and in the field * Training customers in the correct use and routine maintenance of our instruments * Completing and maintaining service reports and service records * Managing service parts and inventory assigned to your territory * Identifying recurring technical issues and sharing field experience with our team to help improve our products and service * Recognizing potential sales opportunities during customer visits and sharing these with our sales team * Supporting emergency service visits when required **This is a hands\-on technical role** This is an **electromechanical service position, not an IT support role**. We are looking for someone who enjoys working on physical equipment, diagnosing mechanical and electrical issues, replacing or adjusting components and getting instruments back up and running. Our instruments also incorporate software and network connectivity, so a basic understanding of application software and TCP/IP networking is useful. However, the core of this position is hands\-on electromechanical service and troubleshooting. **What are we looking for?** * An Associate's or Bachelor's degree, or comparable technical background, in mechatronics, electrical engineering, mechanical engineering or a related technical field * Hands\-on electromechanical experience * Experience in a technical service or similar position * Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills * A practical, solution\-oriented approach * The ability to work independently and make effective use of the resources available to you * Strong communication skills and a customer\-focused attitude * Willingness and ability to travel regularly throughout the assigned service territory **Travel and your service territory** Travel is an important part of this position. Our customers are located across **Northern California, Southern California and the Las Vegas area**, so you should be comfortable spending a significant part of your working time on the road and occasionally staying overnight. The position is based in California and is field\-based. RR Mechatronics does not have an office in California. You will work independently within your service territory while being part of our U.S. service organization based in Warwick, Rhode Island. Initial product and technical training will take place at our Warwick office. Additional travel to Warwick may be required from time to time for training, meetings or collaboration with colleagues. **What we offer** * Base salary of **$60,000 to $70,000 per year** * Health insurance * 401(k) with company match * Paid time off * Comprehensive training on RR Mechatronics instruments and technology * A high degree of independence and responsibility * The opportunity to work with specialized medical and laboratory technology * A varied field\-based position combining technology, problem\-solving and customer contact **About RR Mechatronics** RR Mechatronics develops, manufactures and supports specialized medical and laboratory instruments. Our headquarters are located in the Netherlands, where we currently employ approximately 47 people. Our U.S. office is located in Warwick, Rhode Island, and currently consists of a team of five employees. We are expanding our U.S. organization and are looking for an additional colleague in Warwick as well as a Field Service Technician based in California. Working for RR Mechatronics means joining a relatively small international organization. You will have direct contact with colleagues across the company and a high degree of independence in your day\-to\-day work. **Our hiring process** Because this is a field\-based position and our team is located across the United States and the Netherlands, our interview process will be conducted remotely. The process will typically consist of two video interviews. The first interview will be with our HR Manager, based at our headquarters in the Netherlands. The second interview will be with members of our U.S. team based in Warwick, Rhode Island. This gives us the opportunity to get to know you from both an organizational and technical perspective, while giving you the opportunity to learn more about RR Mechatronics, the role and the team you will be working with. **Interested?** If you enjoy combining hands\-on technology, problem\-solving, travel and customer contact, and like the idea of taking responsibility for your own service territory, we would like to hear from you. **Applicants must currently be authorized to work in the United States. RR Mechatronics does not provide employment visa sponsorship or relocation assistance for this position.** **Please note:** We are managing the recruitment process for this position directly and are not seeking assistance from staffing agencies, recruitment agencies or third\-party recruiters. We kindly ask agencies not to contact us regarding this vacancy or submit candidates on our behalf. Job Types: Full\-time, Contract Pay: $60,000\.00 \- $70,000\.00 per year Work Location: On the road

jobs.title: Municipal Wastewater Process Design Engineer
jobs.description: **Company Description** **Municipal Wastewater Process Design Engineer** Ramboll is seeking motivated and inquisitive candidates to join the Water Division in our Syracuse, NY, Rochester, NY, Arlington, VA or Richmond, VA locations. Develop your excellence in our collaborative, inclusive, diverse, and empowering culture at Ramboll! When you start with Ramboll, you’ll be joining a company that strives to make a difference – for our employees, clients, and society. As you begin working on projects, you will be given increasing responsibility, while also being able to rely on experienced managers and colleagues who offer support and a helping hand as you learn and develop in your role. Our vision is to be a leading consultancy globally, delivering integrated and sustainable solutions that shape today and tomorrow. **Job Description** **You will join our Municipal Water/Wastewater Treatment Group** As our new Municipal Wastewater Process Design Engineer your key tasks and responsibilities will be: * Plan and design portions of projects of greater complexity, following appropriate design, engineering codes, government and third\-party standards using engineering principles in conjunction and in concert with design staff. * Analyze, develop and interpret reports, drawings, analytical data, and other data required for planning and design projects related to Wastewater Treatment. * Review and determine regulatory requirements (local, State, Federal) that would be applicable to the assignment * Prepare and at times present reports or analysis such as design calculations, field data results/conclusions and/or cost estimates. Presentation audiences may include internal team members and external clients. * May communicate directly with external stakeholders (e.g., vendors, subcontractors, contractors, regulators, etc.). * Support preparation of proposals and fee estimates. * Train and mentor early career employees. * Utilize an advanced understanding of engineering fundamentals and proficiency with relevant computer software packages and engineering and design techniques specific to Wastewater Treatment and hydraulic engineering * Demonstrate excellent interpersonal and communication skills. * Work effectively in teams comprised of professionals with diverse skill sets, including engineers from other disciplines, scientists and subcontracted professionals. * Desire to promote Ramboll’s growth through a commitment to delivering high\-quality work products to our clients. * Troubleshooting and proactive problem solving for field assignments in accordance with project control documents and field guidance documents. **Qualifications** The Engineer will perform moderate to complex assignments in Wastewater Treatment ranging from data evaluation, conceptual design, detailed design, construction support, and commissioning that require the application of engineering techniques, procedures, and criteria in carrying out a sequence of related design engineering tasks. Assignments may involve difficult problems requiring proficient job knowledge to resolve. Engineers at this level must be capable of collaborating and making evaluations and interpretations, exercising independent judgment in selecting and applying engineering standards. Travel may be required depending on project requirements. Your starting point for constant growth from the moment you join Ramboll, we will support your personal and professional development so that you grow with the company. For this role, we believe your starting point is: Bachelor’s Degree in Chemical Engineering, Civil Engineering or Environmental Engineering and 10\+ years of qualifying engineering experience in the Wastewater Treatment engineering/design field. Experience with BNR and ENR processes on municipal wastewater projects, particularly as it relates to the Chesapeake Bay Watershed or similar program. Professional Engineering certification or the ability to obtain licensure within their primary state of residence/operation, relevant to job function. **Additional Information** **Welcome to our Water Division** Ramboll’s water team creates value for clients and societies by converting challenges related to water, climate, and sustainability into opportunities. Working with municipalities, utilities, and industrial clients, we deliver a wide range of water\-related consulting; from early phase strategic analysis and project scoping, to designing and implementing infrastructure solutions. **Why Join Ramboll?** As a leader in sustainable and high\-performance infrastructure, Ramboll offers Senior Electrical Construction Managers the opportunity to work on some of the most advanced data center projects in the world. You’ll join a collaborative team committed to excellence, innovation, and safety—empowering you to drive impactful results in the digital infrastructure space **Work at the heart of sustainable change** Ramboll is a global architecture, engineering, and consultancy company. We believe that the purpose of sustainable change is to create a thriving world for both nature and people. So, that’s where we start – and how we work. At Ramboll, our core strength is our people, and our history is rooted in a clear vision of how a responsible company should act. Being open and curious is a cornerstone of our culture. We embrace an inclusive mindset that looks for fresh, diverse, and innovative perspectives. We respect, embrace, and invite diversity in all forms to actively cultivate an environment where everyone can flourish and realize their full potential. **Ready to join us?** Please submit your application. Be sure to include all relevant documents including your CV, cover letter, etc. We recognize that some candidates only apply when they tick every box. However, passion and potential often outweigh a perfect resume and Ramboll’s supportive learning culture can help you grow. So if this role resonates with you but you don't meet all the requirements, we encourage you to apply. You might be the perfect fit for this opportunity or another within our team. Thank you for taking the time to apply! We look forward to receiving your application. **Where People Flourish** Our mission is to create sustainable societies where people and nature flourish. This means that a culture of inclusion is embedded in everything we do. Our people bring diverse backgrounds and experiences to the company, enabling us to deliver innovative and forward\-thinking solutions to our clients. We also know how important it is to achieve the right balance of where, when, and how much you work. At Ramboll, we offer flexibility as part of our positive and inclusive approach to work. We are committed to equal employment opportunity, regardless of age, disability or medical condition, gender identity, marriage and domestic partnership, pregnancy and maternity, race, ancestry, or national origin, religion or belief, sex and sexual orientation, military service and veteran status, or any other protected characteristic. Ramboll wants to ensure opportunities are accessible to candidates with disabilities. So, please let us know if there are any changes we could make to the application process to make it more comfortable for you. You can contact us at job.advert.accessibility@ramboll.com with such requests. **Salary Transparency** At Ramboll, we are committed to fair and transparent compensation practices that support our people and our purpose of creating sustainable societies. The anticipated base salary range for this position is $115,000 to $140,000 per year. This range reflects the compensation we reasonably expect to offer at the time of posting. Actual compensation will vary based on factors such as location, skills, experience, education, and internal equity. Because we operate across multiple U.S. markets, pay may differ depending on the cost of labor in specific locations. In addition to base salary, this position may be eligible for bonus, overtime or other forms of compensation and we offer a comprehensive benefits package that supports well\-being, professional development, and work\-life balance. Our recruiters are happy to share more about the specific salary range and total rewards package applicable to your location during the hiring process.

jobs.title: Mechanical Drafter 1 - Fabricated Metal Parts
jobs.description: ### **Description** **Mechanical Drafter I** **Water and Wastewater Fabricated Products** **Support the design and fabrication of the metal parts, pipeline components, equipment, and assemblies that help maintain critical water and wastewater infrastructure.** **Position Summary** Rangeline is seeking an entry\-level Mechanical Drafter to support the design and fabrication of metal parts, pipeline components, equipment, and assemblies used throughout the water and wastewater industry. This position will create and revise detailed drawings used by our fabrication, production, engineering, and field operations teams. The Mechanical Drafter will work closely with engineers, project managers, shop personnel, and field personnel to ensure drawings are accurate, practical, and ready for manufacturing and field applications. The ideal candidate has a solid understanding of mechanical drafting fundamentals, is comfortable working in CAD software, and is interested in developing hands\-on knowledge of metal fabrication, pipeline systems, and water and wastewater infrastructure.### **Key Responsibilities** * Prepare 2D drawings and 3D models of reinforcement components, pressure\-containing assemblies, and other fabricated products used in water and wastewater systems with accurate dimensions, tolerances, material specifications, weld requirements, and other Rangeline Standards of Manufacturing and Practices. * Create and revise drawings based on sketches, field measurements, engineering direction, customer specifications, and project requirements. * Prepare bills of materials, cut lists, weldment lists, and part lists as required. * Apply basic dimensioning, tolerancing, drafting, and geometric dimensioning and tolerancing principles to drawings. * Review drawings for accuracy, completeness, manufacturability, fit\-up, and alignment with project requirements before release. * Assist with field measurements and the verification of existing piping, components, equipment, and site conditions when required. * Develop a working knowledge of water and wastewater piping systems, pressure\-rated components, fabrication requirements, and applicable industry standards. * Perform other drafting and design\-related duties as assigned. ### **Skills, Knowledge \& Expertise** * Associate degree, technical certificate, or coursework in Mechanical Drafting, CAD, Engineering Technology, Manufacturing Technology, or a related field preferred. * Basic proficiency with CAD software, with experience in both 2D drafting and 3D modeling. * Ability to read and interpret mechanical, fabrication, assembly, and pipeline drawings. * Basic understanding of dimensions, tolerances, scales, weld symbols, and mechanical drawing conventions. * Familiarity with materials commonly used in fabrication, including carbon steel, stainless steel, and aluminum and metal fabrication processes such as cutting, bending, rolling, welding, machining, and assembly is preferred but not required. * Strong attention to detail and accuracy. * Good organizational, communication, and problem\-solving skills. * Ability to manage multiple assignments and meet established deadlines. * Ability to communicate effectively and work as part of a team. * Willingness to learn fabrication methods, industry requirements, company standards, and new software or drafting techniques. * Experience with SolidWorks, DraftSight, AutoCAD, Inventor, or similar CAD software. * Familiarity with sheet metal, structural components, piping components, and weldment design. * Understanding basic GD\&T principles, weld symbols, and fabrication tolerances. * Ability to take field or shop measurements and translate sketches of existing parts or piping configurations into accurate CAD drawings. * Familiarity with CNC cutting, press brake forming, plate rolling, welding, machining, or other fabrication processes. * Familiarity with various water/wastewater pipe types, sizes, and applicable fittings. * Exposure to waterworks products, municipal water systems, wastewater systems, industrial piping, pipeline repair, hot tapping, or line stopping is preferred but not required. * Familiarity with applicable standards and specifications, including AWWA, ASME, ASTM, ANSI, or customer\-specific requirements, is a plus. This position will primarily involve computer\-based drafting and design work but will require regular interaction with other engineering, fabrication, quality, and field operations personnel. The Mechanical Drafter may occasionally enter fabrication areas to take measurements, inspect fabricated components, verify drawing details, observe manufacturing processes, or work directly with shop personnel to resolve fabrication questions. The position may also require occasional visits to project or customer locations to verify piping dimensions, equipment configurations, or existing field conditions. Appropriate personal protective equipment and compliance with all Rangeline and customer safety requirements will be required when entering shop or field environments. A successful Mechanical Drafter will produce clear, accurate, and fabrication\-ready drawings that support the safe and reliable manufacture of products used in water and wastewater systems. The individual will respond well to feedback, maintain accurate drawing and revision records, develop a strong understanding of Rangeline's products and manufacturing processes, and steadily become capable of completing drafting assignments with greater accuracy and independence. Success in this role also includes developing practical knowledge of pipeline systems, pressure\-rated components, fabrication methods, and the needs of Rangeline's customers, shop personnel, and field operations teams.### **About Rangeline Group** Rangeline Pipeline Services provides pipeline solutions such as Line Stops, Tapping, Valve Insertion, but foremost they are known as the Concrete Pipe Specialty Team. This team of experts specializes in all aspects of concrete pressure pipe, and they have the ability to repair or replace the pipelines without interrupting the flow which helps minimize disruption to the daily life of communities, businesses and municipalities. Rangeline Pipeline Services also has a complete line of materials for concrete pipe and offers full turnkey services nationwide and 24\-hr emergency services. Call Rangeline Pipeline Services today for your pipeline installation and repairs, 1\-888\-PCCP\-HLP.

jobs.title: Agentic AI Developer IV
jobs.description: Overview: RealPage is accelerating the adoption of Generative AI and agentic engineering practices across its technology organization. The Internal AI Center of Excellence is responsible for enabling engineering teams to apply AI effectively, safely, and consistently across the software development lifecycle. We are seeking an **AI Developer IV** to help design, build, and scale internal AI solutions that improve engineering productivity, accelerate delivery, and support RealPage’s AI adoption goals. This role will focus on developing reusable AI patterns, agentic workflows, internal developer tools, reference implementations, and enablement assets that help engineering teams move from experimentation to repeatable production use. The ideal candidate is a hands\-on AI engineer with strong software development experience, practical knowledge of LLMs and agentic systems, and the ability to partner with engineering teams to turn AI concepts into usable internal capabilities. Responsibilities: **Internal AI Solution Development** * Design and build internal AI solutions that support engineering productivity and software delivery, including: + AI\-powered developer workflows and assistants + Agentic SDLC automation patterns + Internal tools for code analysis, documentation, testing, migration, and engineering support + Reusable prompt, tool\-calling, and workflow patterns + Reference implementations that can be adopted by engineering teams * Develop solutions that are practical, scalable, maintainable, and aligned with RealPage engineering standards. **Agentic Workflow and Platform Enablement** * Build reusable capabilities that help teams adopt AI consistently across the organization, including: + Multi\-step agentic workflows + Tool\-calling and orchestration patterns + RAG\-based internal knowledge solutions + Shared SDKs, templates, and integration examples + Reusable components for copilots, agents, and AI\-enabled engineering workflows * Partner with senior architects and engineering leaders to establish patterns that can scale beyond one team or use case. **Engineering Team Enablement** * Work directly with engineering teams, champions, and internal stakeholders to help them adopt AI effectively. Responsibilities include: * + Pairing with teams on AI use cases and implementation patterns + Providing technical guidance on LLM, RAG, and agentic workflow design + Supporting proof\-of\-concept efforts and helping mature them into repeatable practices + Creating playbooks, examples, templates, and documentation for internal engineering use + Participating in office hours, workshops, and AI enablement sessions **AI Evaluation, Quality, and Responsible Use** * Help define and apply practical evaluation and governance practices for internal AI solutions, including: + Prompt and workflow evaluation + Accuracy, relevance, and usefulness testing + Safety and responsible AI considerations + PII and sensitive\-data handling + Logging, observability, and feedback loops + Human\-in\-the\-loop review patterns where appropriate * Ensure internal AI solutions are developed with quality, security, privacy, and reliability in mind. **Delivery and Cross\-Functional Collaboration** * Partner with engineering leadership, product teams, architecture, security, and other stakeholders to identify and deliver high\-impact AI use cases. Responsibilities include: * + Translating engineering productivity needs into AI\-enabled solutions + Supporting roadmap\-aligned internal AI initiatives + Contributing to adoption and capacity\-improvement goals + Helping measure the impact of AI enablement efforts + Communicating technical concepts clearly to engineering and non\-engineering audiences **Performance, Reliability, and Cost Awareness** * Design AI solutions with practical performance and cost considerations, including: + Model selection and routing + Prompt and context optimization + Caching and retrieval efficiency + Latency and reliability considerations + Build\-vs\-buy recommendations + Avoidance of vendor lock\-in where practical Qualifications: * Typically **6\+ years of software engineering experience**, with meaningful hands\-on experience building production applications or internal platforms. * **2\+ years of applied AI, LLM, Generative AI, or agentic workflow experience**. * Strong programming experience in **Python**, **TypeScript/JavaScript**, or similar production languages. * Experience designing and building cloud\-native applications or services in **Azure, GCP, or AWS**. * Practical experience with: LLM\-based application development Prompt engineering and prompt versioning Tool calling / function calling RAG architectures Vector databases or semantic retrieval Multi\-step workflow or agent orchestration* Familiarity with modern software engineering practices, including: * CI/CD * Git\-based development * Automated testing * API design * Observability and logging * Experience using or enabling AI coding tools such as **GitHub Copilot, Cursor, Windsurf, Codex, or similar tools**. * Ability to work directly with engineering teams to understand needs, prototype solutions, and drive adoption. * Strong communication skills with the ability to explain AI concepts and implementation patterns clearly. **Nice\-to\-Have Skills / Abilities** * Experience building internal developer platforms, engineering productivity tools, or enablement frameworks. * Experience with agent frameworks or orchestration tools such as **LangGraph****, OpenAI Agents SDK, Google ADK, Semantic Kernel,** **CrewAI****, or similar frameworks**. * Experience with evaluation frameworks such as **OpenAI Evals,** **LangSmith** **Evals, RAGAS, or custom evaluation harnesses**. * Experience with browser automation or workflow automation tools such as **Playwright**. * Experience with knowledge management, internal documentation systems, or enterprise search. * Experience working in environments with privacy, compliance, or regulated\-data considerations. * Background in enterprise software, PropTech, fintech, or other complex business domains. * Experience supporting AI adoption programs, engineering champions, office hours, or internal technical enablement. ***SALARY AND BENEFITS*** RealPage provides a competitive salary package along with a comprehensive benefit plan that includes:* Health, dental, and vision insurance. * Retirement savings plan with company match. * Paid time off and holidays. * Professional development opportunities. * Performance\-based bonus based on position. + *\#LI\-JK1 \#LI\-REMOTE* Compensation may vary depending on your location, qualifications including job\-related education, training, experience, licensure, and certification, that could result at a level outside of these ranges. Certain roles are eligible for additional rewards, including annual bonus, and sales incentives depending on the terms of the applicable plan and role as well as individual performance. Equal Opportunity Employer: RealPage Company is an equal opportunity employer and committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. Pay Range: USD $159,100\.00 \- USD $270,900\.00 /Yr.

jobs.title: Forward Deployed Engineer
jobs.description: The problem we've solved Selling has always run on a brutal ratio. A salesperson spends barely a third of their day actually selling. The other two\-thirds goes to the work around the customer: the research, the lists, the notes, the CRM, the follow\-up. Two\-thirds of every sales payroll dollar buys administration instead of revenue. The manager's ratio is worse. Coaching is the highest\-leverage thing a sales manager does and it's structurally impossible to do at scale, so they sit in on one call a week and guess at the rest while the quiet underperformers repeat the same mistakes on real customers every day. We built the platform that ends both ratios. One system: the humans get coached on every call they make, and an AI coworker absorbs everything that comes with selling but isn't selling, wired into the CRM, the phones, and the calendar the business already runs on. The hours come back, every conversation gets better, and every outcome feeds back into what gets coached and absorbed next. More time, spent better, measured against revenue. The thing worth understanding before you apply: the call itself is about to be free. Within a year every voice model will hold a competent conversation. What lasts is what happens after the agent hangs up, the messy conversation turned into clean structured data, landed in the system the customer already works in, with the reasoning attached and proof it was done right. Anyone can make the call. Almost nobody does the finishing. That finishing is the product, it's deep, unglamorous, customer\-specific work that doesn't get copied over a weekend, and it's already running. It's also most of what this role extends into every new account. The role We need one person to own the technical customer journey end to end: first serious conversation to live in production. Demo, discovery, pilot design, CRM and telephony integration, launch, and support. You'll go into the codebase when a deployment demands it, tuning and extending what's already there so it fits each new customer, and turning what you learn in the field back into the product. This is the hire that stands up our go\-to\-market motion. You won't inherit a process. You'll build one, run it on our first accounts, and make it repeatable enough that the tenth deployment is dramatically easier than the first. Why this role exists The product is built and it works. The two founders ship production code across the platform, and it's live and running today. What we don't yet have is someone who has run an enterprise technical sales cycle and can deploy that product into outside customers reliably. That's the gap this hire fills, and it's the difference between a product that works and a company that sells. We're not looking for a cog. We're looking for the person who owns the commercial engine and teaches the founders the cycle along the way, so the motion lives in the company and not in one person's head. The unfair advantage you're walking into We own and operate a mid\-sized business in our beachhead vertical. The platform is deployed and running inside that operation right now, with real reps, real call volume, real CRM, and real revenue on the line. It was battle\-tested against a business we own before it ever went near an outside account. You are not selling vapor and you are not cold\-starting in an empty category. You're taking something proven in production into a market we know cold. The size of it The beachhead is one vertical, deliberately. But the architecture doesn't care which vertical it's in. The same system, humans coached on the calls that stay human, a coworker taking the volume and the routine events, wired into whatever stack the customer already runs, applies to any floor where the phone is where the revenue happens: distribution, staffing, mortgage, real estate, dealer groups, legal intake, and beyond. And it runs in two directions. On the floor it's the best software a sales team has ever used. On the wire it's infrastructure the customer's own systems call over API when an event fires. That second direction is where the ceiling stops tracking headcount and starts tracking transaction volume. You'd be deploying the first outside proof of a motion that's meant to stamp across an entire market. Where we are The product is live and proven inside our own operation. Outside customers are the frontier you'd be hired to open, so you're employee\-level early, with the ownership and the upside that implies. If you want a mature pipeline handed to you, this isn't it. If you want to be the person who builds it on top of a product that already works, it's exactly it. What you'll own * **Win the customer.** Lead demos and technical discovery with sales leaders, RevOps, and executives. Turn "we use Salesforce and RingCentral" into a real deployment plan. A good demo leaves them thinking this understands how our team actually works. * **Deploy the customer.** CRM integration and write\-back, telephony setup, configuration, end\-to\-end validation. A phone number that shows connected is not enough. You own the test call. An API that connects is not an integration. It's done when the right data lands in the right place and the customer trusts it. * **Design pilots that answer business questions,** not pilots that succeed because people liked the demo. Baseline metrics, instrumentation, clear success criteria, escalation path. * **Tune and extend the product in the field.** Fix the CRM sync, trace the voice defect, close the integration gap, adapt the finishing to a new customer's stack. You own problems through the stack, not up to the edge of a title. * **Turn the field into product.** When three customers need the same thing, the job isn't to configure it three times. It's to see the pattern and help turn it into a platform capability. * **Transfer the motion.** Part of this role is teaching the founders to run discovery and demos without you in the room. Making yourself repeatable is a measure of success here, not a threat to your seat. The stack Next.js, React, TypeScript, Node, Supabase/Postgres, Inngest for durable async workflows, Electron for live\-call experiences. Voice runs over PSTN with realtime AI: ASR, LLM reasoning, TTS, warm transfers, escalation. You don't need every piece on day one. You need to move through the stack without a tour guide and know where the deterministic boundaries have to sit around the AI. What we look for * You've run enterprise technical sales cycles: discovery, demos to executives, pilots, RFP responses, real integrations. * You can ship production code (TypeScript/Node/React/Postgres) and own a deployment end to end. * You've put AI into production and can reason about agents, tools, evaluation, state, and human escalation. * Strong judgment under incomplete information, and the credibility to tell a customer "we don't support that reliably yet, here's what we do, and here's how we'd prove the next step." * Comfort talking to engineers, operators, RevOps, sales leaders, executives, and security teams in the same week. **Especially valuable:** Salesforce architecture and write\-back, telephony provisioning and routing, realtime voice AI, and freight/logistics/TMS experience. What this is not Not pure engineering. Not classic sales engineering that ends at signature. Not implementation consulting. You win the customer, deploy the customer, and improve the product because of what you learned doing both. If you're happiest with a hard problem instead of a detailed ticket, and your instinct after solving something is "how do we turn this into a capability we can use everywhere," this is the seat. Pay: $201,674\.00 \- $256,432\.00 per year Benefits: * 401(k) * 401(k) matching * Dental insurance * Health insurance * Paid time off * Retirement plan Application Question(s): * Why do you want this job? * How do you tell the difference between a bug, a missing feature, and a customer who's using the product wrong? * What's a strong opinion you hold about building AI products that you think most engineers get wrong? * How are you using AI coding agents in your own work right now, and where have they burned you? Work Location: Remote

jobs.title: Mechanical Engineer
jobs.description: **About Redtree** Redtree Engineering specializes in engineering, project management, and construction support services across mission\-critical facilities, power systems, industrial projects, and complex infrastructure. Redtree offers **100% remote work** for this role. As a growing engineering firm, we've built our team around flexibility from day one, giving engineers the ability to do serious, high\-impact power generation design work from anywhere in the U.S., without relocating or commuting to an office. **Position Summary** Redtree is seeking a **Mechanical Engineer** to support front\-end planning, detailed design, and construction administration for power generation projects, with a focus on coal and natural gas\-fired power plants, as well as associated balance of plant systems. This role covers the full engineering lifecycle, from front\-end planning and preliminary design through final design, construction administration, and startup, and will work closely with multidisciplinary teams (electrical, civil, structural, PM/CM), equipment suppliers, and clients on both new\-build and plant modernization/uprate projects. This is an opportunity to join a fast\-growing engineering firm with the technical depth of an established AEC group and the agility of a startup, offering broad exposure across sectors rather than a narrow, single\-client scope. **You Will...** * Perform front\-end planning, preliminary design, code analysis and detailed design for mechanical systems at coal and natural gas fired generation facilities and associated balance of plant systems. * Design and size mechanical equipment and piping systems, including pumps, blowers, tanks, and vessels, along with hydraulic calculations and valve/pipe material selection. * Develop and review P\&IDs for pumps, vessels, and tanks. * Support air quality control systems and effluent limitation guideline (ELG) management for generation facilities. * Prepare final design packages, including bidding documents and specifications, for compliance with applicable mechanical and building codes, industry standards, and client specifications. * Manage teams of mechanical engineers to complete assigned activities. * Coordinate with electrical, civil, structural, and project management teams to ensure integrated, constructible designs. * Provide construction administration, field engineering, and startup support, including review of compliance submittals and resolution of construction issues (if/when needed). * Support proposal development, scoping, and schedule estimation for new project pursuits. * Contribute to project documentation, drawing sets, and technical specifications throughout the project lifecycle (feasibility, preliminary engineering, detailed design, PM/CM, startup/commissioning). * As applicable to seniority level, mentor junior engineers and/or manage mechanical scope on assigned projects, including development\-support and owner's\-engineer work such as technical due diligence and design reviews. **If You have...** * Bachelor of Science in Mechanical Engineering or related field from an ABET\-accredited program. * Experience with mechanical design for power generation facilities: combined cycle * Working knowledge of hydraulic calculations, pump/piping selection and sizing, and valve and pipe material selection. * Familiarity with P\&ID development and mechanical equipment condition assessment. * Understanding of relevant mechanical, and environmental/air quality jobs.description: ***Posting Type*** Hybrid/Remote ***Job Overview*** Who We Are Relativity is a leading legal data intelligence company building technology that helps users organize data, discover the truth, and act on it with confidence. Our AI‑powered, cloud platform, RelativityOne, transforms massive volumes of complex information into actionable insights for litigation, investigations, regulatory inquiries, data breach responses, and other high‑stakes legal work where accuracy and trust are crucial. The world’s largest law firms, corporations and government agencies rely on Relativity’s legal AI software to securely surface and manage the most relevant and impactful information in their matters. We own the systems that orchestrate large\-scale document review by LLM — durable workflows that carry a job through millions of documents — and the gateway that routes every model request across cloud regions and sovereign environments while managing capacity, throughput, and cost. offers the opportunity to make a measurable difference in the marketplace. ***Job Description and Requirements*** **What** **You’ll** **Do** * Contribute to the design, development, and operation of distributed, scalable, secure full\-stack cloud services that process petabytes of data weekly. * Build performant , accessible user interfaces and extend backend services and data pipelines. * C onsistently implement clean, testable , maintainable code to deliver customer impact . * Collaborate with a diverse group of teammates and product partners to solve problems, achieve team goals, and build AI\-powered legal data solutions at massive scale. * Actively contribute to design and code reviews, providing constructive feedback to improve quality and maintainability. * Contribute to service ownership by supporting reliability efforts, including on\-call rotations and incident response. * Improve throughput, latency, and cost per document across the platform: capacity headroom, token efficiency, and model routing and failover across regions. * Partner directly with the product teams building on the platform to shape its APIs and get new models and capabilities into production safely, including in government cloud environments. **What** **We’re** **Looking For** **Required** * 3\+ years designing, building, and operating cloud‑native, distributed systems * Hands‑on experience with APIs, event‑driven architecture, and data platforms * Comfortable developing cloud\-based, distributed services. * Ability to write clean, maintainable, well‑tested code using modern tooling and CI/CD * Security‑ and reliability‑focused mindset with strong cross‑functional collaboration across engineering, product, and design. * Proficiency in Python and/or C\#/.NET, with production experience running services on Kubernetes in a major cloud. * A track record of debugging and improving systems in production: distributed tracing, metrics, and comfort owning a service others depend on, on\-call included. **Preferred** * Experience with full\-stack development and modern UI frameworks. * Familiarity with performance or cost optimization . * Familiarity with AI\-development tools like GitHub Copilot, Cursor or Claude Code. * Experience building on LLM APIs (Azure OpenAI, OpenAI, Anthropic): prompt and model versioning, evaluation, streaming, token accounting, or working within rate limits and provisioned throughput. * Experience with durable workflow engines (Temporal, Airflow, Step Functions) or high\-volume batch and streaming data pipelines. * Interest in agentic systems — MCP, tool calling, and the infrastructure that makes them safe to run in a regulated environment. **Why We Could Be** **A** **Great Fit** * **Impactful Mission:** *Organize Data, Discover the* *Truth* *and Act on It* \- Our customers include Fortune 500 enterprises and leading law firms managing high\-stakes matters on our platform. * **Growth Path:** Engineers gain exposure across the stack, from distributed systems to AI\-enabled workflows, accelerating career growth . * **Engineering Culture:** Continuous delivery, strong observability, and end\-to\-end ownership. * **Inclusive Environment:** Diverse backgrounds and perspectives make us stronger . * **Community Impact:** Volunteer opportunities and company\-sponsored charitable programs. * **Compensation \& Benefits:** Competitive salary, health and retirement programs, wellness r esources, discretionary time off (DTO), parental leave for primary and secondary caregivers, two annual company breaks, home office stipend, and an equity program. **Relativity is committed to competitive, fair, and equitable compensation practices.** This position is eligible for total compensation which includes a competitive base salary, an annual performance bonus, and long\-term incentives. The expected salary range for this role is between following values: $103,000 and $155,000 The final offered salary will be based on several factors, including but not limited to the candidate's depth of experience, skill set, qualifications, and internal pay equity. Hiring at the top end of the range would not be typical, to allow for future meaningful salary growth in this position. **Required Skills:** Engineering Principle, Hardware Integration, Innovation, Problem Solving, Process Improvements, Quality Assurance (QA), Research and Development, System Designs, Technical Documents, Troubleshooting

Our HPAC (High Performance AI \& Compute Power) division creates advanced power management solutions for data centers, cloud infrastructure, and AI computing. **Job Description** As Staff Marketing Specialist for U.S. OEMs, you will drive design\-wins and revenue growth for our HPAC product portfolio across leading Enterprise and Networking OEM accounts. jobs.title: Senior Security Engineer - Threat Detection
jobs.description: **Who we are** Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale. Working at Samsara means you'll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that's shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video\-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you'll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term. ### **About the role** Samsara Security is looking for a Senior Threat Detection Engineer. This is a hands\-on engineering role: you will build and operate the signals, pipelines, and tooling that power how we discover threats against Samsara and our customers. The Threat Detection team owns the detection platform end to end — the data pipelines that feed it, the detection content that runs on it, the CI/CD that ships it, and the AI\-assisted tooling that scales what a small team can cover. You will write detections, and you will also build the machinery that makes the next detection faster to develop, safer to deploy, and measurable in production. You will report to the Director of Threat Detection and Response and work closely with Security Operations, Application Security, and Enterprise Security, as well as engineering teams across the company. We are looking for someone who takes projects from idea to proof\-of\-concept to production, who is comfortable being the first person to build something, and who is genuinely interested in what AI can and cannot do for detection engineering — including where it introduces risk rather than removing it. This role is open to candidates residing in the US **except** the San Francisco Bay Metro Area, NYC Metro Area, and Washington, D.C. Metro Area. ### **You should apply if:** * **You want to impact the industries that run our world:** Your efforts will result in real\-world impact—helping to keep the lights on, get food into grocery stores, reduce emissions, and most importantly, ensure workers return home safely. * **You are the architect of your own career:** If you put in the work, this role won't be your last at Samsara. We set up our employees for success and have built a culture that encourages rapid career development, countless opportunities to experiment and master your craft in a hyper growth environment. * **You're energized by our opportunity:** The vision we have to digitize large sectors of the global economy requires your full focus and best efforts to bring forth creative, ambitious ideas for our customers. * **You want to be with the best:** At Samsara, we win together, celebrate together and support each other. You will be surrounded by a high\-caliber team that will encourage you to do your best. ### **In this role, you will:** * Build, deploy, and continuously improve MITRE ATT\&CK–aligned detections across cloud, endpoint, identity, email, and application telemetry, with clear false\-positive thresholds. * Own the full detection lifecycle—from hypothesis, data validation, and baselining through deployment, tuning, validation, and retirement. * Advance our detection\-as\-code platform through version control, peer review, automated testing, CI/CD, and improved pipeline reliability and observability. * Identify emerging threat surfaces and build integrations that strengthen data ingestion, enrichment, and coverage across internal and third\-party systems. * Evaluate AI\-powered security capabilities, including secure MCP integrations, threat hunting, anomaly detection, and response automation. * Turn threat intelligence into actionable detection and retrospective scanning. * Partner closely with Security Operations during investigations, incidents, table top exercises, detection maintenance, and code pairing. * Champion, role model, and embed Samsara's cultural principles (Focus on Customer Success, Build for the Long Term, Adopt a Growth Mindset, Be Inclusive, Win as a Team) as we scale globally and across new offices. ### **Minimum requirements for the role:** * 6\+ years in security engineering, detection engineering, or a related technology discipline. * Strong Python and SQL skills, with experience analyzing large datasets to build and validate detections. * Hands\-on experience with detection\-as\-code, Git\-based workflows, automated testing, and CI/CD deployment. * Deep experience with modern SIEM platforms, includin nologies quickly, and communicate technical concepts clearly through documentation, RFCs, and presentations. ### **An ideal candidate also has:** * Experience with data orchestration platforms such as Airflow or Databricks. * Applied experience with LLMs, agentic frameworks, and MCP integrations, including their security risks and failure modes. * Experience with behavioral analytics, anomaly detection, feature engineering, and model evaluation. * Familiarity with risk\-based alerting, ChatOps, distributed alerting, and attack simulation. * Additional experience with Go, Terraform, malware analysis, digital forensics, or FedRAMP environments. \#LI\-Remote **Total Rewards** At Samsara, we build for the people who keep the global economy moving. We want owners, not passengers, which is why our rewards are designed to fuel high\-impact builders. Our compensation program delivers above\-market total compensation through a combination of base salary, performance\-based bonus/variable pay, and equity (for eligible roles) in a high\-growth public company. We meaningfully differentiate pay for our top performers, who have the opportunity to earn above\-market compensation that can outpace the broader market over time. Beyond compensation, we provide the foundations that enable long\-term success: a flexible, employee\-led remote model, a professional development stipend, comprehensive health and parental leave plans, and more. If you're ready to build for the long term and own the outcome, your journey starts here. **Flexible Working** At Samsara, we embrace a flexible working model that caters to the diverse needs of our teams. Our offices are open for those who prefer to work in\-person and we also support remote work where it aligns with our operational requirements. For certain positions, being close to one of our offices or within a specific geographic area is important to facilitate collaboration, access to resources, or alignment with our service regions. In these cases, the job description will clearly indicate any working location requirements. Our goal is to ensure that all members of our team can contribute effectively, whether they are working on\-site, in a hybrid model, or fully remotely. All offers of employment are contingent upon an individual's ability to secure and maintain the legal right to work at the company and in the specified work location, if applicable. **Belonging at Samsara** At Samsara, we welcome everyone regardless of their background. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, and other characteristics protected by law. We depend on the unique approaches of our team members to help us solve complex problems and want to ensure that Samsara is a place where people from all backgrounds can make an impact. **Accommodations** Samsara is an inclusive work environment, and we are committed to ensuring equal opportunity in employment for qualified persons with disabilities. Please email accessibleinterviewing@samsara.com or click here if you require any reasonable accommodations throughout the recruiting process. **Our Commitment to Authenticity** We use Tofu, a fraud detection tool, to validate the authenticity of applications and protect against identity fraud. This ensures we are connecting with real people and allows us to prioritize genuine candidates. Please see Samsara's Candidate Privacy Notice for more information. **Fraudulent Employment Offers** Samsara is aware of scams involving fake job interviews and offers. Please know we do not charge fees to applicants at any stage of the hiring process. Official communication about your application will only come from emails ending in @samsara.com, @us\-greenhouse\-mail.io or @mail3\.guide.co. For more information regarding fraudulent employment offers, please visit our blog post here.

jobs.title: Design-Minded Mobile Engineer
jobs.description: **About Sempulse** Sempulse makes an FDA\-cleared, non\-invasive vital signs monitor called Halo that streams real\-time patient data to first responders and clinicians. It's validated by the U.S. Military, SOCOM, NATO, the Gates Foundation, and the Cleveland Clinic, among others, and it's been selected for the U.S. Army's Project Convergence. In December 2024, it saved its first life in the field. We’re looking for a mid\-to\-senior individual\-contributor role with real autonomy on the software that supports Halo. **About the Work** First and foremost, this is a software engineering role. You'll build and improve the mobile applications and integrations that support Halo. That means writing, debugging, and shipping production\-grade code across our native application codebases. Our primary application is LiveCharts for iOS and Android, but we also support integrations with third party applications like ATAK. This is a role that requires a design\-minded, user\-focused approach to building software. Our ideal candidate has a good eye for how user interfaces should be structured, flow, and communicate with users. Experience taking feedback and iterating is necessary since you'll often be producing initial concepts and working with the team to refine and finalize the implementation. Halo is an FDA\-cleared device, which strongly influences our development and testing process. You'll work directly with our quality team to make sure V\&V and the right quality checkpoints are in place for all changes. We require rigorous testing and expect engineers to take responsibility for their work, including careful design, testing, and incorporating peer review from others. **What We're Looking For** * Professional experience building software for iOS or Android. You must have specific experience shipping fully native applications on one of these platforms. Experience on both is a plus. * Fluency and demonstrable experience with platform\-native debugging and performance tools. * A genuine eye for UX. You notice when something is functional but awkward to use, and you know how to approach improvements. * Experience building and releasing an app on a small team or solo. You should be prepared to share specific experiences in either of these conditions and talk about what you did. * Strong, hands\-on software engineering fundamentals. You've written and debugged real production code yourself (not just through an AI agent). You understand what your code is doing and can describe it clearly (and in detail) to others. * Demonstrable knowledge of mobile accessibility standards and best practices. * Experience in multi\-language localization, ideally in multi\-platform environments. * Experience applying test automation at multiple levels: unit, integration, end\-to\-end. You're comfortable contributing to hardware\-in\-the\-loop automation too, not just app\-level testing. * A real sense of ownership over the code you write. Your instinct should be to leave it better than you found it, including code that you didn’t write. You know how to refactor with confidence. * Comfort working within a regulated quality system: documentation, traceability, formal review. The strongest candidates will have hands\-on experience with V\&V and release processes in a regulated environment (medical device or similar). * Genuine pragmatism. You value stability over trends and will choose a proven, time\-tested framework over something new and volatile. * Low ego, high confidence: you flag problems and propose better approaches without being asked. * Interest in learning or expanding Rust experience. **How to Apply** Please submit a resume and brief cover letter explaining your experiences and how you’re uniquely qualified for this role. **Location and Travel** Our engineering team is fully distributed, and we hire talent from anywhere. Travel is minimal, with occasional trips for in\-person working sessions, software demonstrations, or high\-profile customer exercises. Candidates should expect periodic travel to Central Texas (Austin, San Antonio), California (San Diego), Pennsylvania, or Connecticut. *Note: No offshore resources or hiring agents.* Benefits: * 401(k) * Health insurance * Paid time off Work Location: Remote

jobs.title: Product Design Engineer II/III
jobs.description: **Product Design Engineer II/III** **Long Beach, CA – Onsite** Sierra Pacific Engineering and Products (SPEP) designs, manufactures, and proudly distributes high quality, cost\-effective industrial hardware components B2B. As an ISO\-certified industrial hardware company, our vision is to bring growth and stability to our customers through sustainable methods of engineering, service, and value. **Employee\-Powered, Employee\-Owned \-** Our employees make SPEP all that it is. This belief is reinforced with the Employee Stock Ownership Plan (ESOP) providing employees with 100% ownership in the business and the opportunity to benefit from the company’s success. **Position Summary** The Product Design Engineer is responsible for the design, development, and continuous improvement of new and existing products throughout its lifecycle. This role leads engineering projects from concept through production, working closely with internal teams, customers, and suppliers to develop innovative, cost\-effective, and manufacturable solutions. The Product Design Engineer applies sound engineering principles, advanced CAD design techniques, testing methodologies to ensure products meet performance, quality, and all customer and/or regulatory requirements. **Here’s what you’ll do:** · Design, develop, and improve industrial hardware products and related assemblies from concept through production release. · Create and maintain 3D CAD models, 2D engineering drawings, bills of materials (BOMs), design specifications, and technical documentation using SolidWorks and related engineering tools. · Support and manage planning and scheduling for new product development and engineering projects and quotation activities to meet revenue objectives. · Coordinate and participate in design reviews with cross\-functional teams to ensure designs meet customer requirements, meet manufacturing feasibility and quality standards, and cost objectives. · Prepare technical reports, presentations, engineering change documentation, customer\-facing project updates as required to communicate with customers and suppliers. · Interact and support QA department on inspection, fixture, and gauging designs to aid product inspection and/or performance testing. Conduct root cause analysis and implement corrective actions for any continuous improvement, product performance, or reliability enhancements. · Comply with all ISO documentation control procedures for product data management. **Here’s what you will bring to the table:** · Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical Engineering or a related engineering discipline required. · 3 \- 5 years of product design, mechanical engineering, and product development experience. · Advanced proficiency with SolidWorks CAD software, including 3D modeling, assemblies, 2D engineering drawing creation; PDM and FEA/simulation knowledge desirable. o Professional certifications such as Certified SolidWorks Professional (CSWP), or related engineering certifications are a plus. · Strong knowledge of engineering principles, mechanical design, GD\&T, quality methodologies. Capable of using APQP, FMEA, PPAP, and other techniques in support of product development. Experience with rapid prototyping and 3D printing for design / concept realization. Familiarity with ERP systems, BOM management, engineering change management, and product lifecycle management processes.
