jobs.title: Senior Quality Specialist - Federal
jobs.description: **Please note our clients and projects are nationwide – Travel will be required.** At Haskell, you’re not just joining a company—you’re joining a nationally recognized Top Workplace where diverse perspectives and inclusive thinking drive stronger outcomes. Whether you’re starting out, growing your expertise, or leading the way, you’ll find a culture grounded in trust, driven by excellence, and built to support your goals. Here, you’ll have the opportunity, flexibility, and sense of belonging to grow your career your way—while making a real impact. **Your Responsibilities will Include:** * Initiates QIP on every assigned project. * During design phase: + Conducts design Quality kick\-off meeting. + Ensures design reviews are completed and signed off at 30 and 100%. + Ensures Quality risks and mitigation plans are established/documented. + Personally reviews final documents on all assigned projects. * Ensures that geotechnical, concrete and envelope reviews are held on all assign projects. Performs geotechnical report review. Advises Project Director, Construction Project Manager and Design Project Manager on critical related information. Recommends alternative solutions and engages QA Manager when appropriate. * During construction phase: + Conducts construction Quality kick\-off meeting. + Participates in the selection and evaluation of independent testing agencies to support project construction phase. Develops budgets, administers contracts, and monitors scheduled activities, such as reports, field activities, tests and inspections on all agencies contracted. Distributes test results to appropriate design and Quality team members. + Performs testing, when required, on all scheduled activities not covered by the testing agency or subcontractor. + Finalizes the remaining Quality risks with well\-developed mitigation plans. + In conjunction with the Project Manager and Superintendent ensures all precons/preparatory meetings required by the QIP are conducted. Conducts meetings in area of expertise. + Ensures that all first work in place (initial) observations are scheduled and conducted. Also monitors progress of all required corrective measures. Performs observations in area of expertise. + Ensures in cooperation with Design Project Manager, Construction Project Manager and Superintendent that all site (follow\-up) observations are conducted. Performs all assigned QA inspections, prepares reports, documents deficiencies, and monitors progress of all corrective measures. + Performs the following QC checks during site visits: verification of materials, compliance with material storage, protection and maintenance requirements (including motors), material installation compliance with documents (foundation systems, slab on ground, structural framing systems, building enclosure systems, interior partitions, interior finishes, mechanical system installation, electrical system installation, and equipment installation. Notifies project team to provide assistance for checks in areas outside of expertise. * During the closeout phase: + Ensures in cooperation with the Construction Project Manager and Superintendent that Haskell completion conference and subcontractor completion conferences are conducted and documented. + Monitors that AE punch lists are created and completed. + Performs final QA punch list, documents findings and verifies/documents completion of those items. + Conducts/coordinates in conjunction with the Project Director, Design Project Manager and Construction Project Manager a lesson learned meeting. Prepares lessons learned document and distributes to project team and Director of Quality. * Produces reports which are concise, thorough, logically structured and well written for each QIP activity for which they are responsible. Distributes reports in a timely manner. * Communicates to the Quality Manager or Director of Quality potential inconsistencies, deficiencies, errors, omissions and conditions that expose the company to liability expenses. Defines and documents corrective actions. Communicates and initiates resolution through the Construction Project Manager, Design Project Manager, and Superintendent. Monitors deficiencies to ensure corrective action. * Participates in QIP audits with the Quality Manager and/or Director of Quality as requested. * Actively engages in the development and creation of Qualigrams and Best Practices. * Actively participates in the technical development of the Quality Coordinators and Associates and provides training for the Quality Coordinators and Quality Associates. * Performs a minimum of 2 seminars each year to large audience to improve quality and technical knowledge of staff. * Attends a minimum of 24 hours each year of professional development (in or out of house) to improve knowledge base. * Creates and implements, with supervisor input, a development plan to become recognized as an SME (Subject Matter Expert) in additional areas within the company in a specif onstruction (\*OSHA 30\-hour Construction Industry Outreach Training Program\*). Compétences fondamentales 1\. Responsabilité : Assumer la responsabilité de ses actions, ce qui implique d'anticiper et de prévenir les problèmes potentiels, ainsi que de résoudre les difficultés, tant au sein du département que de l'organisation dans son ensemble. 2\. Orientation client : Faire du service aux clients (internes et externes) une priorité ; viser à dépasser les attentes des clients, et non simplement à les satisfaire ; reconnaître et valoriser l'ensemble des parties prenantes clés ; développer et mettre en œuvre des compétences axées sur l'excellence du service. 3\. Communication efficace : Écouter activement pour comprendre et apprécier le point de vue d'autrui ; encourager un retour d'information ouvert et constructif ; s'exprimer de manière claire et efficace, que ce soit en entretien individuel ou devant de petits et grands groupes ; adapter ses messages et choisir les canaux de communication appropriés en fonction de son auditoire ; instaurer et favoriser des canaux de communication ouverts et transparents. 4\. Exécution / Autonomisation : Démontre sa capacité à obtenir des résultats ; gère les demandes concurrentes dans un environnement au rythme soutenu avec efficacité ; identifie et élabore des solutions de repli pour garantir une exécution dans les délais impartis. 5\. Apprentissage et développement : Accorde une priorité élevée à l'acquisition de nouvelles compétences et au renforcement de ses capacités ; prend des mesures pour répondre à ses propres besoins de développement ainsi qu'à ceux d'autrui, le cas échéant ; identifie les lacunes et les opportunités d'apprentissage afin d'assurer une maîtrise technique complète du poste ; assume la responsabilité de son propre développement et de l'amélioration de ses compétences. Valeurs 1\. Esprit d'équipe : Collabore et fait preuve de respect envers les membres de l'équipe, les partenaires et toutes les personnes avec lesquelles nous faisons affaire ; favorise une communication ouverte. 2\. Excellence : Vise la qualité et la sécurité ; assure une exécution de premier ordre ; fait preuve de créativité et d'innovation ; s'engage en faveur de l'amélioration continue. 3\. Service : Passion pour le service à la clientèle (interne et externe) ainsi que pour la communauté ; et création d'une valeur supérieure. 4\. Confiance : Normes élevées en matière d'éthique et de responsabilité personnelle ; transparence ; crédibilité ; équité. Facteurs environnementaux et/ou exigences physiques Dans l'exercice des fonctions liées à ce poste, le titulaire doit posséder des capacités de déplacement ordinaires suffisantes pour se rendre sur d'autres sites, ainsi que la capacité de se tenir debout, de marcher, de se pencher, de s'agenouiller, de s'accroupir et de manipuler (soulever, porter, déplacer) des charges légères à moyennes, allant de 10 à 50 livres (environ 4,5 à 22,5 kg). Le poste exige une bonne coordination œil\-main, ainsi qu'une dextérité des bras, des mains et des doigts — y compris la capacité de saisir des objets — et une acuité visuelle suffisante pour utiliser un clavier, manipuler des équipements et lire les informations figurant sur des formulaires ou des applications. L'employé est fréquemment amené à s'asseoir, à tendre les mains et les bras, à parler et à écouter. Haskell mettra en œuvre des aménagements raisonnables, conformément à l'Americans with Disabilities Act de 1990 et à l'Americans with Disabilities Act Amendments Act de 2008\. La description de poste fera l'objet d'une révision périodique à mesure que les tâches et responsabilités évolueront en fonction des nécessités de l'entreprise. Les fonctions essentielles et marginales du poste sont sujettes à modification. Description de poste Haskell est un employeur garantissant l'égalité des chances (femmes, minorités, anciens combattants protégés, personnes en situation de handicap) et un lieu de travail exempt de drogues.

jobs.title: Application Systems Analyst/Programmer - Staff Specialist
jobs.description: **Mission Statement** --------------------- Michigan Medicine improves the health of patients, populations and communities through excellence in education, patient care, community service, research and technology development, and through leadership activities in Michigan, nationally and internationally. Our mission is guided by our Strategic Principles and has three critical components; patient care, education and research that together enhance our contribution to society. **Job Summary** --------------- The Michigan Medicine Department of Radiation Oncology is seeking an experienced and motivated software engineering professional to build and maintain clinical applications that support safe and effective radiation therapy. This position supports team\-based workflows across a broad range of radiation therapy areas, including treatment planning, medical imaging, quality assurance, and clinical workflow automation. Alongside a dedicated team of software developers, you will collaborate with radiation oncologists, medical physicists, dosimetrists, radiation therapists, clinical informatics specialists, enterprise IT teams, and commercial system vendors. Prior healthcare or radiation oncology experience is welcome but not required. We are looking for a strong software engineer who is interested in learning the clinical domain and applying sound engineering practices to meaningful problems in patient care with a commitment to patient safety. We recognize that excellent candidates may not meet every preferred qualification. If this role interests you and your experience aligns with most of the required qualifications, we encourage you to apply. **Responsibilities\*** ---------------------- **Application Development and Maintenance (60%)** * Participate in the full software development lifecycle, including requirements analysis, architecture, design, implementation, testing, deployment, documentation, production support, and maintenance. * Design, develop, and maintain enterprise applications using Java, Spring Boot, Spring Framework, and related technologies. * Develop modern web\-based user interfaces using JavaScript or TypeScript frameworks such as Angular or React. * Build secure, scalable, maintainable, and well\-documented REST APIs and backend services. * Develop applications and interfaces that support radiation therapy planning, treatment delivery, clinical workflow, reporting, visualization, and data validation. * Translate complex clinical and operational requirements into reliable, testable, and maintainable software solutions. * Diagnose production issues, integration failures, performance problems, and data inconsistencies through structured troubleshooting and root\-cause analysis. * Modernize, migrate, or replace legacy and end\-of\-life applications while maintaining clinical functionality, data integrity, and continuity of operations. * Apply object\-oriented programming, design patterns, SOLID principles, clean\-code practices, secure coding, automated testing, and appropriate application architecture. **Clinical Informatics and Systems Integration (30%)** * Collaborate with clinical and technical stakeholders to design and maintain informatics tools supporting Radiation Oncology protocols and workflows. * Develop workflow applications that automate clinical data processing, validation, communication, task management, notifications, and reporting. * Develop dashboards and web applications that provide authorized users with timely access to clinical radiotherapy data and operational metrics. * Integrate applications with treatment planning systems, oncology information systems, imaging systems, databases, electronic health record platforms, vendor APIs, and institutional services. * Design and maintain relational database structures, SQL queries, stored procedures, data\-access components, interfaces, and data\-transformation processes. * Support secure clinical data exchange, mapping, reconciliation, audit logging, authentication, authorization, and role\-based access control. * Evaluate artificial intelligence, large language models, rule engines, cloud services, and other emerging technologies for appropriate use in clinical and operational workflows. **Software Quality and Documentation (10%)** * Create and maintain software requirements, architecture, design, testing, validation, deployment, support, and troubleshooting documentation. * Develop unit, integration, API, system, regression, security, and user\-acceptance testing appropriate to each application. * Participate in code reviews, architecture reviews, security reviews, testing reviews, and peer review of departmental applications. * Maintain traceability among requirements, implementation, testing, releases, and production changes. * Contribute to continuous improvement of coding standards, testing practices, CI/CD processes, monitoring, documentation, and software quality procedures. **Required Qualifications\*** ----------------  create clear software requirements, design documentation, test plans, release notes, installation guides, and support procedures. * Ability to work independently and collaborate effectively with multidisciplinary clinical and technical teams. * Ability and willingness to learn radiation oncology workflows, healthcare technologies, clinical terminology, and emerging software development practices. **Desired Qualifications\*** ---------------------------- Experience in any of the following is helpful but not required: * Healthcare, medical imaging, scientific computing, or other complex software environments. * DICOM, DICOM\-RT, DICOMweb, HL7, FHIR, or clinical system integration. * 3D visualization and medical image processing * Angular, React, REST APIs, OpenAPI, or asynchronous processing. * SQL Server, Oracle, PostgreSQL. * CI/CD, GitLab, Docker, Kubernetes, deployment to Hyperscaler platforms * PowerShell scripting, Haskell * EPIC, including certification courses * System monitoring, vulnerability scanning and remediation. * Medical device development, HIPAA, accessibility, or human\-centered design. * AI, machine learning, large language models **Why Join Michigan Medicine?** ------------------------------- Michigan Medicine is one of the largest health care complexes in the world and has been the site of many groundbreaking medical and technological advancements since the opening of the U\-M Medical School in 1850\. Michigan Medicine is comprised of over 30,000 employees and our vision is to attract, inspire, and develop outstanding people in medicine, sciences, and healthcare to become one of the world's most distinguished academic health systems. In some way, great or small, every person here helps to advance this world\-class institution. Work at Michigan Medicine and become a victor for the greater good. **What Benefits can you Look Forward to?** * Excellent medical, dental and vision coverage effective on your very first day * 2:1 Match on retirement savings **Modes of Work** ----------------- Positions that are eligible for hybrid or mobile/remote work mode are at the discretion of the hiring department. Work agreements are reviewed annually at a minimum and are subject to change at any time, and for any reason, throughout the course of employment. Learn more about the work modes. **Background Screening** ------------------------ Michigan Medicine conducts background screening and pre\-employment drug testing on job candidates upon acceptance of a contingent job offer and may use a third party administrator to conduct background screenings. Background screenings are performed in compliance with the Fair Credit Report Act. Pre\-employment drug testing applies to all selected candidates, including new or additional faculty and staff appointments, as well as transfers from other U\-M campuses. **Application Deadline** ------------------------ Job openings are posted for a minimum of seven calendar days. jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer, Agentic Commerce
jobs.description: **About ThredUp** ThredUp is transforming resale with technology and a mission to inspire the world to think secondhand first. By making it easy to buy and sell secondhand, ThredUp has become one of the world's largest online resale platforms for apparel, shoes and accessories. Sellers love ThredUp because we make it easy to clean out their closets and unlock value for themselves or for the charity of their choice while doing good for the planet. Buyers love shopping value, premium and luxury brands all in one place, at up to 90% off estimated retail price. Our proprietary operating platform is the foundation for our managed marketplace and consists of distributed processing infrastructure, proprietary software and systems and data science expertise. With ThredUp’s Resale\-as\-a\-Service, some of the world's leading brands and retailers are leveraging our platform to deliver customizable, scalable resale experiences to their customers. ThredUp has processed over 172 million unique secondhand items from 55,000 brands across 100 categories. By extending the life cycle of clothing, ThredUp is changing the way consumers shop and ushering in a more sustainable future for the fashion industry. Recognized on TIME Most Influential Companies of 2023, Digiday's WorkLife 50 2023, TIME's Best Inventions of 2022, and Lattice's People Success Awards 2022\. **How You Will Make An Impact** A generation of shoppers is starting to find what they want by asking an AI agent instead of browsing a website. The marketplaces those agents can read, understand, and buy from will win that traffic; the ones they can't won't get surfaced at all. As our first Senior Software Engineer for Agentic Commerce, you'll build the layer that makes 4 million unique secondhand items discoverable and transactable by AI shopping agents, and own how ThredUp shows up when someone asks an agent to find them a dress for a wedding. This is early, open territory. The standards are young, customer behaviors are still forming, and there's no established playbook to follow. You'll partner closely with engineering and product leadership to give the space shape — working out what's worth building, making the architectural decisions together, and getting real functionality in front of customers to learn from. For the first stretch you'll be the primary engineer on this work, with broad ownership of how it comes together. You'll report to our Senior Director of Engineering. **In This Role You'll Get To:** * Design and build the agentic\-commerce layer end to end — from exposing our catalog, pricing, and inventory to AI shopping agents through cart, checkout, and order handoff — defining the integration surface rather than inheriting one. * Own how ThredUp gets discovered and surfaced by LLM\-driven shopping agents, including the structured data that makes 4M\+ unique, single\-SKU items legible to machines. * Prototype quickly against real agent platforms, then harden what proves out into production\-grade services — working across the stack, wherever the problem lives. * Use AI tools and agentic workflows as a core part of how you build, setting the bar for what AI\-native engineering looks like at ThredUp. * Partner with engineering, product, and executive leadership to turn an undefined space into a roadmap, carry it from idea to shipped, and let real customer usage drive what comes next. * Our stack: Ruby on Rails, Java/JVM, MySQL, Kafka, Redis, Sidekiq, OpenSearch, AWS, Kubernetes, Terraform. Apollo GraphQL API gateway. React, PWA, native iOS and Android. No prior experience with any particular piece required. **What We're Looking For:** * 5\+ years of software engineering experience, owning systems end to end from ambiguous problem to production. * Fluent daily use of LLMs and agentic coding tools, with strong instincts for where AI output needs human judgment. * Experience building or deploying systems powered by LLMs, and an understanding of how model behavior shapes product experience. * Strong API and integration design skills, for interfaces consumed by other systems rather than by people. * Depth in backend engineering with the range to work across the stack. Design judgment matters more here than which languages you've used. * Genuine curiosity about a space that changes monthly — new protocols, new tooling, new model capabilities — and the habit of keeping up with it. * Comfort working from a blank page without a surrounding team to make progress. * The judgment to scope a problem, put a plan behind it, and drive it to shipped rather than exploring indefinitely. * Clear communication with engineers and non\-technical executives alike. * Familiarity with the Agentic Commerce Protocol (ACP), MCP, or other emerging agentic\-commerce standards is a plus. * E\-commerce or marketplace experience is a plus. * Experience having built something from zero, whether at a startup or inside a larger company is a plus. Many ThredUp employees also have the opportunity to own shares of ThredUp stock, ThredUp employees are eligible for discretionary restricted stock unit awards, as well as a discount when purchasing ThredUp stock if voluntarily participating in ThredUp's Employee Stock Purchase Plan. Subject to eligibility requirements, you'll also receive other benefits: Comprehensive medical \& dental coverage, vision, 401k, life and disability insurance. This role is not eligible for visa sponsorship. **What We Offer:** * 4\-day work week, with most Fridays off * Competitive salary (we leverage market data) * Many ThredUp employees also have the opportunity to own shares of ThredUp stock and are eligible for discretionary restricted stock unit awards * Employee stock purchase plan * Flexible PTO (take the time you need) \+ 13 company holidays * Paid Sabbatical after 3 years of full time employment * Generous paid parental leave for new mothers and fathers * Medical, dental, vision, 401k, life and disability insurance offered * We live by our Core Values of Transparency, SpeakingUP, Thinking Big, Infinite Learning, Influencing Outcomes \& Seeking the Truth **We believe diversity, inclusion and belonging is key for our team** At ThredUp, our mission has been built on extending the lives of millions of unique clothing items. Much like our inventory, we are proud to have fostered a workplace that is one\-of\-a\-kind. As a company focused on diversity, inclusion and belonging, we are committed to ensuring our employees are comfortable bringing their authentic selves to work every day. A unique perspective is critical to solving complex problems and inspiring a new generation to think secondhand first. Be you. If you are a candidate with a disability and have a reasonable accommodation request for the job application process, please email *disabilitysupport@ThredUp.com* the specific details of your disability related accommodation request. This email address is reserved for candidates with disabilities only. General application inquiries will not receive a response.

You will work with engineers across teams to understand their changing development lifecycle with the use of AI, reduce friction in shipping code, and implement robust security and assurance guardrails that keep our production environments stable, auditable, and compliant. Responsibilities \- Software Lifecycle: re\-architect, design, build and maintain software development workflows (from compilation to deployment) for backend and platform services, improving reliability, speed and experience for both humans and agents, while embedding security and compliance \- Secure Supply Chain Management: Implement and manage software supply chain security controls, including SBOM generation and validation, artifact signing and attestation (e.g., SLSA), and provenance tracking to ensure the integrity of the build and release process. \- Automate Policy\-as\-Code Gates: Integrate and enforce automated security and compliance gates within CI/CD pipelines, such as secrets scanning, dependency risk analysis, license compliance checks, and vulnerability scanning, with fail\-safe promotion rules. \- Enhance System Resilience and Disaster Recovery: Align and enhance build and release tooling to be more resilient, support Disaster Recovery (DR), and Business Continuity Planning (BCP) requirements. Implement and periodically test backup and restore procedures for critical repositories and pipelines. \- Technical Leadership \& Execution: Act as the tech lead for a high\-impact engineering team. Drive design reviews, establish rigorous engineering standards, manage technical debt, and ensure the team hits aggressive roadmap milestones (e.g., scaling build loads by 3X). Preferred Qualifications \- Experience in platform or developer productivity teams, building internal tools and templates for other engineers. \- Familiarity with containerization (Docker, Kubernetes) and its security ecosystem. \- A demonstrated track record of writing clear technical documentation for security processes and runbooks. Appropriately handling and managing confidential information including proprietary and trade secret information and access to information technology systems; and 3\. Exercising sound judgment. The Joint Venture has been established in compliance with the Executive Order signed by President Trump on September 25, 2025\. USDS Joint Venture helps ensure Americans can continue to express their creativity, discover new hobbies and interests, and build thriving communities and businesses on a global scale. jobs.title: Senior AI Solutions Engineer, AI Studio
jobs.description: At VF, we strive to foster a culture of belonging based on respect, connection, openness, and authenticity. So, before we get to the job details, take a minute to learn a little more about us – our values and our culture \- visit VF Careers or www.vfc.com. **What will you do?** A day in the life of a Senior AI Solutions Engineer, AI Studio at VF looks a little like this. Apply advanced data science methods to solve business problems, generate actionable insights, and support data\-driven decision making. Partners with cross\-functional teams develop analytical models, optimize processes, and translate complex data into business value. Let’s break down that day\-in\-the\-life a bit more. ***Principal Accountabilities*** *Under general direction:* * *Design, develop, and deploy statistical, predictive, and machine learning models to address business challenges.* * *Analyze large, structured and unstructured datasets to identify trends, opportunities, and risks.* * *Collaborate with business, product, and technology teams to define analytical requirements and translate them into scalable solutions.* * *Communicate findings and recommendations through clear visualizations, reports, and presentations.* * *Ensure data quality, integrity, and adherence to governance standards.* * *Contribute to the continuous improvement of analytics capabilities, methodologies, and best practices.* * *Support the evaluation and implementation of emerging data science tools and technologies.* ***Knowledge \& Application*** * *Applies advanced knowledge of data science principles, methodologies, and industry practices.* * *Integrates information from multiple sources to solve complex business problems.* * *Evaluates data limitations and recommends appropriate analytical approaches.* * *Serves as a subject matter resource within the function.* ***Problem Solving*** * *Uses analytical judgment to address ambiguous or complex issues.* * *Develops innovative solutions when data, requirements, or business conditions are incomplete.* * *Identifies root causes, evaluates alternatives, and recommends practical actions.* * *Anticipates future analytical needs and opportunities.* ***Interaction*** * *Partners effectively with technical and business stakeholders.* * *Influences decisions through data\-driven insights and recommendations.* * *Adapts communication style to different audiences and levels of the organization.* * *Builds alignment and drives adoption of analytical solutions.* ***Impact*** * *Directly contributes to operational, strategic, and business performance goals.* * *Improves decision quality through actionable insights and predictive analytics.* * *Supports functional and cross\-functional initiatives through analytical expertise.* ***Accountability*** * *Responsible for delivering high\-quality analytical outcomes within agreed timelines.* * *Accountable for the accuracy, reliability, and business relevance of analytical solutions.* * *Exercises judgment independently while escalating significant risks or issues when appropriate.* **What do you need to succeed?** We all have unique skills that we bring to work and celebrate every day. For this role, there are foundation skills you’ll need to succeed and excel. Additionally, while formal education in a related field is great to have, we are most interested in your 5\+ years of experience and professional achievements. The foundation skills you will need in this position are: * *Bachelor's degree in Data Science, Statistics, Mathematics, Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field.* + *Equivalent relevant experience may be considered in lieu of a degree.* * *Typically 5\+ years of experience in data science, advanced analytics, or a related discipline.* * *Strong understanding of statistical analysis, predictive modeling, and machine learning techniques.* * *Proficiency in Python, R, SQL, and data visualization tools.* * *Experience working with cloud\-based data platforms and large\-scale datasets.* * *Strong communication and stakeholder management skills with the ability to explain technical concepts to non\-technical audiences.* **Now WE have a question for YOU.** **Are you in?** **Hiring Range****:** $142,560\.00 USD \- $178,200\.00 USD annually**Incentive Potential**: This position is eligible for additional compensation awards that may include an annual incentive plan, sales incentive, or commission potential. jobs.title: Field Operations Engineer
jobs.description: Join Tomorrow.io's Global Field Team! At Tomorrow.io, we're transforming how the world understands and acts on weather. Our technology powers decisions for some of the world's most weather\-sensitive operations, from aviation and logistics to global sporting events and beyond. We're building a specialized international field team to support a flagship project that combines advanced weather technology, on\-the\-ground operations, and global collaboration. If you're resourceful, proactive, and thrive in dynamic environments where technology meets real\-world impact, we want you on our team. We are seeking a Field Ops Engineer to join Tomorrow.io's on\-site technical operations for a high\-profile, fast\-moving global technology project. You'll support the deployment, operation, and maintenance of Tomorrow.io's weather systems, including radar and weather stations, ensuring everything runs smoothly and reliably across multiple international sites. **What You'll Do** * Lead and execute on\-site technical challenges during global operations. * Manage the deployment, installation, calibration, operation, and disassembly of weather systems. * Ensure technical readiness and uptime before, during, and after events. * Support field logistics, including transporting equipment, setup coordination, and on\-site troubleshooting. * Serve as an on\-site point of contact during field activitiesreflecting the field\-centric nature of the job. * Work cross\-functionally with engineering, product, and meteorology teams to define configurations and integrations, and bring resolution to customer projects. * Support customer discussions, clarify system capabilities, and document solution designs. * Ensure deployed systems meet technical, operational, and customer needs. * Represent Tomorrow.io in the field with professionalism, precision, and technical excellence. **What You Bring** * 3\+ years of experience working in an Enterprise SaaS, B2B, customer\-facing role. * Hands\-on experience with weather systems, such as weather stations, radars, or environmental monitoring equipment. * Valid international driver's license (or ability to obtain one), and comfort managing travel logistics and equipment transport. * Willingness and ability to travel internationally at a significant frequency throughout the year (approximately \~60%). * + Reliable/practical access to a major international airport strongly preferred. * Hands\-on, practical mindset, able to solve complex issues in dynamic conditions. * Ability to design solutions involving hardware, software, and data flows. * Strong troubleshooting and decision\-making skills in dynamic environments. * Proven teamwork and coordination skills for working alongside a small field team. * Clear communication and customer\-facing technical presentation abilities. * Independent, proactive, and resourceful \- someone who gets things done. **Physical Requirements** This is a hands\-on field role that involves working in dynamic, real\-world environments. As part of day\-to\-day responsibilities, you may be required to: * Lift, carry, and move equipment (including items over 40 lbs) * Assemble and disassemble weather stations and related hardware * Operate in outdoor environments (including heights) and varying weather conditions *If your experience is close but doesn't fulfill all requirements, please apply. Tomorrow.io is on a mission to build a special company. To achieve our goal, we are focused on hiring people with different backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences.* *Tomorrow.io is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity and Affirmative Action employer. We do not discriminate based upon race, religion, color, national origin, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender, gender identity, gender expression, transgender status, sexual stereotypes, age, status as a protected veteran, status as an individual with a disability, or other applicable legally protected characteristics. Tomorrow.io participates in the E\-Verify program in all US states, as required by law.* *At tomorrow.io we have established a workplace culture that values fairness and equal opportunities and we believe it is crucial for fostering a positive and productive environment. Regularly reviewing and adjusting pay practices to align with legitimate drivers of pay, such as job level, geographic location, and performance, demonstrates a commitment to maintaining equity within the organization.This commitment to ongoing assessment and improvement is key to creating a workplace that is not only diverse and inclusive but also fair and just. The anticipated range for this role is $100k\-$120k, subject to local market and candidates skills and experience. Comprehensive health benefits, unlimited paid time off and other benefits included. Relocation assistance may be offered/available for certain roles.* *Tomorrow.io is committed to providing reasonable accommodations for candidates with disabilities in our recruiting process. If you need any assistance or accommodations due to a disability, please let us know at* *jobs@tomorrow.io* **About Tomorrow.io:** Selected by*TIME* Magazine as one of the Top 100 Most Influential Companies in the World, Tomorrow.io is the world's leading Resilience Platform™. Combining next\-generation space technology, advanced generative AI, and proprietary weather modeling, Tomorrow.io delivers unmatched forecasting and decision\-making capabilities. Trusted by six of the top ten Fortune 500 companies, Tomorrow.io empowers organizations to proactively manage weather\-related risks, opportunities, and enhance operational efficiency. From cutting\-edge weather intelligence to real\-time early warning systems, Tomorrow.io enables predictive, impact\-based action for a safer, more resilient future. Learn more at Tomorrow.io. **Ethos:** Our ethos guides us in everything we do \- The people of Tomorrow are here to make an impact, they show true grit, and always put people first. **How we roll:** We work in an "one office" environment. We believe that magic happens when people work together. Together also includes Zoom meetings, flexible hours and unlimited vacation days. Your success is achieved by your impact and deliveries and not by the hours you put in. We believe in transparency and directness, putting work before ego and empathy. We grow fast and move faster but we always see people first. Each person has their own career growth path for we believe that the only way for the company to grow is if you grow.

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager (AI Agents)
jobs.description: **About Traba** =============== Traba is building the AI operating layer for the industrial supply chain. We started in the workforce space because contingent labor is the biggest operational pain point our manufacturing and logistics customers face. We used it to embed ourselves inside their daily operations and create a far better customer experience through technology. Now those same customers are pulling us beyond staffing into the broader operational workflows that run their facilities. That foundation gave us proprietary data from millions of shifts and deep enterprise relationships. But our edge is more than data. By connecting to the systems running across every facility and activating the workers already on our platform to execute against them, we are building applied AI that drives real productivity gains and transforms how the global supply chain operates at scale. We are backed by Founders Fund, Khosla Ventures, and General Catalyst. **The Role** ------------ We are looking for an entrepreneurial and experienced Product Manager to join as a founding member of the Agents team and help us build the next layer of Traba's product, an agentic platform that synthesizes the data flowing through our marketplace and operates autonomously inside our customers' supply chain workflows. Think Claude, but for Light Industrial businesses. You'll embed deeply in our customers' operations, design and ship production agents that understand context, reason through ambiguity, make decisions, and execute work on behalf of users. This is a true 0\-to\-1 product role operating at the frontier of applied AI. You will work directly with founders, product engineers, ML teams, and early design partners to define workflows, shape product strategy, and build products while the underlying model ecosystem continues changing beneath us. The assumptions, capabilities, and constraints will evolve rapidly and the product will evolve with them. This role reports directly to our VP of Product. **What you’ll do** ------------------ * Architect and steward product strategy for Traba’s AI agent platform * Solve complex customer problems by balancing user needs, technical constraints, and evolving AI capabilities * Write detailed product requirements and partner deeply with product engineers and ML teams * Rapidly validate and prototype ideas alongside customers and design partners * Design agent systems that reason through workflows, orchestrate tools, maintain context, and execute meaningful work * Define product behavior, evaluation systems, and quality frameworks that improve reliability and performance * Use data to uncover patterns and answer key product and system questions * Evolve our AI product portfolio with a deep understanding of model capabilities and system architecture * Visualize and communicate complex concepts from system behavior and evaluations to user experiences and business impact * Socialize your work across all levels and departments while synthesizing diverse stakeholder feedback **What we’re looking for** -------------------------- **Real agent builder.** You have launched customer\-facing AI products where the system took meaningful actions on behalf of users. We are intentionally setting a high bar here. Shipping AI features, copilots, chat interfaces, wrappers, or lightweight LLM integrations alone is not enough. You understand agents that execute workflows, orchestrate systems, use tools, maintain context, and perform work autonomously. **0\-to\-1 operator.** You have built products from scratch with real customers and understand the realities of finding product market fit. You have launched, rebuilt, changed direction, killed ideas, and iterated toward signals. You are comfortable creating structures where no playbook exists. **AI\-native problem solver.** You move quickly in environments where models evolve constantly and assumptions regularly break. You understand that building AI products often means navigating prompt rewrites, model shifts, reliability tradeoffs, and capability cliffs. **First\-principles thinker.** You spend equal time thinking about why, how, and what. You understand that strong product judgment often comes from deeply understanding systems and constraints rather than applying generic playbooks. **Customer\-embedded builder.** You believe the best products are built shoulder\-to\-shoulder with customers. You have experience deeply embedding with early customers, understanding workflows firsthand, and rapidly shipping based on direct feedback loops. Experience with forward deployed environments or customer\-embedded product development models is highly valued. **Technical depth.** You are comfortable operating alongside ML engineers and highly technical teams as peers. You can understand evaluations, reason through system tradeoffs, prototype ideas, and participate deeply in technical conversations. You do not need to be an ex\-engineer, but you should have strong technical instincts and enjoy getting into the details. **Builder mentality.** Inventive and scrappy problem solver. You move quickly, embrace ambiguity, and know how to create meaningful outcomes without relying on giant teams or excessive process. **Deeply collaborative.** You work seamlessly across engineering, ML, operations, design, leadership, and customers to bring new products to life. **What you’ll bring** --------------------- * 5 – 7 years of experience as a Product Manager * Evidence of launching products from scratch and driving meaningful customer outcomes * Experience building AI\-native products or customer\-facing agent systems * Strong technical abilities with the ability to work deeply with engineering and ML teams * Ability to read evaluations, reason through system performance, and prototype ideas * Experience operating in highly ambiguous startup environments with fast iteration cycles * Deep familiarity with AI tools and hands\-on experience building with modern AI systems * Desire to work at a startup and cover an exceptionally wide surface area * A strong work ethic and desire to build a category\-defining company **Benefits** ------------ * Start\-up equity * Competitive Salary * 100% Paid health, dental \& vision coverage * Dinner Provided via Grubhub \& stocked kitchen for NY employees * Commuter benefit * Team building events * Gympass Benefit * Flexible PTO * ✚✚ Additional: One Medical Membership, Gympass, HSA via Optum, Talkspace, Health Advocate, Teledoc Health **Salary Range Details** ------------------------ The compensation range for this position is set between $180,000 and $210,000, reflecting our market analysis and other relevant considerations. However, exceptions may be made for candidates with qualifications that significantly differ from those outlined in the job description.We also offer a highly competitive equity package designed to ensure you share meaningfully in the long\-term success and upside of the business. The position is based onsite in New York City or San Francisco, five days per week, giving you the opportunity to collaborate closely with a high\-performing team in a fast\-paced, energetic environment. Being in person supports real\-time decision\-making, stronger teamwork, and the kind of creative problem\-solving that drives meaningful impact. **Equal Opportunity Employer** ------------------------------ Traba is dedicated to promoting Equal Opportunity employment practices. We evaluate all applicants without discrimination based on race, color, religion, creed, national origin, age, sex, gender, marital status, sexual orientation and identity, genetic information, veteran status, citizenship, or any other characteristics that are legally protected by local, state, or federal regulations. We encourage applicants from a variety of backgrounds, experiences, and skill sets. **Our Values** -------------- **Dream Big \-** We are on a path to change the world for the better. We create and communicate a bold direction that inspires a life\-changing vision. We don’t sacrifice long\-term value for short\-term results. **Olympian’s Work Ethic \-** Changing the world never comes easy. We work harder, longer, and smarter, not just two out of three. We put everything we have on the field. **Growth Mindset \-** We confront the toughest challenges head\-on and persevere. Sometimes we fail, but we brush ourselves off, adapt, learn, and push forward with resilience. **Customer Obsession \-** We go the extra mile for our workers and businesses. We remain focused on delivering high\-quality products and services that solve this massive and overlooked industries’ problems Privacy Notice for CA Applicants Compensation Range: $180K \- $210K

jobs.title: Network Engineer I
jobs.description: Transcor Data Services provides the ground transportation industry with the most advanced systems designed to maximize efficiency and revenue without maximizing costs. Our advanced applications and SaaS (Software as a Service) solutions integrate data and coordinate booking functionality across multiple platforms and sales channels globally. **Job Summary** As a Network Engineer I, you will be a core team member delivering digital business transformation solutions to our clients. You will assist in the day\-to\-day administration, monitoring, maintenance, and troubleshooting of our cloud and on\-premises network infrastructure while learning from senior engineers. In this role, you will also leverage modern AI platforms including Claude AI to accelerate scripting, streamline technical documentation, and assist with network operations. **Duties/Responsibilities** * Assists in configuring, maintaining, and monitoring local, metropolitan, and wide area networks. * Supports department staff in maintaining routers, switches, firewalls, and cloud networks. * Assists senior engineers in implementing network architectures, topologies, hardware, software, transmission, signaling links, and protocols into complete configurations. * Leverages Claude AI and generative AI tools to assist in drafting network scripts, summarizing system logs, and producing technical runbooks. * Actively builds and maintains positive relationships with internal user communities and vendors to understand business needs. * Performs, documents, and communicates basic network health checks, routine installations, and performance evaluations. * Supports department staff in the analysis, solution, and documentation of network issues and tickets. * Escalates complex errors or high\-impact incidents to senior team members for advanced resolution. * Learns and adheres to department network design policies, standards, and security procedures. * Actively solicits feedback and guidance on best practices from management and senior engineers. * Continually enhances knowledge of network engineering concepts and company standards for professional growth. * Contributes to existing technical documentation, runbooks, and educational content based on system updates and user feedback. * Triages initial product or system issues by analyzing basic log sources and assessing the impact on hardware, network, or service quality. * Tracks all work time accurately across assigned tickets and projects. **Required Skills/Abilities** * Foundational understanding of physical architecture, interconnect firewalls, and basic setup procedures. * Basic knowledge of Google Cloud Networking concepts and cloud infrastructure. * Hands\-on experience or familiarity with using Claude AI (or similar AI assistants) for code/script generation, query building, and technical troubleshooting. * Ability to assist in creating, reviewing, and updating basic network diagrams and documentation in Google Cloud. * Familiarity with setting up and maintaining VPN connections between on\-premises and cloud (GCP) environments. * Basic understanding of external hub\-and\-spoke ingress/egress configurations. * General knowledge of Google DNS services, subnets, shared VPCs, and load balancers. * Basic exposure to or interest in working with Terraform modules and CI/CD pipelines. * Strong written and verbal communication skills. * Diligent time\-tracking habits across projects and ticketing tools. **Education and Experience** * Bachelor’s degree in information technology, Computer Science, or a related field (or equivalent work experience/certifications). * 0–2 years of hands\-on experience in cloud, server, or network administration. * Practical exposure to utilizing Claude AI or equivalent AI tools within standard engineering workflows preferred. * Basic exposure to shared VPCs, firewalls, subnets, VPN tunneling, and load balancing. * Entry\-level cloud or network certifications (e.g., CompTIA Network\+, GCP Associate Cloud Engineer, or CCNA) are a plus.

jobs.title: Senior Software Developer
jobs.description: **Trimark Associates** is a leader in SCADA software, metering services, and system integration for the U.S. power industry. We support generation facilities of all sizes—from 1 MW solar sites to multi‑GW nuclear plants—delivering solutions for operational visibility, regulatory compliance (including NERC and CAISO), and reliable system control. Our in‑house platforms, including **T1‑S Vantage** and **True:SCADA**, are built on deep expertise in metering, SCADA, and energy market integration. Clients depend on us to ensure seamless operations, enable fast controls, provide reliable data, and adapt quickly to changing grid demands. From concept through commissioning, we design and deliver complete systems—covering architecture, software development, hardware integration, deployment, testing, certification, and ongoing support. **Role Overview** Trimark Associates is seeking an experienced **Senior Software Developer** to help drive the continued evolution of our **T1\-S Vantage** platform. This role is ideal for a software engineer who enjoys solving complex technical challenges, designing scalable enterprise applications, and building software that directly supports critical infrastructure across the electrical grid. As a Senior Software Developer, you will play a key role in designing, developing, and enhancing core platform capabilities. You will work closely with product owners, developers, project managers, systems engineers, and customers to deliver high\-quality software solutions that are reliable, maintainable, and scalable. The ideal candidate combines strong software engineering fundamentals with practical experience building modern enterprise applications using Microsoft technologies. You should be comfortable leading technical initiatives, mentoring other developers, and contributing throughout the entire software development lifecycle. **What You'll Do** Software Development * Design, develop, test, and maintain new features within the **T1\-S Vantage** platform * Build scalable, high\-performance applications using **C\# and .NET** * Develop and maintain RESTful APIs, backend services, and distributed application components * Create and enhance web\-based user interfaces using modern web technologies * Write clean, maintainable, and well\-documented code following established engineering standards * Participate in architectural planning and technical design discussions Platform Engineering * Improve the performance, reliability, and scalability of mission\-critical applications * Design solutions for handling large volumes of operational, telemetry, and time\-series data * Integrate software with industrial devices, third\-party systems, data historians, and external services * Support cloud and on\-premises deployments across customer environments * Contribute to software security, observability, monitoring, and operational readiness Technical Leadership * Lead development efforts for major features and initiatives * Mentor junior and mid\-level developers through code reviews and technical guidance * Advocate for engineering best practices, coding standards, and software quality * Collaborate with cross\-functional teams to define technical requirements and implementation strategies * Assist in estimating work, planning releases, and managing technical risk Continuous Improvement * Participate in Agile development activities, including sprint planning, standups, reviews, and retrospectives * Identify opportunities to improve software architecture, development processes, and team productivity * Evaluate emerging technologies and recommend solutions that align with business objectives * Contribute to technical documentation and knowledge\-sharing initiatives **Education and Experience** * Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience * 7\+ years of professional software development experience * Proven experience developing and maintaining enterprise software applications * Experience working on complex, distributed, or mission\-critical systems * Demonstrated ability to lead technical projects and mentor other developers **Required Qualifications** * Strong proficiency in **C\# and .NET** * Strong understanding of object\-oriented design principles and software architecture patterns * Experience designing and developing **RESTful APIs** * Experience with **Microsoft SQL Server** and relational database design * Strong knowledge of SQL, performance optimization, and data modeling * Experience building modern web applications using **HTML, CSS, and JavaScript** * Familiarity with source control systems such as **Git** * Experience working within Agile software development environments * Strong debugging, troubleshooting, and analytical skills * Excellent verbal and written communication skills * Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively across teams * Must be legally authorized to work in the United States for any employer. This position is not eligible for visa sponsorship **Preferred Qualifications** * Experience with both modern **ASP.NET Core** (.NET 8\+) and legacy **ASP.NET MVC/WebForms** web applications * Experience with .Net testing frameworks and principals, specifically **xUnit** * Experience with **TypeScript (**Angular, React, or similar modern front\-end frameworks) * Experience with **PostgreSQL** and time\-series databases * Experience building cloud\-native applications in **Microsoft Azure** * Familiarity with containerization technologies such as **Docker** and **Kubernetes** * Experience with message\-based and event\-driven architectures * Experience with CI/CD pipelines and DevOps practices * Understanding of networking fundamentals and distributed systems * Experience with industrial automation, SCADA, telemetry, or operational technology environments * Familiarity with power generation, utility operations, energy markets, or regulatory compliance systems * Knowledge of industrial communication protocols such as Modbus, DNP3, OPC\-UA, or ICCP **Why This Role** * Work on **high\-impact systems** that support the electrical grid. You’ll have a direct impact on systems that support real\-time utility operations across the U.S. * Gain deep exposure to **data, infrastructure, APIs, and distributed systems** * Collaborate directly with experienced developers and domain experts * Clear path to **move into a software engineering role** **Equal Opportunity** Trimark is committed to compliance with all applicable laws providing equal employment opportunities. This commitment applies to all people involved in Company operations and prohibits unlawful discrimination by any employee of the Company, including supervisors and coworkers. **Work Authorization** This role is Not Eligible for sponsorship by Trimark, including future sponsorship. Candidates must reside in the United States. **Pay Transparency** Compensation is based on market rate, job level, job related knowledge, skills, experience, education, and certifications. The posted range reflects a realistic estimate of the range of salaries that may be offered for this position. **Candidate Safety** Trimark engages in a structured hiring process during which you will meet with multiple team members. We do not issue offers based on email contact and will not ask for your personal or sensitive information prior to an accepted offer. Communications from our talent team will come from the trimarkassoc.com domains. **Unsolicited Candidate Referrals** Trimark values our strategic partnerships with our agency partners who may supplement our internal recruitment team’s efforts from time to time. To submit candidates for consideration, agency partners must have an executed agreement signed by Trimark’s CEO or President and a job specific requisition. Without such agreements in place, Trimark will not pay a fee to any agency. Unsolicited referrals from any source other than directly from a candidate will be considered Trimark property and will be considered to have been referred by the agency free of any charge or fee. This includes resumes, partial resumes, candidate profiles, and candidate details or information.

jobs.description: **About Turple Communications** Turple Communications delivers specialized Information Technology (IT) and Operational Technology (OT) solutions for ports, container terminals, and industrial facilities across North America. Our team supports mission\-critical systems that enable safe, efficient, and reliable terminal operations, including wireless communications, networking infrastructure, Real\-Time Location Systems (RTLS), industrial IoT devices, and operational technology platforms. We work in complex, fast\-paced environments where technical expertise, problem\-solving, and system reliability are essential. As we continue to expand, we are seeking motivated technical professionals who want to build a career at the intersection of technology and port operations. This role provides the opportunity to receive specialized training and develop expertise in RTLS, industrial wireless systems, and advanced technologies used throughout modern container terminals and logistics facilities. **Position Summary** The successful candidate will support the installation, maintenance, testing, and troubleshooting of RTLS infrastructure, wireless communications systems, networking equipment, sensors, and associated technologies at a major container terminal in Tacoma, Washington. RTLS experience is preferred but not required. We are willing to train the right candidate with a strong technical foundation and demonstrated troubleshooting ability. **Responsibilities** * Install, test, and maintain RTLS and wireless infrastructure * Troubleshoot electrical, electronic, network, and communications systems * Perform field diagnostics and root\-cause analysis * Support equipment commissioning and system upgrades * Work with sensors, antennas, networking equipment, and field devices * Document service activities and technical findings * Follow all site safety and operational procedures * Participate in technical training programs to become an RTLS specialist **Required Qualifications** * Associate's degree in Electrical Engineering Technology, Electronics Technology, or a related technical field, or equivalent hands\-on experience * Minimum 3 years of technical troubleshooting experience * Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills * Comfortable working with computers, software, and technical documentation * Valid driver's license * Ability to work in an active industrial environment **Preferred Qualifications** Experience in one or more of the following: * Electrical Engineering Technology * Electronics Technology * RF Communications * Telecommunications * Industrial Controls * Networking * Wireless Infrastructure * Field Service Engineering * Two\-Way Radio Systems * Military Communications Systems * Marine Electronics The following certifications are a plus: * CompTIA Network\+ * CCNA * FCC GROL * ETA Certifications * Military technical training **Ideal Candidate** The ideal candidate is naturally curious, highly technical, and enjoys solving challenging problems. We are looking for someone who learns quickly, takes ownership of issues, and is interested in building a long\-term career working with advanced RTLS and industrial wireless technologies. **Preferred Experience** * Container terminal, port, maritime, or industrial facility experience is preferred but not required. **Career Growth** This position is designed as a career path into an RTLS Field Engineer role. Successful candidates will receive specialized training and opportunities for advancement as they develop expertise in RTLS, wireless systems, and industrial technology. Pay: $75,000\.00 \- $95,000\.00 per year Benefits: * 401(k) * Dental insurance * Health insurance * Life insurance * Paid time off * Vision insurance Application Question(s): * Do you have at least 3 years of experience troubleshooting technical systems? * Do you have experience working on container terminals, ports, or other industrial facilities? (Preferred but not required) Work Location: In person

jobs.title: Data Engineer I
jobs.description: **Job Details:** **Job Summary** Tyson Foods is seeking a motivated and curious Data Engineer I to join the Inventory Optimization organization. Inventory Optimization brings together Enterprise Asset Management (EAM), Enterprise Inventory Management (EIM), and Maintenance, Repair, and Operations (MRO) into one department focused on improving inventory visibility, data quality, operational efficiency, working capital performance, and enterprise value creation. This is a foundational career\-development position designed for individuals who are eager to learn, solve problems, and build expertise across business, technology, finance, operations, and data management disciplines. Successful candidates are not expected to enter the role with expertise in every area of responsibility. Instead, they will be provided opportunities to learn through hands\-on execution, mentorship, project participation, and exposure to multiple business functions. The Data Engineer I will support data, systems, reporting, governance, and business process activities associated with assets, direct materials, work\-in\-process, finished goods, packaging, spare parts, operational supplies, and related financial information. This role works closely with Operations, Engineering, Maintenance, Supply Chain, Finance, Procurement, and Information Technology teams to ensure enterprise data remains accurate, reliable, and actionable. **Why This Role Exists** Our department believes that great solutions begin by understanding the problem. We encourage team members to ask questions, challenge assumptions, improve processes, automate repetitive work, and connect data to measurable business value. We are building a culture where curiosity, learning, and continuous improvement are just as important as technical capability. This role is ideal for someone who enjoys learning, seeks diverse experiences, and wants to build a career at the intersection of operations, inventory management, engineering, finance, analytics, and technology. \- **Essential Duties and Responsibilities** * Support inventory, asset, and operational data management activities across EAM, EIM, and MRO business processes. * Assist with data validation, reconciliation, correction, and reporting activities. * Maintain master data records in SAP and connected systems according to established standards. * Support business users with reporting, system questions, issue resolution, and application support activities. * Participate in inventory optimization, data quality, governance, analytics, and process improvement initiatives. * Help document business processes, system configurations, standards, and procedures. * Assist with dashboard creation, report development, and analysis that support operational and financial decision\-making. Collaboration and Development * Collaborate with team members and business partners to complete assigned projects, support day\-to\-day operations, and communicate findings effectively. * Learn and apply data, systems, and business knowledge to support inventory optimization initiatives across Finance, Operations, Maintenance, Engineer, and IT * Contribute to a culture of collaboration, continuous learning, and improvement through curiosity, clear communication, and reliable execution. **Requirements:** Education/Certifications: Bachelor’s degree preferred in Supply Chain, Engineering, Information Systems, Computer Science, Data Analytics, Finance, Accounting, or a related field. An equivalent combination of education and relevant work experience will also be considered. Experience: 0–2 years of relevant work experience. College projects will be considered. Computer Skills: Above\-standard computer skills needed. Prior SAP experience is not required, and candidates are not expected to arrive fluent in asset accounting, maintenance operations, or inventory management. A demonstrated willingness to learn SAP S/4HANA and the business processes behind it is essential. Foundational data handling skills such as advanced Excel, introductory SQL, or exposure to Python, with genuine interest in analytics platforms including Power BI, Palantir, or Tableau. AI platforms exposure preferred. jobs.title: Consultant, Software Engineering
jobs.description: **Lead. Innovate. Grow. Make An Impact.** UDig is seeking an Engineering Consultant who is ready to own their work, grow their consulting craft, and deliver real value to clients across a range of industries. This is the core delivery role at UDig — you'll contribute meaningfully to complex engineering engagements, develop independent judgment on technical problems, and begin building the client relationships that define a consulting career. You bring 3–5 years of hands\-on engineering experience and are ready to do more than execute tickets. **Why Top Consultants Choose UDig:** * **Career Growth —** Own your path with UDig Elevate, offering a clear trajectory for career growth and leadership opportunities. * **Consulting with Purpose —** Contribute to real solutions that directly impact clients from your first day. * **Flexibility \& Balance —** Hybrid work environment with opportunities for high\-caliber in\-person collaboration. * **Investment in You —** $1,500 annual training budget, mentorship, and hands\-on learning. * **Competitive Compensation —** Strong salary, performance\-based bonuses, and career progression. * **Comprehensive Benefits —** PTO, parental leave, 401(k) match, health, dental, vision, and more. **What You'll Do:** * Deliver full\-stack engineering solutions as a contributing team member on client engagements — backend, frontend, and data\-integrated systems. * Design, build, and deploy cloud\-native applications following established architectural patterns and engineering standards. * Actively incorporate AI\-assisted development into your daily workflow — using AI tools to accelerate implementation, review, and testing — and share what's working with your team. * Participate in and contribute to code and design reviews, agile ceremonies, and delivery check\-ins with increasing confidence. * Begin engaging directly with client stakeholders: presenting work, asking clarifying questions, and translating technical concepts for non\-technical audiences. * Mentor Associate Consultants through code reviews, pairing, and sharing hard\-won lessons. * Identify and surface opportunities to improve delivery quality or team practices on your engagements. **What You'll Bring:** * 3–5 years of experience in software or data engineering, ideally with exposure to client\-facing or consulting environments. * Technical delivery ownership: you take end\-to\-end accountability for the features and systems you build. * Developing consulting instincts — you think about the client's problem, not just the engineering task. * Strong problem decomposition instincts — you consider edge cases, weigh tradeoffs between approaches, and can explain your technical decisions clearly. * Proficiency in backend API development and at least one frontend framework (e.g., React, Angular, Vue); comfortable working across multiple languages and frameworks. * Working knowledge of cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, or GCP), relational databases, and DevOps fundamentals (CI/CD, containerization). * Comfort navigating both software and data engineering contexts — reading from and writing to data systems, contributing to pipelines, and understanding how data shapes product decisions. * Active fluency with AI development tools — you use them regularly, can evaluate their output critically, and are building your own practices around AI\-assisted delivery. * Experience building software in enterprise team settings, following established standards and contributing to shared codebases. * Strong communication skills with the ability to explain technical work to varied audiences. * Previous consulting or client management experience is preferred. * Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, or a related field — or equivalent demonstrated experience. **Join UDig — Where Consulting Meets Innovation.** UDig is a technology consulting firm dedicated to delivering high\-impact solutions that have driven client success for over 20 years. Our team collaborates directly with clients, taking a consultative approach to turning complex challenges into successful projects that deliver business value. By harnessing expertise, innovation, and connections, we achieve extraordinary outcomes across multiple verticals. At UDig, we're more than consultants — we're problem solvers, mentors, and innovators. If you're ready to dig into your first career chapter and build alongside people who take the craft seriously, let's talk. \#LI\-HYBRID \#LI\-JS1
