jobs.title: Communications Engineer I, II
jobs.description: We are looking for talented individuals who are passionate about making an impact in the company and the community. **Apply now** and become part of the dynamic energy industry! Help power the future of critical infrastructure. Join our team and play a key role in designing, building, and securing the communications networks that support electric transmission, distribution, substations, and smart grid technologies across our service territory. **What You Will Do** * Design, engineer, and support telecommunications and operational network solutions that enable reliable electric system operations. * Develop and maintain fiber optic, microwave, RF, wireless, and IP/MPLS communications networks for substations, control centers, and field operations. * Support SCADA, AMI, grid automation, and tele\-protection systems by ensuring secure and dependable data communications. * Lead or assist with telecom and operational network projects, including planning, budgeting, design, implementation, and vendor coordination. * Monitor network performance, troubleshoot issues, implement upgrades, and maintain cybersecurity and regulatory compliance standards. Create engineering designs, technical documentation, network standards, and project specifications while collaborating with cross\-functional utility and IT teams. * **What You Bring** * Bachelor's degree in Engineering from an ABET\-accredited institution; Electrical Engineering, Telecommunications Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field preferred. * Knowledge of networking fundamentals including switching, routing, VLANs, OSPF, BGP, STP, WAN technologies, and IP/MPLS networks. * Experience or interest in critical infrastructure communications systems, including fiber optics, RF, microwave, wireless, and operational technology networks. * Understanding of network security principles, firewalls, cybersecurity frameworks, and industrial protocols such as DNP3 and IEC 61850\. * Strong analytical, problem\-solving, communication, and project coordination skills with the ability to work effectively across teams. For Engineer II consideration, relevant utility, industrial networking, or telecommunications experience and industry certifications such as CCNA, CCNP, or Nokia NRS are preferred. * This is an exciting opportunity to help design and maintain the communications infrastructure that keeps the electric grid safe, secure, and reliable while supporting the modernization of critical utility operations. **Position Description:** Responsible for the planning, engineering, design, implementation, management and administration of mission critical communications infrastructure that encompasses the Unisource Transmission and Distribution Telecommunications system and operational network infrastructure for Unisource’s substation LAN/WAN. This includes networks for SCADA, Data Center interconnection, AMI, services for substation corporate and security networks, and smart grid systems, with a focus on reliability, security, and performance. The ideal candidate will have experience in network and security architecture, RF system design, communications facility planning and design, and hands\-on expertise in configuring and managing switches, routers, and firewalls and advance protocols such as IP/MPLS—particularly Nokia service routers and Siemens/Ruggedcom industrial networking devices. Create engineered designs and documentation for new and existing communications facilities and infrastructure for substation projects and other company wide communication application needs. The creation and administration of Ethernet and other networks for multiple Wide Area Networks. Perform engineering studies and evaluate alternative designs or processes related to communication equipment and networks. Develop project scopes of work that specify material and estimate time and material costs required for assigned projects and assist in the evaluation of suppliers and products. Act as a project engineer for communications projects as well as train less experienced personnel. **Position\-Related Responsibilities:** * Design network and telecommunications solutions for Unisource and its subsidiaries with an emphasis on integration between companies and flexible solutions that are cost\-effective and scalable for effective control, monitoring, protection and maintenance of electrical generation, high voltage transmission, and distribution systems. As well as provide Corporate Voice and Data Transport Communications Systems. * Wide range of communications and computer networking experience required to manage networks and intelligent electronic devices utilizing different telecommunications equipment. Specific knowledge about Ethernet networks and Wide Area Network (WAN) skills to compliment a telecommunications knowledgebase. * Lead or support telecom and operational network related capital projects, including planning, budgeting, and execution. * Engineer, design, deploy, and maintain fiber  proper operation and/or maintenance of equipment. Provide technical assistance to the Electronics Construction \& Maintenance Section. * Assist in divisional O \& M and Capital Budget preparation and adherence. * Internal and external representation of section responsibilities, requirements, methods and procedures. * Initiate job tasks (work orders) and track expenditures as may be required to complete Capital Budget project assignments. Lead formal and informal meetings concerning assigned projects and can communicate effectively with all levels of personnel both in the office and field crews. * Collaborate with substations engineering, protection, metering \& control, IT, and operations teams to ensure alignment of telecom and operational network infrastructure with utility needs * Develop and provide detailed design specifications for bidding and purchase requirements. * Evaluate and recommend equipment and/or components available to meet project requirements or improve existing installations in a way which optimizes cost and reliability. * Ensure compliance with NERC CIP, IEEE, FCC, and other regulatory standards. This position may provide services to affiliates of the Company subject to the UNS Energy Code of Conduct and the related Policies and Procedures. * **Knowledge, Skills \& Abilities:** (Equivalent combination of education and experience will be considered.) * Strong knowledge of switching and routing protocols (e.g., OSPF, BGP, STP, VLANs) and IP/MPLS technologies. * Experience with network monitoring tools and cybersecurity frameworks for critical infrastructure. * Knowledge of grid modernization initiatives and utility automation systems. * Experience with communications facility design including structural, electrical, and environmental considerations. Fiber optic systems, microwave radio, and wireless technologies. * Proficiency in RF system design and deployment, including propagation modeling and site planning. * Strong understanding of SCADA protocols (e.g., DNP3, IEC 61850\), IP networking, and cybersecurity principles. * Experience in developing and implementing security architecture for telecom and operational networks, including firewall design, configuration, and ongoing management. * FCC license management. Excellent problem\-solving, communication, and project management skills. * **Level I Description:** * Will have primary responsibility for small modification or revision projects. * Will assist more experienced personnel in large projects. * Will assist in the review and revision of material and design standards. Requires close supervision and detailed instruction for tasks and expected results. * Minimum Qualifications: * BS degree in Engineering, from an ABET accredited institution, with less than two (2\) years professional experience in an engineering role. * Effective written and oral communication skills required and a willingness to learn in a rapidly changing environment. Enterprise networking aptitude is required. * Preferred Qualifications Bachelor’s degree in electrical engineering, telecommunications Engineering, Management Information Systems, Computer Science or related discipline is preferred. * **Level II Description:** * Will have primary responsibility for medium sized projects and act as the project engineer/manager. * May be assigned to perform technical studies as needed. * May have several projects assigned at the same time. * Requires close supervision on new aspects of assignments. Assists more experienced personnel on projects and deals with day\-to\-day support. * Minimum Qualifications: * Requires two or more years of experience as an Engineer I or a Master’s degree or qualifications for Engineer I plus a industrial/operational network background. Industry certifications, CCNA, CCNP, NRS I/II or equivalent. * Shall have strong analytical capabilities. * Requires self\-direction and the ability to work with vendors on creating statements of work and completing that work.

jobs.title: Data Engineer
jobs.description: **Job Overview:** As a Data Engineer at US Tiger Securities, you will support the company’s data platform and work with cross\-functional teams to deliver reliable data pipelines, reports, data services, and interface applications for business users. The ideal candidate has strong SQL and Python skills, hands\-on experience with data pipelines and orchestration, and the ability to debug data issues across database, streaming, batch processing, and BI systems. **Key Responsibilities:** * Build and maintain reliable batch and near\-real\-time data pipelines using Python, SQL, Airflow, Kafka, Flink, Spark, Hive, Doris, DataSight, or similar technologies. * Identify recurring reporting or data service needs and implement reusable internal solutions. Experience with Python, Java, Django, and JavaScript debugging is helpful. * Develop and maintain data interfaces for internal and external systems using RESTful APIs and message queue technologies such as Apache Kafka or IBM MQ. * Help troubleshoot, monitor, and improve data platform components across TiDB, Kafka, Flink, Hive, Spark, Doris, DataSight, and AWS services such as EC2, Docker, RDS, Redshift, and S3\. **Qualifications:** **Required:** * Bachelor’s degree in Data Engineering, Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field. * Minimum of 3 years of experience in a data engineering or data platform role. * Strong SQL skills and hands\-on experience with relational databases or analytical databases. * Proficiency in Python; Java experience is a plus. * Experience building or maintaining ETL/ELT data pipelines. * Experience with Apache Airflow or another workflow orchestration tool. * Ability to debug production data issues across logs, SQL queries, pipeline jobs, and application interfaces. * Proficiency in Mandarin Chinese is required, as the role will involve collaboration with Mandarin\-speaking engineering and business stakeholders. **Preferred:** * Experience with TiDB, Kafka, Flink, Hive, Spark, Doris, and DataSight, or a comparable real\-time/batch data warehouse architecture. * Experience with Kafka, CDC, streaming data processing, and IBM MQ is a big plus. * Experience with Spark/PySpark, Flink/PyFlink, Hive, or Doris performance tuning and data modeling. * Experience with Django, RESTful APIs, JavaScript, and web debugging tools. * Experience with AWS and related cloud technologies, including EC2, Docker, RDS, Redshift, and S3\. **Benefits:** * 401(k) * 401(k) matching * Dental insurance * Health insurance * Paid time off Job Types: Full\-time, Internship Pay: $80,000\.00 \- $110,000\.00 per year Education: * Bachelor's (Required) Experience: * Python: 1 year (Required) * SQL: 1 year (Required) Language: * Mandarin (Required) Location: * New York, NY 10022 (Required) Ability to Commute: * New York, NY 10022 (Required) Work Location: Hybrid remote in New York, NY 10022

jobs.title: Software Engineer I - Claims
jobs.description: **Location** Phoenix, Arizona **Job ID** R0120181 **Date posted** 09/21/2026 **Why USAA?** At USAA, our mission is to empower our members to achieve financial security through highly competitive products, exceptional service and trusted advice. We seek to be the \#1 choice for the military community and their families. Embrace a fulfilling career at USAA, where our core values – honesty, integrity, loyalty and service – define how we treat each other and our members. Be part of what truly makes us special and impactful. We are proud to support active\-duty military spouses. USAA roles may offer remote or hybrid flexibility for active\-duty military spouses consistent with applicable policy and business needs. **The Opportunity** As a dedicated **Software Engineer I \- Claims** you will provide support to the Enterprise through delivering best in class technology solutions that support and enhance USAA’s core claims applications. You will engage in all phases of the software systems and application development lifecycle which include gathering and analyzing requirements, designing, testing, documenting, and implementing software, and responding to outages. We offer a flexible work environment that requires an individual to be **in the office 4 days per week.** This position can be based in Phoenix, AZ. Relocation assistance is **not** available for this position. **What you'll do:** * Designs, develops, codes, and tests complex technical solutions. * Investigates and resolves complex application and system technical problems and production issues through troubleshooting techniques. * Continually improves operations by conducting complex systems analysis and recommending changes in policies and procedures. * Prepares and installs complex solutions by determining and designing system specifications, standards, and programming. * Follows the software development lifecycle. * Participates in design reviews and learns key system design principles. * Mentors junior engineers and may begin mentoring peer engineers; Review teammates' code. * Ensures risks associated with business activities are effectively identified, measured, monitored, and controlled in accordance with risk and compliance policies and procedures. **What you have:** * Bachelor's degree; OR 4 years of relevant education and/or experience. * 4 years of software development experience demonstrating depth of technical understanding within a specific discipline(s)/technology(s). * 2 years of experience delivering technology solutions in all phases of the software systems and application development lifecycle to include leading code/design reviews. * Hands\-on software development experience with Java and Spring Boot. * Basic Understanding of one or more of the following: Java, Swift, Objective\-C, Cobol, JavaScript, Kotlin, C\+\+, HTML, CSS, SQL, Go, and Python. * Developing level of business acumen in the areas of business operations, risk management, industry practices and emerging trends. * Experience supporting efforts to address production issues through troubleshooting applications and systems. * Experience articulating technical challenges and solutions. * Basic understanding of cloud technologies and tools. **What sets you apart:** * Experience deploying Cloud applications with AWS. * 2\+ years in REST frameworks with focus on API development * 2\+ years in AGILE methodology * 1\+ years experience working with JavaScript * 2\+ years experience integrating with backend services like JMS, J2C, ORM frameworks (Hibernate, JPA, JDO, etc), JDBC. * Experience building APIs with Spring Boot. * Experience with event driven frameworks such as Kafka, RabbitMQ, IBM MQ. * Ability to implement container based APIs using a container frameworks OpenShift, Docker, or Kubernetes. * Relational Database design and optimization with Oracle DB2, MySQL, Postgress. * Familiar with Gradle, GIT, GitHUB, GITLab, etc. around continuous integration and continuous delivery infrastructure. * Experience testing in REST services. * Experience in design and develop automated test framework. * US military experience gained through military service or gained as a military spouse / domestic partner. **Compensation range:** The salary range for this position is: $93,770 \- $179,240\. **USAA does not provide visa sponsorship for this role. Please do not apply for this role if at any time (now or in the future) you will need immigration support (i.e., H\-1B, TN, STEM OPT Training Plans, etc.).** **Compensation:** USAA has an effective process for assessing market data and establishing ranges to ensure we remain competitive. You are paid within the salary range based on your experience and market data of the position. The actual salary for this role may vary by location. Employees may be eligible for pay incentives based on overall corporate and individual performance and at the discretion of the USAA Board of Directors. The above description reflects the details considered necessary to describe the principal functions of the job and should not be construed as a detailed description of all the work requirements that may be performed in the job. **Benefits:** At USAA our employees enjoy best\-in\-class benefits to support their physical, financial, and emotional wellness. These benefits include comprehensive medical, dental and vision plans, 401(k), pension, life insurance, parental benefits, adoption assistance, paid time off program with paid holidays plus 16 paid volunteer hours, and various wellness programs. Additionally, our career path planning and continuing education assists employees with their professional goals. For more details on our outstanding benefits, visit our benefits page on USAAjobs.com. *Applications for this position are accepted on an ongoing basis, this posting will remain open until the position is filled. Thus, interested candidates are encouraged to apply the same day they view this posting.* *USAA is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or status as a protected veteran.*

jobs.description: Who We Are: *At UES, we’re a team of more than 4,000 engineers, scientists, geologists, inspectors, technicians, and drillers united by a shared purpose—to make a meaningful impact in the communities we serve. jobs.title: Software Engineer II, Marketplace Optimzation
jobs.description: **About Upstart** At Upstart, we’re united by a mission that matters: to radically reduce the cost and complexity of borrowing for all Americans. Every day, we bring creativity, experimentation, and advanced AI to reshape access to credit, helping millions move forward financially with clarity and confidence. As the leading AI lending marketplace, we partner with banks and credit unions to expand access to affordable credit through technology that’s both radically intelligent and deeply human. Our platform runs over one million predictions per borrower using more than 3,000 signals, powering smarter, fairer decisions for millions of customers. But the numbers only hint at the impact. Every idea, every voice, and every contribution moves us closer to a world where credit never stands between people and their financial progress. We’re proudly digital\-first, giving most Upstarters the flexibility to do their best work from wherever they thrive, alongside teammates across 80\+ cities in the US and Canada. Digital\-first doesn’t mean distant. We’re intentional about in\-person connection through team onsites, planning sessions, and moments that spark creativity and trust. And whether you choose to work primarily from home or collaborate in\-person from one of our offices in Columbus, Austin, the Bay Area, or New York City (opening Summer 2026\), you’ll have the support to work in the way that works best for you. If you’re energized by tackling meaningful problems, excited to innovate with purpose, and motivated by work that truly matters, we’d love to hear from you. **The Team** ------------ Upstart’s **Marketplace Optimization** team is part of Capital Marketplace Engineering and is responsible for optimizing Upstart’s two\-sided capital marketplace. Across Matching \& Offer Selection and Monetization, the team builds the real\-time decisioning systems, experimentation capabilities, and marketplace services that help match borrowers with sources of capital while improving marketplace efficiency, investor utilization, and business outcomes. As a **Software Engineer II**, you will help design and build systems that enable faster experimentation, more sophisticated marketplace decisioning, and new monetization capabilities. You’ll work on business\-critical systems where engineering decisions can directly influence revenue, profitability, capital utilization, borrower experience, and the scalability of Upstart’s marketplace. **How you’ll make an impact** ----------------------------- * Design, build, and operate scalable backend systems that power real\-time marketplace decisioning, matching, offer selection, and monetization. * Build flexible platform capabilities that enable experimentation with allocation strategies, marketplace economics, and new monetization approaches while maintaining reliability and scalability. * Develop reliable, observable services that balance availability, latency, correctness, and operational simplicity across complex distributed systems. * Partner with Product, Machine Learning, Pricing Engineering, Data Science, Capital Markets, and Lending Partnerships to translate marketplace needs into effective technical solutions. * Make architectural decisions that simplify systems, reduce coupling across marketplace and adjacent platforms, and create reusable capabilities that support future marketplace innovation. * Use Generative AI tools thoughtfully throughout the development lifecycle to accelerate implementation, testing, debugging, documentation, and learning while maintaining ownership of technical decisions, security, code quality, and correctness. engineering experience**. * Experience designing, building, and operating scalable backend or distributed systems in production. * Experience developing production services using one or more modern backend programming languages. * Experience building and operating business\-critical systems with demonstrated use of testing, monitoring, incident response, and root cause analysis. * Experience designing production systems where reliability, availability, observability, and correctness are critical. **Preferred Qualifications** ---------------------------- * Experience with marketplaces, financial systems, recommendation or matching engines, optimization systems, or experimentation platforms. * Knowledge of low\-latency, high\-throughput distributed system design and architecture. * Experience partnering with machine learning or data science teams to integrate models or data\-driven decisioning into production systems. * Experience with Ruby, Ruby on Rails, Python, or Kotlin. * Ability to navigate ambiguous technical and business problems, evaluate tradeoffs, and collaborate across engineering, product, and business teams. **Position location** This role  within the below jobs.description: **Company Description** VERSANT (Nasdaq: VSNT) is an industry\-changing media and entertainment business and home to trusted brands that shape culture, inform audiences, and build lasting connections. It operates across four core markets: political news and opinion, business news and personal finance, golf, and sports and genre entertainment. These markets are served through a powerful portfolio of iconic and innovative brands, including CNBC, MS NOW, USA Network, Golf Channel, Oxygen, E!, SYFY, and Versant's sports division USA Sports, along with complementary digital assets including Fandango, Rotten Tomatoes, GolfNow and GolfPass. **Job Description** We are seeking a hands\-on Data Product Engineering Lead to lead engineering resources to deliver trusted, scalable, and reusable data products from source systems through the Silver layer of our enterprise data platform. This role is accountable for turning product and business needs into reliable, governed data capabilities: ingesting source data, applying standardized transformations, implementing data\-quality controls, and publishing documented Silver\-layer datasets ready for downstream analytics, reporting, AI, and operational use. The Data Product Engineering Lead works closely with Solution Architects, Data Modelers, Product Managers, domain experts, platform teams, and governance partners to ensure each data and digital product is built on a scalable data foundation. **What you will do** **Lead delivery of source\-to\-Silver data products** * Lead and develop a distributed/offshore team of Data Engineers responsible for delivery from source ingestion through curated Silver\-layer data products. * Translate product roadmaps and requirements into actionable engineering plans, milestones, estimates, dependencies, and delivery commitments. * Design and oversee ingestion, transformation, standardization, orchestration, and publication of data from operational, SaaS, file, streaming, API, and partner sources. * Ensure Silver\-layer data products are validated, standardized, documented, reusable, performant, secure, and ready for Gold\-layer analytics and AI consumption. * Establish repeatable patterns for batch, incremental, change\-data\-capture, and event\-driven processing. **Build scalable engineering foundations** * Implement reusable data\-engineering frameworks, templates, libraries, and pipeline patterns that reduce repeated effort across products and domains. * Apply modern engineering practices, including source control, peer review, automated testing, CI/CD, observability, release management, and incident remediation. * Define and maintain standards for naming, partitioning, schema evolution, error handling, replay/recovery, performance, cost management, and documentation. * Partner with the Data Platform team to use approved workspace, compute, storage, security, and deployment patterns. * Identify technical debt and lead pragmatic improvements that increase delivery speed, reliability, and maintainability. **Partner across architecture, modeling, and product** * Work with Data Modelers to implement canonical entities, conformed dimensions, data contracts, source\-to\-target mappings, and enterprise modeling standards. * Work with Product Managers and domain leaders to clarify intended outcomes, source\-system realities, priority use cases, and acceptance criteria. * Coordinate dependencies with source\-system owners, platform teams, analytics teams, and external partners. **Ensure trusted, governed data** * Establish data profiling, reconciliation, quality testing, freshness monitoring, lineage, and alerting for every delivered data product. * Ensure source\-to\-Silver traceability, including authoritative source identification, transformation logic, ownership, metadata, and data\-quality expectations. * Implement appropriate access controls, sensitive\-data classification, masking, retention, and regional/data\-residency requirements. * Drive resolution of data defects, schema changes, pipeline failures, and quality issues through clear ownership and service\-level expectations. **Lead the team and delivery operating model** * Set clear priorities, technical direction, delivery expectations, and quality standards for the engineering team. * Coach engineers in data engineering, cloud development, testing, observability, and product\-oriented delivery practices. * Create a healthy onshore/offshore delivery model with defined handoffs, overlap hours, documentation standards, ceremonies, and escalation paths. * Communicate delivery progress, risks, tradeoffs, and decisions clearly to technical and business stakeholders. * Build a culture of ownership, continuous improvement, and reliable execution. **What success looks like** * Product teams receive reliable Silver\-layer data products on predictable timelines. * New sources and data products are delivered faster because teams reuse proven patterns and shared components. * Silver\-layer data is trusted: complete, reconciled, monitored, documented, and traceable to authoritative sources. * Data model and architecture standards are implemented consistently across domains. * Pipeline failures, data\-quality defects, and late\-breaking schema changes are detected early and resolved quickly. * The distributed engineering team operates as one accountable delivery unit rather than as a ticket\-fulfillment function. **Qualifications** **Required qualifications** * 8\+ years of data engineering, software engineering, or data\-platform experience, including 2\+ years leading engineers, technical workstreams, or large\-scale delivery. * Demonstrated experience designing and delivering enterprise\-scale ingestion and transformation pipelines. * Strong hands\-on expertise in SQL, Python, Spark/PySpark, and modern ELT/ETL patterns. * Experience with Databricks, Delta Lake, or a comparable lakehouse platform; experience with cloud storage, orchestration, and CI/CD. * Strong understanding of Bronze/Silver/Gold or equivalent layered data\-platform patterns. * Experience implementing data quality, observability, lineage, metadata, and production support practices. * Proven ability to partner with architects, data modelers, product leaders, and domain stakeholders. * Experience leading distributed teams and creating effective delivery practices across time zones. * Strong communication skills and the ability to explain technical choices, risks, and tradeoffs to non\-technical stakeholders. **Preferred qualifications** * Experience with Unity Catalog or comparable governance, catalog, and access\-control capabilities. * Experience with data contracts, schema evolution, change data capture, APIs, event streaming, and large\-volume data processing. * Experience supporting multiple data domains, global data products, or regional data\-residency requirements. * Experience with infrastructure\-as\-code, DataOps, and automated environment provisioning. * Experience in a regulated, high\-scale, or operationally sensitive environment. **Additional Information** You can submit your request to candidateaccessibility@versantmedia.com. VERSANT Media is committed to fair and equitable compensation practices. This role is accountable for turning product and business needs into reliable, governed data capabilities: ingesting source data, applying standardized transformations, implementing data\-quality controls, and publishing documented Silver\-layer datasets ready for downstream analytics, reporting, AI, and operational use. product is built on a scalable data foundation. **What you will do** **Lead delivery of source\-to\-Silver data products** * Lead and develop a distributed/offshore team of Data Engineers responsible for delivery from source ingestion through curated Silver\-layer data products. * Translate product roadmaps and requirements into actionable engineering plans, milestones, estimates, dependencies, and delivery commitments. * Design and oversee ingestion, transformation, standardization, orchestration, and publication of data from operational, SaaS, file, streaming, API, and partner sources. * Ensure Silver\-layer data products are validated, standardized, documented, reusable, performant, secure, and ready for Gold\-layer analytics and AI consumption. * Establish repeatable patterns for batch, incremental, change\-data\-capture, and event\-driven processing. **Build scalable engineering foundations** * Implement reusable data\-engineering frameworks, templates, libraries, and pipeline patterns that reduce repeated effort across products and domains. * Apply modern engineering practices, including source control, peer review, automated testing, CI/CD, observability, release management, and incident remediation. * Define and maintain standards for naming, partitioning, schema evolution, error handling, replay/recovery, performance, cost management, and documentation. * Partner with the Data Platform team to use approved workspace, compute, storage, security, and deployment patterns. * Identify technical debt and lead pragmatic improvements that increase delivery speed, reliability, and maintainability. **Partner across architecture, modeling, and product** * Work with Data Modelers to implement canonical entities, conformed dimensions, data contracts, source\-to\-target mappings, and enterprise modeling standards. * Work with Product Managers and domain leaders to clarify intended outcomes, source\-system realities, priority use cases, and patterns and shared components. * Silver\-layer data is trusted: complete, reconciled, monitored, documented, and traceable to authoritative sources. * Data model and architecture standards are implemented consistently across domains. * Pipeline failures, data\-quality defects, and late\-breaking schema changes are detected early and resolved quickly. * The distributed engineering team transformation pipelines. * Strong hands\-on expertise in SQL, Python, Spark/PySpark, and modern ELT/ETL patterns. * Experience with Databricks, Delta Lake, or a comparable lakehouse platform; jobs.title: IT Field Technician & End User Support Specialist (Manufacturing Operations)
jobs.description: **Position Summary** The IT Field Technician \& Support Specialist is responsible for providing hands\-on technical support for a manufacturing facility and its associated office environments. This role serves as the primary on\-site resource for endpoint support, basic infrastructure maintenance, troubleshooting, and IT project execution. The technician works closely with plant personnel, office staff, engineering teams, and IT administrators from multiple organizations within a joint\-venture environment. Success in this position requires strong customer service skills, a solid understanding of desktop support and networking fundamentals, and the ability to collaborate effectively with internal and external IT teams. The technician will support end\-user computing devices, printers, network\-connected equipment, and auxiliary systems that are critical to daily manufacturing and business operations. **Key Responsibilities** **Endpoint Support \& User Services** * Provide on\-site support for desktops, laptops, thin clients, tablets, and peripheral devices. * Install, configure, upgrade, and troubleshoot Windows operating systems and business applications. * Diagnose and resolve hardware and software issues affecting end users. * Support Microsoft Office, collaboration tools, browsers, security software, and manufacturing\-related applications. * Deploy, image, and configure endpoint devices according to company standards. * Perform hardware replacements and upgrades including memory, storage devices, monitors, docking stations, and accessories. * Maintain accurate inventory records for IT assets and equipment. * Document support activities, resolutions, and system changes within ticketing systems. **Printer \& Peripheral Support** * Troubleshoot network and locally connected printers. * Replace consumables and coordinate vendor support when necessary. * Configure printer queues and network printer deployments. * Support barcode printers, label printers, scanners, and other manufacturing\-related peripherals. **Network Support** * Perform basic network troubleshooting involving connectivity, switching, wireless access, DNS, DHCP, and routing issues. * Assist with physical installation and maintenance of network equipment including switches, routers, firewalls, access points, and cabling. * Understand network topologies and identify potential connectivity issues through systematic troubleshooting. * Coordinate with network engineering teams to diagnose and remediate infrastructure issues. * Verify physical layer connectivity and perform cable tracing and labeling activities. **Server \& Infrastructure Support** * Perform routine server maintenance activities under the guidance of senior administrators. * Support operating system patching and maintenance schedules. * Monitor infrastructure health and escalate issues when appropriate. * Assist with backup verification and basic recovery procedures. * Participate in hardware replacements and physical server maintenance within data centers or server rooms. **Active Directory \& Account Administration** * Create, modify, disable, and maintain user accounts and security groups. * Assist with password resets and account troubleshooting. * Maintain organizational unit structures and permissions following established procedures. * Support identity and access management processes while adhering to security policies. **Security \& Compliance** * Apply operating system and application patches to endpoints and infrastructure systems. * Ensure devices comply with security standards and corporate policies. * Support antivirus, endpoint protection, and vulnerability remediation initiatives. * Assist with security audits and inventory reviews. **Projects \& Continuous Improvement** * Participate in IT infrastructure and business technology projects. * Support facility expansions, equipment deployments, and workstation relocations. * Assist with hardware refresh initiatives and technology rollouts. * Contribute ideas for process improvements and operational efficiencies. * Perform additional technical duties as assigned. **Joint\-Venture Collaboration Responsibilities** This position operates within a joint\-venture environment where multiple organizations share responsibility for systems, infrastructure, and operational technologies. The successful candidate will: * Collaborate professionally with engineers, administrators, vendors, and support teams from partner organizations. * Follow established governance, communication, and escalation processes across multiple companies. * Coordinate troubleshooting efforts that involve shared systems and infrastructure. * Build strong working relationships with stakeholders from diverse technical backgrounds. * Balance local site requirements with corporate and partner\-company standards. * Demonstrate flexibility and diplomacy while working across organizational boundaries. **Required Qualifications** **Education** * Associate degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Networking, or a related field preferred. * Equivalent combination of education, certification, and experience will be considered. **Experience** * Minimum of **1 year of experience** in an IT support, help desk, desktop support, field technician, or related technical role. * Experience supporting Windows\-based environments preferred. * Experience in manufacturing, industrial, or production environments is beneficial but not required. **Technical Knowledge** Candidates should possess working knowledge of: * Microsoft Windows operating systems * Desktop and laptop hardware troubleshooting * Software installation and support * Network printers and peripherals * TCP/IP networking fundamentals * DNS and DHCP concepts * Active Directory administration * Endpoint patching and maintenance * Microsoft Office applications * Ticketing and asset management systems **Networking Knowledge** Candidates must understand: * Basic switching and routing concepts * Network cabling standards * Physical installation and connectivity of switches, routers, firewalls, and wireless access points * Network troubleshooting methodologies * VLAN concepts and network segmentation fundamentals * Use of basic networking tools and diagnostics **Desired Skills \& Certifications** Preferred but not required: * CompTIA A\+ * CompTIA Network\+ * Microsoft certifications * Experience with imaging and endpoint deployment tools * Experience with virtualization technologies * Familiarity with manufacturing technology environments **Key Competencies** * Strong troubleshooting and analytical skills * Customer\-focused service mindset * Excellent verbal and written communication abilities * Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast\-paced environment * Strong organizational and documentation skills * Ability to work independently with minimal supervision * Team\-oriented approach and willingness to collaborate across organizations * Professionalism when interacting with production personnel, engineers, management, and external partners **Working Environment** * Primarily on\-site within a manufacturing facility and office environment. * Frequent movement throughout production, warehouse, office, and IT infrastructure areas. * Occasional lifting and installation of IT equipment up to 50 lbs. * Participation in after\-hours maintenance, upgrades, or project activities as required. * Exposure to manufacturing environments requiring adherence to plant safety procedures and PPE requirements. **Job Title** **IT Field Technician \& End User Support Specialist (Manufacturing Operations)** This role is ideal for an early\-career IT professional seeking broad exposure to endpoint support, networking, infrastructure, manufacturing technology, and cross\-company collaboration within a dynamic industrial environment. Pay: $40,000\.00 \- $55,000\.00 per year People with a criminal record are encouraged to apply Work Location: In person

jobs.title: Senior Manager, Data & AI Review Enablement

In this role, you will drive Visa’s Responsible Data Use program – evaluating cutting\-edge AI and data initiatives – to safeguard trust and unlock business value. You will be at the forefront of Visa’s innovation, guiding how new AI solutions roll out globally while ensuring they meet our obligations to clients, regulators, and consumers. This position offers a unique opportunity to lead cross\-functional collaborations, take ownership of mission\-critical processes, and shape policies that govern data and AI use at Visa. **Key Responsibilities** * Drive and enhance the Data \& AI Use Case Assessment process – a key engine of Visa’s innovation – enabling calculated, transparent risk\-taking for faster business growth. Coordinate with internal stakeholders to propose well\-founded policy updates or alternative solutions, backing your recommendations with solid facts and analysis to drive leadership discussions. * Provide thought leadership in Data \& AI: Develop and share informed perspectives on emerging data and AI domains, including responsible AI, generative AI, data governance, privacy\-enhancing technologies, and evolving regulatory expectations. Your content will showcase progress, highlight success stories, and reinforce the importance of responsible AI and data use. * Communicate progress and insights: Prepare compelling materials (presentations, reports, dashboards) to socialize Data \& AI Use Policy developments and share insights from Data Use Case Assessment reviews with stakeholders at all levels. Ensure transparency, buy\-in, an handle multiple priorities without sacrificing quality. * Strong communication \& stakeholder management: Excellent interpersonal skills with a proactive communication style. You’re able to engage and influence cross\-functional teams – from engineers to lawyers to business leaders – ensuring everyone understands and aligns with data policy objectives. * Clarity in complexity: Ability to interpret complex technical documents (policies, standards, procedures) and distill them into clear, concise guidance for non\-technical audiences. You can translate “legal/technical speak” into actionable business terms that others readily grasp. * Thrives under pressure: Energized by challenges, you excel in high\-pressure, high\-volume settings – delivering quality results even when working with demanding stakeholders and tight deadlines. * Team leadership and collaboration: A true team player who is highly collaborative and diplomatic. You build strong relationships across diverse teams and lead by example, fostering an environment of trust and high performance. * Meticulous and quality\-focused: Keep attention to detail in everything you do, while still keeping sight of the bigger picture. You take pride in producing work that is accurate and of high quality. * Exceptional problem solver: Superior analytical thinking with demonstrated intellectual rigor. When faced with a complex or ambiguous problem, you approach it systematically and resourcefully, finding innovative solutions. * Self\-motivated with ownership mentality: An independent self\-starter who takes full ownership of your responsibilities. You have a strong sense of accountability for your deliverables and drive initiatives forward with minimal oversight. * Adaptable and flexible: Comfortable working in a fast\-changing, often ambiguous environment. You adapt quickly to new information and changing circumstances, staying effective and positive amid uncertainty. * Open and innovative mindset: Open\-minded and receptive to feedback and new ideas. You actively listen to others’ perspectives and are willing to change approach when current processes aren’t sufficient, always seeking better solutions. * Enthusiastic \& results\-driven: Bring a high level of enthusiasm to your work and maintain an unrelenting focus on results. You’re driven to exceed targets and set new standards, motivated by the impact you create. * Global mindset: Excited to work in a multicultural, global environment. You value diverse perspectives and are respectful and mindful of cultural differences when collaborating with colleagues around the world. **Information for US Applicants** For roles located in the US, the estimated salary range for this position is $180,600\.00 to $ 289,300\.00 USD per year, which may include potential sales incentive payments (if applicable). jobs.description: As **IT Infrastructure Specialist** you will lead the planning, implementation, and support of IT infrastructure solutions from concept to deployment. Run complex operational/technical projects. Manage enterprise IT systems, including cloud computing, servers, and storage, ensuring alignment with company\-defined standards. You will provide proof\-of\-concept (POC) evaluations and expert guidance on implementing secure, scalable, and high\-performance IT infrastructure solutions. The successful candidate will be managing infrastructure\-related projects while supporting the operational needs of a data center environment. This role is located with our client in the Greenville, SC area. This position requires occasional after\-hours, weekend, and holiday work. **Responsibilities:** * Serve as a subject matter expert (SME) for IT infrastructure systems, including cloud platforms (AWS, Azure), storage solutions (SAN, NAS), and cybersecurity frameworks (firewalls, intrusion prevention, encryption). * Deploy, configure, and maintain IT infrastructure components, such as servers, storage, virtualization platforms, and security tools. * Collaborate with external providers for the deployment and support of IT infrastructure services. * Ensure high availability of systems by implementing redundancy, backup strategies, and disaster recovery solutions. * Optimize IT infrastructure performance through monitoring, capacity planning, and proactive issue resolution. * Adhere to compliance and audit requirements by enforcing security policies, implementing access controls, and supporting regulatory standards. * Manage ITIL processes, including change management, incident response, and configuration management, to ensure service stability and operational efficiency. * Document IT infrastructure design, configurations, and best practices to enhance knowledge sharing and continuous improvement. * Support infrastructure lifecycle management, including upgrades, patching, and decommissioning, to maintain system reliability and security. * Collaborate with global IT teams to standardize processes, align on best practices, and support cross\-functional IT initiatives. * Provide technical leadership and mentorship to junior engineers, ensuring adherence to IT standards and driving skill development. * Research and evaluate emerging technologies, including automation, cloud native services, and AI\-driven IT operations, to drive innovation and efficiency. * Communicate IT infrastructure strategies and solutions to technical and non technical stakeholders, ensuring clarity in decision\-making processes. * Runs complex projects ensuring they are completed on time and within budget with only general direction from management. * Perform other duties as assigned by management. **Requirements:** * BS/BA in Information Technology OR AA/AS degree with 2 years of professional experience OR 4 years of equivalent IT experience. * 5\+ years of experience in IT infrastructure engineering, specializing in cloud services, storage, or enterprise IT systems. * 5\+ years of experience managing enterprise IT infrastructure, including servers, storage, virtualization, and security. * Strong experience in **fiber optic and copper cabling installation, testing, quality assurance, and infrastructure planning** * 3\+ years of experience in IT project management * 3\+ years of experience demonstrating strong communication skills in IT environments. * 3\+ years of junior leadership experience managing IT projects. * Advanced to expert knowledge of fiber \& copper cabling, pathways, racks, and IT power implementations * Strong experience with IT infrastructure construction project management and a solid understanding of data center operations. * ITIL certification. * IT Infrastructure, IT Architecture, or other relevant IT product certifications. * Utilize 5\+ years of experience in IT applications, tools, and technology to enhance operational efficiency. * Apply 3\+ years of agile methodology principles in IT infrastructure projects. * Demonstrate 2\+ years of experience in supplier/vendor management. * Implement 1\+ years of cloud technology experience, including infrastructure as\-a\-service (IaaS) and platform\-as\-a\-service (PaaS) solutions. * 6 Sigma / LEAN methodology. * 5S/6S methodology. **What we offer** This position is for a long term renewable contract with an excellent hourly rate including benefits including but not limited to medical, dental, vision, FSA and 401k along with paid holidays and vacation days. Please apply ONLY if you fulfill the above mentioned minimum requirements. Art der Stelle: Vollzeit Arbeitsort: Vor Ort

jobs.title: Leader, Business Analytics & Data Management
jobs.description: **Leader, Business Analytics and Data Managment Opportunity Summary** The Leader, Business Analytics \& Data Management owns W.W. Williams’ enterprise data and analytics function end to end: the data architecture and platform, the enterprise data warehouse and lakehouse, the business intelligence estate, data governance, and the delivery of operational and financial metrics to leaders across the company. This is a player\-coach role that blends hands\-on technical depth with executive\-level business partnership. You will serve as the primary analytics interface to Finance, the C\-suite, and business unit leaders, translating their questions into trusted, governed data products, and you will lead the migration of our reporting estate from Tableau and legacy sources to a unified Power BI and Microsoft Fabric platform. You will report to the Chief Information Officer and sit within the AI \& Transformation (AiT) team. **Key Responsibilities** **Data Platform \& Architecture** * Own the enterprise data architecture, including the Microsoft Fabric / OneLake lakehouse and warehouse, integration patterns, and data modeling standards (medallion and dimensional). * Design, build, and operate reliable pipelines from ERP/dealer management, CRM, HCM, telephony, e\-commerce, and telematics sources into governed, analytics\-ready datasets. * Manage platform capacity, performance, cost, security, and disaster recovery on Azure; set and meet data freshness and availability SLAs. * Establish engineering practices for the team: source control, CI/CD deployment pipelines, testing, documentation, and environment promotion. **Business Intelligence \& Analytics Products** * Set Power BI as the enterprise BI standard and lead the sunset and migration of Tableau and spreadsheet\-based reporting with minimal business disruption. * Build and maintain certified semantic models and enterprise datasets that give the company one definition for revenue, margin, technician utilization, parts fill rate, first\-time fix, DSO, and other core metrics. * Deliver executive reporting on a reliable cadence, including monthly operating reviews and KPI scorecards by branch, business unit, and region. * Run analytics as a product function: intake and prioritization, roadmap, adoption targets, and retirement of low\-value reports. * Enable self\-service analytics through training, office hours, templates, and a curated catalog of trusted content. **Business Partnership \& Performance Management** * Act as the primary analytics partner to the CFO and FP\&A, aligning data definitions with the close, forecast, and budgeting processes and supporting month\-end and board deliverables. * Partner with the CEO, COO, and business unit presidents to define the operational metrics that matter, instrument them, and drive accountability through visible, trusted data. * Translate strategic questions from leadership and our private equity sponsor into analyses, models, and dashboards; present findings clearly to technical and non\-technical audiences. * Support the transformation portfolio (system consolidation, customer 360, technician productivity, forecasting) with data models, KPIs, and benefit tracking. **Data Governance, Quality \& AI Readiness** * Stand up and lead a pragmatic data governance program: data ownership and stewardship, business glossary and metric definitions, lineage, access control, retention, and privacy. * Drive master data management for customers, vendors, parts, locations, and technicians across consolidated systems. * Implement data quality monitoring and remediation with measurable improvement targets. * Prepare the data foundation for AI and machine learning use cases in partnership with the AiT team, in line with the company’s AI Acceptable Use Policy and governance framework. **Leadership** * Build, lead, and develop a team of data engineers, BI developers, and analysts; manage vendor and contractor resources and the analytics budget. * Champion a data\-driven culture across the company and raise analytics literacy among leaders and front\-line teams. * Communicate roadmap, progress, risks, and value delivered to the CIO and executive leadership. **Qualifications** **Required** * Bachelor’s degree in Information Systems, Computer Science, Data Science, Finance, Business Analytics, Engineering, or a related field. * 7–10 years of progressive experience in data and analytics, including at least 3 years leading a team or function and owning an enterprise BI or data platform. * Expert\-level Power BI: semantic modeling, DAX, row\-level security, deployment pipelines, capacity management, and enterprise content governance. * Working proficiency in Tableau sufficient to support, assess, and migrate an existing estate. * Hands\-on experience with Microsoft Azure data services and Microsoft Fabric (or equivalent modern cloud data platforms such as Synapse, Databricks, or Snowflake), including lakehouse/warehouse design and pipeline orchestration. * Strong SQL and data modeling skills; experience with Python or PySpark for data engineering and analysis. * Demonstrated success partnering with Finance and executive leadership on KPI definition, management reporting, and performance analytics. * Experience establishing data governance, master data, and data quality practices in a multi\-system environment. * Excellent communication skills with the ability to present complex analysis to executives and to influence without direct authority. **Preferred** * MBA or master’s degree in Analytics, Finance, or a related discipline. * Microsoft certifications such as Fabric Analytics Engineer (DP\-600\), Fabric Data Engineer (DP\-700\), Power BI Data Analyst (PL\-300\), or Azure Data Engineer (DP\-203\). * Experience in distribution, dealer/service, industrial, transportation, or other multi\-branch operating businesses; familiarity with dealer management or ERP systems such as Karmak Fusion. * Experience in a private equity–backed company, including board and sponsor reporting and value\-creation tracking. * Exposure to Microsoft Purview, Azure OpenAI / AI Foundry, Copilot for Power BI, and machine learning workflows. * Experience leading a BI platform consolidation or migration (e.g., Tableau to Power BI). **Employee Rewards and Benefits** * 8 Paid Holidays \& 1 Paid Wellness Day * Paid Time Off * Employee Referral Bonus Program * Medical, Dental \& Vision Insurance * 401k with a Company Match * Company Paid Training * Growth \& Leadership Opportunities **About the Company** W.W. Williams was founded in Columbus, Ohio, in 1912\. Today The W.W. Williams Companies have a broad portfolio of businesses located throughout the U.S. and Mexico. The W.W. Williams Companies include CT Power and Guaranteed Truck Service. W.W. Williams offers a full range of industry\-leading products, while providing technical/mechanical service and repair, remanufacturing and warehouse/supply chain management solutions to a varied customer base. Our products and services include diesel engines, transmissions, heavy duty truck repair, transport refrigeration, power generation and third\-party supply chain logistics services. Our customers include on\-highway truck fleets, off\-highway equipment users, data centers, hospitals, Department of Defense OEMs, vehicle OEMs, U.S. Military and boat owners to name a few. What began as a small family\-owned business has evolved into one of the nation's most diversified solutions provider. We are relentlessly dedicated to helping our customers achieve maximum up time. From single trucking to cranes to fleet management to power generators to military and commercial packaging \- consider it done. We are Genuine. Honest. Passionate. That's not a slogan, it's a mantra. Everyone who wears the W.W. Williams name \- from service technicians to advisors to business executives \- is committed to getting the job done right, the first time around. Our people are our greatest assets; we support our team with access to world class training and development opportunities. It's this level of investment and care that matters to customers, giving you peace of mind that your fleet is in the right hands. W.W. Williams is one of the nation’s largest sales and service networks of industrial power products. With multiple locations across the US and Mexico, we are dedicated to providing highly professional service and strong relationships with our customers. Join us for a career where you'll grow both personally and professionally in a welcoming, diverse, and inclusive environment. Competitive wages and benefits. AAP/EPE/M/F/Vets/Disabled, DFWP.

jobs.title: Senior Project Manager
jobs.description: **About WPP Production** We are WPP Production \- the unified global production company that brings together all of WPP's content producers, studios and craft experts into one connected organisation. We combine world\-class human craft with next generation technology to originate, design, and deliver multi\-channel content systems at scale. Built for borderless collaboration and powered by deep craft expertise, we are the production engine designed for today's always on, AI driven marketing world. **About WPP** WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world's leading brands. We unite cutting\-edge media intelligence and data solutions, world\-class creativity, next\-generation production, transformative enterprise solutions and expert strategic counsel in a single company – powered by exceptional talent and our agentic marketing platform, WPP Open, to help our clients navigate change, capture opportunity and deliver transformational growth. For more information, visit WPP.com. **A Hybrid working model** *We believe the best work happens when we're together, fostering creativity, collaboration, and connection. That's why we've adopted a hybrid approach, with teams in the office around four days a week. If you require accommodations or flexibility, please discuss this with the hiring team during the interview process.* **What does a Senior Project Manager for Hex do at WPP Production?** As **Senior Project Manager for HEX**, you will be at the operational heart of HEX Studio. You will drive the scoping, delivery, and scaling of highly experimental, AI\-native production workflows, innovation workstreams, and commercial proofs\-of\-concept. To learn more about the Hex Studio: https://www.wpp.com/en/news/wpp\-launches\-hex\-creating\-a\-new\-kind\-of\-talent\-pipeline\-designed\-for\-the\-ai\-era. This role requires a rare blend of creative tech literacy, delivery discipline, and commercial acumen. You will act as the crucial translator between client/agency leadership and specialized technical teams (AI engineers, creative technologists, developers)—turning frontier tech ambitions into structured, high\-impact deliverables on time and on budget. **Key Responsibilities:** * AI \& Frontier Tech Delivery * + **End\-to\-End Delivery:** Lead the project lifecycle for complex AI and creative technology initiatives—spanning generative AI asset pipelines, agentic tools, spatial/interactive experiences, and rapid prototyping. + **Pipeline \& System Architecture Support:** Partner with technical leads to scope and build bespoke production workflows, ensuring fluid handoffs between traditional creative teams and AI\-enabled pipelines. + **Beta Tech \& Risk Management:** Proactively identify, evaluate, and manage technical, legal, and operational risks inherent to working with beta software, emerging AI models, IP boundaries, and fluid technical scopes. * Strategic Client \& Stakeholder Leadership * + **Forward\-Deployed Leadership:** Serve as a trusted delivery partner for forward\-deployed HEX teams, agency leads, and brand partners, articulating complex technical concepts into clear strategic choices and actionable milestones. + **Education \& Enablement:** Guide clients and agency stakeholders through the shift toward AI\-assisted workflows, building confidence in rapid iteration, experimentation, and iterative learning. * Financial \& Agile Governance * + **Financial Control:** Take end\-to\-end accountability for project budgets ($250K\+ individual budget size), managing resource allocation, burn rates, margin targets, and financial reconciliations with precision. + **Hybrid Agile Methodologies:** Adapt and apply Agile/Scrum frameworks tailored to creative technology R\&D—balancing sprint speed and rapid feedback loops with commercial deadlines. * Operational Scaling \& Knowledge Transfer * + **Best Practice Definition:** Establish standard operating procedures, pilot evaluation frameworks, and delivery playbooks for AI\-native production within HEX. + **Network Scaling:** Oversee post\-project documentation, capturing learnings from pilot programs and R\&D workstreams to scale successful AI workflows across WPP Production and the broader WPP agency network. **Core Competencies \& Skills** * **Technical Literacy:** Practical understanding of modern generative AI tools, diffusion models, LLMs, agentic workflows, and real\-time engines (e.g., Unreal Engine/Unity) applied to creative production. * **Scope \& Fluidity Management:** Proven ability to bring structure, clarity, and control to highly complex, fluid, and experimental tech scopes without stifling creative innovation. * **Commercial \& Financial Acumen:** Rigorous budget management skills, with a track record of running $250K\+ engagements profitably while managing complex resource models. * **Cross\-Disciplinary Translation:** Exceptional communication skills with the ability to bridge conversation between technologists, creative teams, client leaders, and legal/procurement teams. * **Adaptive Leadership:** Comfort with ambiguity, rapid technological shift, and pioneering new delivery models in a high\-growth studio environment. **Experience:** * **5\+ Years in Creative Tech / Digital Production:** Proven experience as a Project Manager or Producer in a creative agency, innovation lab, or creative tech studio. * **Hands\-On AI \& Innovation Track Record:** Demonstrated experience delivering complex technical projects involving AI integration, custom workflows, or interactive technology from initial concept through to final deployment. * **Multi\-Stakeholder Environments:** Track record of operating successfully across matrixed agency environments, client\-embedded teams, and third\-party tech partners. * **Agile Certification or Equivalent Practice:** Exposure to or practical experience with Agile, Scrum, or Kanban methodologies applied to creative technology. **Desirable Skills:** * Direct experience helping to define new commercial or operational models for creative production. * Experience building or managing production pipelines as the primary project deliverable. * Active personal engagement and ongoing experimentation with emerging AI models, tools, and developer platforms. \#LI\-hybrid \#LI\-RS1 **Why work here:** At WPP Production, you'll help shape the future of content production at a truly global scale. We bring together world\-class talent, cutting\-edge studios, and advanced technology to solve some of the most complex creative and production challenges in the industry. You'll work in a collaborative, borderless environment where craft excellence is valued, innovation is encouraged, and AI and next\-generation tools are used to amplify not replace human creativity. With access to diverse projects, global career opportunities, and the backing of WPP's unmatched network, this is a place where you can grow your skills, make real impact, and create work that performs for every audience, across every channel, at every moment. **Inclusion and Impact** WPP is an equal opportunity employer and considers applicants for all positions without discrimination or regard to particular characteristics. We are committed to fostering a culture of respect in which everyone feels they belong and has the same opportunities to progress in their careers. **Data** We rely on legitimate interest as a legal basis for processing personal information under the GDPR for purposes of recruitment and applications for employment. When you click the "Submit Application" button at the bottom of this page, this will send all the information you have added to WPP Production. Before you do this, we think it's a good idea to read through our Privacy statement. This explains what we do with your personal data when you apply for a role with us, and, how you can update the information you have provided us with or how to remove it. **Please contact** **careers@wppproduction.com** **if you need the job advert or form in another format.**

jobs.title: Senior Systems Engineer
jobs.description: **Job Description** **Who will you be working with?** Wabtec's Train Handling solutions include **Trip Optimizer®** and **Locotrol®,** which work together to optimize train performance and automate freight operations. Trip Optimizer creates and executes fuel\-efficient operating plans that meet schedule and train\-handling requirements, while Locotrol enables coordinated control of distributed locomotives throughout the train. Together, these technologies improve train handling, fuel efficiency, operational safety, and the ability to operate longer and heavier trains. As a **Senior Systems Engineer**, you will serve as a technical leader across engineering, product management, program leadership, and customer organizations, influencing the future direction of train automation and optimization technologies across the rail industry. **How will you make a difference?** As a **Senior Systems Engineer**, you will provide technical leadership for the architecture, strategy, development, and deployment of Wabtec's Train Handling portfolio. You will drive complex system design decisions, guide technology roadmaps, lead cross\-functional initiatives, and ensure solutions meet customer, business, safety, and regulatory requirements. The successful candidate will bring an AI\-native mindset and champion the adoption of AI\-enabled engineering practices across the organization. You will identify and mature opportunities for intelligent automation, advanced analytics, optimization, and next\-generation autonomous train operations. As a recognized technical authority, you will establish engineering standards, mentor other engineers, and help shape the strategic application of AI to create differentiated products and measurable customer value. **What do we want to know about you?** * Bachelor’s Degree in Engineering, Mathematics or Computer Science from an accredited college or university * Minimum of 10 years’ hands\-on design, requirements development and implementation experience involving; Engineering Systems, Hardware / Software Engineering, and/or Data Information Systems * Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills * Strong oral and written communication skills * Ability to work in a cross\-functional, global environment * Willingness and ability to travel domestically and internationally **What will your typical day look like?** * Provide technical leadership for the architecture, strategy, and evolution of Wabtec's Train Handling solutions, ensuring alignment with product roadmaps, customer needs, and business objectives. * Lead the development of complex system architectures, requirements, and design solutions that balance performance, safety, reliability, maintainability, and operational efficiency. * Serve as the technical authority for major programs and initiatives, driving engineering decisions across the product lifecycle from concept development through deployment and sustainment. * Partner with Product Management, Software Engineering, Train Control, Office Systems, Safety, Validation, and Applications Engineering teams to define technical direction and successfully execute strategic product initiatives. * Lead technical reviews, design reviews, trade studies, and system\-level verification and validation activities to ensure robust, high\-quality solutions. * Drive resolution of complex system and product issues, utilizing data\-driven analysis, root cause investigations, and cross\-functional problem\-solving methodologies. * Collaborate directly with railroad executives, customers, industry stakeholders, and subject matter experts to understand operational challenges, influence product strategy, and develop innovative solutions. * Guide field testing, operational demonstrations, and customer deployments to validate performance and ensure successful adoption of new capabilities. * Identify, evaluate, and champion emerging technologies, advanced automation concepts, and next\-generation train handling capabilities that improve customer value and competitive differentiation. * Establish engineering standards, best practices, and technical processes while mentoring and developing systems engineers across the organization. * Promote an AI\-native engineering culture by driving the adoption of AI\-enabled tools, advanced analytics, and intelligent automation throughout the product development lifecycle to improve engineering efficiency, product quality, and business outcomes. **Preferred Qualifications** * Extensive experience applying systems engineering principles across the full product lifecycle, including concept development, architecture, requirements management, system integration, verification, validation, deployment, and sustainment. * Demonstrated success leading the technical development of complex, multi\-disciplinary systems involving software, controls, automation, embedded systems, communications, or safety\-critical applications. * Deep knowledge of systems architecture, requirements decomposition, interface management, risk management, and system integration methodologies. * Proven ability to influence product strategy, technology roadmaps, and engineering direction across multiple teams and programs. * Strong leadership, communication, and stakeholder management skills with the ability to effectively engage customers, executives, and cross\-functional teams. * Experience mentoring engineers and driving technical excellence through coaching, knowledge sharing, and engineering process improvements. * Demonstrated ability to evaluate and apply AI\-enabled technologies, advanced analytics, optimization techniques, and data\-driven decision\-making to solve complex engineering and operational challenges. * Expertise in railroad operations, train control systems, distributed systems, automation technologies, or other transportation and safety\-critical industries is highly desired. * Working knowledge of AAR, CENELEC, FRA, and other applicable industry standards, regulations, and safety practices. Relocation assistance may be provided if eligibility requirements are met. Wabtec will only employ those who are legally authorized to work in the U.S. for this opening. Any offer of employment is conditioned upon the successful completion of a drug screen (as applicable) and fitness for duty test (as applicable). \#LI\-AM1 **Additional Information** Our job titles may span more than one career level. The salary rate for this role is currently $104800\-149300 The actual salary offered to a candidate may be influenced by a variety of factors, such as: training, transferable skills, work experience, education, business needs, market demands and work location. The base pay range is subject to change and may be modified in the future. More information on offered benefits, which include health, welfare, and retirement, are available at mywabtecbenefits.com. Other benefit offerings for this role may include annual bonus, if eligible. **What could you accomplish in a place that puts People First?** At Wabtec, it’s not just about a job \- it’s about the impact you make. When our people come together, we’re Expanding the Possible by continuously improving what we do and how we do it \- for our clients and each other. If you’re ready to revolutionize how the world moves for future generations, Wabtec is the place for you. **Who are we?** Wabtec is a leading global provider of equipment, systems, digital solutions, and value\-added services for the freight and transit rail sectors. Drawing on more than 150 years of experience, we are leading the way in safety, efficiency, reliability, innovation, and productivity. Whether it’s freight, transit, ports, logistics, mining, industrial, or marine, our expertise, technologies, and people together – are accelerating the future of transportation. With roots that date back to George Westinghouse, Thomas Edison, and Louis Faiveley, Wabtec has always built technologies and implemented solutions for a variety of sectors that are critical to meeting the needs of customers and governments alike. Our global team of about 30,000 employees worldwide delivers performance that moves the world forward. We’re lifelong learners, obsessed with better. Learn more at www.WabtecCorp.com. **Culture powers us and the possibilities.** We believe the best ideas come from a mix of experiences and backgrounds. At Wabtec, we strive every day to create a place where everyone belongs. We’re building a culture where leadership, inclusion and your unique perspective fuel progress. We’re proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We welcome talent of all backgrounds, experiences, and identities, including race, gender, age, disability, veteran status and more. Need accommodation? Just let us know \- we’ve got you.

jobs.title: Systems Engineer II
jobs.description: **Job Description** **Who will you be working with?** Wabtec's Train Handling solutions include **Trip Optimizer®** and **Locotrol®**, which work together to optimize train performance and automate freight operations. Trip Optimizer creates and executes fuel\-efficient operating plans that meet schedule and train\-handling requirements, while Locotrol enables coordinated control of distributed locomotives throughout the train. Together, these technologies improve train handling, fuel efficiency, operational safety, and the ability to operate longer and heavier trains. As a **Systems Engineer**, you will work closely with engineering teams, product management, and railroad customers to support the development of innovative solutions that advance automation within the rail industry. **How will you make a difference?** As a **Systems Engineer**, you will support the design, development, testing, and deployment of Wabtec's Train Handling portfolio. Working under the guidance of experienced engineers, you will contribute to requirements development, system analysis, verification activities, and product enhancements while adhering to established engineering processes and standards. The successful candidate will demonstrate an AI\-enabled mindset, leveraging AI tools to improve research, problem\-solving, productivity, and technical decision\-making.
