jobs.title: Principal Software Development Engineer (Control-Plane)
jobs.description: Zscaler (NASDAQ: ZS) accelerates digital transformation so customers can be more agile, efficient, resilient, and secure. The Zscaler Zero Trust Exchange™️ platform protects thousands of customers from cyberattacks and data loss by securely connecting users, devices, and applications in any location. Distributed across 160\+ public exchanges globally and thousands of private exchanges at the edge, the SASE\-based Zero Trust Exchange is the world's largest in\-line cloud security platform. We believe the future of work is Human \+ AI and are building an AI\-native enterprise where human potential is amplified by machine intelligence to solve the world's hardest security challenges. Driven by deep customer obsession, we are committed to the mission, outcome, and to each other. We bring these commitments to life through three core behaviors: ownership and collaboration, trust through outcomes and impact, and a challenge culture with ongoing feedback. Ready to make an impact at the company pioneering security transformation in the AI era? Join us at Zscaler. **Role** We are looking for a Principal Software Development Engineer (Control\-Plane) to join our Engineering team. This is a hybrid (in Santa Clara, CA office minimum 3 days per week) role, reporting to the Director, Software Development Engineering. We are expanding our existing control path and looking for a software engineer to help drive the development of new features and enhanced functionality. You will play a pivotal role in evolving our architecture to ensure it meets the demands of our growing user base. **What you'll do (Role Expectations)** * Define software design specifications and implement bug\-free code using test\-driven methodology and modern AI\-based coding tools * Design, develop, and optimize the system, including networking and security features, to support high\-performance applications while performing unit testing and automation to ensure quality * Apply strong software design principles and deep troubleshooting expertise to deliver scalable, resilient, and impactful improvements to Zscaler's Zero Trust Security Services * Work directly with Engineering Architects, Product Managers, Customers, and Solution Architects to understand customer use cases, review PRDs, and collaborate with cross\-functional teams to identify and resolve system\-related issues * Coach and mentor junior team members and ensure highest level of quality deliverables **Who You Are (Success Profile)** * You thrive in ambiguity. You're comfortable building the path as you walk it. You thrive in a dynamic environment, seeing ambiguity not as a hindrance, but as the raw material to build something meaningful. * You act like an owner. Your passion for the mission fuels your bias for action. You operate with integrity because you genuinely care about the outcome. You adapt to what's needed, navigating seamlessly between high\-level strategy and hands\-on execution. * You are a problem\-solver. You seek out challenges because you are energized by finding solutions, knowing that solving the hard problems delivers the biggest impact. * You are a high\-trust collaborator. You are ambitious for the team, not just yourself. You embrace our challenge culture by giving and receiving ongoing feedback—knowing that candor delivered with clarity and respect is the truest form of teamwork and the fastest way to earn trust. * You are a learner. You have a true growth mindset and never stop developing yourself, actively seeking feedback to become a better partner and a stronger teammate. You love what you do and you do it with purpose. **What We're Looking for (Minimum Qualifications)** * 12\+ years of experience designing and building large\-scale, highly reliable, and scalable software systems, preferably in Python and/or Go * Strong hands\-on experience with public cloud infrastructure across AWS, GCP, and Azure * Deep understanding of cloud networking concepts and services, including Transit Gateway, Internet Gateway, NAT Gateway, NACLs, security groups, GWLB, ILB, Route 53, and Azure DNS * Foundational knowledge of AI/ML technologies, with experience applying, securing, or positioning AI\-driven solutions to improve outcomes within the functional domain * Strong software design, profiling, and verification skills, with exposure to optimizing systems for scale and performance **What Will Make You Stand Out (Preferred Qualifications)** * Strong experience designing and building distributed systems and SaaS platforms, with a proven ability to develop highly available, resilient, and scalable services in production environments * Deep understanding of firewalls, network security principles, and core networking protocols, with the ability to troubleshoot complex traffic flows and enforce secure, high\-performance connectivity * Hands\-on familiarity with architecting and building Firewall\-as\-a\-Service solutions on major cloud platforms, including AWS, GCP, and Azure, with an understanding of cloud\-native networking and security services across each environment \#LI\-Hybrid \#LI\-KM9 At Zscaler, we are committed to building a team that reflects the communities we serve and the customers we work with. We foster an inclusive environment that values all backgrounds and perspectives, emphasizing collaboration and belonging. Join us in our mission to make doing business seamless and secure. Our Benefits program is one of the most important ways we support our employees. Zscaler proudly offers comprehensive and inclusive benefits to meet the diverse needs of our employees and their families throughout their life stages, including: * Various health plans * Time off plans for vacation and sick time * Parental leave options * Retirement options * Education reimbursement * In\-office perks, and more! Learn more about Zscaler's hybrid working model and benefits here. By applying for this role, you adhere to applicable laws, regulations, and Zscaler policies, including those related to security and privacy standards and guidelines. Zscaler is committed to providing equal employment opportunities to all individuals. We strive to create a workplace where employees are treated with respect and have the chance to succeed. All qualified applicants will be considered for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy or related medical conditions), age, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, genetic information, disability status, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local laws. *See more information by clicking on the* *Know Your Rights: Workplace Discrimination is Illegal* *link.* Pay Transparency Zscaler complies with all applicable federal, state, and local pay transparency rules. Zscaler is committed to providing reasonable support (called accommodations or adjustments) in our recruiting processes for candidates who are differently abled, have long term conditions, mental health conditions or sincerely held religious beliefs, or who are neurodivergent or require pregnancy\-related support.

jobs.title: Manager, Product Management - AI Concierge, Service Experience
jobs.description: Join us as we work to create a thriving ecosystem that delivers accessible, high\-quality, and sustainable healthcare for all. **Position Summary** You will own the product direction for the AI Concierge, the front door to the AI agents and experiences that support our Customer Success organization. You will be responsible for the experience a practice has when they come to us for help getting onboarded, going live, and getting the most out of athenaOne, deciding what the Concierge handles on its own, what it routes to another agent, and when a person should step in. You will work closely with engineering and architecture to understand how these systems behave, where they connect, how they must evolve, and you will turn that understanding into requirements teams can build against. Staying close to customers is essential. You will engage with them often, put working solutions in their hands early, and iterate quickly on what you learn. This role reports to the Director of Product Management, Service Experience, and is a hybrid role based in Boston, MA. **About the Team** athenahealth operates one of the largest connected networks in healthcare, working with more than 160,000 providers and 117 million patients. Our mission is to create a thriving ecosystem that delivers accessible, high\-quality, and sustainable healthcare for all. The Service Experience zone is a new product development team, and its job is the AI enablement of the Customer Success journey: the part of the mission customers feel most directly when they are getting onboarded, getting trained, going live, and getting help optimizing their use of athenaOne. The AI Concierge is where that comes together. From the moment a customer joins the athena network, the Concierge understands what they need and either handles it, routes it to the right AI agent, or brings in a person. Getting that right is a hard product problem and a new one, and this role owns it. You will shape what a delightful, AI\-enabled customer experience looks like for everyone who joins us. You will not be starting from a blank page. Our first version is already built, and part of the job early on is understanding what's been built, shaping the vision for where it goes, and putting improvements in customers' hands. You will work alongside Experience Design and engineering partners, and you will be uniquely chartered with owning product direction and making quick decisions. **Essential Job Responsibilities** * Own the product direction for the AI Concierge and the agentic onboarding experiences behind it, in partnership with the Director of Product Management. * Define what the Concierge handles on its own, what it routes to another agent, and when it brings in a person, and design the handoff so the customer is not repeating themselves. * Decide what the Concierge needs to know and remember about a customer to be useful, and what context travels with a request when it moves to another agent or to a person. * Define how the Concierge behaves when it is unsure or wrong, covering when it should decline to answer, how it stays grounded in verified information, and how a customer recovers from a bad answer without losing trust. * Stay close to customers, getting in front of them regularly to understand their experience firsthand, putting working solutions in their hands early, and iterating quickly on what you learn. * Partner with the Experience Design team on customer research, using it to find unmet needs and to test whether what we built actually works before we scale it. * Develop a deep understanding of onboarding and go\-live workflows, system interactions, integration points, and operational dependencies across athenaOne and our enterprise platforms. * Partner with engineering and architecture to define problems, weigh solution options, identify constraints, and guide scope and sequencing. * Turn customer, operational, regulatory, and business needs into clear requirements, acceptance criteria, and measurable outcomes. * Establish how we measure whether the Concierge is working, covering task success, answer quality, handoff rates, and cost, and use that evidence to decide what to fix and what to expand. * Prioritize work based on customer impact, technical feasibility, effort, risk, and business value. * Coordinate dependencies across teams and keep delivery risks, technical decisions, and release readiness visible. * Use AI tools to accelerate research, analysis, documentation, and planning, applying your own judgment to validate what they produce. **Additional Job Responsibilities** * Support iterative delivery through discovery, backlog refinement, sprint planning, and ongoing clarification. * Communicate product recommendations, tradeoffs, sequencing rationale, and release status to technical and nontechnical jobs.description: **Full job description** We are seeking an experienced Firmware/Embedded Software Engineer to participate in the design and development of firmware used in electronic instrumentation products.
